====/File: react/AIInlineMenu.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface AIAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options?: string[];
}

export interface AIInlineMenuProps {
  actions?: AIAction[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  tone?: "neutral" | "brand";
  onAction?: (id: string, option?: string) => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SPARKLE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M10 2.5l1.4 4.1L15.5 8l-4.1 1.4L10 13.5 8.6 9.4 4.5 8l4.1-1.4L10 2.5Z" />
    <path d="M15.8 12.6l.7 2 2 .7-2 .7-.7 2-.7-2-2-.7 2-.7.7-2Z" opacity="0.7" />
  </svg>
);

const CARET_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m6 8 4 4 4-4" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const CLOSE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * AIInlineMenu - selection-anchored floating AI action pill with badge chip, dropdown actions and loading state.
 */
export default function AIInlineMenu({
  actions = [
    { id: "edit", label: "Edit" },
    { id: "tone", label: "Change tone", options: ["Professional", "Friendly", "Concise"] },
  ],
  loading = false,
  error,
  tone = "neutral",
  onAction,
  onDismiss,
  className = "",
}: AIInlineMenuProps) {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastRun, setLastRun] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const run = (action: AIAction, option?: string) => {
    if (loading) return;
    setOpenId(null);
    setLastRun(`${action.id}${option ? `:${option}` : ""}`);
    onAction?.(action.id, option);
  };

  const brand = tone === "brand";

  return (
    <div
      data-ai-inline-menu
      className={`inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full border bg-white py-1 pl-1.5 pr-1 shadow-lg dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
        error ? "border-red-300 dark:border-red-900" : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700"
      } ${className}`}
    >
      <span
        className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
          brand
            ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
            : "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
        }`}
      >
        <span className={loading ? "animate-pulse" : ""}>{SPARKLE_SVG}</span>
        AI
      </span>
      <span className="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
      {actions.map((action) => (
        <div key={action.id} className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-ai-action={action.id}
            disabled={loading}
            onClick={() => {
              if (action.options?.length) setOpenId(openId === action.id ? null : action.id);
              else run(action);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60"
          >
            {action.label}
            {action.options?.length ? CARET_SVG : null}
          </button>
          {openId === action.id ? (
            <div data-ai-menu className="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-10 mb-1 w-40 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              {action.options!.map((option) => (
                <button
                  key={option}
                  type="button"
                  data-ai-option={option}
                  onClick={() => run(action, option)}
                  className="block w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-zinc-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:hover:text-indigo-300"
                >
                  {option}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ))}
      {lastRun && !loading && !error ? (
        <span data-ai-status className="max-w-[160px] truncate px-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400" title={lastRun}>
          {lastRun}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {loading ? <span data-ai-loading className="px-1 text-[10px] text-indigo-500">Working…</span> : null}
      {error ? <span data-ai-error className="px-1 text-[10px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</span> : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-ai-dismiss
        title="Dismiss"
        onClick={() => {
          setOpenId(null);
          onDismiss?.();
        }}
        className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      >
        {CLOSE_SVG}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/Accordion.tsx/====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  content: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

export interface AccordionProps {
  items: AccordionItem[];
  /** Allow several panels open at once. Defaults to false (single-open). */
  allowMultiple?: boolean;
  defaultOpenIds?: string[];
  onToggle?: (id: string, open: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const Accordion: React.FC<AccordionProps> = ({
  items,
  allowMultiple = false,
  defaultOpenIds,
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [openIds, setOpenIds] = useState<string[]>(
    defaultOpenIds ?? items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id)
  );

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    const isOpen = openIds.includes(id);
    const next = isOpen
      ? openIds.filter((entry) => entry !== id)
      : allowMultiple
        ? [...openIds, id]
        : [id];
    setOpenIds(next);
    onToggle?.(id, !isOpen);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {items.map((item) => {
        const open = openIds.includes(item.id);
        return (
          <div key={item.id}>
            <h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                id={`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`}
                aria-expanded={open}
                aria-controls={`accordion-panel-${item.id}`}
                onClick={() => toggle(item.id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
              >
                {item.icon && (
                  <span className="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
                    <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={14} />
                  </span>
                )}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    {item.title}
                  </span>
                  {item.description && (
                    <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {item.description}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                    open ? "rotate-180" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
                </span>
              </button>
            </h3>
            {open && (
              <div
                id={`accordion-panel-${item.id}`}
                role="region"
                aria-labelledby={`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`}
                className="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"
              >
                {item.content}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Accordion;

====/File: react/AccountSwitcher.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface Account {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  /** Avatar image URL; falls back to initials. */
  avatar?: string;
  role?: string;
  plan?: string;
}

export interface AccountSwitcherProps {
  accounts?: Account[];
  currentId?: string;
  onSwitch?: (account: Account) => void;
  onAddAccount?: () => void;
  onSignOut?: () => void;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const AccountSwitcher: React.FC<AccountSwitcherProps> = ({
  accounts = [],
  currentId,
  onSwitch,
  onAddAccount,
  onSignOut,
  onOpenChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const current = accounts.find((account) => account.id === currentId) || accounts[0];

  const setOpenState = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    onOpenChange?.(next);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenState(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenState(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open]);

  if (!current) return null;

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`relative inline-block text-left ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpenState(!open)}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      >
        <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {current.avatar ? (
            <img src={current.avatar} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            initials(current.name)
          )}
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{current.name}</span>
          {current.email && (
            <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{current.email}</span>
          )}
        </span>
        <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={12} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          aria-label="Switch account"
          className="absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        >
          <ul className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">
            {accounts.map((account) => {
              const active = account.id === current.id;
              return (
                <li key={account.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitemradio"
                    aria-checked={active}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSwitch?.(account);
                      setOpenState(false);
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                  >
                    <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                      {account.avatar ? (
                        <img src={account.avatar} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        initials(account.name)
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {account.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                        {[account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || account.email}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    {active && <UiIcon name="check" size={12} className="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />}
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>

          <div className="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {onAddAccount && (
              <button
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  onAddAccount();
                  setOpenState(false);
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <UiIcon name="plus" size={12} className="text-zinc-400" />
                Add account
              </button>
            )}
            {onSignOut && (
              <button
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  onSignOut();
                  setOpenState(false);
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30"
              >
                <UiIcon name="arrow-right" size={12} />
                Sign out
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AccountSwitcher;

====/File: react/ActivityFeed.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type ActivityFeedKind = "event" | "comment" | "merge" | "deploy" | "flag" | "alert";

export interface ActivityEntry {
  id: string;
  kind: ActivityFeedKind;
  actor: string;
  action: string;
  target?: string;
  time: string;
  detail?: string;
}

export interface ActivityFeedProps {
  entries: ActivityEntry[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const KIND: Record<ActivityFeedKind, { icon: UiIconName; iconClass: string }> = {
  event: { icon: "sparkles", iconClass: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300" },
  comment: { icon: "user", iconClass: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-600 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300" },
  merge: { icon: "git-branch", iconClass: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" },
  deploy: { icon: "zap", iconClass: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300" },
  flag: { icon: "star", iconClass: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300" },
  alert: { icon: "alert-triangle", iconClass: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300" },
};

export const ActivityFeed: React.FC<ActivityFeedProps> = ({ entries, title, className = "" }) => {
  return (
    <section className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {title && (
        <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</h3>
      )}
      <ol className="relative space-y-3.5 before:absolute before:bottom-2 before:left-[13px] before:top-2 before:w-px before:bg-zinc-100 dark:before:bg-zinc-800">
        {entries.map((entry) => {
          const kind = KIND[entry.kind] ?? KIND.event;
          return (
            <li key={entry.id} className="relative flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className={`z-10 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${kind.iconClass}`}>
                <UiIcon name={kind.icon} size={12} />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{entry.actor}</span>{" "}
                  {entry.action}
                  {entry.target && (
                    <span className="ml-1 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      {entry.target}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </p>
                {entry.detail && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{entry.detail}</p>
                )}
              </div>
              <time className="shrink-0 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{entry.time}</time>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
};

export default ActivityFeed;

====/File: react/AddonPicker.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface AddonOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  price?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  contactInstead?: boolean;
}

export interface AddonPickerProps {
  title?: string;
  options: AddonOption[];
  selectedIds?: string[];
  onChange?: (selectedIds: string[]) => void;
  totalLabel?: string;
  totalText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const CHECK_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * AddonPicker - User Interviews/Attio style add-on selector: checkbox rows with
 * price (or "Let's talk" contact link) and a running total row.
 */
export default function AddonPicker({
  title = "Add-ons",
  options,
  selectedIds = [],
  onChange,
  totalLabel = "Estimated total",
  totalText,
  className = "",
}: AddonPickerProps) {
  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    const next = selectedIds.includes(id) ? selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...selectedIds, id];
    onChange?.(next);
  };
  return (
    <div data-addon-picker className={`rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {options.map((option) => {
          const checked = selectedIds.includes(option.id);
          return (
            <label
              key={option.id}
              data-addon-row={option.id}
              className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors ${
                checked
                  ? "border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/50"
                  : "border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
              } ${option.disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : ""}`}
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span
                  data-addon-check
                  aria-checked={checked}
                  role="checkbox"
                  className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${
                    checked
                      ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                      : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-transparent dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {CHECK_SVG}
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{option.label}</span>
              </span>
              {option.contactInstead ? (
                <a href="#" data-addon-contact className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Let's talk</a>
              ) : (
                <span data-addon-price className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{option.price}</span>
              )}
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="sr-only"
                checked={checked}
                disabled={option.disabled}
                onChange={() => !option.disabled && toggle(option.id)}
              />
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {totalText && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-sm dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{totalLabel}</span>
          <span data-addon-total className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{totalText}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/AgentBuilderCard.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface AgentBuilderNode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  type: "trigger" | "tool" | "llm" | "output";
  status?: "idle" | "active" | "done" | "error";
}

export interface AgentBuilderCardProps {
  title?: string;
  agentName?: string;
  nodes: AgentBuilderNode[];
  runText?: string;
  running?: boolean;
  onRun?: () => void;
  onEdit?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const NODE_STYLE: Record<string, { icon: string; chip: string }> = {
  trigger: { icon: "⚡", chip: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300" },
  tool: { icon: "🔧", chip: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300" },
  llm: { icon: "🧠", chip: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300" },
  output: { icon: "📤", chip: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" },
};

const STATUS_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  idle: "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600",
  active: "bg-indigo-500 animate-pulse",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-red-500",
};

/**
 * AgentBuilderCard - Agent workflow summary card: name, vertical node chain
 * (trigger → tool → llm → output) with status dots and a Run / Running CTA.
 */
export default function AgentBuilderCard({
  title = "Agent workflow",

====/File: react/AgentRunLog.tsx/====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type AgentRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";

export interface AgentRunStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: AgentRunStatus;
  detail?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface AgentRunLogProps {
  steps: AgentRunStep[];
  title?: string;
  autoExpandRunning?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const statusIcon = (status: AgentRunStatus) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "running":
      return <UiIcon name="loader" size={14} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />;
    case "done":
      return <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={14} className="text-emerald-500" />;
    case "error":
      return <UiIcon name="circle-x" size={14} className="text-red-500" />;
    default:
      return <UiIcon name="clock" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />;
  }
};

const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => {
  if (typeof ms !== "number") return "";
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};

export const AgentRunLog: React.FC<AgentRunLogProps> = ({
  steps,
  title = "Execution log",
  autoExpandRunning = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Set<string>>(
    () => new Set(autoExpandRunning ? steps.filter((s) => s.status === "running" && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : [])
  );

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setExpanded((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
        <UiIcon name="terminal" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {steps.filter((s) => s.status === "done").length}/{steps.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <ol className="px-4 py-3">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
          const isOpen = expanded.has(step.id);
          return (
            <li key={step.id} className="relative pl-6">
              {!isLast && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                />
              )}
              <span className="absolute left-0 top-1">{statusIcon(step.status)}</span>

              <div className="pb-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => step.detail && toggle(step.id)}
                  aria-expanded={step.detail ? isOpen : undefined}
                  className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left ${
                    step.detail ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-default"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    className={`text-xs ${
                      step.status === "pending"
                        ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                        : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {step.label}
                  </span>
                  {step.durationMs !== undefined && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                      {formatDuration(step.durationMs)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {step.detail && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                      <UiIcon name={isOpen ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"} size={12} />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                {step.detail && isOpen && (
                  <pre className="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">
                    {step.detail}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AgentRunLog;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";
  duration?: string;
}

export interface AgentStepTimelineProps {
  steps: AgentStep[];
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_META: Record<AgentStep["status"], { icon: UiIconName; cls: string; pulse?: boolean }> = {
  pending: { icon: "clock", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" },
  running: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60", pulse: true },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", cls: "text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60" },
};

export const AgentStepTimeline: React.FC<AgentStepTimelineProps> = ({ steps = [], className = "" }) => {
  if (steps.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <ol className={`relative space-y-4 ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, i) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[step.status] || STATUS_META.pending;
        const isLast = i === steps.length - 1;
        return (
          <li key={step.id} className="relative flex gap-3">
            {!isLast && (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px ${
                  step.status === "done" ? "bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                }`}
              />
            )}
            <span className={`relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 ${meta.cls}`}>
              <UiIcon name={meta.icon} size={15} className={meta.pulse ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
            </span>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  className={`text-sm font-medium ${
                    meta === STATUS_META.pending ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {step.title}
                </span>
                {step.duration && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{step.duration}</span>}
              </div>
              {step.description && (
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{step.description}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
};
export default AgentStepTimeline;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AgentTaskItem {
  id: string | number;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "active" | "done";
}

export interface AgentTaskChecklistProps {
  items: AgentTaskItem[];
  title?: string;
  onToggle?: (id: string | number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_ICON: Record<AgentTaskItem["status"], { icon: UiIconName; cls: string }> = {
  pending: { icon: "square", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" },
  active: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 animate-spin" },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500" },
};

export const AgentTaskChecklist: React.FC<AgentTaskChecklistProps> = ({
  items = [],
  title = "Tasks",
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const doneCount = items.filter((i) => i.status === "done").length;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        <UiIcon name="layers" size={14} className="text-zinc-400" />
        {title}
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">
          {doneCount}/{items.length}
        </span>
      </div>
      <ul className="p-1.5 space-y-0.5">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const meta = STATUS_ICON[item.status] || STATUS_ICON.pending;
          const isDone = item.status === "done";
          return (
            <li key={item.id}>
              <div
                role={onToggle ? "button" : undefined}
                tabIndex={onToggle ? 0 : undefined}
                onClick={onToggle ? () => onToggle(item.id) : undefined}
                onKeyDown={
                  onToggle
                    ? (e) => {
                        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          onToggle(item.id);
                        }
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
                className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors ${
                  onToggle ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""
                } ${isDone ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"}`}
              >
                <UiIcon name={meta.icon} size={15} className={`shrink-0 ${meta.cls}`} />
                <span className={`flex-1 min-w-0 truncate ${isDone ? "line-through" : ""}`}>{item.label}</span>
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
};
export default AgentTaskChecklist;

export interface ProgressStep {

  state: "done" | "active" | "pending";
  substeps?: string[];
}

export interface AgentTaskProgressProps {
  title?: string;
  contextLabel?: string;
  contextText?: string;
  hint?: string;

  onNext?: () => void;
}

/**
 * AgentTaskProgress - long-running AI job card with stacked step states and substep rail.
 */
export default function AgentTaskProgress({
  title,
  contextLabel,
  contextText,
  hint = "This may take a few minutes, you can come back later.",
  steps = [],
  refineLabel = "Refine",
  nextLabel = "Next",
  feedbackLabel = "Send feedback",
  onRefine,
  onNext,
}: AgentTaskProgressProps) {
  const stepIcon = (state: ProgressStep["state"]) => {
    if (state === "done")
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          <path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" />
        </svg>
      );

      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 animate-spin text-indigo-500">
          <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" />
        </svg>
      );
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
        <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
      </svg>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div data-agent-task-progress className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {title ? <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p> : null}
      {contextText ? (
        <div className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-zinc-800">

        </div>
      ) : null}
      {hint ? <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{hint}</p> : null}

        {steps.map((step, index) => (

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {stepIcon(step.state)}
              {step.label}
            </div>

              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 border-l-2 border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700" data-task-substeps>
                {step.substeps.map((substep) => (
                  <li key={substep} className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {substep}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

          {feedbackLabel}
        </a>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                type="button"
                data-research-run
                onClick={() => onRun?.(t)}
                className="mt-2.5 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                Try it
              </button>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
      <footer className="border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-ai-research-custom
          onClick={() => onRunCustom?.()}
          className="w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300"

import React from "react";

export interface AiTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category?: string;
}

export interface AiTemplatePickerProps {
  open?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  categories?: { id: string; label: string; count: number }[];
  templates: AiTemplate[];
  activeCategory?: string;
  onCategoryChange?: (categoryId: string) => void;
  onTry?: (template: AiTemplate) => void;
  onRunCustom?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * AiTemplatePicker - Apollo style AI research templates modal: category rail
 * with counts, template cards each with a Try it CTA, and a Run custom AI
 * prompt footer action.
 */
export default function AiTemplatePicker({
  open = true,
  title = "AI Research templates",
  categories,
  templates,
  activeCategory,
  onCategoryChange,
  onTry,
  onRunCustom,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}: AiTemplatePickerProps) {
  if (!open) return null;
  const active = activeCategory ?? categories?.[0]?.id;
  const visible = active
    ? templates.filter((t) => !t.category || t.category === active)
    : templates;
  return (
    <div
      data-ai-template-picker
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className={`w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h3>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-ai-templates-close
          aria-label="Close"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300"
        >
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex max-h-[26rem]">
        {categories && categories.length > 0 && (
          <div data-ai-templates-rail className="w-52 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto border-r border-zinc-200 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                type="button"
                data-ai-templates-category={cat.id}
                onClick={() => onCategoryChange?.(cat.id)}
                className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                  cat.id === active
                    ? "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
                    : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{cat.label}</span>
                <span
                  className={`ml-2 shrink-0 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                    cat.id === active
                      ? "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-900/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
                      : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat.count}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3">
          {visible.length === 0 ? (
            <p data-ai-templates-empty className="px-2 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              No templates in this category yet.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div data-ai-templates-grid className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {visible.map((tpl) => (
                <div
                  key={tpl.id}
                  data-ai-template-card={tpl.id}
                  className="flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700"
                >
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{tpl.name}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 flex-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {tpl.description}
                  </p>

                    type="button"
                    data-ai-template-try
                    onClick={() => onTry?.(tpl)}
                    className="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                  >
                    Try it

            </div>

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type AlertBannerTone = "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger";

export interface AlertBannerProps {
  tone?: AlertBannerTone;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionText?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE: Record<
  AlertBannerTone,
  {
    icon: UiIconName;
    iconClass: string;
    wrapClass: string;
    titleClass: string;
    bodyClass: string;
    actionClass: string;
    dismissClass: string;
    role: "status" | "alert";
  }
> = {
  info: {
    icon: "info",
    iconClass: "text-indigo-500",
    wrapClass: "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40",
    titleClass: "text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200",
    bodyClass: "text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300",
    actionClass: "text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-200",
    dismissClass: "text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-500 dark:hover:text-indigo-300",
    role: "status",
  },
  success: {
    icon: "check-circle",
    iconClass: "text-emerald-500",
    wrapClass: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40",
    titleClass: "text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200",
    bodyClass: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300",
    actionClass: "text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-200",
    dismissClass: "text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 dark:hover:text-emerald-300",
    role: "status",
  },
  warning: {
    icon: "alert-triangle",
    iconClass: "text-amber-500",
    wrapClass: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40",
    titleClass: "text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200",
    bodyClass: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300",
    actionClass: "text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 dark:hover:text-amber-200",
    dismissClass: "text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500 dark:hover:text-amber-300",
    role: "alert",
  },
  danger: {
    icon: "circle-x",
    iconClass: "text-rose-500",
    wrapClass: "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40",
    titleClass: "text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200",
    bodyClass: "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300",
    actionClass: "text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:text-rose-200",
    dismissClass: "text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-300",
    role: "alert",
  },
};

export const AlertBanner: React.FC<AlertBannerProps> = ({
  tone = "info",
  title,
  description,
  actionText,
  onAction,
  dismissible = false,
  onDismiss,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const styles = TONE[tone];

  return (
    <div
      role={styles.role}
      className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-3 ${styles.wrapClass} ${className}`}
    >
      <UiIcon name={styles.icon} size={16} className={`mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${styles.iconClass}`} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className={`text-[13px] font-semibold ${styles.titleClass}`}>{title}</p>
        {description && <p className={`mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed ${styles.bodyClass}`}>{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">
        {actionText && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onAction}
            className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.actionClass}`}
          >
            {actionText}
          </button>
        )}
        {dismissible && (
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Dismiss"
            onClick={onDismiss}
            className={`rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.dismissClass}`}
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={13} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AlertBanner;

export default function ApiKeyTable({

  onCopy,
  onRevoke,

  return (

          </span>

  onApprove?: () => void;
  onReject?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_AVATAR: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-600",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-600",
  rose: "bg-rose-600",
  amber: "bg-amber-500",
};

const DECISION_TONE: Record<string, { icon: UiIconName; className: string }> = {
  approved: { icon: "check-circle", className: "text-emerald-600" },
  rejected: { icon: "circle-x", className: "text-rose-600" },
  pending: { icon: "clock", className: "text-zinc-400" },
};

export const ApprovalCard: React.FC<ApprovalCardProps> = ({
  title,
  approvers,
  approvedCount = 0,
  dueDate,
  decision = "pending",
  note,
  onRequestChange,
  onApprove,
  onReject,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const decisionTone = DECISION_TONE[decision] || DECISION_TONE.pending;

  return (

      data-approval-card
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}

              <span
                key={`${approver.initials}-${index}`}
                title={approver.initials}
                className={`flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-white text-[9px] font-bold text-white ring-2 ring-white dark:border-zinc-900 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${TONE_AVATAR[approver.tone || "indigo"]}`}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { X, Code2, Eye, Copy, Check } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ArtifactCanvasProps {
  title?: string;
  code: string;
  language?: "html" | "svg" | "react" | "javascript" | string;
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const ArtifactCanvas: React.FC<ArtifactCanvasProps> = ({
  title = "Artifact Preview",
  code,
  language = "html",
  isOpen = true,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"preview" | "code">("preview");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[680px] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate max-w-[240px]">
            {title}
          </span>
          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 p-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab("preview")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                tab === "preview"
                  ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs"
                  : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              }`}
            >
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Preview</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab("code")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                tab === "code"
                  ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs"
                  : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              }`}
            >
              <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Code</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
            title="Copy Code"
          >
            {copied ? (
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
            ) : (
              <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
          </button>
          {onClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              title="Close Panel"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content Body */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
        {tab === "preview" ? (
          <iframe
            srcDoc={
              language === "svg"
                ? `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#09090b;">${code}</div>`
                : language === "html"
                ? `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script><style>body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }</style></head><body>${code}</body></html>`
                : code
            }
            sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"
            title="Artifact Preview Frame"
            className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
          />
        ) : (
          <pre className="w-full h-full p-4 m-0 overflow-auto bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed">
            <code>{code}</code>
          </pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export interface AttachmentChipProps {
  name: string;
  kind?: "pdf" | "doc" | "csv" | "image";
  size?: string;
  meta?: string;
  onRemove?: () => void;
}

const KIND_TONE: Record<string, { badge: string; glyph: string }> = {
  pdf: { badge: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300", glyph: "PDF" },
  doc: { badge: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300", glyph: "DOC" },
  csv: { badge: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300", glyph: "CSV" },
  image: { badge: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300", glyph: "IMG" },
};

/**
 * AttachmentChip - compact file chip with kind badge, size and remove button.
 */
export default function AttachmentChip({ name, kind = "doc", size, meta, onRemove }: AttachmentChipProps) {
  const tone = KIND_TONE[kind] || KIND_TONE.doc;
  return (
    <span data-attachment-chip className="inline-flex max-w-xs items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-7 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900" title={name}>
      <span className={`flex h-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tone.badge}`}>{tone.glyph}</span>
      <span className="min-w-0">
        <span className="block max-w-[160px] truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{name}</span>

import React from "react";

export interface AudioNotePlayerProps {
  title?: string;
  duration?: string;
  playing?: boolean;
  waveform?: number[];
  className?: string;
  onTogglePlay?: () => void;
}

/**
 * AudioNotePlayer - Voicenotes audio note player card: a play/pause button,
 * a waveform bar strip and the note title / duration metadata row.
 */
export default function AudioNotePlayer({
  title = "Homepage walkthrough notes",
  duration = "00:47",
  playing = false,
  waveform = [],
  className = "",
  onTogglePlay,
}: AudioNotePlayerProps) {
  const bars = waveform.length
    ? waveform
    : Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 25 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.3)) * 75));
  return (
    <div
      data-audio-note-player
      className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-audio-note-toggle
          aria-label={playing ? "Pause note" : "Play note"}
          onClick={() => onTogglePlay?.()}
          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-xs text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300"
        >
          {playing ? "❚❚" : "▶"}
        </button>
        <div data-audio-note-waveform className="flex h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[2px]" aria-hidden="true">
          {bars.map((h, i) => (
            <span
              key={i}
              className={`w-[3px] shrink-0 rounded-full ${playing && i < bars.length / 2 ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600"}`}
              style={{ height: `${Math.max(15, Math.min(100, h))}%` }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        <span data-audio-note-duration className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {duration}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p data-audio-note-title className="mt-3 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
        {title}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export interface AudioWaveVisualizerProps {
  isActive?: boolean;
  barCount?: number;
  color?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const AudioWaveVisualizer: React.FC<AudioWaveVisualizerProps> = ({
  isActive = false,
  barCount = 16,
  color = "bg-amber-500",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const bars = Array.from({ length: barCount }, (_, i) => i);

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 h-8 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 select-none ${className}`}
      role="status"
      aria-label={isActive ? "Audio active" : "Audio idle"}
    >
      {bars.map((idx) => {
        // Pseudo-random animation delays and scales for a natural voice waveform
        const delay = (idx * 0.08) % 0.8;
        const duration = 0.6 + ((idx % 4) * 0.15);

        return (
          <span
            key={idx}
            style={{
              animationDelay: `${delay}s`,
              animationDuration: `${duration}s`,
            }}
            className={`w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${color} ${
              isActive
                ? "h-full animate-[audio-pulse_0.8s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate]"
                : "h-1.5 opacity-40"
            }`}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AuthProvider {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface AuthSubmitPayload {
  name?: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export interface AuthFormProps {
  mode?: "signin" | "signup";
  providers?: AuthProvider[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  submitText?: string;
  footerText?: string;
  onSubmit?: (payload: AuthSubmitPayload) => void;
  onProviderClick?: (provider: AuthProvider) => void;
  onFooterClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const providerFallback = (name: string) => (name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

export const AuthForm: React.FC<AuthFormProps> = ({
  mode = "signin",
  providers = [],
  loading = false,
  error,
  title,
  subtitle,
  submitText,
  footerText,
  onSubmit,
  onProviderClick,
  onFooterClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const isSignup = mode === "signup";

  const handleSubmit = (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (loading) return;
    onSubmit?.({ ...(isSignup ? { name } : {}), email, password });
  };

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors";

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-6 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
        {title || (isSignup ? "Create your account" : "Welcome back")}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {subtitle || (isSignup ? "Start free, no card required." : "Sign in to continue to your workspace.")}
      </div>

      {providers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
          {providers.map((provider) => (
            <button
              key={provider.name}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onProviderClick?.(provider)}
              className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              {provider.icon ? (
                <img src={provider.icon} alt="" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {providerFallback(provider.name)}
                </span>
              )}
              <span>Continue with {provider.name}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {providers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="my-5 flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" />
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">or</span>
          <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" />
        </div>
      )}

      <form className={providers.length > 0 ? "space-y-3" : "mt-5 space-y-3"} onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
        {isSignup && (
          <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Name</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              name="name"
              autoComplete="name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ada Lovelace"
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
        )}

        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Email</span>
          <input
            type="email"
            name="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="you@company.com"
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>

        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Password</span>
          <input
            type="password"
            name="password"
            autoComplete={isSignup ? "new-password" : "current-password"}
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="••••••••"
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>

        {error && (
          <div role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2">
            <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
            <span className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
        >
          {loading && <UiIcon name="loader" size={14} className="animate-spin" />}
          {submitText || (isSignup ? "Create account" : "Sign in")}
        </button>
      </form>

      {footerText && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onFooterClick?.()}
          className="mt-4 w-full text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
        >
          {footerText}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AuthForm;

        {title}

        {providers.map((provider) => (
          <button
            key={provider.id}
            type="button"
            data-auth-provider={provider.id}
            onClick={() => onProvider?.(provider.id)}
            className={`w-full rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${TONE_CLASS[provider.tone || "white"]}`}
          >
            {provider.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="my-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{dividerText}</span>
        <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
      </div>
      {secondaryAction ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          data-auth-secondary
          onClick={() => secondaryAction.onClick?.()}

        >

====/File: react/AutoScrollAnchor.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowDown } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AutoScrollAnchorProps {
  isStreaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const AutoScrollAnchor: React.FC<AutoScrollAnchorProps> = ({
  isStreaming = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isAtBottom, setIsAtBottom] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);

      // Within 80px is considered at bottom
      setIsAtBottom(distanceFromBottom < 80);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Auto follow scroll during streaming only if user is already at bottom
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStreaming && isAtBottom) {
      bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  }, [isStreaming, isAtBottom]);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div ref={bottomRef} className={`h-px w-full pointer-events-none ${className}`} />

      {/* Floating "Back to Bottom" Button */}
      {!isAtBottom && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={scrollToBottom}
          className="fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
          title="Scroll to bottom"
        >
          <ArrowDown className="w-4 h-4" />
          {isStreaming && (
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-ping" />
          )}
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type AvatarStatus = "online" | "away" | "offline";

export interface AvatarMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
}

export interface AvatarGroupProps {
  members: AvatarMember[];
  /** How many avatars to show before collapsing into a +N chip. Defaults to 4. */
  max?: number;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  onMemberClick?: (member: AvatarMember) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<NonNullable<AvatarGroupProps["size"]>, string> = {
  sm: "h-7 w-7 text-[10px]",
  md: "h-9 w-9 text-xs",
  lg: "h-11 w-11 text-sm",
};

const DOT_CLASS: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: "bg-emerald-500",
  away: "bg-amber-400",
  offline: "bg-zinc-400",
};

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const AvatarGroup: React.FC<AvatarGroupProps> = ({
  members,
  max = 4,
  size = "md",
  onMemberClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const visible = members.slice(0, Math.max(0, max));
  const overflow = members.length - visible.length;
  const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASS[size];

  return (
    <div className={`flex items-center -space-x-2 ${className}`}>
      {visible.map((member) => (
        <button
          key={member.id}
          type="button"
          title={member.name}
          aria-label={member.name}
          onClick={onMemberClick ? () => onMemberClick(member) : undefined}
          className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          {member.src ? (
            <img src={member.src} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : member.name.trim() ? (
            <span aria-hidden="true">{initials(member.name)}</span>
          ) : (
            <UiIcon name="user" size={size === "sm" ? 12 : size === "lg" ? 18 : 14} />
          )}
          {member.status && (
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${DOT_CLASS[member.status]}`}
            />
          )}
        </button>
      ))}
      {overflow > 0 && (
        <span
          title={`${overflow} more`}
          className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          +{overflow}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AvatarGroup;

====/File: react/Breadcrumb.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface BreadcrumbProps {
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
  /** Collapse the middle into an ellipsis when the trail is longer than this. 0 disables. */
  maxItems?: number;
  onNavigate?: (item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number) => void;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const collapse = (items: BreadcrumbItem[], maxItems: number): (BreadcrumbItem | null)[] => {
  if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
  const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
  return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
};

export const Breadcrumb: React.FC<BreadcrumbProps> = ({
  items,
  maxItems = 0,
  onNavigate,
  ariaLabel = "Breadcrumb",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const trail = collapse(items, maxItems);

  return (
    <nav aria-label={ariaLabel} className={className}>
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
        {trail.map((item, index) => {
          const last = index === trail.length - 1;
          const content = (
            <>
              {item?.icon && <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={12} />}
              <span>{item ? item.label : "…"}</span>
            </>
          );
          const base = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors";
          return (
            <li key={item ? item.id ?? `${item.label}-${index}` : `ellipsis-${index}`} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {index > 0 && (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-right" size={11} />
                </span>
              )}
              {!item ? (
                <span className="px-1 text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">
                  …
                </span>
              ) : last ? (
                <span aria-current="page" className={`${base} font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100`}>
                  {content}
                </span>
              ) : item.href ? (
                <a
                  href={item.href}
                  onClick={(event) => {
                    if (!onNavigate) return;
                    event.preventDefault();
                    onNavigate(item, index);
                  }}
                  className={`${base} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
                >
                  {content}
                </a>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onNavigate?.(item, index)}
                  className={`${base} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
                >
                  {content}
                </button>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
};

export default Breadcrumb;

      .toUpperCase();

              data-campsite-handoff-check
              checked={Boolean(item.done)}
              onChange={() => onToggle?.(item)}
              className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded accent-indigo-500"
            />
            <span className={`min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs ${item.done ? "text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>
              {item.label}
            </span>
            {item.assignee ? (
              <span data-campsite-handoff-assignee title={item.assignee} className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[9px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                {initialsFor(item.assignee)}
              </span>
            ) : null}
            {item.due ? (
              <span data-campsite-handoff-due className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {item.due}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
      {summary ? (
        <div data-campsite-handoff-summary className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 p-3 dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-300">
            <span aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
            AI summary
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200">{summary}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/ChangedFilesList.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface ChangedFile {
  path: string;
  additions: number;
  deletions: number;
  status?: "new" | "modified" | "generated" | "deleted";
}

export interface ChangedFilesListProps {
  title?: string;
  files: ChangedFile[];
  grouped?: boolean;
  showDiffstat?: boolean;
  defaultExpanded?: boolean;
  onFileClick?: (file: ChangedFile) => void;
}

const STATUS_TAG: Record<string, string> = {
  new: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  generated: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300",
  deleted: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  modified: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
};

const parentOf = (path: string) => {
  const parts = path.split("/");
  return parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).join("/") : "";
};

const nameOf = (path: string) => path.split("/").pop() || path;

/**
 * ChangedFilesList - PR changed-file list with per-file diffstats and status tags, flat or grouped by folder.
 */
export default function ChangedFilesList({ title = "Files changed", files, grouped = false, showDiffstat = true, defaultExpanded = true, onFileClick }: ChangedFilesListProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(defaultExpanded);
  const groups = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!grouped) return [{ folder: "", files }];
    const map = new Map<string, ChangedFile[]>();
    files.forEach((file) => {
      const folder = parentOf(file.path) || "/";
      if (!map.has(folder)) map.set(folder, []);
      map.get(folder)!.push(file);
    });
    return [...map.entries()].map(([folder, list]) => ({ folder, files: list }));
  }, [files, grouped]);

  const totals = files.reduce(
    (acc, file) => ({ additions: acc.additions + file.additions, deletions: acc.deletions + file.deletions }),
    { additions: 0, deletions: 0 },
  );

  return (
    <div data-changed-files className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <button
        type="button"
        data-changed-files-toggle
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-left focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-90" : ""}`}>
          <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
        </svg>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</span>
        {showDiffstat ? (
          <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs">
            <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{totals.additions}</span>{" "}
            <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{totals.deletions}</span>
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div className="px-2 pb-2">
          {groups.map((group, groupIndex) => (
            <div key={group.folder || groupIndex} data-files-group={group.folder || undefined}>
              {grouped && group.folder ? (
                <p className="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{group.folder}/</p>
              ) : null}
              {group.files.map((file) => (
                <button
                  key={file.path}
                  type="button"
                  data-changed-file={file.path}
                  onClick={() => onFileClick?.(file)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                >
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">{nameOf(file.path).split(".").pop()}</span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{grouped ? nameOf(file.path) : file.path}</span>
                  {file.status && STATUS_TAG[file.status] ? (
                    <span className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_TAG[file.status]}`}>{file.status}</span>
                  ) : null}
                  {showDiffstat ? (
                    <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{file.additions}</span>{" "}
                      <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{file.deletions}</span>
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface ChangelogEntry {

export interface ChangelogFeedProps {

const TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",

                {entry.badge && (

                    }`}

                    {entry.badge}

                {entry.title}
