====/File: react/DataTable.tsx/====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DataTableColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  align?: "left" | "center" | "right";
  width?: string;
}

export type DataTableRow = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;

export interface DataTableAction {
  label: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  onClick: (row: DataTableRow) => void;
}

export interface DataTableProps {
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  rows: DataTableRow[];
  selectable?: boolean;
  onSort?: (key: string, direction: "asc" | "desc") => void;
  actions?: DataTableAction[];
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const alignClass = (align?: DataTableColumn["align"]) =>
  align === "right" ? "text-right" : align === "center" ? "text-center" : "text-left";

export const DataTable: React.FC<DataTableProps> = ({
  columns,
  rows,
  selectable = false,
  onSort,
  actions = [],
  emptyText = "No results",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  const sortedRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (onSort || !sortKey) return rows;
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      const av = a[sortKey];
      const bv = b[sortKey];
      if (av === bv) return 0;
      const result = String(av ?? "") > String(bv ?? "") ? 1 : -1;
      return sortDir === "asc" ? result : -result;
    });
  }, [rows, sortKey, sortDir, onSort]);

  const toggleSort = (key: string) => {
    const nextDir = sortKey === key && sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
    setSortKey(key);
    setSortDir(nextDir);
    onSort?.(key, nextDir);
  };

  const allSelected = sortedRows.length > 0 && selected.size === sortedRows.length;
  const toggleAll = () => {
    setSelected(allSelected ? new Set() : new Set(sortedRows.map((_, index) => index)));
  };
  const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(index) ? next.delete(index) : next.add(index);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <table className="w-full text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
            <tr>
              {selectable && (
                <th className="w-10 px-3 py-2">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={allSelected}
                    onChange={toggleAll}
                    aria-label="Select all rows"
                    className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600"
                  />
                </th>
              )}
              {columns.map((column) => (
                <th
                  key={column.key}
                  style={column.width ? { width: column.width } : undefined}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${alignClass(column.align)}`}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSort(column.key)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {column.label}
                    <span className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                      <UiIcon
                        name={sortKey === column.key ? (sortDir === "asc" ? "arrow-up" : "arrow-down") : "chevron-down"}
                        size={11}
                      />
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </th>
              ))}
              {actions.length > 0 && <th className="w-20 px-3 py-2" />}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {sortedRows.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)}
                  className="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                >
                  {emptyText}
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
            {sortedRows.map((row, index) => (
              <tr
                key={index}
                className="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors"
              >
                {selectable && (
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selected.has(index)}
                      onChange={() => toggleRow(index)}
                      aria-label={`Select row ${index + 1}`}
                      className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600"
                    />
                  </td>
                )}
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td
                    key={column.key}
                    className={`px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${alignClass(column.align)} ${
                      column.align === "right" ? "tabular-nums" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    {String(row[column.key] ?? "—")}
                  </td>
                ))}
                {actions.length > 0 && (
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                      {actions.map((action) => (
                        <button
                          key={action.label}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => action.onClick(row)}
                          aria-label={action.label}
                          title={action.label}
                          className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <UiIcon name={action.icon || "more-horizontal"} size={14} />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {selectable && selected.size > 0 && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{selected.size} selected</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {actions.map((action) => (
              <button
                key={action.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  selected.forEach((index) => action.onClick(sortedRows[index]));
                  setSelected(new Set());
                }}
                className="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors"
              >
                {action.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelected(new Set())}
            aria-label="Clear selection"
            className="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DataTable;

====/File: react/DatePicker.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DatePickerProps {
  /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD. */
  value?: string;
  /** Earliest selectable date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. */
  min?: string;
  /** Latest selectable date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. */
  max?: string;
  /** 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday. */
  weekStartsOn?: 0 | 1;
  showToday?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (isoDate: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const MONTHS = [
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December",
];
const WEEKDAYS = ["Su", "Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa"];

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
export const toIso = (year: number, month: number, day: number) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

export const parseIso = (iso?: string): { year: number; month: number; day: number } | null => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || "");
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const todayIso = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
};

export const DatePicker: React.FC<DatePickerProps> = ({
  value,
  min,
  max,
  weekStartsOn = 1,
  showToday = true,
  disabled = false,
  onChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const selected = parseIso(value);
  const today = todayIso();

  const [view, setView] = useState(() => {
    const base = selected || parseIso(today)!;
    return { year: base.year, month: base.month };
  });

  // Follow an externally controlled value.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected) setView({ year: selected.year, month: selected.month });
  }, [value]);

  const cells = useMemo(() => {
    const first = new Date(view.year, view.month, 1).getDay();
    const lead = (first - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const total = new Date(view.year, view.month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const out: Array<number | null> = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
    for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) out.push(day);
    while (out.length % 7 !== 0) out.push(null);
    return out;
  }, [view, weekStartsOn]);

  const weekdays = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + weekStartsOn) % 7]),
    [weekStartsOn]
  );

  const shift = (delta: number) => {
    const next = new Date(view.year, view.month + delta, 1);
    setView({ year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() });
  };

  const isDisabled = (day: number) => {
    if (disabled) return true;
    const iso = toIso(view.year, view.month, day);
    if (min && iso < min) return true;
    if (max && iso > max) return true;
    return false;
  };

  const selectDay = (day: number) => {
    if (isDisabled(day)) return;
    onChange?.(toIso(view.year, view.month, day));
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => shift(-1)}
          aria-label="Previous month"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-left" size={14} />
        </button>
        <span className="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {MONTHS[view.month]} {view.year}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => shift(1)}
          aria-label="Next month"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-right" size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
        {weekdays.map((label) => (
          <span key={label} className="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
            {label}
          </span>
        ))}

        {cells.map((day, index) => {
          if (day === null) return <span key={`blank-${index}`} />;
          const iso = toIso(view.year, view.month, day);
          const isSelected = value === iso;
          const isToday = iso === today;
          const blocked = isDisabled(day);
          return (
            <button
              key={iso}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => selectDay(day)}
              disabled={blocked}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              aria-label={iso}
              className={`relative flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors ${
                isSelected
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500"
                  : isToday
                    ? "font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
                    : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              } disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600`}
            >
              {day}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {showToday && (
        <div className="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (disabled) return;
              const iso = today;
              if ((min && iso < min) || (max && iso > max)) return;
              onChange?.(iso);
            }}
            className="w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
          >
            Today
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DatePicker;

import React from "react";

export interface DeployCommit {

  message?: string;
  branch?: string;
  author?: string;
}

export interface DeploymentCardProps {
  deployId: string;
  status: "queued" | "building" | "live" | "failed" | "canceled";
  commit: DeployCommit;
  createdAt: string;
  source?: string;
  url?: string;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onVisit?: (url: string) => void;

const STATUS_TONE: Record<string, { pill: string; dot: string; label: string }> = {
  queued: { pill: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300", dot: "bg-zinc-400", label: "Queued" },
  building: { pill: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300", dot: "bg-sky-500 animate-pulse", label: "Building" },

  canceled: { pill: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400", dot: "bg-zinc-400", label: "Canceled" },
};

/**
 * DeploymentCard - single deployment record with status pill, commit info and actions.
 */
export default function DeploymentCard({ deployId, status, commit, createdAt, source, url, onCancel, onVisit }: DeploymentCardProps) {

  const terminal = status === "live" || status === "failed" || status === "canceled";
  return (

              <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${tone.dot}`} />
              {tone.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {commit.sha}
            {commit.message ? <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"> {commit.message}</span> : null}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {[source, createdAt].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
          {!terminal && onCancel ? (
            <button type="button" data-deploy-cancel onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-lg border border-rose-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 transition-colors hover:bg-rose-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-rose-500 dark:border-rose-500/60 dark:text-rose-400 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40">
              Cancel deploy
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {terminal && url && onVisit ? (
            <button type="button" data-deploy-visit onClick={() => onVisit(url)} className="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">
              Visit ↗
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/DiffViewer.tsx/====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DiffLine {
  type: "add" | "remove" | "context";
  content: string;
}

export interface DiffFile {
  filename: string;
  language?: string;
  lines: DiffLine[];
}

export interface DiffViewerProps {
  /** Legacy single-diff API (kept for backward compatibility). */
  lines?: DiffLine[];
  filename?: string;
  language?: string;
  /** Multi-file API: renders a tab bar when 1+ files are provided. */
  files?: DiffFile[];
  /** Context lines kept visible around each collapsed gap (default 3). */
  contextSize?: number;
  showLineNumbers?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const LINE_STYLE: Record<DiffLine["type"], { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string }> = {
  add: { row: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", gutter: "text-emerald-500", sign: "+" },
  remove: { row: "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300", gutter: "text-rose-500", sign: "-" },
  context: { row: "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400", gutter: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600", sign: " " },
};

interface HiddenLine {
  line: DiffLine;
  oldNo: number;
  newNo: number;
}

interface RenderRow {
  kind: "line" | "collapsed";
  line?: DiffLine;
  oldNo?: number | "";
  newNo?: number | "";
  /** For "collapsed": number of hidden context lines. */
  count?: number;
  /** For "collapsed": the hidden context lines, revealed on expand. */
  hidden?: HiddenLine[];
  /** Stable key so expanding one gap doesn't open its neighbours. */
  key: string;
}

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines: DiffLine[], contextSize: number): RenderRow[] => {
  const rows: RenderRow[] = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun: HiddenLine[] = [];

  const flushContext = (isTail: boolean) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach((entry) => rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` }));
    } else {
      const head = contextRun.slice(0, contextSize);
      const hiddenStart = isTail ? contextSize : contextSize;
      const hiddenEnd = isTail ? contextRun.length : contextRun.length - contextSize;
      const hidden = contextRun.slice(hiddenStart, hiddenEnd);
      head.forEach((entry) => rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` }));
      rows.push({ kind: "collapsed", count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) {
        contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach((entry) =>
          rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` })
        );
      }
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== "add") oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== "remove") newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === "context") {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({ kind: "line", line, oldNo: line.type !== "add" ? oldNo : "", newNo: line.type !== "remove" ? newNo : "", key: `c-${rows.length}` });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

export const DiffViewer: React.FC<DiffViewerProps> = ({
  lines = [],
  filename,
  language,
  files = [],
  contextSize = 3,
  showLineNumbers = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const multiFile = files.length > 0;
  const [activeFileIdx, setActiveFileIdx] = useState(0);
  const [expandedGaps, setExpandedGaps] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());

  const safeIdx = multiFile ? Math.min(activeFileIdx, files.length - 1) : 0;
  const active = multiFile ? files[safeIdx] : null;
  const activeLines = active ? active.lines : lines;
  const activeFilename = active ? active.filename : filename;
  const activeLanguage = active ? active.language : language;

  const rows = useMemo(() => buildRows(activeLines, contextSize), [activeLines, contextSize]);

  const added = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === "add").length;
  const removed = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === "remove").length;

  const toggleGap = (key: string) => {
    setExpandedGaps((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
      else next.add(key);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      {/* Multi-file tab bar */}
      {multiFile && (
        <div role="tablist" className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 pt-1.5">
          {files.map((file, idx) => {
            const isActive = idx === safeIdx;
            const fileAdded = file.lines.filter((l) => l.type === "add").length;
            const fileRemoved = file.lines.filter((l) => l.type === "remove").length;
            return (
              <button
                key={file.filename}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={isActive}
                onClick={() => setActiveFileIdx(idx)}
                className={`flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-t-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] transition-colors ${
                  isActive
                    ? "border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                    : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="max-w-[10rem] truncate">{file.filename}</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{fileAdded}</span>
                <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{fileRemoved}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Active file header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
        <UiIcon name="git-branch" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
        {activeFilename && <span className="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">{activeFilename}</span>}
        {activeLanguage && (
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {activeLanguage}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{added}</span>
          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{removed}</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto text-[13px] font-mono leading-relaxed">
        {activeLines.length === 0 && <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No changes</div>}

        {rows.map((row) => {
          if (row.kind === "collapsed") {
            const isExpanded = expandedGaps.has(row.key);
            if (!isExpanded) {
              return (
                <button
                  key={row.key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleGap(row.key)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={12} />
                  <span className="font-mono">⋯ {row.count} unchanged lines</span>
                </button>
              );
            }
            return (
              <React.Fragment key={row.key}>
                {(row.hidden || []).map((entry, i) => (
                  <div key={`${row.key}-${i}`} className={`flex ${LINE_STYLE.context.row}`}>
                    {showLineNumbers && (
                      <span className="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">
                        {entry.oldNo} {entry.newNo}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">{" "}</span>
                    <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{entry.line.content}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleGap(row.key)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="minus" size={12} />
                  <span className="font-mono">Collapse unchanged lines</span>
                </button>
              </React.Fragment>
            );
          }

          const meta = LINE_STYLE[row.line!.type] || LINE_STYLE.context;
          return (
            <div key={row.key} className={`flex ${meta.row}`}>
              {showLineNumbers && (
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">
                  {row.oldNo === "" ? "" : row.oldNo} {row.newNo === "" ? "" : row.newNo}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className={`w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center ${meta.gutter}`}>{meta.sign}</span>
              <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{row.line!.content}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DiffViewer;

import React from "react";

export interface EditableHeadingProps {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  breadcrumb?: React.ReactNode;
  meta?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: "md" | "lg";
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * EditableHeading - inline-editable object title: heading when idle, highlighted input on click; Enter/blur commits, Esc cancels.
 */
export default function EditableHeading({
  value,
  defaultValue = "Untitled",
  breadcrumb,
  meta,
  size = "lg",
  onChange,
  className = "",
}: EditableHeadingProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = React.useState(value ?? defaultValue);
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(current);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (value !== undefined) setCurrent(value);
  }, [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    const next = draft.trim() || current;
    setCurrent(next);
    setEditing(false);
    if (next !== current) onChange?.(next);
  };

  const cancel = () => {
    setDraft(current);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const sizeClass = size === "lg" ? "text-2xl" : "text-base";

  return (
    <div data-editable-heading className={className}>
      {breadcrumb ? <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">{breadcrumb}</div> : null}
      {editing ? (
        <input
          data-heading-input
          type="text"
          autoFocus
          value={draft}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
            else if (e.key === "Escape") cancel();
          }}
          className={`w-full rounded-md border-2 border-teal-500 bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none dark:bg-yellow-950/40 dark:text-zinc-50 ${sizeClass}`}
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          data-heading-display
          title="Click to rename"
          onClick={() => {
            setDraft(current);
            setEditing(true);
          }}
          className={`-mx-2 w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          {current}
        </button>
      )}
      {meta ? <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{meta}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface PickerOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  avatar?: string;
  initials?: string;
  system?: boolean;
}

export interface EntityMultiSelectPickerProps {
  options: PickerOption[];
  selected?: string[];
  searchable?: boolean;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  onSelect?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

const AVATAR_TONES = [
  "bg-violet-500",
  "bg-sky-500",
  "bg-emerald-500",
  "bg-amber-500",
  "bg-rose-500",
  "bg-indigo-500",
];

const initialsOf = (label: string) =>
  label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || "").toUpperCase())
    .join("");

/**
 * EntityMultiSelectPicker - searchable checkbox list with avatar rows for multi-picking people/entities.
 */
export default function EntityMultiSelectPicker({
  options,
  selected = [],
  searchable = true,
  emptyMessage = "No matches found.",
  confirmLabel = "Insert results",
  cancelLabel = "Cancel",
  onSelect,
  onSearch,
  onDismiss,
}: EntityMultiSelectPickerProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(selected));

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setPicked(new Set(selected));
  }, [selected]);

  const filtered = query
    ? options.filter((option) => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
    : options;

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setPicked((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div data-entity-picker className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {searchable ? (
        <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 p-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="relative">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
            </svg>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              data-picker-search
              placeholder="Search people…"
              onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); onSearch?.(event.target.value); }}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 py-1.5 pl-8 pr-2 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <ul className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <li data-picker-empty className="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{emptyMessage}</li>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((option, index) => {
            const checked = picked.has(option.id);
            return (
              <li key={option.id}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-picker-option={option.id}
                  aria-pressed={checked}
                  onClick={() => toggle(option.id)}
                  className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    checked ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40" : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    data-picker-checkbox
                    className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${
                      checked ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white" : "border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {checked ? <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg> : null}
                  </span>
                  {option.avatar ? (
                    <img src={option.avatar} alt="" className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
                  ) : option.system ? (
                    <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700">
                      <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500" />
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]}`}>
                      {option.initials || initialsOf(option.label)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{option.label}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })
        )}
      </ul>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button type="button" data-picker-cancel onClick={() => onDismiss?.()} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          {cancelLabel}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-picker-confirm onClick={() => onSelect?.([...picked])} className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
          {confirmLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export type EvalScoreTone = "pass" | "warn" | "fail";

export interface EvalRun {

  name: string;
  score: number;
  grader?: string;
  tone?: EvalScoreTone;
}

export interface EvalCriteria {
  id: string;

  description: string;
}

  runs: EvalRun[];
  criteria?: EvalCriteria[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onRunSelect?: (run: EvalRun) => void;
  onAddCriteria?: () => void;
}

const toneClasses = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "warn":
      return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300";
    case "fail":
      return "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300";
    default:
      return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300";
  }
};

const toneBar = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "warn":
      return "bg-amber-500";
    case "fail":
      return "bg-red-500";
    default:
      return "bg-emerald-500";
  }
};

====/File: react/FederatedSearchResultsPanel.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface FederatedResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  snippet: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface FederatedSearchResultsPanelProps {
  query?: string;
  results: FederatedResult[];
  sourceFilters?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  selectedSources?: string[];
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  showKeyboardLegend?: boolean;
  askAiLabel?: string;
  onQueryChange?: (query: string) => void;
  onSourceChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  onResultSelect?: (result: FederatedResult) => void;
}

const LEGEND = "↑↓ Navigate · ⏎ Select · ESC Close · ⇧⏎ Open in new tab";

/**
 * FederatedSearchResultsPanel - full-text search overlay with source filter chips, snippet results and a keyboard legend.
 */
export default function FederatedSearchResultsPanel({
  query = "",
  results,
  sourceFilters = [],
  selectedSources = [],
  searchPlaceholder = "Search everything…",
  showKeyboardLegend = true,
  askAiLabel = "Press Tab to Ask AI",
  onQueryChange,
  onSourceChange,
  onResultSelect,
}: FederatedSearchResultsPanelProps) {
  const [term, setTerm] = React.useState(query);
  const [scopes, setScopes] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(selectedSources));

  React.useEffect(() => setTerm(query), [query]);

  const highlight = (snippet: string) => {
    if (!term.trim()) return snippet;
    const parts = snippet.split(new RegExp(`(${term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")})`, "gi"));
    return parts.map((part, index) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === term.toLowerCase() ? (
        <mark key={index} className="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">{part}</mark>
      ) : (
        <React.Fragment key={index}>{part}</React.Fragment>
      ),
    );
  };

  const toggleSource = (id: string) => {
    setScopes((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      onSourceChange?.([...next]);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const filtered = scopes.size
    ? results.filter((result) => !result.source || scopes.has(result.source))
    : results;

  return (
    <div data-federated-search className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div className="relative">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={term}
            data-federated-input
            placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
            onChange={(event) => { setTerm(event.target.value); onQueryChange?.(event.target.value); }}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          />
        </div>
        {sourceFilters.length ? (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {sourceFilters.map((filter) => {
              const active = scopes.has(filter.id);
              return (
                <button
                  key={filter.id}
                  type="button"
                  data-source-chip={filter.id}
                  aria-pressed={active}
                  onClick={() => toggleSource(filter.id)}
                  className={`rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    active
                      ? "border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
                      : "border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {filter.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <ul className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <li data-federated-empty className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No results match your filters.</li>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((result) => (
            <li key={result.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-federated-result={result.id}
                onClick={() => onResultSelect?.(result)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {result.icon ? <span aria-hidden="true">{result.icon}</span> : null}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{result.title}</span>
                  {result.source ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{result.source}</span> : null}
                </span>
                {result.subtitle ? <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{result.subtitle}</span> : null}
                <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{highlight(result.snippet)}</span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))
        )}
      </ul>
      {showKeyboardLegend ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <p data-federated-legend className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{LEGEND}</p>
          {askAiLabel ? (
            <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{askAiLabel}</span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/FileAttachmentList.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AttachmentItem {
  id: string | number;
  name: string;
  size?: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface FileAttachmentListProps {
  files: AttachmentItem[];
  onRemove?: (id: string | number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const formatFileSize = (bytes?: number): string => {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return "";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

const iconForType = (type?: string, name?: string): UiIconName => {
  if (type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  const ext = name?.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (["js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "py", "java", "go", "rs", "vue", "html", "css", "json", "sh"].includes(ext)) return "code";
  return "paperclip";
};

export const FileAttachmentList: React.FC<FileAttachmentListProps> = ({ files = [], onRemove, className = "" }) => {
  if (files.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-wrap gap-2 ${className}`}>
      {files.map((f) => {
        const sizeText = formatFileSize(f.size);
        return (
          <div
            key={f.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
          >
            <UiIcon name={iconForType(f.type, f.name)} size={14} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">{f.name}</span>
            {sizeText && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">{sizeText}</span>}
            {onRemove && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`Remove ${f.name}`}
                onClick={() => onRemove(f.id)}
                className="p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
              >
                <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
export default FileAttachmentList;

====/File: react/FileDropzone.tsx/====

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DropzoneFile {
  /** Stable key; falls back to name+index. */
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  /** Bytes. */
  size: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface RejectedFile {
  name: string;
  reason: "type" | "size";
}

export interface FileDropzoneProps {
  files?: DropzoneFile[];
  /** Comma separated extensions or MIME wildcards, e.g. ".png,image/*". */
  accept?: string;
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Reject files larger than this. */
  maxSizeMb?: number;
  hint?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onFiles?: (accepted: File[]) => void;
  onReject?: (rejected: RejectedFile[]) => void;
  onRemove?: (file: DropzoneFile, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
  if (!bytes) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

export const matchesAccept = (file: { name: string; type?: string }, accept?: string) => {
  if (!accept) return true;
  return accept
    .split(",")
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith(".")) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith("/*")) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type?.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file: DropzoneFile) => {
  if (file.type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image" as const;
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return "code" as const;
  return "paperclip" as const;
};

export const FileDropzone: React.FC<FileDropzoneProps> = ({
  files = [],
  accept,
  multiple = true,
  maxSizeMb,
  hint,
  disabled = false,
  onFiles,
  onReject,
  onRemove,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleFiles = (incoming: FileList | File[] | null) => {
    const list = Array.from(incoming || []);
    if (list.length === 0) return;

    const rejected: RejectedFile[] = [];
    const accepted = list.filter((file) => {
      if (!matchesAccept(file, accept)) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: "type" });
        return false;
      }
      if (maxSizeMb && file.size > maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: "size" });
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    if (rejected.length) {
      const first = rejected[0];
      setError(
        first.reason === "size"
          ? `${first.name} is larger than ${maxSizeMb} MB`
          : `${first.name} is not an accepted file type`
      );
      onReject?.(rejected);
    } else {
      setError(null);
    }

    if (accepted.length) onFiles?.(multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1));
  };

  const openPicker = () => {
    if (!disabled) inputRef.current?.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
        aria-label={hint || "Drop files here or browse"}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        onClick={openPicker}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            openPicker();
          }
        }}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (!disabled) setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(false);
          if (!disabled) handleFiles(e.dataTransfer?.files ?? null);
        }}
        className={`flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          dragging
            ? "border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30"
            : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600"
        } ${disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : ""}`}
      >
        <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <UiIcon name="upload" size={16} />
        </span>
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          Drag & drop {multiple ? "files" : "a file"} here, or <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span>
        </p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
          {hint || [accept ? `Accepts ${accept}` : null, maxSizeMb ? `up to ${maxSizeMb} MB` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Any file type"}
        </p>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="file"
          hidden
          accept={accept}
          multiple={multiple}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => {
            handleFiles(e.target.files);
            e.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
          <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" size={12} />
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {files.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {files.map((file, index) => (
            <li
              key={file.id ?? `${file.name}-${index}`}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5"
            >
              <span className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
                <UiIcon name={fileIcon(file)} size={14} />
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{file.name}</span>
                <span className="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`Remove ${file.name}`}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  onRemove?.(file, index);
                }}
                className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              >
                <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FileDropzone;

====/File: react/FilterBar.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

export interface FilterBarProps {
  filters: FilterDefinition[];
  /** Controlled selection map: filter id -> selected option values. */
  selected?: Record<string, string[]>;
  onChange?: (selected: Record<string, string[]>) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const FilterBar: React.FC<FilterBarProps> = ({
  filters,
  selected,
  onChange,
  onClear,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const current = selected ?? internal;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openId) return;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenId(null);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenId(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [openId]);

  const commit = (next: Record<string, string[]>) => {
    if (selected === undefined) setInternal(next);
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  const toggleOption = (filterId: string, value: string) => {
    const values = current[filterId] ?? [];
    const nextValues = values.includes(value)
      ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value)
      : [...values, value];
    const next = { ...current };
    if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
    else delete next[filterId];
    commit(next);
  };

  const clearAll = () => {
    commit({});
    onClear?.();
  };

  const activeCount = Object.values(current).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0);

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      {filters.map((filter) => {
        const values = current[filter.id] ?? [];
        const active = values.length > 0;
        const open = openId === filter.id;
        return (
          <div key={filter.id} className="relative">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-expanded={open}
              aria-haspopup="true"
              onClick={() => setOpenId(open ? null : filter.id)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300"
                  : "border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600"
              }`}
            >
              <span>{filter.label}</span>
              {active && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">
                  {values.length}
                </span>
              )}
              <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={11} className={open ? "rotate-180 transition-transform" : "transition-transform"} />
            </button>

            {open && (
              <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                {filter.options.map((option) => {
                  const checked = values.includes(option.value);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={checked}
                      onClick={() => toggleOption(filter.id, option.value)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border ${
                          checked
                            ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                            : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {checked && <UiIcon name="check" size={9} strokeWidth={3} />}
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{option.label}</span>
                      {option.count !== undefined && (
                        <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                          {option.count}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {activeCount > 0 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={clearAll}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={11} />
          Clear all
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FilterBar;

====/File: react/FilterQueryBuilder.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface QueryFilterField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  operators?: string[];
}

export interface QueryFilterRow {
  id: string;
  conjunction: "where" | "and" | "or";
  field: string;
  operator: string;
  value: string;
}

export interface FilterQueryBuilderProps {
  fields?: QueryFilterField[];
  rows?: QueryFilterRow[];
  addLabel?: string;
  clearLabel?: string;
  maxRows?: number;
  onChange?: (rows: QueryFilterRow[]) => void;
  onApply?: (rows: QueryFilterRow[]) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
}

const OPERATORS = ["equals", "not-equals", "greater", "less", "contains", "gte", "lte"];
const OPERATOR_GLYPH: Record<string, string> = {
  equals: "=",
  "not-equals": "<>",
  greater: ">",
  less: "<",
  contains: "~",
  gte: ">=",
  lte: "<=",
};

/**
 * FilterQueryBuilder - compositional field/operator/value filter rows with conjunction chips.
 */
export default function FilterQueryBuilder({
  fields = [],
  rows = [],
  addLabel = "+ Add filter",
  clearLabel = "Clear filters",
  maxRows = 8,
  onChange,
  onApply,
  onClear,
}: FilterQueryBuilderProps) {
  const fieldFor = (name: string) => fields.find((field) => field.name === name);
  const operatorsFor = (name: string) => fieldFor(name)?.operators || OPERATORS;

  const update = (next: QueryFilterRow[]) => {
    onChange?.(next);
    onApply?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div data-filter-query-builder className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, index) => (
          <div key={row.id} data-filter-row={row.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${index === 0 ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300"}`}>
              {row.conjunction}
            </span>
            <select
              data-filter-field
              value={row.field}
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, field: event.target.value, operator: "equals" } : item)))}
              className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {fields.map((field) => (
                <option key={field.name} value={field.name}>{field.label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <select
              data-filter-operator
              value={row.operator}
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, operator: event.target.value } : item)))}
              className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {operatorsFor(row.field).map((op) => (
                <option key={op} value={op}>{OPERATOR_GLYPH[op] || op}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <input
              type="text"
              data-filter-value
              value={row.value}
              placeholder="Value"
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, value: event.target.value } : item)))}
              className="min-w-[100px] flex-1 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:border-indigo-400 focus-visible:outline-none dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              data-filter-remove
              aria-label="Remove filter"
              onClick={() => update(rows.filter((item) => item.id !== row.id))}
              className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="mx-auto h-3 w-3"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
        {rows.length === 0 ? <p data-filter-empty className="py-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No filters applied.</p> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-filter-add
          disabled={rows.length >= maxRows}
          onClick={() =>
            update([
              ...rows,
              { id: `f${Date.now()}`, conjunction: rows.length === 0 ? "where" : "and", field: fields[0]?.name || "", operator: "equals", value: "" },
            ])
          }
          className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
        >
          {addLabel}
        </button>
        {rows.length ? (
          <button type="button" data-filter-clear onClick={() => { onChange?.([]); onClear?.(); }} className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 hover:underline dark:text-zinc-400">
            {clearLabel}
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface FilterChip {
  label: string;
  value?: string;
  /** Value tone pill for highlighted filter values (e.g. "High" in rose). */
  valueTone?: "rose" | "emerald" | "amber" | "indigo";
  removable?: boolean;
}

export interface FilterToolbarProps {
  chips: FilterChip[];
  searchValue?: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  view?: "list" | "grid";
  viewOnChange?: (view: "list" | "grid") => void;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onChipRemove?: (index: number, chip: FilterChip) => void;
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  onAction?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const VALUE_TONE: Record<NonNullable<FilterChip["valueTone"]>, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  amber: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  indigo: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",
};

export const FilterToolbar: React.FC<FilterToolbarProps> = ({
  chips,
  searchValue,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search…",
  view = "list",
  viewOnChange,
  actionLabel,
  onChipRemove,
  onSearch,
  onAction,
  className = "",
}) => (
  <div
    data-filter-toolbar
    role="toolbar"
    aria-label="List filters"
    className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
  >
    {chips.map((chip, index) => (
      <span
        key={`${chip.label}-${index}`}
        data-filter-chip={index}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
      >
        {chip.label}
        {chip.value ? (
          <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${VALUE_TONE[chip.valueTone || "indigo"]}`}>
            {chip.value}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={12} className="text-zinc-400" />
        )}
        {chip.removable && chip.value ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            data-chip-remove={index}
            aria-label={`Remove ${chip.label} filter`}
            onClick={() => onChipRemove?.(index, chip)}
            className="ml-0.5 rounded-full p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={11} />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    ))}
    <span className="relative ml-auto min-w-[140px] flex-1 sm:max-w-xs">
      <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
      <input
        type="search"
        data-toolbar-search
        value={searchValue}
        placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
        onChange={(event) => onSearch?.(event.target.value)}
        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white py-1.5 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
      />
    </span>
    {viewOnChange ? (
      <span
        data-view-toggle
        role="group"
        aria-label="View mode"
        className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700"
      >
        {(["list", "grid"] as const).map((mode) => (
          <button
            key={mode}
            type="button"
            data-view-mode={mode}
            aria-pressed={view === mode}
            onClick={() => viewOnChange?.(mode)}
            className={`flex h-7 w-8 items-center justify-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              view === mode
                ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                : "bg-white text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            }`}
          >
            <UiIcon name={mode === "list" ? "more-horizontal" : "square"} size={13} />
          </button>
        ))}
      </span>
    ) : null}
    {actionLabel ? (
      <button
        type="button"
        data-toolbar-action
        onClick={onAction}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white"
      >
        <UiIcon name="plus" size={12} />
        {actionLabel}
      </button>
    ) : null}
  </div>
);

export default FilterToolbar;

  model: string;

  eta?: string;

  onCancel?: (job: FineTuneJob) => void;

const STATUS_STYLE: Record<string, { chip: string; label: string }> = {
  queued: { chip: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300", label: "Queued" },
  training: { chip: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300", label: "Training" },
  completed: { chip: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300", label: "Completed" },
  failed: { chip: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300", label: "Failed" },
};

/**
 * FineTuneJobList - OpenAI-style fine-tuning job list: model rows with status
 * chips, progress bars, cost/ETA metadata and per-job cancel for active jobs.
 */
export default function FineTuneJobList({
  title = "Fine-tuning jobs",
  jobs,
  newText = "New fine-tune",
  onNew,
  onCancel,
  className = "",
}: FineTuneJobListProps) {

          {newText}
        </button>
      </div>

        {jobs.map((job) => {
          const style = STATUS_STYLE[job.status] || STATUS_STYLE.queued;
          const active = job.status === "queued" || job.status === "training";
          return (
            <div
              key={job.id}
              data-finetune-job={job.id}
              className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <p className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                  <code data-finetune-model className="truncate font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{job.model}</code>
                  {job.baseModel && <span className="truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">from {job.baseModel}</span>}
                </p>
                <span data-finetune-status={job.status} className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${style.chip}`}>{style.label}</span>
              </div>
              {(job.cost || job.eta) && (
                <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {job.cost && <span data-finetune-cost>{job.cost}</span>}
                  {job.cost && job.eta && <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>}
                  {job.eta && <span data-finetune-eta>ETA {job.eta}</span>}
                </p>
              )}
              {job.status === "training" && (
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div data-finetune-progress className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                    <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all" style={{ width: `${job.progress ?? 0}%` }}></div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="w-8 text-right font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{job.progress ?? 0}%</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {active && (
                <div className="mt-2 flex justify-end">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-finetune-cancel
                    onClick={() => onCancel?.(job)}
                    className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400"
                  >
                    Cancel job
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {jobs.length === 0 && (
          <div data-finetune-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
            No fine-tuning jobs yet.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface FooterLink {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}

export interface FooterColumn {
  title: string;
  links: FooterLink[];
}

export interface FooterSectionProps {
  brand?: string;
  tagline?: string;
  columns?: FooterColumn[];
  socials?: { label: string; icon?: UiIconName }[];
  copyright?: string;
  onLinkClick?: (link: FooterLink) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const FooterSection: React.FC<FooterSectionProps> = ({
  brand,
  tagline,
  columns = [],
  socials = [],
  copyright,
  onLinkClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  return (
    <footer className={`border-t border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 ${className}`}>
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8 px-4 py-10 md:flex-row md:gap-12">
        {(brand || tagline) && (
          <div className="md:w-56 md:shrink-0">
            {brand && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white">
                  <UiIcon name="layers" size={15} />
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{brand}</span>
              </div>
            )}
            {tagline && <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{tagline}</p>}
          </div>
        )}

        {columns.length > 0 && (
          <div className="grid flex-1 grid-cols-2 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {columns.map((column) => (
              <div key={column.title}>
                <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                  {column.title}
                </h3>
                <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  {column.links.map((link) => (

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ForecastPoint {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  /** true renders the dashed/striped forecast column instead of the solid actual bar. */
  forecast?: boolean;
}

export interface ForecastTrendChartProps {
  headline: string | number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  deltaTone?: "emerald" | "rose" | "zinc";
  note?: string;
  points: ForecastPoint[];
  unit?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_TEXT: Record<NonNullable<ForecastTrendChartProps["deltaTone"]>, string> = {
  emerald: "text-emerald-600",
  rose: "text-rose-600",
  zinc: "text-zinc-400",
};

export const ForecastTrendChart: React.FC<ForecastTrendChartProps> = ({
  headline,
  deltaLabel,
  deltaTone = "emerald",
  note,
  points,
  unit,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const max = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.value), 0.0001);
  const deltaIcon = deltaTone === "emerald" ? "trending-up" : deltaTone === "rose" ? "trending-down" : "minus";
  return (
    <div
      data-forecast-trend
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
        <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {headline}
          {unit ? <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{unit}</span> : null}
        </p>
        {deltaLabel ? (
          <span className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[deltaTone]}`}>
            <UiIcon name={deltaIcon} size={12} />
            {deltaLabel}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {note ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400">{note}</p> : null}
      <div className="mt-4 flex h-28 items-end gap-1" role="img" aria-label="Trend with forecast">
        {points.map((point, index) => {
          const height = Math.max(4, Math.round((point.value / max) * 100));
          return (
            <div key={`${point.label}-${index}`} data-point-index={index} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div className="relative flex h-full w-full items-end justify-center">
                {point.forecast ? (
                  <div
                    className="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50 dark:border-sky-500 dark:bg-sky-900/40"
                    style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
                    title={`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ""} (forecast)`}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    className="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md bg-sky-500 transition-all duration-300 dark:bg-sky-400"
                    style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
                    title={`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ""}`}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="truncate text-[9px] text-zinc-400">{point.label}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-sky-500" /> Actual
        </span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50" /> Forecast
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ForecastTrendChart;

import React from "react";
