export interface FormFieldOption {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

export interface FormFieldProps {
  label: string;
  htmlFor?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  optional?: boolean;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  counter?: { value: number; max: number };
  helperFooter?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export const FormField: React.FC<FormFieldProps> = ({
  label,
  htmlFor,
  required = false,
  optional = false,
  hint,
  error,
  counter,
  helperFooter,
  children,
  className = "",
}) => (
  <div
    data-form-field
    className={`flex flex-col gap-1.5 ${className}`}
    aria-invalid={error ? "true" : undefined}
  >
    <label
      htmlFor={htmlFor}
      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
    >
      {required ? (
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-rose-500">*</span>
      ) : null}
      {label}
      {optional ? (
        <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>
      ) : null}
    </label>
    {children}
    {error ? (
      <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
        <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" size={12} />
        {error}
      </p>
    ) : hint ? (
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{hint}</p>
    ) : null}
    {counter ? (
      <p className="self-end text-xs tabular-nums text-zinc-400">
        {counter.value}/{counter.max}
      </p>
    ) : null}
    {helperFooter ? (
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{helperFooter}</p>
    ) : null}
  </div>

====/File: react/GanttTimeline.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface GanttTask {
  label: string;
  start: number;
  span: number;
  progress?: number;
  tone?: "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "sky";
  depth?: number;
}

export interface GanttTimelineProps {
  tasks: GanttTask[];
  columns?: number;
  today?: number;
  columnLabel?: string;
  rowLabel?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
  onTaskClick?: (task: GanttTask, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_CLASS: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  sky: "bg-sky-500",
};

export const GanttTimeline: React.FC<GanttTimelineProps> = ({
  tasks,
  columns = 10,
  today,
  columnLabel = "Timeline",
  rowLabel = "Name",
  emptyText = "No tasks scheduled",
  onTaskClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const cells = Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => index);

  return (
    <div
      data-gantt-timeline
      role="table"
      aria-label={columnLabel}
      aria-rowcount={tasks.length}
      className={`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        role="row"
        className="flex items-center border-b border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40"
      >
        <span
          role="columnheader"
          className="w-44 shrink-0 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400"
        >
          {rowLabel}
        </span>
        <div className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1">
          {cells.map((cell) => (
            <span
              key={cell}
              role="columnheader"
              className="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 px-1 py-2 text-center text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800"
            >
              {cell + 1}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : (
        tasks.map((task, index) => {
          const tone = TONE_CLASS[task.tone || "indigo"];
          const offset = Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), columns) / columns;
          const width = Math.min(Math.max(task.span, 0), columns - Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), columns)) / columns;
          return (
            <div
              key={`${task.label}-${index}`}
              role="row"
              data-task-index={index}
              onClick={() => onTaskClick?.(task, index)}
              className={`flex items-stretch border-b border-zinc-50 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
                onTaskClick ? "cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <span
                role="cell"
                className="flex w-44 shrink-0 items-center px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                style={{ paddingLeft: `${1 + (task.depth || 0) * 1.25}rem` }}
              >
                <span className="truncate">{task.label}</span>
              </span>
              <div role="cell" className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                {cells.map((cell) => (
                  <span
                    key={cell}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-0 border-l border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60"
                    style={{ left: `${(cell / columns) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                ))}
                {today !== undefined ? (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-0 w-px bg-rose-400"
                    style={{ left: `${(Math.min(Math.max(today, 0), columns) / columns) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <div
                  data-task-bar
                  className="absolute top-1/2 flex h-4 -translate-y-1/2 items-center overflow-hidden rounded"
                  style={{
                    left: `${offset * 100}%`,
                    width: `calc(${width * 100}% - 4px)`,
                  }}
                >
                  <div className={`relative h-full ${tone}`}>
                    {task.progress !== undefined ? (
                      <span
                        className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white/30"
                        style={{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(task.progress, 0), 100)}%` }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
                    {task.progress !== undefined ? `${task.progress}%` : ""}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GanttTimeline;

import React from "react";

export interface GroupedBarRow {
  name: string;
  estimated: number;
  actual: number;
  unit?: string;
}

export interface GroupedBarCompareProps {
  rows: GroupedBarRow[];
  title?: string;
  legendEstimated?: string;
  legendActual?: string;
  unit?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const GroupedBarCompare: React.FC<GroupedBarCompareProps> = ({
  rows,
  title = "Estimated vs actual",
  legendEstimated = "Estimated",
  legendActual = "Actual",
  unit = "h",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const max = Math.max(...rows.flatMap((row) => [row.estimated, row.actual]), 0.0001);
  return (
    <div
      data-grouped-bar-compare
      role="table"
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-violet-400" />
            {legendEstimated}
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-lime-400" />
            {legendActual}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3" aria-label="Grouped bar chart">
        {rows.map((row, index) => {
          const estimatedHeight = Math.max(4, Math.round((row.estimated / max) * 100));
          const actualHeight = Math.max(4, Math.round((row.actual / max) * 100));
          return (
            <div key={`${row.name}-${index}`} data-bar-row={index} role="row" className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex h-28 w-full items-end justify-center gap-1">
                <div className="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span className="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {row.estimated}
                    {row.unit ?? unit}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className="w-full rounded-t-md bg-violet-400 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ height: `${estimatedHeight}%` }}
                    title={`${legendEstimated}: ${row.estimated}${row.unit ?? unit}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span className="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {row.actual}
                    {row.unit ?? unit}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className="w-full rounded-t-md bg-lime-400 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ height: `${actualHeight}%` }}
                    title={`${legendActual}: ${row.actual}${row.unit ?? unit}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="w-full truncate text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{row.name}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";

export type GuardrailVerdict = "pending" | "approved" | "rejected";

export interface GuardrailItem {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  content: string;
  reasons: string[];
  rule?: string;
  confidence?: number;
  verdict?: GuardrailVerdict;
}

export interface GuardrailReviewQueueProps {
  items: GuardrailItem[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onApprove?: (item: GuardrailItem) => void;
  onReject?: (item: GuardrailItem) => void;
}

/**
 * GuardrailReviewQueue - moderation review queue for AI-flagged content:
 * cards with reason chips, rule hit and confidence, approve/reject actions
 * that collapse the card (Circle moderation / X moderation log pattern).
 */
export default function GuardrailReviewQueue({
  items,
  title = "Moderation queue",
  className = "",
  onApprove,
  onReject,
}: GuardrailReviewQueueProps) {
  const pending = items.filter((i) => (i.verdict ?? "pending") === "pending");

  return (
    <div
      data-guardrail-queue
      className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span
          data-guardrail-count
          className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
        >
          {pending.length} flagged
        </span>
      </div>

      <div data-guardrail-list className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const verdict = item.verdict ?? "pending";
          if (verdict !== "pending") {
            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                data-guardrail-resolved={item.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
              >
                <span
                  className={`inline rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium ${
                    verdict === "approved"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
                      : "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  {verdict === "approved" ? "✓ Approved" : "✕ Rejected"}
                </span>
                <span data-guardrail-resolved-author>{item.author}</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{item.content}</span>
              </div>
            );
          }
          return (
            <div key={item.id} data-guardrail-card={item.id} className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span data-guardrail-author className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {item.author}
                </span>
                {typeof item.confidence === "number" && (
                  <span
                    data-guardrail-confidence
                    className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${
                      item.confidence >= 0.9
                        ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                        : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {Math.round(item.confidence * 100)}% confidence
                  </span>
                )}
                {item.rule && (
                  <span data-guardrail-rule className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {item.rule}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p
                data-guardrail-content
                className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
              >
                {item.content}
              </p>
              {item.reasons.length > 0 && (
                <div data-guardrail-reasons className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {item.reasons.map((reason) => (
                    <span
                      key={reason}
                      data-guardrail-reason
                      className="inline rounded bg-amber-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                    >
                      {reason}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-guardrail-approve
                  onClick={() => onApprove?.(item)}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500"
                >
                  Approve
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-guardrail-reject
                  onClick={() => onReject?.(item)}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-md bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500"
                >
                  Reject
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <p data-guardrail-empty className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            No flagged content in the queue.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/HealthDonutStats.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface HealthDonutSlice {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone: "indigo" | "amber" | "zinc" | "emerald" | "rose";
}

export interface HealthDonutStatsProps {
  cards: {
    title: string;
    caption?: string;
    slices: HealthDonutSlice[];
    action?: { label: string; onClick?: () => void };
  }[];
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_SLICE: Record<NonNullable<HealthDonutSlice["tone"]>, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  zinc: "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
};

const TONE_DOT: Record<NonNullable<HealthDonutSlice["tone"]>, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  zinc: "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
};

const donutStyle = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]): React.CSSProperties => {
  const total = slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0) || 1;
  let cursor = 0;
  const stops: string[] = [];
  slices.forEach((slice) => {
    const start = (cursor / total) * 360;
    cursor += Math.max(0, slice.value);
    const end = (cursor / total) * 360;
    stops.push(`${TONE_SLICE[slice.tone].split(" ")[0]} ${start}deg ${end}deg`);
  });
  return { background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(", ")})` };
};

export const HealthDonutStats: React.FC<HealthDonutStatsProps> = ({ cards, className = "" }) => {
  if (!cards.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      data-health-donut-stats
      className={`grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 ${className}`}
    >
      {cards.map((card, index) => {
        const total = card.slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0);
        const primary = card.slices.reduce(
          (best, slice) => (slice.value > best.value ? slice : best),
          card.slices[0] || { label: "", value: 0, tone: "indigo" as const },
        );
        const percent = total ? Math.round((primary.value / total) * 100) : 0;
        return (
          <div
            key={`${card.title}-${index}`}
            data-donut-card={index}
            className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0">
                <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-full" style={donutStyle(card.slices)} />
                <div className="absolute inset-[10px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" data-donut-center>
                    {percent}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{card.title}</p>
                {card.caption ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{card.caption}</p> : null}
                <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                  {card.slices.map((slice, sliceIndex) => {
                    const share = total ? Math.round((slice.value / total) * 100) : 0;
                    return (
                      <li key={`${slice.label}-${sliceIndex}`} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                        <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${TONE_DOT[slice.tone]}`} />
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{slice.label}</span>
                        <span className="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums">{share}%</span>
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
            {card.action ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                data-donut-action
                onClick={card.action.onClick}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                {card.action.label}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default HealthDonutStats;

import React from "react";

export interface HeroSectionProps {

  description?: string;

  /** Short proof points rendered as a check list under the CTAs. */

export const HeroSection: React.FC<HeroSectionProps> = ({

  onPrimary,

            >

====/File: react/HomepageDashboard.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — React
 * A copy-paste, zero-backbox single-file homelab dashboard with the iconic
 * gethomepage/homepage look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive
 * grouped service cards with status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source copied.
 */
export type HomepageStatus = "online" | "up" | "down" | "offline" | "warn" | "error" | "unknown";

export interface HomepageService {
  /** Optional stable key — used for React reconciliation; falls back to name+index */
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** URL, data-URI, relative path, single-emoji, or omitted (letter monogram fallback) */
  icon?: string;
  /** Only http(s), mailto, protocol-relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs are rendered as a link */
  href?: string;
  /** fallback/pill label, e.g. "12ms" */
  pingText?: string;
  status?: HomepageStatus;
}

export interface HomepageGroup {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  services: HomepageService[];
}

export interface HomepageDashboardProps {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  version?: string;
  groups?: HomepageGroup[];
  headerStyle?: "underlined" | "boxed" | "clean";
  statusStyle?: "pill" | "dot" | "none";
  showClock?: boolean;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  /** Emitted when a group is collapsed/expanded (parity with Vue `group-toggle` emit and Vanilla CustomEvent) */
  onToggleGroup?: (group: string, collapsed: boolean) => void;
}

export const statusConfig = (
  status?: HomepageStatus
): { dot: string; pill: string; label: string } => {
  switch (status) {
    case "online":
    case "up":
      return { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "UP" };
    case "down":
    case "offline":
      return { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "DOWN" };
    case "warn":
      return { dot: "bg-amber-500", pill: "text-amber-500", label: "WARN" };
    case "error":
      return { dot: "bg-orange-500", pill: "text-orange-500", label: "ERROR" };
    default:
      return { dot: "bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60", pill: "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400", label: "—" };
  }
};

const STATUS_STYLES = ["pill", "dot", "none"] as const;
export type HomepageStatusStyle = (typeof STATUS_STYLES)[number];

/** Unknown values quietly fall back to "pill" (they must never silently hide all status UI). */
const resolveStatusStyle = (value?: string): HomepageStatusStyle =>
  STATUS_STYLES.includes(value as HomepageStatusStyle) ? (value as HomepageStatusStyle) : "pill";

/** Only allow safe URL protocols into the anchor. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: … */
export const isSafeHref = (href?: string): boolean => {
  if (typeof href !== "string") return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("/") || t.startsWith("./") || t.startsWith("../")) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const ServiceIcon: React.FC<{ service: HomepageService }> = ({ service }) => {
  const monogram = (service.name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  const wrap =
    "shrink-0 my-1.5 ml-1.5 w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10";
  if (!service.icon) {
    return (
      <div className={wrap}>
        <span className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">{monogram}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (/^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(service.icon)) {
    return (
      <div className={wrap}>
        <img
          src={service.icon}
          alt=""
          loading="lazy"
          width={32}
          height={32}
          className="w-8 h-8 object-contain"
          onError={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.display = "none")}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={wrap}>
      <span className="text-xl leading-none">{service.icon}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

/** Self-contained ticking clock — isolates re-render storms to this subtree only. */
const Clock: React.FC = () => {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date());
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="text-right shrink-0 min-w-28">
      <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-tight">
        {now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const HomepageDashboard: React.FC<HomepageDashboardProps> = ({
  title = "Homepage",
  subtitle = "A highly customizable homelab dashboard",
  version = "Homepage · awesome-ui",
  groups = [],
  headerStyle = "underlined",
  statusStyle = "pill",
  showClock = true,
  showSearch = false,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search services…",
  collapsible = true,
  className = "",
  onToggleGroup,
}) => {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const effectiveStatusStyle = resolveStatusStyle(statusStyle);

  const trimmedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!trimmedQuery) return groups;
    return groups
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        services: (g.services || []).filter(
          (s) =>
            (s.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(trimmedQuery) ||
            (s.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(trimmedQuery)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.services.length > 0);
  }, [groups, trimmedQuery]);

  const toggleGroup = (name: string) => {
    if (!collapsible) return;
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      const next = !prev[name];
      onToggleGroup?.(name, next);
      return { ...prev, [name]: next };
    });
  };

  const headerCls =
    headerStyle === "boxed"
      ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4"
      : headerStyle === "clean"
        ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0"
        : "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4";

  const searching = trimmedQuery.length > 0;
  const emptyMessage = groups.length === 0
    ? "No services configured yet."
    : searching
      ? `No matching services for “${trimmedQuery}”.`
      : "No services configured yet.";

  return (
    <div
      className={`homepage-dashboard relative w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden ${className}`}
      style={{ fontFamily: "'Manrope', 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" }}
    >
      <header className={headerCls}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h1>
            {subtitle && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          {(showSearch || showClock) && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              {showSearch && (
                <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
                  <svg
                    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                    viewBox="0 0 20 20"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 3.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 0 11 5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-11ZM2 9a7 7 0 1 1 12.452 4.391l2.328 2.328a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-2.328-2.328A7 7 0 0 1 2 9Z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                  <input
                    type="search"
                    value={query}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                    aria-label="Search services"
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-white/5 px-9 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              {showClock && <Clock />}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex flex-wrap items-start px-3 sm:px-5 pb-4">
        {filteredGroups.length === 0 && <p className="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">{emptyMessage}</p>}
        {filteredGroups.map((group, groupIndex) => {
          const isCollapsed = Boolean(collapsed[group.name]);
          return (
            <div key={`${group.name}-${groupIndex}`} className="services-group w-full md:w-1/2 lg:w-1/3 xl:w-1/4 p-1 pb-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleGroup(group.name)}
                aria-expanded={!isCollapsed}
                className={`group-header flex w-full select-none items-center gap-1 py-0.5 ${collapsible ? "" : "cursor-default"}`}
              >
                {group.icon && (
                  <span className="mr-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 text-sm leading-none">
                    {group.icon}
                  </span>
                )}
                <h2 className="text-xl font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{group.name}</h2>
                {collapsible && (
                  <svg
                    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className={`w-5 h-5 ml-auto transition-transform duration-200 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 ${isCollapsed ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
                  >
                    <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
                  </svg>
                )}
              </button>
              {!isCollapsed && (
                <ul className="mt-2">
                  {group.services.map((service, i) => {
                    const cfg = statusConfig(service.status);
                    const safeHref = isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : undefined;
                    const statusLabel = service.pingText || cfg.label;
                    const key = service.id ?? `${group.name}-${service.name}-${i}`;
                    const content = (
                      <>
                        <ServiceIcon service={service} />
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-2.5 text-sm text-left">
                          <div className="truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                            {service.name}
                          </div>
                          {service.description && (
                            <div className="truncate mt-0.5 text-xs font-light text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">
                              {service.description}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    );
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={key}
                        data-name={service.name || ""}
                        className="service-card relative overflow-clip rounded-md shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 dark:shadow-zinc-900/20 bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-all mb-2 p-0.5"
                      >
                        {safeHref ? (
                          <a href={safeHref} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="flex select-none items-center">
                            {content}
                          </a>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex select-none items-center">{content}</div>
                        )}
                        {effectiveStatusStyle === "dot" && (
                          <span
                            title={statusLabel}
                            role="img"
                            aria-label={statusLabel}
                            className={`absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${cfg.dot}`}
                          />
                        )}
                        {effectiveStatusStyle === "pill" && (
                          <span
                            role="img"
                            aria-label={statusLabel}
                            className={`absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-500/10 dark:bg-zinc-400/10 ${cfg.pill}`}
                          >
                            {statusLabel}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </main>

      <footer className="px-5 py-6 text-right">
        <a
          href="https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noreferrer"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
        >
          <span>{version}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
};

export default HomepageDashboard;

/**
 * ImageActionMenu - Krea generated-image context menu: Fullscreen / Vary /
 * Edit / Upscale & enhance / Make video / Download actions anchored to an
 * image card, with optional danger styling and per-action icons.
 */
export default function ImageActionMenu({
  open = true,
  actions = [],
  className = "",
  onAction,
  onClose,
}: ImageActionMenuProps) {

  const iconFor = (action: ImageMenuAction) =>

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface InboxMessage {
  id: string | number;
  sender: string;
  /** Number appended after the sender, e.g. thread count. */
  count?: number;
  subject: string;
  /** Preview text after the subject. */
  snippet?: string;
  /** Date label, e.g. "Aug 26". */
  dateLabel: string;
  unread?: boolean;
  /** Optional tag pill, e.g. "pitch" or "Draft". */
  tag?: string;
  tagTone?: "rose" | "emerald" | "indigo";
}

export interface InboxListProps {
  messages: InboxMessage[];
  activeId?: string | number | null;
  onSelect?: (message: InboxMessage) => void;
  /** Group boundary labels rendered between rows when the value changes. */
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const TAG_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  indigo: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",
};

export const InboxList: React.FC<InboxListProps> = ({
  messages = [],
  activeId = null,
  onSelect,
  emptyText = "Inbox zero — enjoy your day",
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (messages.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
        {emptyText}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {messages.map((message) => {
        const active = String(message.id) === String(activeId);
        return (
          <div
            key={message.id}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-current={active ? "true" : undefined}
            onClick={() => onSelect?.(message)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                onSelect?.(message);
              }
            }}
            className={`flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors ${
              active
                ? "bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/40"
                : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            }`}
          >
            {/* Unread dot column */}
            <span className="flex w-2 shrink-0 pt-1.5">
              {message.unread && (
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread" />
              )}
            </span>

            <span className="w-36 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
              {message.sender}
              {message.count ? <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-zinc-400">{message.count}</span> : null}
            </span>

            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {message.tag && (
                <span
                  className={`mr-1.5 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-px align-middle font-mono text-[9.5px] font-medium ${
                    TAG_TONE[message.tagTone || "rose"]
                  }`}
                >
                  {message.tag}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className={`font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${message.unread ? "" : "font-normal"}`}>
                {message.subject}
              </span>
              {message.snippet && <span className="text-zinc-400"> — {message.snippet}</span>}
            </span>

            <span className="shrink-0 pt-px font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-zinc-400">{message.dateLabel}</span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface KanbanColumn {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Tailwind background class for the column accent dot, e.g. "bg-indigo-500". */
  accent?: string;
  /** Soft cap shown as "n/limit" in the header. */
  limit?: number;
}

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string;
  columnId: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  assignee?: string;
  priority?: "low" | "medium" | "high";
}

export interface KanbanBoardProps {
  columns?: KanbanColumn[];
  cards?: KanbanCard[];
  onMoveCard?: (cardId: string, toColumnId: string) => void;
  onCardClick?: (card: KanbanCard) => void;
  onAddCard?: (columnId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const PRIORITY_META: Record<NonNullable<KanbanCard["priority"]>, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  low: { label: "Low", cls: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" },
  medium: { label: "Medium", cls: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400" },
  high: { label: "High", cls: "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400" },
};

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const KanbanBoard: React.FC<KanbanBoardProps> = ({
  columns = [],
  cards = [],
  onMoveCard,
  onCardClick,
  onAddCard,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [draggingId, setDraggingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [overColumn, setOverColumn] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const move = (cardId: string, toColumnId: string) => {
    const card = cards.find((entry) => entry.id === cardId);
    if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
    onMoveCard?.(cardId, toColumnId);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, card: KanbanCard) => {
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
    const index = columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
    const next = columns[index + (event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1)];
    if (!next) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    move(card.id, next.id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 ${className}`}>
      {columns.map((column) => {
        const columnCards = cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === column.id);
        const isOver = overColumn === column.id;
        return (
          <section
            key={column.id}
            aria-label={column.title}
            onDragOver={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (overColumn !== column.id) setOverColumn(column.id);
            }}
            onDragLeave={() => setOverColumn((current) => (current === column.id ? null : current))}
            onDrop={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              const cardId = event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain") || draggingId;
              if (cardId) move(cardId, column.id);
              setDraggingId(null);
              setOverColumn(null);
            }}
            className={`flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border bg-zinc-50/60 p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40 ${
              isOver
                ? "border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20"
                : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            }`}
          >
            <header className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
              <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${column.accent || "bg-zinc-400"}`} aria-hidden="true" />
              <h3 className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {column.title}
              </h3>
              <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-200/70 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {column.limit ? `${columnCards.length}/${column.limit}` : columnCards.length}
              </span>
              {onAddCard && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onAddCard(column.id)}
                  aria-label={`Add card to ${column.title}`}
                  className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="plus" size={12} />
                </button>
              )}
            </header>

            <div className="flex min-h-[3rem] flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
              {columnCards.length === 0 && (
                <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-2 py-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
                  Drop cards here
                </p>
              )}
              {columnCards.map((card) => {
                const priority = card.priority ? PRIORITY_META[card.priority] : null;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={card.id}
                    role="button"
                    tabIndex={0}
                    draggable
                    onDragStart={(event) => {
                      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", card.id);
                      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
                      setDraggingId(card.id);
                    }}
                    onDragEnd={() => {
                      setDraggingId(null);
                      setOverColumn(null);
                    }}
                    onClick={() => onCardClick?.(card)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        onCardClick?.(card);
                        return;
                      }
                      handleKeyDown(event, card);
                    }}
                    className={`cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${
                      draggingId === card.id ? "opacity-40" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {card.title}
                      </p>
                      {priority && (
                        <span className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${priority.cls}`}>
                          {priority.label}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {card.description && (
                      <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        {card.description}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {(card.tags?.length || card.assignee) && (
                      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                        {card.tags?.slice(0, 2).map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                        {card.assignee && (
                          <span
                            title={card.assignee}
                            className="ml-auto flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[8px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                          >
                            {initials(card.assignee)}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default KanbanBoard;

import React from "react";

export interface TailLogLine {
  ts?: string;
  level: "info" | "warn" | "error" | "success";
  message: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface LiveTailLogConsoleProps {
  lines: TailLogLine[];
  sources?: string[];
  liveTail?: boolean;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  maxLines?: number;
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
  onLiveTailChange?: (enabled: boolean) => void;
}

const LEVEL_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  info: "bg-sky-500",
  warn: "bg-amber-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
  success: "bg-emerald-500",
};

/**
 * LiveTailLogConsole - dark streaming log terminal with toolbar (source filter, search, live tail, timezone).
 */
export default function LiveTailLogConsole({
  lines,
  sources = [],
  liveTail = true,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search logs…",
  timezone = "GMT+7",
  maxLines = 200,
  onSearch,
  onLiveTailChange,
}: LiveTailLogConsoleProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [follow, setFollow] = React.useState(liveTail);

  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
    const base = query
      ? lines.filter((line) => line.message.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) || (line.source || "").toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
      : lines;
    return maxLines > 0 ? base.slice(-maxLines) : base;
  }, [lines, query, maxLines]);

  return (
    <div data-live-tail-console className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-neutral-800 px-3 py-2">
        {sources.length ? (
          <select
            data-tail-source
            className="rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-neutral-200 focus-visible:outline-none"
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value === "all" ? "" : event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="all">All sources</option>
            {sources.map((source) => (
              <option key={source} value={source}>{source}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        ) : null}
        <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-neutral-500">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={query}
            placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
            data-tail-search
            onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); onSearch?.(event.target.value); }}
            className="w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 py-1 pl-7 pr-2 text-xs text-neutral-200 placeholder:text-neutral-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-tail-follow
          onClick={() => { setFollow(!follow); onLiveTailChange?.(!follow); }}
          className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500 ${
            follow ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40" : "border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300"
          }`}
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className="h-3 w-3"><path d="M13 2 3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z" /></svg>
          Live tail
        </button>
        {timezone ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-neutral-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{timezone}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <div data-tail-lines className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-300">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-4 text-center text-neutral-500">No log lines match.</p>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((line, index) => (
            <div key={index} data-tail-line className="flex items-start gap-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
              {line.ts ? <span className="shrink-0 text-neutral-500">{line.ts}</span> : null}
              <span className={`mt-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${LEVEL_DOT[line.level] || LEVEL_DOT.info}`} />
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-neutral-300">{line.message}</span>
              {line.source ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-neutral-800 px-1 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{line.source}</span> : null}
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface MarqueeCard {
  name: string;
  handle?: string;
  text: string;
  /** Renders an anonymous NPS-style card (initials avatar, no handle link). */
  anonymous?: boolean;
}

export interface MarqueeWallProps {
  rows: MarqueeCard[][];
  speedSeconds?: number;
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
    .join("");

const AVATAR_TONES = [
  "bg-indigo-500",
  "bg-emerald-500",
  "bg-rose-500",
  "bg-amber-500",
  "bg-sky-500",
  "bg-violet-500",
];

export const MarqueeWall: React.FC<MarqueeWallProps> = ({ rows, speedSeconds = 40, paused, className = "" }) => {
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      data-marquee-wall
      className={`space-y-3 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-950 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 ${className}`}
    >
      {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => {
        const reverse = rowIndex % 2 === 1;
        return (
          <div
            key={rowIndex}
            data-marquee-row={rowIndex}
            className="group flex overflow-hidden"
            style={
              paused
                ? { animationPlayState: "paused" }
                : undefined
            }
          >
            <div
              className={`flex min-w-full shrink-0 gap-3 marquee-track${reverse ? " marquee-track-reverse" : ""}`}
              style={{
                animation: `marquee-scroll ${speedSeconds}s linear infinite${reverse ? " reverse" : ""}`,
                animationPlayState: paused ? "paused" : "running",
              }}
            >
              {[...row, ...row].map((card, index) => (
                <figure
                  key={`${card.name}-${index}`}
                  data-marquee-card={index}
                  className="w-64 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${
                        AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]
                      }`}
                    >
                      {initialsOf(card.name)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{card.name}</span>
                      {card.handle && !card.anonymous ? (
                        <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-500">@{card.handle}</span>
                      ) : null}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <blockquote className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {card.text}
                  </blockquote>
                </figure>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <style>{`@keyframes marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } } .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused !important; }`}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MarqueeWall;

export interface MemoryItem {

}

export interface MemoryPanelProps {

/**
 * MemoryPanel - ChatGPT-style "Memory" manager: remembered facts with source
 * captions, inline editing, delete per row, add input and a clear-all action.
 */
export default function MemoryPanel({
  title = "Memory",
  note = "Facts the assistant remembers across conversations.",
  items,
  addPlaceholder = "Add a memory…",
  addText = "Add",
  onAdd,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onClearAll,
  className = "",
}: MemoryPanelProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState("");
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editDraft, setEditDraft] = React.useState("");

  const submitAdd = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    onAdd?.(text);
    setDraft("");
  };
  const startEdit = (item: MemoryItem) => {
    setEditingId(item.id);
    setEditDraft(item.text);
  };
  const submitEdit = () => {
    if (!editingId) return;
    const text = editDraft.trim();
    if (text) onEdit?.(editingId, text);
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div data-memory-panel className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <button type="button" data-memory-clear onClick={() => onClearAll?.()} className="text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400">
            Clear all
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{note}</p>
      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.id} data-memory-item={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {editingId === item.id ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  data-memory-edit-input
                  value={editDraft}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditDraft(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter") submitEdit();
                    if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingId(null);
                  }}
                  autoFocus
                  className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/60 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100"
                />
                <button type="button" data-memory-save onClick={submitEdit} className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500">Save</button>
                <button type="button" data-memory-cancel onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <p data-memory-text className="text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{item.text}</p>
                  <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                    <button type="button" data-memory-edit aria-label="Edit memory" onClick={() => startEdit(item)} className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.7 3.3a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.12 0l1.88 1.88a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 0 2.12l-8.37 8.37a2 2 0 0 1-1.02.55l-2.9.65a.6.6 0 0 1-.7-.71l.64-2.9a2 2 0 0 1 .55-1.02L12.7 3.3Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" data-memory-delete aria-label="Forget memory" onClick={() => onDelete?.(item.id)} className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.25h4a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h1.75a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5H6.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5H8Zm-2.75 4.5h9.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-.5l-.4 5.6A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 12.1 16.3H7.9a1.75 1.75 0 0 1-1.75-1.62l-.4-5.68h-.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </div>
                {item.source && <p data-memory-source className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{item.source}</p>}
              </>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <li data-memory-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
            No memories yet.
          </li>
        )}
      </ul>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          data-memory-add-input
          value={draft}
          placeholder={addPlaceholder}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") submitAdd();
          }}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
        />
        <button type="button" data-memory-add onClick={submitAdd} disabled={!draft.trim()} className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">
          {addText}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/MessageActionToolbar.tsx/====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Check, RotateCcw, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "./UiIcon";

export interface MessageActionToolbarProps {
  content: string;
  role?: "assistant" | "user" | string;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onFeedback?: (type: "up" | "down") => void;
  branchIndex?: number;
  totalBranches?: number;
  onBranchChange?: (nextIndex: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const MessageActionToolbar: React.FC<MessageActionToolbarProps> = ({
  content,
  role = "assistant",
  onRetry,
  onFeedback,
  branchIndex,
  totalBranches,
  onBranchChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<"up" | "down" | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleThumb = (type: "up" | "down") => {
    const next = feedback === type ? null : type;
    setFeedback(next);
    if (onFeedback && next) onFeedback(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Branch Navigator (if multiple versions exist) */}
      {totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined && onBranchChange && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex <= 0}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex - 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Previous version"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
          <span>
            {branchIndex + 1}/{totalBranches}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex + 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Next version"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Copy */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleCopy}
        className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
        title="Copy response"
      >
        {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
      </button>

      {/* Retry / Regenerate */}
      {onRetry && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
          title="Regenerate response"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Thumbs Up / Down */}
      {role === "assistant" && (
        <>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("up")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "up" ? "text-blue-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Good response"
          >
            <ThumbsUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("down")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "down" ? "text-rose-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Bad response"
          >
            <ThumbsDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

====/File: react/MetricStrip.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface MetricStripItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface MetricStripProps {
  metrics: MetricStripItem[];
  activeIndex?: number;
  onMetricClick?: (index: number, metric: MetricStripItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const toneOf = (delta: number | undefined) => {
  if (delta === undefined) return "text-zinc-400";
  return delta > 0 ? "text-emerald-600" : delta < 0 ? "text-rose-600" : "text-zinc-400";
};

export const MetricStrip: React.FC<MetricStripProps> = ({
  metrics,
  activeIndex,
  onMetricClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (!metrics.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      data-metric-strip
      className={`flex flex-wrap items-stretch divide-x divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {metrics.map((metric, index) => {
        const active = index === activeIndex;
        const deltaTone = toneOf(metric.delta);
        const deltaIcon = metric.delta === undefined ? null : metric.delta > 0 ? "trending-up" : metric.delta < 0 ? "trending-down" : "minus";
        return (
          <div
            key={`${metric.label}-${index}`}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            data-metric-index={index}
            aria-current={active ? "true" : undefined}
            onClick={() => onMetricClick?.(index, metric)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                onMetricClick?.(index, metric);
              }
            }}
            className={`group flex min-w-[140px] flex-1 cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 px-4 py-3 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              active ? "bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60" : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
            }`}
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {metric.icon ? <UiIcon name={metric.icon} size={12} className="text-zinc-400" /> : null}
              {metric.label}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{metric.value}</span>
              {metric.delta !== undefined ? (
                <span className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${deltaTone}`}>
                  {deltaIcon ? <UiIcon name={deltaIcon} size={11} /> : null}
                  {metric.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}
                  {metric.delta}
                  {metric.deltaLabel ? ` ${metric.deltaLabel}` : "%"}
                </span>
              ) : metric.deltaLabel ? (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">{metric.deltaLabel}</span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MetricStrip;

====/File: react/Modal.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Close on backdrop click / Escape. Defaults to true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Close button in the header. Defaults to true. */
  showClose?: boolean;
  /** Footer actions; rendered right-aligned. */
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  open,
  title,
  description,
  dismissible = true,
  showClose = true,
  footer,
  onClose,
  children,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && dismissible) onClose?.();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, dismissible, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 ${className}`}
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (dismissible && panelRef.current && !panelRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) onClose?.();
      }}
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/50 backdrop-blur-[2px]" />
      <div
        ref={panelRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
            {description && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          {showClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Close"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {children && <div className="px-5 py-4 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">{children}</div>}
        {footer && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/50">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Modal;

export interface ModelComparePaneProps {

  modelB?: string;
  outputA?: string;
  outputB?: string;
  statusA?: CompareStatus;
  statusB?: CompareStatus;
  voteLabelA?: string;
  voteLabelB?: string;
  voteLabelTie?: string;
  onVote?: (choice: "A" | "B" | "tie") => void;
  className?: string;
}

const ERROR_TEXT = "Generation failed — try again.";

/**
 * ModelComparePane - LMArena style side-by-side model comparison: one shared
 * prompt, two anonymous model outputs and a vote bar (A / Tie / B).
 */
export default function ModelComparePane({
  prompt = "",
  modelA = "Model A",
  modelB = "Model B",
  outputA = "",
  outputB = "",
  statusA = "done",
  statusB = "done",
  voteLabelA = "A is better",
  voteLabelB = "B is better",
  voteLabelTie = "Tie",
  onVote,
  className = "",
}: ModelComparePaneProps) {
  const column = (side: "a" | "b") => {
    const model = side === "a" ? modelA : modelB;
    const output = side === "a" ? outputA : outputB;
    const status = side === "a" ? statusA : statusB;
    return (
      <div
        data-compare-col={side}
        className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60"

          <span data-compare-model={side} className="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">{model}</span>
          {status === "streaming" && (
            <span data-compare-status={side} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
              streaming
              <span className="flex gap-0.5" aria-hidden="true">
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:0ms]" />
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:150ms]" />
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:300ms]" />
              </span>
            </span>
          )}
          {status === "error" && <span data-compare-status={side} className="text-[11px] font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">error</span>}
        </div>
        <p
          data-compare-output={side}
          className={`mt-2 min-h-16 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed ${
            status === "error" ? "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          }`}
        >
          {status === "error" ? ERROR_TEXT : output}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div data-model-compare className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {prompt && (
        <p data-compare-prompt className="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <span className="mr-1.5 font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">Prompt</span>
          {prompt}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        {column("a")}
        {column("b")}
      </div>
      <div data-compare-votebar className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="A" onClick={() => onVote?.("A")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          👈 {voteLabelA}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="tie" onClick={() => onVote?.("tie")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          🤝 {voteLabelTie}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="B" onClick={() => onVote?.("B")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          👉 {voteLabelB}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
