import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

export interface ModelSelectorProps {
  models: ModelOption[];
  selectedId: string;
  onSelect?: (model: ModelOption) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const ModelSelector: React.FC<ModelSelectorProps> = ({
  models = [],
  selectedId,
  onSelect,
  placeholder = "Select model...",
  showSearch = true,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedModel = useMemo(
    () => models.find((m) => m.id === selectedId) || null,
    [models, selectedId]
  );

  const filteredModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return models;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return models.filter(
      (m) =>
        m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    );
  }, [models, searchQuery]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        containerRef.current &&
        !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (model: ModelOption) => {
    onSelect?.(model);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 ${className}`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-all shadow-sm ${
          disabled ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer"
        }`}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 shrink-0">
            <UiIcon name="sparkles" size={14} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col text-left truncate">
            <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">
              {selectedModel ? selectedModel.name : placeholder}
            </span>
            {selectedModel?.provider && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                {selectedModel.provider}
                {selectedModel.contextLength ? ` · ${selectedModel.contextLength}` : ""}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <UiIcon
          name="chevron-down"
          size={14}
          className={`text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          {showSearch && (
            <div className="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
                <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search models..."
                  className="w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
            {filteredModels.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>
            ) : (
              filteredModels.map((model) => {
                const isSelected = model.id === selectedId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={model.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelect(model)}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSelected}
                    className={`w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
                        : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
                          {model.name}
                        </span>
                        {model.contextLength && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">
                            {model.contextLength}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {model.tags?.map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50"
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {model.description && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                          {model.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {isSelected && (
                      <UiIcon
                        name="check"
                        size={14}
                        className="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                      />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default ModelSelector;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface NavbarLink {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  badge?: string | number;
}

export interface NavbarMenu {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  columns: { heading?: string; links: NavbarLink[] }[];
}

export interface NavbarProps {
  brand: string;
  links?: NavbarLink[];
  menus?: NavbarMenu[];
  ctaText?: string;
  onCtaClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const Chevron: React.FC<{ open: boolean }> = ({ open }) => (
  <UiIcon
    name="chevron-down"
    size={12}
    className={`shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
  />
);

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({ brand, links = [], menus = [], ctaText, onCtaClick, className = "" }) => {
  const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const rootRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const onDocMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    const onDocKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDocMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onDocKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDocMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onDocKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <nav className="flex items-center gap-6 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <span className="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{brand}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {menus.map((menu) => {
            const open = openMenu === menu.id;
            return (
              <div key={menu.id} className="relative">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-expanded={open}
                  aria-haspopup="true"
                  onClick={() => setOpenMenu(open ? null : menu.id)}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    open
                      ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50"
                      : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {menu.label}
                  <Chevron open={open} />
                </button>
                {open && (
                  <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 flex gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                    {menu.columns.map((column, columnIndex) => (
                      <div key={column.heading ?? columnIndex} className="min-w-36 space-y-1">
                        {column.heading && (
                          <p className="px-2 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{column.heading}</p>
                        )}
                        {column.links.map((link) => (
                          <a
                            key={link.id ?? link.label}
                            href={link.href ?? "#"}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
                          >
                            {link.icon && <UiIcon name={link.icon} size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />}
                            <span className="flex-1">{link.label}</span>
                            {link.badge != null && (
                              <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                                {link.badge}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </a>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {links.map((link) => (
            <a
              key={link.id ?? link.label}
              href={link.href ?? "#"}
              className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
          {ctaText && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onCtaClick}
              className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              {ctaText}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </nav>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Navbar;

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Pre-formatted relative time, e.g. "2m ago". */
  time?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  unread?: boolean;
  type?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
}

export interface NotificationCenterProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  notifications?: NotificationItem[];
  title?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Show the All / Unread filter row. */
  showFilter?: boolean;
  onSelect?: (notification: NotificationItem) => void;
  onMarkRead?: (ids: Array<string | number>) => void;
  onMarkAllRead?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TYPE_META = {
  info: { chip: "bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400", icon: "info" as UiIconName },
  success: { chip: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400", icon: "check-circle" as UiIconName },
  warning: { chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400", icon: "alert-triangle" as UiIconName },
  error: { chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", icon: "circle-x" as UiIconName },
};

export const NotificationCenter: React.FC<NotificationCenterProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  notifications = [],
  title = "Notifications",
  emptyText = "You're all caught up",
  showFilter = true,
  onSelect,
  onMarkRead,
  onMarkAllRead,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<"all" | "unread">("all");

  const unreadIds = useMemo(
    () => notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id),
    [notifications]
  );
  const visible = filter === "unread" ? notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : notifications;

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg ${className}`}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2.5">
        <UiIcon name="bell" size={14} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h3>
        {unreadIds.length > 0 && (
          <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">
            {unreadIds.length} new
          </span>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onMarkAllRead?.()}
          disabled={unreadIds.length === 0}
          className="ml-auto text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:disabled:text-zinc-600"
        >
          Mark all read
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onClose?.()}
          aria-label="Close notifications"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {showFilter && (
        <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5">
          {(["all", "unread"] as const).map((key) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={filter === key}
              onClick={() => setFilter(key)}
              className={`rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${
                filter === key
                  ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {key}
              <span className="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">
                {key === "all" ? notifications.length : unreadIds.length}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
        {visible.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="px-3 py-8 text-center">
            <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={20} className="mx-auto mb-1.5 text-emerald-500" />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {visible.map((item) => {
              const meta = TYPE_META[item.type || "info"];
              return (
                <li key={item.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (item.unread) onMarkRead?.([item.id]);
                      onSelect?.(item);
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
                  >
                    <span className={`mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}`}>
                      <UiIcon name={item.icon || meta.icon} size={13} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{item.title}</span>
                        {item.unread && <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread" />}
                      </span>
                      {item.description && (
                        <span className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                          {item.description}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.time && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{item.time}</span>}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NotificationCenter;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface OnboardingTask {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  done: boolean;
  actionText?: string;
}

export interface OnboardingChecklistProps {
  tasks: OnboardingTask[];
  title?: string;
  onToggle?: (task: OnboardingTask) => void;
  onTaskAction?: (task: OnboardingTask) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const OnboardingChecklist: React.FC<OnboardingChecklistProps> = ({
  tasks,
  title = "Get started",
  onToggle,
  onTaskAction,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const doneCount = tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length;
  const total = tasks.length;
  const percent = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount / total) * 100);
  const allDone = total > 0 && doneCount === total;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {doneCount}/{total}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {allDone ? (
            <>
              <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={12} className="text-emerald-500" />
              <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">All set — nothing left to do.</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <span>
              {percent}% complete · {total - doneCount} left
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {tasks.map((task) => (
          <li key={task.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggle?.(task)}
              aria-pressed={task.done}
              aria-label={task.done ? `Mark ${task.title} as not done` : `Mark ${task.title} as done`}
              className={`mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                task.done
                  ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                  : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 text-transparent hover:border-indigo-500"
              }`}
            >
              <UiIcon name="check" size={10} />
            </button>

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`text-xs ${
                  task.done
                    ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-through"
                    : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {task.title}
              </div>
              {task.description && (
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{task.description}</div>
              )}
            </div>

            {!task.done && task.actionText && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onTaskAction?.(task)}
                className="shrink-0 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {task.actionText}
              </button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingChecklist;

====/File: react/OnboardingStepper.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface StepperSegment {
  label: string;
  description: string;
  /** Optional example rows shown inside the description card. */
  examples?: { label: string; value: string }[];
}

export interface OnboardingStepperProps {
  steps: string[];
  current?: number;
  segments?: StepperSegment[];
  title?: string;
  continueLabel?: string;
  onContinue?: () => void;
  onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const OnboardingStepper: React.FC<OnboardingStepperProps> = ({
  steps,
  current = 0,
  segments = [],
  title = "Transaction types",
  continueLabel = "Continue",
  onContinue,
  onStepClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [activeSegment, setActiveSegment] = React.useState(0);
  const total = steps.length;
  const active = Math.min(Math.max(current, 0), total - 1);
  const segment = segments[Math.min(activeSegment, segments.length - 1)];

  return (
    <div
      data-onboarding-stepper
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Horizontal step chain */}
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs" aria-label="Setup steps">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const done = index < active;
          const isCurrent = index === active;
          return (
            <li key={step} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {index > 0 ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">
                  &gt;
                </span>
              ) : null}
              <button
                type="button"
                data-step-index={index}
                aria-current={isCurrent ? "step" : undefined}
                onClick={() => onStepClick?.(index)}
                className={`rounded-md px-2 py-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  isCurrent
                    ? "border-b-2 border-indigo-500 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : done
                      ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
                      : "text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step}
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <div className="mt-2 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div
          data-stepper-progress
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-500 transition-all duration-300"
          style={{ width: `${((active + 1) / total) * 100}%` }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Segmented control + description card */}
      {segments.length ? (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
          <div
            role="tablist"
            aria-label={title}
            className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            {segments.map((seg, index) => (
              <button
                key={seg.label}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={index === activeSegment}
                data-segment-index={index}
                onClick={() => setActiveSegment(index)}
                className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  index === activeSegment
                    ? "bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {seg.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {segment ? (
            <div data-segment-description className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{segment.description}</p>
              {segment.examples?.length ? (
                <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  {segment.examples.map((example, index) => (
                    <li
                      key={`${example.label}-${index}`}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
                    >
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                        <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
                          {index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span className="truncate">{example.label}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                        {example.value}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        data-stepper-continue
        onClick={onContinue}
        className="mt-5 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
      >
        {continueLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingStepper;

import React from "react";

export interface SummaryRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  kind?: "item" | "discount" | "tax" | "fee" | "subtotal" | "total";
  strikeValue?: string;
  note?: string;
}

export interface OrderSummaryPanelProps {
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  heading?: string;
  ctaLabel?: string;
  ctaAmount?: string;
  promoPlaceholder?: string;
  appliedPromos?: string[];
  trustFooter?: string;
  onCta?: () => void;
  onApplyPromo?: (code: string) => void;
  onRemovePromo?: (code: string) => void;
}

const KIND_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  discount: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  fee: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  total: "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50",
};

/**
 * OrderSummaryPanel - price breakdown with line rows, discounts, bold total, promo entry and primary CTA.
 */
export default function OrderSummaryPanel({
  rows,
  heading = "Order summary",
  ctaLabel = "Place your order",
  ctaAmount,
  promoPlaceholder = "Add a promo code",
  appliedPromos = [],
  trustFooter,
  onCta,
  onApplyPromo,
  onRemovePromo,
}: OrderSummaryPanelProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = React.useState("");

  const submitPromo = () => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    onApplyPromo?.(code.trim());
    setCode("");
  };

  return (
    <div data-order-summary className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{heading}</p>
      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, index) => {
          const isTotal = row.kind === "total";
          const isLast = index === rows.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={row.id} data-summary-row={row.id} className={`flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 ${isTotal ? "border-t border-zinc-200 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-700" : ""}`}>
              <span className={`text-xs ${isTotal ? "font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"}`}>
                {row.label}
                {row.note ? <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">({row.note})</span> : null}
              </span>
              <span className={`shrink-0 text-xs font-medium ${KIND_TONE[row.kind || ""] || "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>
                {row.strikeValue ? <span className="mr-1.5 font-normal text-zinc-400 line-through">{row.strikeValue}</span> : null}
                {row.value}
              </span>
              {isLast && !isTotal ? null : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      <div data-promo-block className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {appliedPromos.length ? (
          <ul className="mb-2 space-y-1">
            {appliedPromos.map((promo) => (
              <li key={promo} data-promo-applied className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">{promo} applied</span>
                <button type="button" data-promo-remove={promo} aria-label={`Remove ${promo}`} onClick={() => onRemovePromo?.(promo)} className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 hover:underline dark:text-emerald-400">Remove</button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          <input
            type="text"
            data-promo-input
            value={code}
            placeholder={promoPlaceholder}
            onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter") submitPromo(); }}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"

        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" data-summary-cta onClick={() => onCta?.()} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">

import React from "react";

export interface TrackerStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  timestamp?: string;
}

export interface OrderTrackerProps {
  stages: TrackerStage[];
  current: number | "canceled";
  variant?: "dots" | "bar";
  eta?: string;
  trackingNumber?: string;
  trackingUrl?: string;
  canceledReason?: string;
  onTrack?: () => void;
}

/**
 * OrderTracker - horizontal fulfillment progress tracker (dot connector or continuous bar) with canceled state.
 */
export default function OrderTracker({
  stages,
  current,
  variant = "dots",
  eta,
  trackingNumber,
  trackingUrl,
  canceledReason,
  onTrack,
}: OrderTrackerProps) {
  const canceled = current === "canceled";
  const currentIndex = canceled ? -1 : (current as number);
  const progress = canceled ? 0 : Math.round(((currentIndex + 1) / stages.length) * 100);

  if (variant === "bar") {
    return (
      <div data-order-tracker className="w-full">
        <div className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div
            data-tracker-fill
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${canceled ? "bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-600" : "bg-emerald-600"}`}
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between">
          {stages.map((stage, index) => {
            const reached = !canceled && index <= currentIndex;
            const isCurrent = !canceled && index === currentIndex;
            return (
              <span
                key={stage.id}
                data-tracker-stage={stage.id}
                className={`text-[10px] font-medium ${isCurrent ? "font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : reached ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600"}`}
              >
                {stage.label}
              </span>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {canceled && canceledReason ? <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{canceledReason}</p> : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div data-order-tracker className="w-full">
      {eta && !canceled ? (
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {eta}
          {trackingNumber ? <span className="ml-2 font-normal text-zinc-400">· {trackingNumber}</span> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {canceled ? <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Canceled{canceledReason ? ` — ${canceledReason}` : ""}</p> : null}
      <ol className="flex items-start">
        {stages.map((stage, index) => {
          const reached = !canceled && index <= currentIndex;
          const isCurrent = !canceled && index === currentIndex;
          const last = index === stages.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={stage.id} data-tracker-stage={stage.id} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start">
              <span className="flex flex-col items-center">
                <span
                  className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
                    isCurrent
                      ? "ring-2 ring-zinc-900 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white dark:ring-zinc-100 dark:ring-offset-zinc-900"
                      : ""
                  } ${reached ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"}`}
                >
                  {reached ? <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="3" className="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg> : null}
                </span>
                <span className={`mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] font-medium ${isCurrent ? "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : reached ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600"}`}>{stage.label}</span>
                {stage.timestamp ? <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">{stage.timestamp}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {!last ? <span className={`mx-1 mt-2 h-0.5 flex-1 ${reached && index < currentIndex ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"}`} /> : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      {trackingUrl ? (
        <button type="button" data-tracker-track onClick={() => onTrack?.()} className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">
          Track shipment &gt;
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/OtpInput.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { useRef } from "react";

export interface OtpInputProps {
  length?: number;
  value?: string;
  heading?: string;
  subtext?: string;
  status?: "idle" | "error";
  errorText?: string;
  continueLabel?: string;
  resendHint?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onComplete?: (value: string) => void;
}

/**
 * OtpInput - verification code entry with per-cell auto-advance and error state.
 */
export default function OtpInput({
  length = 6,
  value = "",
  heading,
  subtext,
  status = "idle",
  errorText,
  continueLabel = "Continue",
  resendHint,
  onChange,
  onComplete,
}: OtpInputProps) {
  const chars = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => value[i] ?? "");
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);
  const errored = status === "error";

  const commit = (next: string) => {
    onChange?.(next);
    if (next.length >= length) onComplete?.(next.slice(0, length));
  };

  const setAt = (index: number, char: string) => {
    const digits = chars.slice();
    digits[index] = char;
    commit(digits.join("").slice(0, length));
  };

  const cellClass = (filled: boolean) =>
    `h-12 w-11 rounded-lg border text-center text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
      errored
        ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/60 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-500/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200"
        : filled
          ? "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50"
          : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-400 placeholder:text-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-500"
    }`;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm" data-otp-input>
      {heading ? <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{heading}</h2> : null}
      {subtext ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtext}</p> : null}

      <div className={`flex gap-1.5 ${heading || subtext ? "mt-4" : ""}`} data-otp-cells>
        {chars.map((char, index) => (
          <input
            key={index}
            ref={(node) => {
              refs.current[index] = node;
            }}
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={1}
            value={char}
            aria-label={`Digit ${index + 1}`}
            data-otp-cell={index}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const char = event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-1);
              if (!char) return;
              setAt(index, char);
              refs.current[Math.min(index + 1, length - 1)]?.focus();
            }}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Backspace") {
                if (chars[index]) {
                  setAt(index, "");
                } else if (index > 0) {
                  setAt(index - 1, "");
                  refs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
                }
              }
            }}
            onPaste={(event) => {
              const pasted = event.clipboardData.getData("text").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, length);
              if (pasted.length > 1) {
                event.preventDefault();
                commit(pasted);
                refs.current[Math.min(pasted.length, length - 1)]?.focus();
              }
            }}
            className={cellClass(Boolean(char))}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {errored && errorText ? (
        <p data-otp-error className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5">
            <path d="m10.29 3.86 1.58-2.75a1 1 0 0 1 1.74 0l1.58 2.75 3.18.55a1 1 0 0 1 .6 1.62l-2.2 2.5 2.2 2.5a1 1 0 0 1-.6 1.62l-3.18.55-1.58 2.75a1 1 0 0 1-1.74 0l-1.58-2.75-3.18-.55a1 1 0 0 1-.6-1.62l2.2-2.5-2.2-2.5a1 1 0 0 1 .6-1.62Z" />
            <path d="M12 9v4M12 17h.01" />
          </svg>
          {errorText}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        data-otp-continue
        className="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
      >
        {continueLabel}
      </button>

      {resendHint ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <a href="#" data-otp-resend className="font-medium text-indigo-600 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">
            Resend code
          </a>{" "}
          · {resendHint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/Pagination.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface PaginationProps {
  /** Current page, 1-based. */
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
  onChange?: (page: number) => void;
  /** How many page numbers to show on each side of the current page. Defaults to 1. */
  siblingCount?: number;
  /** Show first/last page jump buttons. Defaults to true. */
  showEdges?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export type PaginationSlot = number | "gap";

export const paginationSlots = (page: number, pageCount: number, siblingCount = 1): PaginationSlot[] => {
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<number>([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const slots: PaginationSlot[] = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) slots.push("gap");
    slots.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return slots;
};

const BASE =
  "inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({
  page,
  pageCount,
  onChange,
  siblingCount = 1,
  showEdges = true,
  ariaLabel = "Pagination",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const slots = paginationSlots(page, pageCount, siblingCount);
  const go = (next: number) => {
    if (next < 1 || next > pageCount || next === page) return;
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  const edge = (target: number, label: string, icon: "chevron-left" | "chevron-right") => (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      disabled={target < 1 || target > pageCount}
      onClick={() => go(target)}
      className={`${BASE} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
    >
      <UiIcon name={icon} size={13} />
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <nav aria-label={ariaLabel} className={`flex items-center gap-1 ${className}`}>
      {showEdges && edge(1, "First page", "chevron-left")}
      {edge(page - 1, "Previous page", "chevron-left")}
      {slots.map((slot, index) =>
        slot === "gap" ? (
          <span key={`gap-${index}`} aria-hidden="true" className="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
            …
          </span>
        ) : (
          <button
            key={slot}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`Page ${slot}`}
            aria-current={slot === page ? "page" : undefined}
            onClick={() => go(slot)}
            className={`${BASE} tabular-nums ${
              slot === page
                ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                : "text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
            }`}
          >
            {slot}
          </button>
        )
      )}
      {edge(page + 1, "Next page", "chevron-right")}
      {showEdges && edge(pageCount, "Last page", "chevron-right")}
    </nav>
  );
};

export default Pagination;

====/File: react/PipelineStageList.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface PipelineStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "success" | "failed";
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface PipelineGroup {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  currentStep?: string;
  stages: PipelineStage[];
}

export interface PipelineStageListProps {
  groups: PipelineGroup[];
  defaultExpanded?: string[];
  showDuration?: boolean;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  onStageClick?: (stage: PipelineStage) => void;
}

const STAGE_STATUS: Record<string, { text: string; tone: string }> = {
  pending: { text: "Pending", tone: "text-zinc-400" },
  running: { text: "Running", tone: "text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" },
  success: { text: "Completed", tone: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" },
  failed: { text: "Failed", tone: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" },
};

const durationLabel = (ms?: number) => {
  if (ms == null) return "";
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 60000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms % 1000 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.round((ms % 60000) / 1000)}s`;
};

/**
 * PipelineStageList - grouped CI pipeline accordion with per-stage status, durations and chevron expansion.
 */
export default function PipelineStageList({ groups, defaultExpanded = [], showDuration = true, collapsible = true, onStageClick }: PipelineStageListProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(defaultExpanded));
  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    if (!collapsible) return;
    setExpanded((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div data-pipeline-list className="w-full divide-y divide-zinc-200 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {groups.map((group) => {
        const open = expanded.has(group.id);
        const running = group.stages.some((stage) => stage.status === "running");
        return (
          <div key={group.id} data-pipeline-group={group.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-pipeline-group-header
              onClick={() => toggle(group.id)}
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            >
              {running ? (
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-400" />
              )}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{group.title}</span>
                {group.currentStep ? <span className="block truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{group.currentStep}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {showDuration ? (
                <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {durationLabel(group.stages.reduce((sum, stage) => sum + (stage.durationMs || 0), 0) || undefined)}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {collapsible ? (
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-90" : ""}`}>
                  <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
                </svg>
              ) : null}
            </button>
            {open ? (
              <div className="mx-3 mb-3 rounded-md bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-1.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
                {group.stages.map((stage) => {
                  const tone = STAGE_STATUS[stage.status] || STAGE_STATUS.pending;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={stage.id}
                      type="button"
                      data-pipeline-stage={stage.id}
                      data-stage-status={stage.status}
                      onClick={() => onStageClick?.(stage)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-200 py-2 text-left last:border-b-0 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700/60"
                    >
                      <span className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{stage.label}</span>
                      <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
                        {showDuration && stage.durationMs != null ? <span className="text-zinc-400">{durationLabel(stage.durationMs)}</span> : null}
                        <span className={tone.tone}>{tone.text}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

          >

        ))}
      </div>
      {sections.map((section) => (

            data-comparison-section={section.id}
            className="bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            {section.title}

          {section.rows.map((row) => (

              {plans.map((plan) => {
                const cell = row.values[plans.indexOf(plan)] || { value: false };

                const v = row.values[idx]?.value ?? false;
                return (
                  <div

                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 ${plan.highlighted ? "bg-indigo-50/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40" : ""}`}
                  >
                    {v === true ? (
                      <span data-comparison-check className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">{CHECK_SVG}</span>
                    ) : v === false ? (
                      <span data-comparison-empty>{MINUS_SVG}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span data-comparison-check className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">{CHECK_SVG}</span>
                        <span data-comparison-note className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">{v}</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}
      {/* footer CTA row */}
      <div className="grid border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `minmax(180px, 1.4fr) repeat(${plans.length}, minmax(120px, 1fr))` }}>
        <div className="px-4 py-3" />
        {plans.map((plan) => (
          <div key={plan.id} className={`px-4 py-3 ${plan.highlighted ? "bg-indigo-50/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40" : ""}`}>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-comparison-cta={plan.id}
              onClick={() => onSelect?.(plan.id)}
              className={`w-full rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                plan.highlighted
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500"
                  : "border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-zinc-600"
              }`}
            >
              {ctaText}
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ProfileStat {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
}

export interface ProfileHeaderProps {
  name: string;
  /** Handle shown under the name (without @). */
  handle?: string;
  /** Role or short bio line. */
  headline?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  /** Initials fallback when no avatarUrl is given. */
  initials?: string;
  /** Cover gradient class, e.g. "from-indigo-500 to-sky-400". */
  coverClass?: string;
  stats?: ProfileStat[];
  actions?: { label: string; variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" }[];
  /** Status line under the actions, e.g. "Available for work". */
  statusText?: string;
  statusTone?: "ok" | "away";
  tabs?: string[];
  activeTab?: string;
  onTabChange?: (tab: string) => void;
  onAction?: (label: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const ACTION_VARIANT: Record<string, string> = {
  primary:
    "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500",
  secondary:
    "border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400",
  ghost:
    "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400",
};

export const ProfileHeader: React.FC<ProfileHeaderProps> = ({
  name,
  handle,
  headline,
  avatarUrl,
  initials,
  coverClass = "from-indigo-500 via-violet-500 to-sky-400",
  stats = [],
  actions = [],
  statusText,
  statusTone = "ok",
  tabs = [],
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  onAction,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const initialsFallback = (initials || name || "?")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div className={`overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {/* Cover */}
      <div className={`relative h-28 bg-gradient-to-r ${coverClass}`}>
        <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-white/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white backdrop-blur">
          Pro
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="px-5 pb-4">
        {/* Avatar overlaps the cover */}
        <div className="-mt-8 mb-3 flex items-end justify-between">
          {avatarUrl ? (
            <img
              src={avatarUrl}
              alt={name}
              className="h-16 w-16 rounded-full border-4 border-white object-cover dark:border-zinc-900"
            />
          ) : (
            <span className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-indigo-100 text-lg font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
              {initialsFallback}
            </span>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {actions.map((action) => (
              <button
                key={action.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onAction?.(action.label)}
                className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${
                  ACTION_VARIANT[action.variant || "secondary"]
                }`}
              >
                {action.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Identity */}
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{name}</h2>
        {handle && (
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
@{handle}
          </p>
        )}
        {headline && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{headline}</p>}

        {/* Status line */}
        {statusText && (
          <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span
              className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${statusTone === "ok" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-400"}`}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            {statusText}
          </p>
        )}

        {/* Stats */}
        {stats.length > 0 && (
          <dl className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1">
            {stats.map((stat) => (
              <div key={stat.label} className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                <dt className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{stat.value}</dt>
                <dd className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{stat.label}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        {tabs.length > 0 && (
          <nav aria-label="Profile sections" className="-mb-px mt-4 flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {tabs.map((tab) => {
              const active = tab === (activeTab ?? tabs[0]);
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab}
                  type="button"
                  aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                  onClick={() => onTabChange?.(tab)}
                  className={`whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none ${
                    active
                      ? "border-indigo-600 text-zinc-900 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-zinc-50"
                      : "border-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  {tab}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default ProfileHeader;

====/File: react/PromptLibrary.tsx/====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface PromptItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  prompt: string;
  category?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  favorite?: boolean;
}

export interface PromptLibraryProps {
  prompts?: PromptItem[];
  /** Extra categories shown even when no prompt uses them yet. */
  categories?: string[];
  searchable?: boolean;
  onUse?: (prompt: PromptItem) => void;
  onToggleFavorite?: (prompt: PromptItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const PromptLibrary: React.FC<PromptLibraryProps> = ({
  prompts = [],
  categories = [],
  searchable = true,
  onUse,
  onToggleFavorite,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState("all");

  const allCategories = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>(categories);
    for (const prompt of prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
    return Array.from(seen);
  }, [prompts, categories]);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return prompts.filter((prompt) => {
      const inCategory = activeCategory === "all" || prompt.category === activeCategory;
      if (!inCategory) return false;
      if (!needle) return true;
      return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(needle);
    });
  }, [prompts, activeCategory, query]);

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <UiIcon name="sparkles" size={14} className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold">Prompt library</h3>
          <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {visible.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        {searchable && (
          <div className="relative sm:ml-auto sm:w-56">
            <UiIcon
              name="search"
              size={12}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400"
            />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={query}
              onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search prompts…"
              aria-label="Search prompts"
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 pl-6 pr-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {["all", ...allCategories].map((category) => {
          const active = activeCategory === category;
          return (
            <button
              key={category}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
              className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                  : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
              }`}
            >
              {category === "all" ? "All" : category}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No prompts match your filters.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="grid gap-2 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {visible.map((prompt) => (
            <li
              key={prompt.id}
              className="group flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-indigo-700"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {prompt.title}
                    </span>
                    {prompt.category && (
                      <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 dark:text-indigo-400">
                        {prompt.category}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {prompt.description && (
                    <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {prompt.description}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={prompt.favorite ? `Unfavorite ${prompt.title}` : `Favorite ${prompt.title}`}
                  aria-pressed={!!prompt.favorite}
                  onClick={() => onToggleFavorite?.(prompt)}
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    prompt.favorite
                      ? "text-amber-500"
                      : "text-zinc-300 hover:text-amber-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  <UiIcon name="star" size={13} />
                </button>
              </div>

              <p className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 rounded bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {prompt.prompt}
              </p>

              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {(prompt.tags || []).slice(0, 3).map((tag) => (
                    <span key={tag} className="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {tag}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onUse?.(prompt)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
                >
                  Use
                  <UiIcon name="arrow-right" size={10} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PromptLibrary;

import React from "react";

export interface PromptPerformanceRow {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  visibility: string;
  sentiment: string;
  position: string;
  mentions: string;
  trend?: "up" | "down" | "flat";
}

export interface PromptPerformanceTableProps {
  title?: string;
  exportLabel?: string;
  rows?: PromptPerformanceRow[];
  className?: string;
  onExport?: () => void;
  onRowClick?: (row: PromptPerformanceRow) => void;
}

const trendIcon = (trend?: "up" | "down" | "flat") => {
  if (trend === "up") return <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-emerald-500">▲</span>;
  if (trend === "down") return <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-red-500">▼</span>;
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-400">—</span>;
};

/**
 * PromptPerformanceTable - Peec AI prompt tracking table: rows of tracked
 * prompts with Visibility %, Sentiment score, Position # and Mentions
 * columns, plus an Export CTA in the header.
 */
export default function PromptPerformanceTable({
  title = "Prompt performance",
  exportLabel = "Export",
  rows = [],
  className = "",
  onExport,
  onRowClick,
}: PromptPerformanceTableProps) {
  return (
    <div
      data-prompt-performance-table
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <h4 data-prompt-performance-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {title}
        </h4>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-prompt-performance-export
          onClick={() => onExport?.()}
          className="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          {exportLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p data-prompt-performance-empty className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          No tracked prompts yet.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <table data-prompt-performance-list className="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th className="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Prompt</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Visibility</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Sentiment</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Position</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">Mentions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <tr
                key={row.id}
                data-prompt-row={row.id}
                onClick={() => onRowClick?.(row)}
                className="cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <td data-prompt-row-prompt className="max-w-[220px] truncate px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                  {row.prompt}
                </td>
                <td data-prompt-row-visibility className="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {row.visibility}
                </td>
                <td data-prompt-row-sentiment className="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {row.sentiment} {trendIcon(row.trend)}
                </td>
                <td data-prompt-row-position className="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {row.position}
                </td>
                <td data-prompt-row-mentions className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {row.mentions}

 * PromptSaveDialog - Langdock style "save prompt" modal: folder picker row,

export default function PromptSaveDialog({
  open = true,
  title = "ASMobbin Onboarding Ratings",

  prompt = "Create a Google Sheet report that rates the onboarding experience of {{company}}.\nOverview:",
