====/File: react/PromptVariantDiff.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface PromptVariant {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface PromptVariantDiffProps {
  variants: PromptVariant[];
  variables?: string[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onApply?: (variant: PromptVariant) => void;
}

const VAR_CHIP =
  "inline rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300";

/** Render prompt text with {{var}} tokens as chips. */
const renderText = (text: string) =>
  text.split(/(\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\})/g).map((part, i) =>
    /^\{\{/.test(part) ? (
      <span key={i} className={VAR_CHIP}>
        {part.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, "")}
      </span>
    ) : (
      <React.Fragment key={i}>{part}</React.Fragment>
    )
  );

/**
 * PromptVariantDiff - side-by-side prompt version A/B comparison with
 * variable-chip highlighting and change stats (Braintrust playground /
 * LangSmith compare pattern).
 */
export default function PromptVariantDiff({
  variants,
  variables = [],
  title = "Prompt variants",
  className = "",
  onApply,
}: PromptVariantDiffProps) {
  const [base, compare] = variants;
  if (!base || !compare) return null;

  const baseVars = (base.text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ""));
  const cmpVars = (compare.text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ""));
  const addedVars = cmpVars.filter((v) => !baseVars.includes(v));
  const removedVars = baseVars.filter((v) => !cmpVars.includes(v));
  const changedText = base.text !== compare.text;

  return (
    <div
      data-prompt-variant-diff
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <span data-diff-added className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{addedVars.length}</span>
          <span data-diff-removed className="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">−{removedVars.length}</span>
          {changedText && <span data-diff-text className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">~text</span>}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-0 divide-x divide-zinc-100 sm:grid-cols-2 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {variants.map((variant, index) => (
          <div key={variant.id} data-variant-panel={variant.id} className="flex flex-col p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2">
              <span
                className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${index === 0 ? "bg-zinc-400" : "bg-violet-500"}`}
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <span data-variant-label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {variant.label}
              </span>
              {index === 0 && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  Base
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p
              data-variant-text
              className="min-h-16 flex-1 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {renderText(variant.text)}
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-variant-apply
              onClick={() => onApply?.(variant)}
              className="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Use this version
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {(addedVars.length > 0 || removedVars.length > 0) && (
        <div data-variant-varlist className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {addedVars.map((v) => (
            <span key={`add-${v}`} data-var-added className="inline rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300">
              + {v}
            </span>
          ))}
          {removedVars.map((v) => (
            <span key={`rm-${v}`} data-var-removed className="inline rounded bg-red-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300">
              − {v}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/QaTestTable.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export type QaRating = "good" | "acceptable" | "poor";

export interface QaTestRow {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  answered?: boolean;
  rating?: QaRating;
}

export interface QaTestTableProps {
  rows: QaTestRow[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onRowCheck?: (row: QaTestRow, checked: boolean) => void;
  onRowSelect?: (row: QaTestRow) => void;
}

const RATING_CHIP: Record<QaRating, string> = {
  good: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  acceptable: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  poor: "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300",
};

const RATING_LABEL: Record<QaRating, string> = {
  good: "Good",
  acceptable: "Acceptable",
  poor: "Poor",
};

/**
 * QaTestTable - AI answer QA test table (Intercom Fin "Test" pattern):
 * checkbox + question + answer status icon + tone-colored rating chip.
 */
export default function QaTestTable({
  rows,
  title = "QA tests",
  className = "",
  onRowCheck,
  onRowSelect,
}: QaTestTableProps) {
  const [checked, setChecked] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const toggle = (row: QaTestRow) => {
    const next = !checked[row.id];
    setChecked((c) => ({ ...c, [row.id]: next }));
    onRowCheck?.(row, next);
  };

  const answeredCount = rows.filter((r) => r.answered !== false).length;

  return (
    <div
      data-qa-test-table
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {rows.length} questions
        </span>
        <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
          {answeredCount} answered
        </span>
      </div>
      <table data-qa-rows className="w-full text-left">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <th className="w-10 py-2 pl-4 font-medium"></th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Question</th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-3 text-center font-medium">Answer status</th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Answer rating</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <tr
              key={row.id}
              data-qa-row={row.id}
              onClick={() => onRowSelect?.(row)}
              className={`border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
                onRowSelect ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <td className="py-2.5 pl-4">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  data-qa-check
                  aria-label={`Select ${row.question}`}
                  checked={!!checked[row.id]}
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  onChange={() => toggle(row)}
                  className="h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer accent-emerald-600"
                />
              </td>
              <td data-qa-question className="max-w-72 truncate py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {row.question}
              </td>
              <td className="py-2.5 pr-3 text-center">
                {row.answered !== false ? (
                  <span data-qa-status className="text-emerald-500">✓</span>
                ) : (
                  <span data-qa-status className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">—</span>
                )}
              </td>
              <td className="py-2.5 pr-4">
                {row.rating && (
                  <span
                    data-qa-rating={row.rating}
                    className={`inline rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${RATING_CHIP[row.rating]}`}
                  >
                    {RATING_LABEL[row.rating]}
                  </span>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface QuoteCard {
  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  company?: string;
  /** Shows a decorative quote mark above the text when true (default true). */
  marked?: boolean;
}

export interface QuoteMasonryProps {
  quotes: QuoteCard[];
  columns?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  className?: string;
}

export const QuoteMasonry: React.FC<QuoteMasonryProps> = ({ quotes, columns = 3, className = "" }) => {
  if (!quotes.length) return null;
  const columnClass = { 2: "sm:columns-2", 3: "sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3", 4: "sm:columns-2 lg:columns-4" }[columns];
  return (
    <div
      data-quote-masonry
      className={`gap-4 ${columnClass} columns-1 [column-fill:balance] ${className}`}
    >
      {quotes.map((card, index) => (
        <figure
          key={`${card.name}-${index}`}
          data-quote-index={index}
          className="mb-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        >
          {card.marked !== false ? (
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="block text-3xl font-black leading-none text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700">
              &ldquo;
            </span>
          ) : null}
          <blockquote
            className={`text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${card.marked !== false ? "-mt-2" : ""}`}
          >
            {card.quote}
          </blockquote>
          <figcaption className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                {card.name}
              </span>
              {card.role || card.company ? (
                <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  {[card.role, card.company].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
            {card.company ? (
              <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {card.company}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </figcaption>
        </figure>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default QuoteMasonry;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface RankListItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  ratio?: number;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface RankListProps {
  items: RankListItem[];
  title?: string;
  valueHeader?: string;
  showRatio?: boolean;
  maxItems?: number;
  emptyText?: string;
  onSelect?: (index: number, item: RankListItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const RankList: React.FC<RankListProps> = ({
  items,
  title,
  valueHeader = "Value",
  showRatio = false,
  maxItems,
  emptyText = "No data yet",
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const visible = typeof maxItems === "number" ? items.slice(0, maxItems) : items;
  const peak = Math.max(...visible.map((item) => Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0), 1);

  return (
    <section
      data-rank-list
      className={`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {title || valueHeader ? (
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {title ? <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h3> : <span />}
          {valueHeader ? (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{valueHeader}</span>
          ) : null}
        </header>
      ) : null}
      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
          {visible.map((item, index) => {
            const ratio = Math.max(4, Math.min(100, ((Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0) / peak) * 100));
            return (
              <li
                key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
                role={onSelect ? "button" : undefined}
                tabIndex={onSelect ? 0 : undefined}
                data-rank-index={index}
                onClick={() => onSelect?.(index, item)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (onSelect && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    onSelect(index, item);
                  }
                }}
                className={`relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  onSelect ? "cursor-pointer" : ""
                }`}
              >
                {showRatio ? (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-1 left-2 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                    style={{ width: `calc((100% - 1rem) * ${ratio / 100})` }}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <span
                  className={`relative z-10 flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${
                    showRatio ? "px-1.5 py-0.5" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.icon ? <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" /> : null}
                  <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="relative z-10 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {item.value}
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default RankList;

import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ResourceItem {

  path?: string;
  kind?: string;

const KIND_TONE: Record<string, string> = {

  indigo: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",

export const ResourceList: React.FC<ResourceListProps> = ({

      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
          {visible.map((item, index) => (
            <li
              key={`${item.name}-${index}`}
              role={onSelect ? "button" : undefined}
              tabIndex={onSelect ? 0 : undefined}
              data-resource-index={index}
              onClick={() => onSelect?.(item, index)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (onSelect && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  onSelect(item, index);
                }
              }}
              className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                onSelect ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                <UiIcon name={item.icon || "layers"} size={14} />
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  {item.name}
                </span>
                {item.path ? (
                  <span className="block truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{item.path}</span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
              {item.timeLabel ? (
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{item.timeLabel}</span>
              ) : null}
              {item.kind ? (
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-px text-[10px] font-medium ${
                    KIND_TONE[item.kindTone || "zinc"]
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.kind}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default ResourceList;

export interface RichToolbarItem {

  disabled?: boolean;

  id: string;
  label?: string;
  items: RichToolbarItem[];

  onAction?: (id: string) => void;
  className?: string;

const BASE_BUTTON =
  "flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

====/File: react/SchedulerSlots.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SchedulerSlot {
  id: string;
  /** Start time in 24h "HH:MM". */
  time: string;
  available?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

export interface SchedulerSlotsProps {
  /** ISO date shown in the header, e.g. "2026-11-20". */
  date: string;
  slots?: SchedulerSlot[];
  selectedId?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  onSelect?: (slot: SchedulerSlot) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const PERIODS = [
  { key: "morning", label: "Morning", range: [6, 12] },
  { key: "afternoon", label: "Afternoon", range: [12, 17] },
  { key: "evening", label: "Evening", range: [17, 24] },
] as const;

const humanDate = (iso: string) => {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso;
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
  });
};

const hourOf = (time: string) => {
  const [hour] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const AM_PM = (time: string) => {
  const [hour, minute] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, "0")} ${suffix}`;
};

export const SchedulerSlots: React.FC<SchedulerSlotsProps> = ({
  date,
  slots = [],
  selectedId,
  timezone,
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const groups = PERIODS.map((period) => ({
    period,
    slots: slots.filter((slot) => {
      const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
      return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
    }),
  })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0);

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">
          <UiIcon name="calendar" size={14} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{humanDate(date)}</h3>
          {timezone && <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in {timezone}</p>}
        </div>
        <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length} open
        </span>
      </header>

      {groups.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No slots available for this day.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-3">
          {groups.map(({ period, slots: periodSlots }) => (
            <fieldset key={period.key}>
              <legend className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">
                {period.label}
              </legend>
              <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                {periodSlots.map((slot) => {
                  const disabled = slot.available === false;
                  const selected = slot.id === selectedId;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={slot.id}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      aria-pressed={selected}
                      onClick={() => onSelect?.(slot)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                        selected
                          ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white"
                          : disabled
                            ? "cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600"
                            : "border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="tabular-nums">{AM_PM(slot.time)}</span>
                      {selected && <UiIcon name="check" size={11} />}
                      {!selected && disabled && <UiIcon name="lock" size={11} />}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {periodSlots.some((slot) => slot.note) && (
                <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                  {periodSlots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note).join(" · ")}
                </p>
              )}
            </fieldset>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SchedulerSlots;

====/File: react/SearchInput.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SearchInputProps {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Show ⌘K-style hint chip on the right. */
  shortcut?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const SearchInput: React.FC<SearchInputProps> = ({
  value,
  defaultValue = "",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  shortcut,
  loading = false,
  autoFocus = false,
  onChange,
  onSearch,
  onClear,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [inner, setInner] = React.useState(defaultValue);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? value : inner;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoFocus) inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, [autoFocus]);

  const update = (next: string) => {
    if (!controlled) setInner(next);
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-500/20 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${className}`}
    >
      <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="text"
        role="searchbox"
        aria-label={placeholder}
        value={current}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        onChange={(event) => update(event.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter") onSearch?.(current);
          if (event.key === "Escape" && current) {
            update("");
            onClear?.();
          }
        }}
        className="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100"
      />
      {loading ? (
        <UiIcon name="loader" size={13} className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-zinc-400" />
      ) : current ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Clear search"
          onClick={() => {
            update("");
            onClear?.();
            inputRef.current?.focus();
          }}
          className="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
        </button>
      ) : shortcut ? (
        <kbd className="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9.5px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          {shortcut}
        </kbd>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SearchInput;

import React from "react";
export interface TypeaheadSuggestion {
  label: string;
  type?: string;
  meta?: string;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface TypeaheadResult {
  title: string;
  badge?: string;
}

export interface SearchTypeaheadProps {
  query?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  suggestions?: TypeaheadSuggestion[];
  results?: TypeaheadResult[];
  resultsHeading?: string;
  footerHint?: string;
  highlight?: string;
  onSelect?: (label: string) => void;
  onSubmit?: (query: string) => void;
}

const escapeRegExp = (value: string) => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

/**
 * SearchTypeahead - page-level search with match highlighting, type badges and grouped results.
 */
export default function SearchTypeahead({
  query = "",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  suggestions = [],
  results = [],
  resultsHeading = "Top results",
  footerHint,
  highlight = "",
  onSelect,
  onSubmit,
}: SearchTypeaheadProps) {
  const markMatches = (label: string) => {
    if (!highlight.trim()) return label;
    const parts = label.split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(highlight.trim())})`, "ig"));
    return parts.map((part, i) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === highlight.trim().toLowerCase() ? (
        <mark key={i} className="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">
          {part}
        </mark>
      ) : (
        part
      ),
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full" data-search-typeahead>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-200 pb-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
          <path d="m21 21-4-4" />
        </svg>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={query}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          data-typeahead-input
          onChange={(event) => onSubmit?.(event.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-600"
        />
        {query ? (
          <button type="button" data-typeahead-clear aria-label="Clear search" onClick={() => onSubmit?.("")} className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4">
              <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {suggestions.length ? (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1" data-typeahead-suggestions>
          {suggestions.map((suggestion, index) => (
            <li key={index}>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-typeahead-suggestion={index}
                onClick={() => onSelect?.(suggestion.label)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
                  <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
                  <path d="m21 21-4-4" />
                </svg>
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{markMatches(suggestion.label)}</span>
                {suggestion.type ? (
                  <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {suggestion.type}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}

      {results.length ? (
        <div className="mt-5" data-typeahead-results>
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{resultsHeading}</p>
          <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {results.map((result, index) => (
              <li key={index} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-typeahead-result={index}
                  onClick={() => onSelect?.(result.title)}
                  className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:text-indigo-400"
                >
                  {markMatches(result.title)}
                </button>
                {result.badge ? (
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {result.badge}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {footerHint ? (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span>{footerHint}</span>
          <a href="#" className="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" data-typeahead-help>
            Help Center
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SegmentBreakdownItem {

  amber: "bg-amber-400",

  headlineUnit = "%",
  caption,
  items,
  unit,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const total = Math.round(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Math.max(0, item.value), 0) * 100) / 100 || 1;
  const max = Math.max(...items.map((item) => Math.max(0, item.value)), 0.0001);
  return (
    <div
      data-segment-breakdown
      role="table"
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <p className="border-l-2 border-zinc-900 pl-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-50">
        {headline}
        <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{headlineUnit}</span>
      </p>
      {caption ? <p className="mt-1 pl-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">{caption}</p> : null}
      <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        {items.map((item, index) => {
          const share = Math.max(0, item.value);
          const width = Math.min(100, Math.round((share / max) * 100));
          const tone = TONE_BAR[item.tone || "indigo"];
          return (
            <div key={`${item.label}-${index}`} role="row" data-segment-index={index} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{item.label}</span>
              <span className="relative h-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                <span
                  data-segment-bar
                  className={`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${tone}`}
                  style={{ width: `${width}%` }}
                />
              </span>
              <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                {share}
                {item.unit ?? unit ?? ""}
              </span>
              {item.delta !== undefined ? (
                <span
                  className={`w-16 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-medium tabular-nums ${
                    item.delta > 0 ? "text-emerald-600" : item.delta < 0 ? "text-rose-600" : "text-zinc-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}
                  {item.delta}
                  {item.deltaUnit ?? "pp"}
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0" />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
        Share of {total}
        {unit ?? ""} across {items.length} segments
      </p>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SegmentBreakdownBars;

                  {service.url ? (
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{service.url}</span>
                  ) : null}
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {checks.length ? (
        <div className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {checks.map((check) => (
              <li key={check.label} data-check-row className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">

                )}

                  <code className="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{check.label}</code>

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SettingsItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  value?: string;
  actionText?: string;
}

export interface SettingsSection {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  description?: string;
  items: SettingsItem[];
}

export interface SettingsPanelProps {
  sections: SettingsSection[];
  activeId?: string;
  saving?: boolean;
  saveText?: string;
  onSectionChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onItemAction?: (sectionId: string, item: SettingsItem) => void;
  onSave?: (sectionId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const SettingsPanel: React.FC<SettingsPanelProps> = ({
  sections,
  activeId,
  saving = false,
  saveText = "Save changes",
  onSectionChange,
  onItemAction,
  onSave,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState(() => activeId || sections[0]?.id || "");
  const section = sections.find((item) => item.id === currentId) || sections[0];

  const select = (id: string) => {
    setCurrentId(id);
    onSectionChange?.(id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`md:flex md:gap-6 ${className}`}>
      <nav className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:w-44 md:shrink-0 md:flex-col md:overflow-visible md:pb-0">
        {sections.map((item) => {
          const active = item.id === section?.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => select(item.id)}
              aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
              className={`flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? "bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {item.icon && <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={14} className="shrink-0" />}
              <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{item.title}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {section && (
        <div className="mt-3 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mt-0">
          <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{section.title}</div>
            {section.description && (
              <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{section.description}</div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {section.items.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{item.label}</div>
                  {item.description && (
                    <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{item.description}</div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                  {item.value && (
                    <span className="max-w-[12rem] truncate text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {item.value}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {item.actionText && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onItemAction?.(section.id, item)}
                      className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
                    >
                      {item.actionText}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {onSave && (
            <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSave(section.id)}
                disabled={saving}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
              >
                {saving && <UiIcon name="loader" size={12} className="animate-spin" />}
                {saveText}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsPanel;

  buttonTone?: "indigo" | "danger" | "outline";

}

export interface SettingsSection {

  rows: SettingsRow[];
}

export interface SideDrawerProps {
  title?: string;
  side?: "right" | "left";
  tabs?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  activeTab?: string;
  sections?: SettingsSection[];
  footerPrimary?: string;
  footerSecondary?: string;
  onTabChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onRowToggle?: (label: string, enabled: boolean) => void;
  onRowAction?: (label: string) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  onFooterPrimary?: () => void;
}

const BUTTON_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500",
  danger: "border border-rose-300 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-500/50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40",

    "border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800",

/**
 * SettingsSideDrawer - side-anchored settings panel with tabs, setting rows and a sticky footer.

export default function SettingsSideDrawer({
  title = "Settings",
  side = "right",
  tabs = [],
  activeTab = "",
  sections = [],
  footerPrimary = "",
  footerSecondary = "",
  onTabChange,
  onRowToggle,
  onRowAction,
  onClose,
  onFooterPrimary,
}: SideDrawerProps) {

            aria-label="Close settings"

          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4">
              <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>

                role="tab"

                onClick={() => onTabChange?.(tab.id)}
                className={`-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  tab.id === activeTab
                    ? "border-indigo-500 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}

        ) : null}

                    </span>
                    {row.control === "toggle" ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        role="switch"
                        aria-checked={Boolean(row.enabled)}
                        data-row-toggle
                        onClick={() => onRowToggle?.(row.label, !row.enabled)}
                        className={`flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full px-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                          row.enabled ? "bg-indigo-600" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className={`h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${row.enabled ? "translate-x-4" : ""}`} />
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                    {row.control === "select" ? (
                      <select

                        className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"

                        {row.buttonLabel || "Open"}
                      </button>
                    ) : null}

                ))}

          ))}
        </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800" data-drawer-footer>
            {footerSecondary ? (
              <button type="button" data-drawer-secondary className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">
                {footerSecondary}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {footerPrimary ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                data-drawer-primary
                onClick={() => onFooterPrimary?.()}
                className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {footerPrimary}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

/**

 * role with per-row remove, plus a Copy link footer action.
 */
export default function ShareAccessDialog({
  open = true,

            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        <div data-share-access-invite className="mt-4">
          <input
            type="email"
            data-share-access-input
            placeholder="Add people by name or email"
            className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:border-zinc-400 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder-zinc-500 dark:focus:border-zinc-500"

          <span data-share-access-url-text className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {url}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-share-access-copy

            className="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300"
          >
            {copyLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/ShortcutCheatSheet.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface ShortcutEntry {
  id: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  keys: string[];
  section?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutCheatSheetProps {
  shortcuts: ShortcutEntry[];
  columns?: 1 | 2;
  title?: string;
  searchable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const KbdChip: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <kbd className="inline-flex min-w-[24px] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
    {children}
  </kbd>
);

/**
 * ShortcutCheatSheet - two-column editor shortcut list with icons, markdown hints and keycap chips.
 */
export default function ShortcutCheatSheet({
  shortcuts,
  columns = 2,
  title = "Shortcuts",
  searchable = false,
  className = "",
}: ShortcutCheatSheetProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();

  const sections = React.useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = needle
      ? shortcuts.filter((entry) => `${entry.label} ${entry.hint || ""} ${entry.keys.join(" ")}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
      : shortcuts;
    const map = new Map<string, ShortcutEntry[]>();
    for (const entry of filtered) {
      const key = entry.section || "";
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key)!.push(entry);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries());
  }, [shortcuts, needle]);

  return (
    <div data-shortcut-sheet className={`w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {searchable ? (
          <input
            data-shortcut-search
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search…"
            className="w-32 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div className={`mt-2 grid gap-x-6 ${columns === 2 ? "grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2" : "grid-cols-1"}`}>
        {sections.map(([section, entries]) => (
          <div key={section || "default"} data-shortcut-section={section || undefined} className={columns === 2 ? "sm:col-span-1" : ""}>
            {section ? <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{section}</p> : null}
            <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5">
              {entries.map((entry) => (
                <li
                  key={entry.id}
                  data-shortcut-row={entry.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                >
                  {entry.icon ? <span className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 [&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4">{entry.icon}</span> : null}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    {entry.label}
                    {entry.hint ? <code className="ml-1 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{entry.hint}</code> : null}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                    {entry.keys.map((key, i) => (
                      <KbdChip key={`${entry.id}-${i}`}>{key}</KbdChip>
                    ))}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {!sections.length ? <p data-shortcut-empty className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “{query}”.</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export { KbdChip };

====/File: react/ShortcutsOverlay.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ShortcutItem {
  /** Individual keycaps, e.g. ["⌘", "K"] or ["↑", "↓"]. */
  keys: string[];
  label: string;
  /** Optional grouping override; falls back to the parent group. */
  group?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  items: ShortcutItem[];
}

export interface ShortcutsOverlayProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  /** Either grouped shortcuts, or a flat list that is bucketed by item.group. */
  groups?: ShortcutGroup[];
  shortcuts?: ShortcutItem[];
  title?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const Kbd: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <kbd className="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
    {children}
  </kbd>
);

export const ShortcutsOverlay: React.FC<ShortcutsOverlayProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  groups = [],
  shortcuts = [],
  title = "Keyboard shortcuts",
  placeholder = "Search shortcuts...",
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setQuery("");
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose?.();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Normalize: flat list → groups by item.group (or "General").
  const normalized = useMemo<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
    if (groups.length > 0) return groups;
    const buckets: ShortcutGroup[] = [];
    shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
      const label = item.group || "General";
      const bucket = buckets.find((g) => g.label === label);
      if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
      else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-"), label, items: [item] });
    });
    return buckets;
  }, [groups, shortcuts]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return normalized;
    return normalized
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter(
          (item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.keys.join("").toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }, [normalized, query]);

  const total = useMemo(() => normalized.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.items.length, 0), [normalized]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 pt-[10vh] backdrop-blur-sm"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={`flex max-h-[75vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl ${className}`}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
          <UiIcon name="terminal" size={16} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h2>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{total}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onClose?.()}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="ml-auto rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5">
            <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              autoFocus
              className="w-full border-none bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “{query}”</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {filtered.map((group) => (
                <section key={group.id}>
                  <h3 className="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">{group.label}</h3>
                  <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                    {group.items.map((item, idx) => (
                      <li key={`${group.id}-${idx}`} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{item.label}</span>
                        <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">
                          {item.keys.map((key, i) => (
                            <Kbd key={`${key}-${i}`}>{key}</Kbd>
                          ))}
                        </span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </section>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Kbd>esc</Kbd>
            <span>Close</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ShortcutsOverlay;

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SideDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Which edge the panel slides in from. */
  side?: "left" | "right";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  onClose?: () => void;
  /** Optional sticky footer row. */
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<NonNullable<SideDrawerProps["size"]>, string> = {
  sm: "max-w-xs",
  md: "max-w-md",
  lg: "max-w-xl",
};

export const SideDrawer: React.FC<SideDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  title,
  description,
  side = "right",
  size = "md",
  onClose,
  footer,
  children,
  className = "",
}) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose?.();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex ${className}`}>
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]"
        aria-hidden="true"
        onClick={() => onClose?.()}
      />
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className={`relative z-10 flex h-full w-full ${SIZE_CLASS[size]} flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
          side === "right" ? "ml-auto border-l" : "mr-auto border-r"
        }`}
      >
        <header className="flex items-start gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</h2>
            {description && (
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onClose?.()}
            aria-label="Close drawer"
            className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <footer className="border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">{footer}</footer>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { ExternalLink, Globe } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SourceItem {
  id?: string | number;
  title: string;
  url: string;
  snippet?: string;
  siteName?: string;
  favicon?: string;
}

export interface SourcesCitationProps {
  sources: SourceItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export const SourcesCitation: React.FC<SourcesCitationProps> = ({
  sources,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [activeHoverId, setActiveHoverId] = useState<string | number | null>(null);

  if (!sources || sources.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`my-3 space-y-2 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

      </div>

          const indexNum = idx + 1;
          const domain = (() => {

              return new URL(item.url).hostname.replace("www.", "");

              return item.siteName || "web";
            }
          })();

          return (
            <a
              key={item.id || idx}
              href={item.url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"

====/File: react/StatCard.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface StatCardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  trend?: number[];
  icon?: UiIconName;
  className?: string;
}

const Sparkline: React.FC<{ data: number[]; positive: boolean }> = ({ data, positive }) => {
  if (data.length < 2) return null;
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const points = data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(" ");
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <polyline
        points={points}
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        className={positive ? "stroke-emerald-500" : "stroke-red-500"}
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

export const StatCard: React.FC<StatCardProps> = ({
  label,
  value,
  delta,
  deltaLabel,
  trend,
  icon,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const positive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;
  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{label}</span>
        {icon && (
          <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <UiIcon name={icon} size={16} />
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{value}</div>
          {typeof delta === "number" && (
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
              <UiIcon
                name={positive ? "trending-up" : "trending-down"}
                size={13}
                className={positive ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-red-500"}
              />
              <span className={`text-[11px] font-medium ${positive ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500" : "text-red-600 dark:text-red-500"}`}>
                {positive ? "+" : ""}
                {delta}%
              </span>
              {deltaLabel && (
                <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{deltaLabel}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {trend && trend.length > 1 && <Sparkline data={trend} positive={positive} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StatCard;

import React from "react";

export type StatusType = "online" | "offline" | "busy" | "connecting" | "error";

export interface StatusIndicatorProps {
  status: StatusType;
  label?: string;
  pingMs?: number;
  showDot?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StatusIndicator: React.FC<StatusIndicatorProps> = ({
  status,
  label,
  pingMs,
  showDot = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const getStatusConfig = () => {
    switch (status) {
      case "online":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-emerald-500",
          pingBg: "bg-emerald-400",
          text: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60",
          defaultLabel: "Online",
        };
      case "connecting":
      case "busy":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-amber-500",
          pingBg: "bg-amber-400",
          text: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting",
        };
      case "error":
      case "offline":
      default:
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-rose-500",
          pingBg: "bg-rose-400",
          text: "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline",
        };
    }
  };

  const config = getStatusConfig();
  const displayLabel = label || config.defaultLabel;

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${config.badgeBg} ${config.text} ${className}`}
    >
      {showDot && (
        <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
          {status === "online" && (
            <span
              className={`animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${config.pingBg}`}
            />
          )}
          <span className={`relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${config.dotBg}`} />
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="font-semibold">{displayLabel}</span>
      {pingMs !== undefined && (
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">
          ({pingMs}ms)
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";

export interface StepSliderProps {
  /** Discrete stops, e.g. ["+0k", "+1k", "+5k"]. */
  steps: string[];
  /** Zero-based selected index. */
  value?: number;
  onChange?: (index: number, step: string) => void;
  /** Marks steps from index+1 as emphasized (paid tiers). */
  highlightFrom?: number;
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StepSlider: React.FC<StepSliderProps> = ({
  steps,
  value = 0,
  onChange,
  highlightFrom,
  label,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const count = steps.length;
  const lastIndex = count - 1;
  const ratio = count > 1 ? value / lastIndex : 0;
  const highlightIndex = highlightFrom === undefined ? lastIndex + 1 : highlightFrom;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      {label && (
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{label}</p>
      )}
      <div
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
        aria-label={label || "Step slider"}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={lastIndex}
        aria-valuenow={value}
        aria-valuetext={steps[value]}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (disabled) return;
          if (event.key === "ArrowRight" && value < lastIndex) onChange?.(value + 1, steps[value + 1]);
          if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" && value > 0) onChange?.(value - 1, steps[value - 1]);
          if (event.key === "Home") onChange?.(0, steps[0]);
          if (event.key === "End") onChange?.(lastIndex, steps[lastIndex]);
        }}
        className="group relative flex cursor-pointer items-center pb-1 focus-visible:outline-none"
      >
        {/* Track */}
        <span className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        {/* Filled portion */}
        <span
          className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-[width] duration-150"
          style={{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }}
        />
        {/* Click targets + stops */}
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const reached = index <= value;
          const highlighted = index >= highlightIndex;
          return (
            <button
              key={step + index}
              type="button"
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-label={step}
              aria-pressed={index === value}
              onClick={(event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                onChange?.(index, step);
              }}
              className="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col items-center focus-visible:outline-none"
            >
              <span
                className={`h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${
                  reached
                    ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600"
                    : highlighted
                      ? "border-indigo-300 bg-white dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                      : "border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                } ${disabled ? "opacity-50" : ""}`}
              />
              <span
                className={`mt-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] ${
                  index === value
                    ? "font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
                    : "text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default StepSlider;

====/File: react/Stepper.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type StepperStatus = "complete" | "current" | "upcoming" | "error";

export interface StepperStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: StepperStatus;
}

export interface StepperProps {
  steps: StepperStep[];
  /** 1-based index of the current step; steps before it render complete unless status overrides. */
  current?: number;
  onStepClick?: (step: StepperStep, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const statusFor = (step: StepperStep, index: number, current: number): StepperStatus =>
  step.status ?? (index + 1 < current ? "complete" : index + 1 === current ? "current" : "upcoming");

const CIRCLE: Record<StepperStatus, { cls: string; icon?: UiIconName }> = {
  complete: { cls: "bg-indigo-600 text-white", icon: "check" },
  current: { cls: "border-2 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" },
  upcoming: { cls: "border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700" },
  error: { cls: "bg-rose-500 text-white", icon: "x" },
};

export const Stepper: React.FC<StepperProps> = ({ steps, current = 1, onStepClick, className = "" }) => {
  return (
    <ol className={`flex items-start ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const status = statusFor(step, index, current);
        const styles = CIRCLE[status];
        const last = index === steps.length - 1;
        const clickable = onStepClick && status !== "upcoming";
        return (
          <li key={step.id} className={`flex min-w-0 ${last ? "flex-none" : "flex-1"}`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={!clickable}
                onClick={() => clickable && onStepClick?.(step, index)}
                aria-current={status === "current" ? "step" : undefined}
                className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-default ${styles.cls}`}
              >
                {styles.icon ? <UiIcon name={styles.icon} size={12} /> : index + 1}
              </button>
              <div className="max-w-28">
                <p
                  className={`text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight ${
                    status === "upcoming"
                      ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                      : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {step.label}
                </p>
                {step.description && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{step.description}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {!last && (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`mt-3.5 h-0.5 flex-1 rounded ${
                  status === "complete" ? "bg-indigo-600" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                } ${index === 0 ? "ml-2" : "ml-2"} mr-2`}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
};

export default Stepper;

====/File: react/StreamMarkdown.tsx/====

import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { marked } from "marked";
import Prism from "prismjs";
import "prismjs/themes/prism-tomorrow.css";
import { Check, Copy } from "./UiIcon";

export interface StreamMarkdownProps {
  content: string;
  isStreaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StreamMarkdown: React.FC<StreamMarkdownProps> = ({
  content,
  isStreaming = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Configure marked renderer for syntax highlighting & clean markup
  const htmlContent = useMemo(() => {
    const renderer = new marked.Renderer();

    renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }: { text: string; lang?: string }) {
      const language = lang && Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
      let highlighted = text;
      try {
        if (Prism.languages[language]) {
          highlighted = Prism.highlight(text, Prism.languages[language], language);
        }
      } catch {
        highlighted = text;
      }

      return `
        <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
            <span>${lang || "code"}</span>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
              class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
            >
              Copy
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
        </div>
      `;
    };

    return marked.parse(content || "", { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
  }, [content]);

  // Delegated safe copy handler (CSP safe, avoids inline onclick)
  const handleContainerClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest(".copy-btn");
    if (!target) return;
    const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
    if (rawCode) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
      target.textContent = "Copied";
      setTimeout(() => {
        target.textContent = "Copy";
      }, 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onClick={handleContainerClick}
      className={`prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: htmlContent }}
        className="inline-block w-full"
      />
      {isStreaming && (
        <span className="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";

export interface StreamingProgressBarProps {
  value?: number | null;
  label?: string;
  status?: "streaming" | "done" | "error";
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  streaming: "bg-indigo-500",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
};

export const StreamingProgressBar: React.FC<StreamingProgressBarProps> = ({
  value = null,
  label,
  status = "streaming",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const clamped = value === null || value === undefined ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  const indeterminate = clamped === null;
  const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      {(label || !indeterminate) && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
          <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
          {!indeterminate && <span className="tabular-nums shrink-0">{Math.round(clamped)}%</span>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
        aria-valuenow={indeterminate ? undefined : Math.round(clamped)}
        aria-label={label || "Progress"}
        className="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >
        {indeterminate ? (
          <div className={`h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse`} />
        ) : (
          <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}`} style={{ width: `${clamped}%` }} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default StreamingProgressBar;
