import React from "react";

export interface SuccessToastProps {
  message: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  duration?: number;
  position?: "top-right" | "bottom-right";
  className?: string;
}

const CHECK_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16Zm-1.2-5.4 5-5-1.13-1.13L8.8 10.34 7.33 8.87 6.2 10l2.6 2.6Z" />
  </svg>
);

const CLOSE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * SuccessToast - self-dismissing mint confirmation toast with check icon and close button for copy/success feedback.
 */
export default function SuccessToast({
  message,
  icon,
  onClose,
  duration = 3000,
  position = "top-right",
  className = "",
}: SuccessToastProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setVisible(true);
    if (duration > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), duration);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message, duration]);

  if (!visible) return null;
  const posClass = position === "bottom-right" ? "bottom-4" : "top-4";

  return (
    <div
      data-success-toast
      className={`fixed right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm dark:bg-emerald-950 ${posClass} ${className}`}
      role="status"
    >
      <span className="shrink-0 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">{icon || CHECK_SVG}</span>
      <span className="text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{message}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-toast-close
        title="Dismiss"
        onClick={() => {
          setVisible(false);
          onClose?.();
        }}
        className="ml-1 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-emerald-800/70 hover:bg-emerald-200 hover:text-emerald-900 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900"
      >
        {CLOSE_SVG}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface SystemPromptEditorProps {
  title?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  version?: string;
  savedValue?: string;
  variables?: string[];
  temperature?: number;
  onSave?: (text: string) => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  onTemperatureChange?: (value: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TOKENS_PER_CHAR = 0.25;

/**
 * SystemPromptEditor - Agent studio prompt editor: textarea with live token
 * estimate, {{variable}} chips, temperature slider and save/reset actions.
 */
export default function SystemPromptEditor({
  title = "System prompt",
  value: valueProp = "",
  placeholder = "You are a helpful assistant that…",
  version = "v3",
  savedValue,
  variables = [],
  temperature,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onTemperatureChange,
  className = "",
}: SystemPromptEditorProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(valueProp);
  const dirty = savedValue !== undefined ? draft !== savedValue : draft !== valueProp;
  const tokens = Math.max(1, Math.round(draft.length * TOKENS_PER_CHAR));

  return (
    <div data-prompt-editor className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {title}
          <span data-editor-version className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{version}</span>
        </p>
        <span data-editor-state className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${dirty ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
          {dirty ? "Unsaved changes" : "Saved"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <textarea
        data-editor-textarea
        value={draft}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        rows={6}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        className="mt-3 w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
      />
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span data-editor-tokens>~{tokens} tokens · {draft.length} chars</span>
        {variables.length > 0 && (
          <span data-editor-variables className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {variables.map((v) => (
              <code key={v} className="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{`{{${v}}}`}</code>
            ))}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {typeof temperature === "number" && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
          <label className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" htmlFor="prompt-editor-temp">Temperature</label>
          <input
            id="prompt-editor-temp"
            data-editor-temperature
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={2}
            step={0.1}
            value={temperature}
            onChange={(e) => onTemperatureChange?.(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-200 accent-indigo-600 dark:bg-zinc-700"
          />
          <span data-editor-temp-value className="w-8 text-right font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{temperature.toFixed(1)}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-editor-reset
          onClick={() => {
            setDraft(savedValue ?? valueProp);
            onReset?.();
          }}
          className="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          Reset
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-editor-save
          disabled={!dirty}
          onClick={() => onSave?.(draft)}
          className="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Save prompt
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/Tabs.tsx/====

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface TabsProps {
  tabs: TabItem[];
  /** Controlled active tab id. Omit for uncontrolled behavior. */
  activeId?: string;
  defaultActiveId?: string;
  variant?: "underline" | "pills";
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const BASE_TAB =
  "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

export const Tabs: React.FC<TabsProps> = ({
  tabs,
  activeId,
  defaultActiveId,
  variant = "underline",
  onChange,
  ariaLabel = "Tabs",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [internalId, setInternalId] = useState(defaultActiveId ?? tabs[0]?.id ?? "");
  const current = activeId ?? internalId;
  const refs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null>>({});
  const isPills = variant === "pills";

  const select = (tab: TabItem) => {
    if (tab.disabled) return;
    if (activeId === undefined) setInternalId(tab.id);
    onChange?.(tab.id);
  };

  const move = (event: React.KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
    const keys = ["ArrowRight", "ArrowLeft", "Home", "End"];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const enabled = tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
    if (enabled.length === 0) return;
    const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
    let next = position;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    if (event.key === "End") next = enabled.length - 1;
    const target = enabled[next];
    if (target) {
      select(target.tab);
      refs.current[target.tab.id]?.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      className={
        isPills
          ? `inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800 ${className}`
          : `flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 ${className}`
      }
    >
      {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
        const active = tab.id === current;
        const tone = isPills
          ? active
            ? "bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
            : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          : active
            ? "-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400"
            : "-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200";
        const shape = isPills ? "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5" : "border-b-2 px-3 py-2";
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            ref={(node) => {
              refs.current[tab.id] = node;
            }}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id={`tab-${tab.id}`}
            aria-selected={active}
            aria-controls={`panel-${tab.id}`}
            tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
            disabled={tab.disabled}
            onClick={() => select(tab)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, index)}
            className={`${BASE_TAB} ${shape} ${tone}`}
          >
            {tab.icon && <UiIcon name={tab.icon} size={13} />}
            <span>{tab.label}</span>
            {tab.badge !== undefined && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {tab.badge}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Tabs;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type TagTone = "neutral" | "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "rose" | "sky";
export type TagSize = "sm" | "md";

export interface TagProps {
  label: string;
  tone?: TagTone;
  size?: TagSize;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  removable?: boolean;
  onRemove?: () => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE: Record<TagTone, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
  indigo: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  amber: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  rose: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  sky: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300",
};

export const Tag: React.FC<TagProps> = ({ label, tone = "neutral", size = "md", icon, removable = false, onRemove, onClick, className = "" }) => {
  const sizing = size === "sm" ? "px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px]" : "px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px]";
  const content = (
    <>
      {icon && <UiIcon name={icon} size={size === "sm" ? 10 : 11} className="shrink-0 opacity-70" />}
      <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
      {removable && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`Remove ${label}`}
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            onRemove?.();
          }}
          className="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-current dark:hover:bg-white/10"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={size === "sm" ? 9 : 10} />
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );

  const cls = `inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full font-medium ${TONE[tone]} ${sizing} ${className}`;

  if (onClick) {
    return (
      <button type="button" onClick={onClick} className={`${cls} cursor-pointer transition-opacity hover:opacity-80 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500`}>
        {content}
      </button>
    );
  }
  return <span className={cls}>{content}</span>;
};

export default Tag;

import React from "react";

export interface TargetGaugeZone {
  /** Raw start of the zone on the 0–100 scale. */
  from: number;
  tone: "rose" | "amber" | "emerald";
}

export interface TargetGaugeProps {
  value: number;
  target: number;
  label?: string;
  valuePrefix?: string;
  valueSuffix?: string;
  zones?: TargetGaugeZone[];
  remainingLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const ZONE_COLOR: Record<NonNullable<TargetGaugeZone["tone"]>, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
};

const clamp01 = (value: number) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));

export const TargetGauge: React.FC<TargetGaugeProps> = ({
  value,
  target,
  label = "Progress",
  valuePrefix = "",
  valueSuffix = "",
  zones = [
    { from: 0, tone: "rose" },
    { from: 60, tone: "amber" },
    { from: 85, tone: "emerald" },
  ],
  remainingLabel,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const percent = target > 0 ? (value / target) * 100 : 0;
  const angle = (clamp01(percent) / 100) * 180 - 90;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, target - value);
  const sorted = [...zones].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
  const segments = sorted.map((zone, index) => {
    const end = index + 1 < sorted.length ? sorted[index + 1].from : 100;
    return { ...zone, width: `${Math.max(0, end - zone.from)}%` };
  });
  const currentTone = [...segments].reverse().find((zone) => clamp01(percent) >= zone.from)?.tone || "rose";

  return (
    <div
      data-target-gauge
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${label}: ${valuePrefix}${value}${valueSuffix} of ${valuePrefix}${target}${valueSuffix}`}
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{label}</p>
      <div className="relative mx-auto mt-3 h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Zone band (top half of a 140px circle) */}
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden rounded-t-full">
          {segments.map((zone, index) => (
            <span key={index} className={`h-full ${ZONE_COLOR[zone.tone]}`} style={{ width: zone.width }} />
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Inner cut-out to make it an arc */}
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-[18px] h-[52px] w-[104px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-t-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900" />
        {/* Needle */}
        <div
          data-gauge-needle
          className="absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 h-[54px] w-0.5 origin-bottom bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100"
          style={{ transform: `rotate(${angle}deg)` }}
        >
          <span className="absolute -top-[3px] left-1/2 h-2 w-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
        </div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-[-4px] left-1/2 h-3 w-3 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
        <span>
          {valuePrefix}0{valueSuffix}
        </span>
        <span
          className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white ${ZONE_COLOR[currentTone]}`}
          data-gauge-value
        >
          {valuePrefix}
          {value}
          {valueSuffix}
        </span>
        <span>
          {valuePrefix}
          {target}
          {valueSuffix}
        </span>
      </div>
      {remainingLabel ? (
        <p className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {remaining > 0 ? `Remaining: ${valuePrefix}${remaining}${valueSuffix} — ` : ""}
          {remainingLabel}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <span className="hidden" data-gauge-percent>
        {Math.round(percent)}%
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TargetGauge;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface Testimonial {
  id: string;
  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  company?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  /** 1–5; omitted hides the star row. */
  rating?: number;
}

export interface TestimonialGridProps {
  testimonials?: Testimonial[];
  columns?: 2 | 3;
  onSelect?: (testimonial: Testimonial) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const COLUMN_CLASS: Record<2 | 3, string> = {
  2: "sm:grid-cols-2",
  3: "sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3",
};

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const TestimonialGrid: React.FC<TestimonialGridProps> = ({
  testimonials = [],
  columns = 3,
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (testimonials.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-200 p-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500 ${className}`}
      >
        No testimonials yet.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`grid gap-4 ${COLUMN_CLASS[columns]} ${className}`}>
      {testimonials.map((testimonial) => {
        const rating = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(testimonial.rating ?? 0)));
        return (
          <figure
            key={testimonial.id}
            onClick={() => onSelect?.(testimonial)}
            className="flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          >
            {rating > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label={`${rating} out of 5 stars`}>
                {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (
                  <UiIcon
                    key={index}
                    name="star"
                    size={13}
                    className={index < rating ? "text-amber-500" : "text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700"}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            <blockquote className="mt-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              “{testimonial.quote}”
            </blockquote>

            <figcaption className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              {testimonial.avatar ? (
                <img
                  src={testimonial.avatar}
                  alt=""
                  className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover"
                />
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  {initials(testimonial.name)}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {testimonial.name}
                </span>
                {(testimonial.role || testimonial.company) && (
                  <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                    {[testimonial.role, testimonial.company].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
            </figcaption>
          </figure>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

====/File: react/ThemeToggle.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Sun, Moon, Monitor } from "./UiIcon";

export type ThemeMode = "auto" | "light" | "dark";

export interface ThemeToggleProps {
  storageKey?: string;
  onChange?: (mode: ThemeMode, resolved: "light" | "dark") => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const ThemeToggle: React.FC<ThemeToggleProps> = ({
  storageKey = "mango-theme",
  onChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>("auto");

  const resolveTheme = (m: ThemeMode): "light" | "dark" => {
    if (m === "light" || m === "dark") return m;
    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const isNight =
      (typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches) ||
      hour >= 19 ||
      hour < 7;
    return isNight ? "dark" : "light";
  };

  const applyTheme = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    const resolved = resolveTheme(nextMode);
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
    document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
    if (resolved === "dark") {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
    }
    setMode(nextMode);
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, nextMode);
    if (onChange) onChange(nextMode, resolved);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) as ThemeMode) || "auto";
    applyTheme(saved);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none ${className}`}
      role="group"
      aria-label="Theme toggle"
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => applyTheme("auto")}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
          mode === "auto"
            ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold"
            : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
        }`}
        title="Follow System/Time"
      >
        <Monitor className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span>Auto</span>
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => applyTheme("light")}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
          mode === "light"
            ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold"
            : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
        }`}
        title="Light Mode"
      >
        <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span>Light</span>
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => applyTheme("dark")}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
          mode === "dark"
            ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold"
            : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
        }`}
        title="Dark Mode"
      >
        <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span>Dark</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Sparkles } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ThinkingStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface ThinkingBlockProps {
  content: string;
  isThinking?: boolean;
  durationSeconds?: number;
  steps?: ThinkingStep[];
  defaultExpanded?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => {
  if (typeof ms !== "number") return "";
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};

export const ThinkingBlock: React.FC<ThinkingBlockProps> = ({
  content,
  isThinking = false,
  durationSeconds,
  steps = [],
  defaultExpanded = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded || isThinking);

  if (!content && !isThinking && steps.length === 0) return null;

  const runningStep = steps.find((step) => !step.durationMs);
  const collapsedSummary =
    runningStep?.label ||
    (durationSeconds ? `Thought for ${durationSeconds}s` : "Thought process");

  return (
    <div
      className={`my-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 text-xs overflow-hidden transition-all ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header Bar */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
        aria-expanded={isExpanded}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 hover:bg-zinc-100/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium transition-colors select-none text-left"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Sparkles
            className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
              isThinking ? "text-amber-500 animate-spin" : "text-zinc-400"
            }`}
          />
          <span>
            {isThinking
              ? "Deeply thinking..."
              : durationSeconds
              ? `Thought for ${durationSeconds}s`
              : "Thought process"}
          </span>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isExpanded ? "rotate-180" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Collapsed summary row: running step or last finished step */}
      {!isExpanded && (runningStep || steps.length > 0) && (
        <div className="px-3.5 pb-2.5 -mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {runningStep ? (
            <>
              <span className="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span className="truncate">{runningStep.label}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <span className="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
              <span className="truncate">{steps[steps.length - 1].label}</span>
              {steps[steps.length - 1].durationMs !== undefined && (
                <span className="tabular-nums">{formatDuration(steps[steps.length - 1].durationMs)}</span>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Expandable Reasoning Content */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 bg-white/40 dark:bg-zinc-950/20">
          {steps.length > 0 && (
            <ol className="px-4 pt-3 pb-1">
              {steps.map((step, index) => {
                const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
                const done = typeof step.durationMs === "number";
                return (
                  <li key={step.id} className="relative pl-5">
                    {!isLast && (
                      <span
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className="absolute left-[5px] top-4 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                      />
                    )}
                    <span className="absolute left-0 top-1.5">
                      {done ? (
                        <span className="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                      ) : (
                        <span className="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <div className="pb-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className={`truncate ${done ? "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"}`}>
                        {step.label}
                      </span>
                      {step.durationMs !== undefined && (
                        <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                          {formatDuration(step.durationMs)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          )}
          <div
            className={`px-4 py-3 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px] ${
              steps.length > 0 ? "border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50" : ""
            }`}
          >
            {content || <span className="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ThinkingBlock;

import React from "react";

export interface TimeSlot {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  period?: "morning" | "afternoon" | "evening";
  available?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface SlotDay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  weekday: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  slots: TimeSlot[];
}

export interface TimeSlotPickerProps {
  days: SlotDay[];
  value?: { dayId: string; slotId: string } | null;
  timezone?: string;
  daysLabel?: string;
  slotsLabel?: string;
  onSelect?: (value: { dayId: string; slotId: string; slot: TimeSlot }) => void;
}

const PERIOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  morning: "Morning",
  afternoon: "Afternoon",
  evening: "Evening",
};

/**
 * TimeSlotPicker - date strip plus grouped time-slot list with availability counts for appointment booking.
 */
export default function TimeSlotPicker({
  days,
  value = null,
  timezone,
  daysLabel = "Date",
  slotsLabel = "Select a time",
  onSelect,
}: TimeSlotPickerProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(value);
  const [activeDayId, setActiveDayId] = React.useState(
    value?.dayId || days.find((day) => !day.disabled)?.id || days[0]?.id || "",
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (value) {
      setSelected(value);
      setActiveDayId(value.dayId);
    }
  }, [value]);

  const activeDay = days.find((day) => day.id === activeDayId) || days[0];

  const choose = (slot: TimeSlot) => {
    if (slot.disabled) return;
    const next = { dayId: activeDayId, slotId: slot.id };
    setSelected(next);
    onSelect?.({ ...next, slot });
  };

  return (
    <div data-time-slot-picker className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{daysLabel}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-3">
          {days.map((day) => {
            const active = day.id === activeDayId;
            return (
              <button
                key={day.id}
                type="button"
                data-slot-day={day.id}
                disabled={day.disabled}
                onClick={() => setActiveDayId(day.id)}
                className={`min-w-[64px] rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
                  active
                    ? "bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900"
                    : "bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="block text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70">{day.weekday}</span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-semibold">{day.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <p data-slot-heading className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
            {slotsLabel}
            {activeDay ? <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-zinc-400">· {activeDay.weekday} {activeDay.label}</span> : null}
          </p>
          {timezone ? <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{timezone}</span> : null}
        </div>
        {activeDay ? (
          <div data-slot-periods className="mt-3 space-y-4">
            {["morning", "afternoon", "evening"].map((period) => {
              const slots = activeDay.slots.filter((slot) => (slot.period || "morning") === period);
              if (!slots.length) return null;
              return (
                <div key={period}>
                  <p className="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{PERIOD_LABELS[period]}</p>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
                    {slots.map((slot) => {
                      const isSelected = selected?.dayId === activeDayId && selected?.slotId === slot.id;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={slot.id}
                          type="button"
                          data-time-slot={slot.id}
                          disabled={slot.disabled}
                          onClick={() => choose(slot)}
                          className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
                            isSelected
                              ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/60"
                              : "border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className={`block text-xs font-semibold ${isSelected ? "text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"}`}>{slot.label}</span>
                          {slot.available != null ? (
                            <span className={`mt-0.5 block text-[10px] ${slot.available > 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>
                              {slot.available > 0 ? `${slot.available} available` : "Fully booked"}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface TimeframePickerProps {
  presets?: string[];
  value?: string;
  rangeLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onStep?: (direction: -1 | 1, value: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const TimeframePicker: React.FC<TimeframePickerProps> = ({
  presets = ["Today", "7d", "30d", "90d", "12mo"],
  value,
  rangeLabel,
  disabled = false,
  onChange,
  onStep,
  className = "",
}) => {

  return (
    <div

              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${

            >
              {preset}

        })}
      </div>

        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-left" size={13} />
        </button>
        {rangeLabel ? (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-x border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
            <UiIcon name="calendar" size={12} className="text-zinc-400" />

          </span>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"

====/File: react/ToastStack.tsx/====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string | number;
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";
}

export interface ToastStackProps {
  toasts: ToastItem[];
  onDismiss?: (id: string | number) => void;
  duration?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const TYPE_META: Record<string, { icon: UiIconName; color: string; bar: string }> = {
  success: { icon: "check-circle", color: "text-emerald-500", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", color: "text-rose-500", bar: "bg-rose-500" },
  warning: { icon: "alert-triangle", color: "text-amber-500", bar: "bg-amber-500" },
  info: { icon: "sparkles", color: "text-sky-500", bar: "bg-sky-500" },
};

const ToastCard: React.FC<{
  toast: ToastItem;
  duration: number;
  onDismiss?: (id: string | number) => void;
}> = ({ toast, duration, onDismiss }) => {
  const onDismissRef = useRef(onDismiss);
  onDismissRef.current = onDismiss;
  // 100 → 0 over `duration` ms; paused while hovering. duration <= 0 = sticky.
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(duration > 0 ? 100 : 0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (duration <= 0) return;
    if (paused) return;
    const started = Date.now();
    const remainingPct = remaining;
    const total = (duration * remainingPct) / 100;
    if (total <= 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setRemaining(0);
      onDismissRef.current?.(toast.id);
    }, total);
    const raf = setInterval(() => {
      const left = Math.max(0, 100 - ((Date.now() - started) / total) * remainingPct);
      setRemaining(left);
    }, 100);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      clearInterval(raf);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [toast.id, duration, paused]);

  const meta = TYPE_META[toast.type || "info"] || TYPE_META.info;

  return (
    <div
      className="relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 animate-in slide-in-from-right fade-in duration-200"
      role="alert"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
    >
      <UiIcon name={meta.icon} size={16} className={`${meta.color} shrink-0`} />
      <span className="flex-1 min-w-0">{toast.message}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onDismiss?.(toast.id)}
        className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0"
        aria-label="Dismiss"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
      </button>
      {duration > 0 && (
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 ${meta.bar} transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear`}
          style={{ width: `${remaining}%` }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const ToastStack: React.FC<ToastStackProps> = ({
  toasts = [],
  onDismiss,
  duration = 4000,
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (toasts.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] ${className}`}
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      {toasts.map((t) => (
        <ToastCard key={t.id} toast={t} duration={duration} onDismiss={onDismiss} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
export default ToastStack;

====/File: react/ToggleSwitch.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface ToggleSwitchProps {
  checked: boolean;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  label?: string;
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  className?: string;
}

export const ToggleSwitch: React.FC<ToggleSwitchProps> = ({
  checked,
  onChange,
  label,
  description,
  disabled = false,
  size = "md",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const track = size === "sm" ? "h-4 w-8" : "h-5 w-9";
  const knob = size === "sm" ? "h-3 w-3" : "h-4 w-4";
  const shift = size === "sm" ? "translate-x-4" : "translate-x-4";

  const control = (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={checked ? "true" : "false"}
      aria-label={label}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={() => onChange?.(!checked)}
      className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors duration-200 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-white dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
        checked ? "bg-indigo-600" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
      } ${track}`}
    >
      <span
        className={`inline-block transform rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform duration-200 ${
          checked ? shift : "translate-x-0.5"
        } ${knob}`}
      />
    </button>
  );

  if (!label && !description) {
    return <span className={`inline-flex ${className}`}>{control}</span>;
  }

  return (
    <label className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 ${disabled ? "opacity-60" : ""} ${className}`}>
      {control}
      <span className="min-w-0">
        {label && <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{label}</span>}
        {description && (
          <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</span>
        )}
      </span>
    </label>
  );
};

export default ToggleSwitch;

import React from "react";

export interface TokenCostSegment {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  amountUsd: number;
  color?: string;
}

export interface TokenUsageRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  tokens: number;
  percent: number;
  barColor?: string;
}

export interface TokenCostBreakdownProps {
  segments: TokenCostSegment[];
  usageRows?: TokenUsageRow[];
  title?: string;
  spendUsed?: number;
  spendTotal?: number;
  className?: string;
  onSegmentSelect?: (segment: TokenCostSegment) => void;
}

const defaultColors = ["bg-zinc-500", "bg-emerald-500", "bg-amber-500", "bg-sky-500", "bg-violet-500", "bg-rose-500"];

const segColor = (segment: TokenCostSegment, index: number) =>
  segment.color ?? defaultColors[index % defaultColors.length];

const fmtUsd = (usd: number) =>
  usd >= 100 ? `$${usd.toFixed(0)}` : usd >= 1 ? `$${usd.toFixed(2)}` : `$${usd.toFixed(3)}`;

const fmtTokens = (tokens: number) => tokens.toLocaleString("en-US");

/**
 * TokenCostBreakdown - stacked spend bar with per-segment legend and
 * token usage rows (Cofounder spend / OpenAI usage pattern).
 */
export default function TokenCostBreakdown({
  segments,
  usageRows = [],
  title = "Spend breakdown",
  spendUsed,
  spendTotal,
  className = "",
  onSegmentSelect,
}: TokenCostBreakdownProps) {
  const totalUsd = segments.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.amountUsd, 0);
  const used = typeof spendUsed === "number" ? spendUsed : totalUsd;
  const percent = spendTotal && spendTotal > 0 ? Math.min((used / spendTotal) * 100, 100) : 100;

  return (
    <div
      data-token-cost
      className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {spendTotal ? `${fmtUsd(used)} of ${fmtUsd(spendTotal)}` : fmtUsd(totalUsd)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div data-token-cost-bar className="mt-3 flex h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        {segments.map((segment, index) => {
          const width = totalUsd > 0 ? (segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * percent : 0;
          return (
            <span
              key={segment.id}
              data-token-cost-segment={segment.id}
              onClick={() => onSegmentSelect?.(segment)}
              className={`h-full ${segColor(segment, index)} ${onSegmentSelect ? "cursor-pointer" : ""}`}
              style={{ width: `${width}%` }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div data-token-cost-legend className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
        {segments.map((segment, index) => (
          <div
            key={segment.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs"
          >
            <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-sm ${segColor(segment, index)}`} />
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{segment.label}</span>
            <span className="tabular-nums font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{fmtUsd(segment.amountUsd)}</span>
            <span className="w-12 text-right tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
              {totalUsd > 0 ? `${Math.round((segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * 100)}%` : "—"}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {usageRows.length > 0 && (
        <div data-token-usage className="mt-4 space-y-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            Token usage
          </p>
          {usageRows.map((row) => (
            <div key={row.id} data-token-usage-row={row.id}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{row.label}</span>
                <span className="tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {fmtTokens(row.tokens)} ({row.percent}%)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                <div
                  data-token-usage-bar
                  className={`h-full rounded-full ${row.barColor ?? "bg-sky-500"}`}
                  style={{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(row.percent, 0), 100)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export type ToolApprovalStatus = "pending" | "approved" | "rejected";

export interface ToolApprovalCardProps {

  description?: string;
  args?: Record<string, unknown> | string;
  risk?: "low" | "high";
  status?: ToolApprovalStatus;

export const ToolApprovalCard: React.FC<ToolApprovalCardProps> = ({
  toolName,
  description,
  args,
  risk = "low",
  status = "pending",
  onApprove,
  onReject,

  return (
    <div

          }`}
        >
          <UiIcon name={isHigh ? "lock" : "tool"} size={15} />

              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          {description && <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate">{description}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>

          {argsText}
        </pre>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 pb-3">
        {status === "pending" ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"

            >
              <UiIcon name="x" size={13} />
              Reject
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium ${
              status === "approved" ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
            }`}
          >
            <UiIcon name={status === "approved" ? "check-circle" : "circle-x"} size={14} />

import React from "react";

export interface ToolParameter {
  name: string;
  type: "string" | "number" | "boolean";
  required?: boolean;
}

export interface ToolSchema {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  method?: string;
  endpoint?: string;
  parameters?: ToolParameter[];
}

export interface ToolSchemaEditorProps {
  title?: string;
  tools: ToolSchema[];
  onValidate?: (tool: ToolSchema) => void;
  onToggle?: (tool: ToolSchema, enabled: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TYPE_BADGE: Record<string, string> = {
  string: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300",
  number: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300",
  boolean: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
};

/**
 * ToolSchemaEditor - Agent tool registry: function/tool cards with method +
 * endpoint, typed parameter lists and per-tool validate / enable toggles.
 */
export default function ToolSchemaEditor({
  title = "Tools & functions",
  tools,
  onValidate,
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}: ToolSchemaEditorProps) {
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  return (
    <div data-tool-editor className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <span data-tool-count className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {tools.filter((t) => !disabled[t.id]).length}/{tools.length} enabled
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
        {tools.map((tool) => {
          const off = !!disabled[tool.id];
          return (
            <div
              key={tool.id}
              data-tool-card={tool.id}
              className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-3 transition-colors ${
                off
                  ? "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 opacity-60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40"
                  : "border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <code data-tool-name className="truncate font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{tool.name}</code>
                    {tool.method && (
                      <span data-tool-method className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tool.method === "GET" ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" : "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"}`}>{tool.method}</span>
                    )}
                  </p>
                  {tool.endpoint && <code data-tool-endpoint className="mt-0.5 block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{tool.endpoint}</code>}
                  {tool.description && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{tool.description}</p>}
                </div>
                <label className="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center" title={off ? "Enable tool" : "Disable tool"}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    data-tool-toggle
                    checked={!off}
                    onChange={() => {
                      const next = !off;
                      setDisabled((d) => ({ ...d, [tool.id]: !next }));

                    className="peer sr-only"

                  </span>

              </div>
              {tool.parameters && tool.parameters.length > 0 && (
                <div data-tool-params className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  {tool.parameters.map((param) => (
                    <span key={param.name} data-tool-param={param.name} className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold ${TYPE_BADGE[param.type] || TYPE_BADGE.string}`}>
                      {param.name}
                      <span className="font-normal opacity-70">{param.type}</span>
                      {param.required && <span className="font-bold text-red-500" title="required">*</span>}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="mt-2 flex justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-tool-validate
                  onClick={() => onValidate?.(tool)}
                  className="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"

                  Validate schema

import React, { useId } from "react";

export type TooltipSide = "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";

export interface TooltipProps {
  content: string;
  side?: TooltipSide;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const SIDE_CLASS: Record<TooltipSide, string> = {
  top: "bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  bottom: "top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  left: "right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2",
  right: "left-full top-1/2 ml-1.5 -translate-y-1/2",
};

export const Tooltip: React.FC<TooltipProps> = ({ content, side = "top", children, className = "" }) => {
  const id = useId();

  return (
    <span className={`group relative inline-flex ${className}`} aria-describedby={id}>
      {children}
      <span
        id={id}
        role="tooltip"
        className={`pointer-events-none absolute z-30 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 ${SIDE_CLASS[side]}`}
      >
        {content}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
};

export default Tooltip;

import React from "react";
export interface TourTooltipProps {
  step: number;
  totalSteps: number;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  theme?: "light" | "dark";
  caret?: "top" | "bottom" | "none";
  feedback?: boolean;
  onPrev?: () => void;
  onNext?: () => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  onFeedback?: (helpful: boolean) => void;
}

/**
 * TourTooltip - anchored coach mark with step counter, prev/next flow and optional thumbs feedback.
 */
export default function TourTooltip({
  step,
  totalSteps,
  title,
  body,
  theme = "light",
  caret = "top",
  feedback = false,
  onPrev,
  onNext,
  onDismiss,
  onFeedback,
}: TourTooltipProps) {
  const dark = theme === "dark";
  const surface = dark
    ? "bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-50 border-zinc-700"
    : "bg-white text-zinc-900 border-zinc-200";
  const bodyTone = dark ? "text-zinc-300" : "text-zinc-500";
  const caretClass =
    caret === "top"
      ? "before:absolute before:-top-1.5 before:left-8 before:h-3 before:w-3 before:rotate-45 before:rounded-[2px] before:border-l before:border-t"
      : caret === "bottom"
        ? "after:absolute after:-bottom-1.5 after:left-8 after:h-3 after:w-3 after:rotate-45 after:rounded-[2px] after:border-r after:border-b"
        : "";
  const caretBorder = dark ? "before:border-zinc-700 after:border-zinc-700" : "before:border-zinc-200 after:border-zinc-200";
  const caretBg = dark ? "before:bg-zinc-900 after:bg-zinc-900" : "before:bg-white after:bg-white";

  return (
    <div
      data-tour-tooltip
      className={`relative w-80 rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-xl ${surface} ${caretClass} ${caretBorder} ${caretBg}`}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label={title}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <p className={`text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${dark ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>
          Step {step} of {totalSteps}
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-tour-dismiss
          aria-label="Dismiss"
          onClick={() => onDismiss?.()}
          className={`rounded-md p-0.5 transition-colors ${dark ? "text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-200" : "text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600"}`}
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4">
            <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-bold leading-snug">{title}</p>
      <p className={`mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed ${bodyTone}`}>{body}</p>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-3" style={{ borderColor: dark ? "rgb(63 63 70)" : "rgb(228 228 231)" }}>
        {feedback ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`text-[11px] ${dark ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-500"}`}>Was this helpful?</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-tour-feedback-up
              aria-label="Yes"
              onClick={() => onFeedback?.(true)}
              className={`rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? "border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800" : "border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50"}`}
            >
              👍
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-tour-feedback-down
              aria-label="No"
              onClick={() => onFeedback?.(false)}
              className={`rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? "border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800" : "border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50"}`}
            >
              👎
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <span className={`text-[11px] ${dark ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>
            {step}/{totalSteps}
          </span>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {step > 1 ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              data-tour-prev
              onClick={() => onPrev?.()}
              className={`text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${dark ? "text-zinc-300 hover:text-white" : "text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900"}`}
            >
              Previous
            </button>
          ) : null}
          <button
            type="button"
            data-tour-next
            onClick={() => onNext?.()}
            className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              step >= totalSteps ? "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500" : "bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-indigo-600 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500"
            }`}
          >
            {step >= totalSteps ? "Finish tour" : "Next"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/TraceSpanWaterfall.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export type TraceSpanKind = "llm" | "tool" | "retrieval";

export interface TraceSpan {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  startMs: number;
  durationMs: number;
  depth?: number;
  kind?: TraceSpanKind;
  costUsd?: number;
  tokens?: number;
}

export interface TraceSpanWaterfallProps {
  spans: TraceSpan[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onSpanSelect?: (span: TraceSpan) => void;
}

const kindColor = (kind?: TraceSpanKind) => {
  switch (kind) {
    case "tool":
      return "bg-emerald-500";
    case "retrieval":
      return "bg-amber-500";
    default:
      return "bg-indigo-500";
  }
};

const kindDot = (kind?: TraceSpanKind) => {
  switch (kind) {
    case "tool":
      return "bg-emerald-500";
    case "retrieval":
      return "bg-amber-500";
    default:
      return "bg-indigo-500";
  }
};

const formatDuration = (ms: number) =>
  ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;

const formatCost = (usd?: number) =>
  typeof usd === "number" ? `$${usd.toFixed(3)}` : "";

/**
 * TraceSpanWaterfall - horizontal span timeline for an agent/LLM trace
 * (Braintrust / Adaline monitor waterfall pattern).
 */
export default function TraceSpanWaterfall({
  spans,
  title = "Trace waterfall",
  className = "",
  onSpanSelect,
}: TraceSpanWaterfallProps) {
  const total =
    spans.length > 0
      ? Math.max(...spans.map((s) => s.startMs + s.durationMs))
      : 0;

  return (
    <div
      data-trace-waterfall
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {spans.length} spans · {formatDuration(total)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 py-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 pb-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${kindDot("llm")}`} /> LLM
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${kindDot("tool")}`} /> Tool
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${kindDot("retrieval")}`} /> Retrieval
          </span>
        </div>

        <div data-trace-rows className="space-y-1.5">
          {spans.map((span) => {
            const left = total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0;
            const width = total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0;
            const depth = span.depth ?? 0;
            return (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={span.id}
                data-trace-row={span.id}
                onClick={() => onSpanSelect?.(span)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <span
                  className="flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.max(120 - depth * 14, 88)}px`, paddingLeft: `${depth * 14}px` }}
                >
                  <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${kindDot(span.kind)}`} />
                  <span data-trace-name className="min-w-0 truncate">{span.name}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span
                    data-trace-bar
                    className={`absolute top-0.5 h-3 rounded-full ${kindColor(span.kind)}`}
                    style={{ left: `${left}%`, width: `${width}%` }}
                  />
                  <span
                    className="absolute top-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
                    style={{ left: `calc(${left + width}% + 6px)` }}
                  >
                    {formatDuration(span.durationMs)}
                    {formatCost(span.costUsd) ? ` · ${formatCost(span.costUsd)}` : ""}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface TrialBannerProps {
  planName?: string;
  daysLeft: number;
  message?: string;
  ctaText?: string;
  onCta?: () => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  tone?: "indigo" | "amber";
  className?: string;
}

const CLOSE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * TrialBanner - Later style trial countdown banner: days-left pill, unlock CTA and dismiss.
 */
export default function TrialBanner({
  planName = "Pro",
  daysLeft,
  message,
  ctaText = "Upgrade now",
  onCta,
  onDismiss,
  dismissible = false,
  tone = "indigo",
  className = "",
}: TrialBannerProps) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "amber"
      ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40"
      : "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40";
  const pillClass = tone === "amber" ? "bg-amber-500" : "bg-indigo-600";
  const urgent = daysLeft <= 3;
  return (
    <div
      data-trial-banner
      className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${toneClass} ${className}`}
    >
      <span
        data-trial-days
        className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white ${pillClass} ${urgent ? "animate-pulse" : ""}`}
      >
        {daysLeft} {daysLeft === 1 ? "day" : "days"} left
      </span>
      <span data-trial-message className="flex-1 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
        {message || `Your ${planName} trial ends soon — upgrade to keep ${planName} features.`}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-trial-cta
        onClick={() => onCta?.()}
        className="rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200"
      >
        {ctaText}
      </button>
      {(dismissible || onDismiss) && (
        <button
          type="button"
          data-trial-dismiss
          title="Dismiss"
          onClick={() => onDismiss?.()}
          className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          {CLOSE_SVG}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/TypingIndicator.tsx/====

import React from "react";

export interface TypingIndicatorProps {
  label?: string;
  variant?: "dots" | "pulse";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_MAP: Record<string, { dot: string; gap: string }> = {
  sm: { dot: "w-1.5 h-1.5", gap: "gap-1" },
  md: { dot: "w-2 h-2", gap: "gap-1.5" },
  lg: { dot: "w-2.5 h-2.5", gap: "gap-2" },
};

export const TypingIndicator: React.FC<TypingIndicatorProps> = ({
  label,
  variant = "dots",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const { dot, gap } = SIZE_MAP[size] || SIZE_MAP.md;

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${className}`}
      role="status"
      aria-label={label || "Loading"}
    >
      <span className={`inline-flex items-center ${gap}`}>
        {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
          <span
            key={i}
            className={`${dot} rounded-full bg-current ${
              variant === "pulse" ? "animate-pulse" : "animate-bounce"
            }`}
            style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 160}ms` }}
          />
        ))}
      </span>
      {label && <span className="text-xs font-sans">{label}</span>}
    </div>
  );
};
export default TypingIndicator;

import React from "react";

export interface CheckoutLineItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  amount: string;
  muted?: boolean;
  strikethrough?: boolean;
}

export interface UpgradeCheckoutPanelProps {
  title?: string;
  planName?: string;
  billingPeriod?: "monthly" | "annual";
  onBillingPeriodChange?: (period: "monthly" | "annual") => void;
  seats?: number;
  onSeatsChange?: (seats: number) => void;
  minSeats?: number;
  maxSeats?: number;
  lineItems: CheckoutLineItem[];
  totalLabel?: string;
  total: string;
  totalNote?: string;
  discountLabel?: string;
  discount?: string;
  confirmText?: string;

  onConfirm?: () => void;
  terms?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const MINUS_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M5.5 9.25h9v1.5h-9v-1.5Z" />
  </svg>
);

const PLUS_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M9.25 5.5h1.5v3.75h3.75v1.5h-3.75v3.75h-1.5v-3.75H5.5v-1.5h3.75V5.5Z" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * UpgradeCheckoutPanel - Clockwise/Attio style upgrade checkout: billing-period switch,
 * seat stepper, line-item summary with total and confirm CTA.
 */
export default function UpgradeCheckoutPanel({
  title = "Upgrade to the Teams plan",
  planName = "Teams",
  billingPeriod = "annual",
  onBillingPeriodChange,
  seats,
  onSeatsChange,
  minSeats = 1,
  maxSeats = 99,
  lineItems,
  totalLabel = "Total billed today",
  total,
  totalNote,
  discountLabel,
  discount,
  confirmText = "Confirm upgrade",
  processing = false,
  onConfirm,
  terms,
  className = "",
}: UpgradeCheckoutPanelProps) {
  const clampSeats = (n: number) => Math.min(maxSeats, Math.max(minSeats, n));
  return (
    <div data-upgrade-checkout className={`grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr] dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div>
        <h3 data-checkout-title className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h3>

        <p className="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Billing cadence</p>
        <div className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700">
          {(["monthly", "annual"] as const).map((period) => (
            <button
              key={period}
              type="button"
              data-checkout-period={period}
              onClick={() => onBillingPeriodChange?.(period)}
              className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${
                billingPeriod === period
                  ? "bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900"
                  : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {period === "annual" ? "Annual plan" : "Monthly plan"}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {seats !== undefined && (
          <>
            <p className="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Seats</p>
            <div data-checkout-seats className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                data-checkout-seat-minus
                title="Fewer seats"
                onClick={() => onSeatsChange?.(clampSeats(seats - 1))}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                disabled={seats <= minSeats}
              >
                {MINUS_SVG}
              </button>
              <span data-checkout-seat-count className="min-w-8 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{seats}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-checkout-seat-plus
                title="More seats"
                onClick={() => onSeatsChange?.(clampSeats(seats + 1))}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                disabled={seats >= maxSeats}
              >
                {PLUS_SVG}
              </button>
              <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${planName} plan · {billingPeriod === "annual" ? "billed annually" : "billed monthly"}</span>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-2.5">

                {item.amount}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface UpgradePromptCardProps {
  used: number;
  limit: number;
  planName?: string;
  unit?: string;
  title?: string;
  features?: string[];
  ctaText?: string;
  onUpgrade?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const formatNumber = (value: number) => (typeof value === "number" ? value.toLocaleString("en-US") : String(value));

export const UpgradePromptCard: React.FC<UpgradePromptCardProps> = ({
  used,
  limit,
  planName = "Free",
  unit = "requests",
  title = "Upgrade to keep going",
  features = [],
  ctaText = "See plans",
  onUpgrade,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const safeLimit = limit > 0 ? limit : 1;
  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((used / safeLimit) * 100)));
  const tone =
    percent >= 90
      ? { bar: "bg-red-500", text: "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40" }
      : percent >= 70
        ? { bar: "bg-amber-500", text: "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400", chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40" }
        : { bar: "bg-emerald-500", text: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400", chip: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40" };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <span className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${tone.chip} ${tone.text}`}>
          <UiIcon name="zap" size={16} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            You're on the {planName} plan — {percent}% of your {unit} used.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${tone.bar} transition-all duration-300`} style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span className="tabular-nums">
          {formatNumber(used)} / {formatNumber(limit)} {unit}
        </span>
        <span className={`ml-auto tabular-nums ${tone.text}`}>{percent}%</span>
      </div>

      {features.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {features.map((feature) => (
            <li key={feature} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <UiIcon name="check" size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
              <span>{feature}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onUpgrade?.()}
        className="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
      >
        {ctaText}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UpgradePromptCard;

====/File: react/UsageMeter.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type UsageMeterTone = "ok" | "warning" | "danger";

export interface UsageMeterProps {
  label: string;
  used: number;
  limit: number;
  unit?: string;
  showLegend?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const usageTone = (used: number, limit: number): UsageMeterTone => {
  if (limit <= 0) return "danger";
  const ratio = used / limit;
  if (ratio >= 0.9) return "danger";
  if (ratio >= 0.7) return "warning";
  return "ok";
};

const TONE = {
  ok: { bar: "bg-indigo-500", text: "text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" },
  warning: { bar: "bg-amber-500", text: "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" },
  danger: { bar: "bg-rose-500", text: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" },
};

export const UsageMeter: React.FC<UsageMeterProps> = ({
  label,
  used,
  limit,
  unit = "",
  showLegend = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const tone = usageTone(used, limit);
  const ratio = limit > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, used / limit)) : 1;
  const percent = Math.round(ratio * 100);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - used);
  const styles = TONE[tone];

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{label}</p>
        <p className={`text-xs font-bold tabular-nums ${styles.text}`}>{percent}%</p>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 ${styles.bar}`} style={{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }} />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span>
          {used.toLocaleString()} / {limit.toLocaleString()}
          {unit && ` ${unit}`}
        </span>
        {showLegend && remaining > 0 && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
            <UiIcon name="clock" size={10} />
            {remaining.toLocaleString()} left
          </span>
        )}
        {showLegend && remaining <= 0 && <span className="font-semibold text-rose-500">Limit reached</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UsageMeter;

/**
 * UsageQuotaCard - credit/quota meter card (or banner) with progress and upgrade CTA.
 */
export default function UsageQuotaCard({
  label = "Credits Remaining",
  used = 0,
  total = 0,
  unit = "",
  summary = "",
  upgradeLine = "Upgrade for unlimited use",
  ctaLabel = "Upgrade",
  ctaTone = "dark",
  banner = false,
  onCta,
}: UsageQuotaCardProps) {
  if (banner) {
    return (
      <div data-quota-banner className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-emerald-500/40 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">
