        >
          {ctaLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round(((total - used) / total) * 100) : 0;
  const valueLabel = `${used}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}${total ? ` of ${total}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}` : ""}`;

  return (
    <div data-quota-card className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
      {label ? <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400">{label}</p> : null}
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{summary || valueLabel}</p>
      {total ? (
        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-sky-500 transition-all" style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {upgradeLine ? <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{upgradeLine}</p> : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-quota-cta
        onClick={() => onCta?.()}
        className={`mt-3 w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          ctaTone === "dark" ? "bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white" : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500"
        }`}
      >
        {ctaLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type VoiceModeState = "idle" | "listening" | "thinking" | "speaking";

export interface VoiceModePanelProps {
  state?: VoiceModeState;
  /** Live user transcript shown under the orb. */
  transcript?: string;
  /** Assistant reply shown while thinking/speaking. */
  reply?: string;
  /** Called when the orb is pressed (start/stop listening). */
  onToggle?: () => void;
  /** Called by the end-session button. */
  onEnd?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: {
    label: "Tap to speak",
    hint: "Voice mode is ready",
    ring: "bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40",
    orb: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
  },
  listening: {
    label: "Listening…",
    hint: "Speak now — tap again to stop",
    ring: "bg-indigo-400/40",
    orb: "bg-indigo-600 text-white",
  },
  thinking: {
    label: "Thinking…",
    hint: "Working on a response",
    ring: "bg-amber-400/40",
    orb: "bg-amber-500 text-white",
  },
  speaking: {
    label: "Speaking…",
    hint: "Tap to interrupt",
    ring: "bg-emerald-400/40",
    orb: "bg-emerald-500 text-white",
  },
};

const BAR_COUNT = 9;

export const VoiceModePanel: React.FC<VoiceModePanelProps> = ({
  state = "idle",
  transcript,
  reply,
  onToggle,
  onEnd,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const meta = STATE_META[state];
  const animated = state === "listening" || state === "speaking";

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-full ${meta.ring} ${animated ? "animate-ping" : "opacity-0"}`}
        />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className={`absolute inset-3 rounded-full ${meta.ring} opacity-60`} />
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${
            state === "thinking"
              ? "animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50"
              : state === "listening"
                ? "bg-indigo-400/40"
                : state === "speaking"
                  ? "bg-emerald-400/40"
                  : "bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40"
          }`}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggle}
          aria-label={state === "idle" ? "Start voice mode" : "Stop voice mode"}
          aria-pressed={state !== "idle"}
          className={`relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${meta.orb}`}
        >
          <UiIcon name={state === "idle" ? "mic" : "square"} size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
        {Array.from({ length: BAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => (
          <span
            key={index}
            className={`w-1 rounded-full ${
              animated
                ? "animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500"
                : "h-1 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
            style={animated ? { animationDelay: `${(index * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s` } : undefined}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{meta.label}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{meta.hint}</p>

      {transcript && (
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          “{transcript}”
        </p>
      )}
      {reply && (
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {reply}
        </p>
      )}

      {onEnd && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onEnd}
          className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
          End voice session
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default VoiceModePanel;

import React from "react";

export type VoiceOrbState = "listening" | "speaking" | "thinking" | "idle";

export interface VoiceOrbProps {
  state?: VoiceOrbState;
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  showControls?: boolean;
  muted?: boolean;
  onToggleMute?: () => void;
  onEnd?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS = {
  sm: "h-20 w-20",
  md: "h-36 w-36",
  lg: "h-56 w-56",
} as const;

const STATE_RING = {
  listening: "bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-400 via-indigo-500 to-violet-600 animate-pulse",
  speaking: "bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 via-teal-500 to-cyan-600 animate-pulse",
  thinking: "bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-500 animate-pulse",
  idle: "bg-gradient-to-br from-zinc-300 to-zinc-400 dark:from-zinc-600 dark:to-zinc-700",
} as const;

const STATE_LABEL = {
  listening: "Listening…",
  speaking: "Speaking…",
  thinking: "Thinking…",
  idle: "Tap to talk",
} as const;

const BARS = [10, 18, 26, 34, 26, 18, 10] as const;

/**
 * VoiceOrb - ElevenLabs / Grok / Mindtrip style voice conversation orb: a
 * centered gradient disc whose color tracks the conversation state, with an
 * optional waveform readout and Mute / End controls beneath.
 */
export default function VoiceOrb({
  state = "idle",
  label,
  hint,
  size = "md",
  showControls = true,
  muted = false,
  onToggleMute,
  onEnd,
  className = "",
}: VoiceOrbProps) {
  return (
    <div data-voice-orb className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-4 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
        <div
          data-voice-orb-disc
          data-orb-state={state}
          className={`${SIZE_CLASS[size]} rounded-full ${STATE_RING[state]} shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20`}
        />
        {state !== "idle" && (
          <div data-voice-orb-wave className="flex h-8 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
            {BARS.map((h, i) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                className="w-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-400"
                style={{ height: `${h}px` }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <p data-voice-orb-label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {label ?? STATE_LABEL[state]}
        </p>
        {hint && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{hint}</p>}
      </div>
      {showControls && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-voice-orb-mute
            aria-pressed={muted}
            onClick={onToggleMute}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
              muted
                ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
          >
            {muted ? "Unmute" : "Mute"}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-voice-orb-end
            onClick={onEnd}
            className="rounded-full bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500"
          >
            End call
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

====/File: react/WizardSteps.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface WizardStep {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

export interface WizardStepsProps {
  steps: WizardStep[];
  current: number;
  variant?: "vertical" | "bar";
  nextLabel?: string;
  onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const WizardSteps: React.FC<WizardStepsProps> = ({
  steps,
  current,
  variant = "vertical",
  nextLabel,
  onStepClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const total = steps.length;
  const progress = total ? Math.round(((current + 1) / total) * 100) : 0;
  const nextStep = steps[current + 1];

  if (variant === "bar") {
    return (
      <div
        data-wizard-steps
        role="group"
        aria-label="Wizard progress"
        className={`flex flex-col gap-2 ${className}`}
      >
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
            {current + 1} of {total} steps
          </span>
          {nextStep ? (
            <>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">|</span>
              <span>Next: {nextStep.label}</span>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </p>
        <div
          role="progressbar"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={total}
          aria-valuenow={current + 1}
          className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50"
        >
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-violet-600 transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ol data-wizard-steps className={`flex flex-col ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const state = index < current ? "done" : index === current ? "active" : "todo";
        const isLast = index === total - 1;
        const interactive = typeof onStepClick === "function" && index <= current;
        return (
          <li
            key={`${step.label}-${index}`}
            className="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 last:pb-0"
          >
            {!isLast ? (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-0 w-px ${
                  index < current ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                }`}
              />
            ) : null}
            <button
              type="button"
              data-step-index={index}
              disabled={!interactive}
              onClick={() => onStepClick?.(index)}
              aria-current={state === "active" ? "step" : undefined}
              className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                state === "done"
                  ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                  : state === "active"
                    ? "border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900"
                    : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400"
              } ${interactive ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-default"}`}
            >
              {state === "done" ? <UiIcon name="check" size={13} /> : index + 1}
            </button>
            <span className="min-w-0 pt-1">
              <span
                className={`block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
                  state === "active"
                    ? "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : state === "done"
                      ? "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                      : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step.label}
                {step.optional ? (
                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
              {step.hint ? (
                <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">{step.hint}</span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </li>
        );
      })}
      {nextLabel ? (
        <li className="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">{nextLabel}</li>
      ) : null}
    </ol>
  );
};

export default WizardSteps;

  { id: "company", label: "Company" },
  { id: "team", label: "Team" },
  { id: "my", label: "My" },

  entries = [
    { id: "g1", title: "Don't use passive voice", description: "It dilutes meaning and bloats sentences.", minutes: 3 },
    { id: "g2", title: "Use contracted forms", description: "Write \"can't\" instead of \"cannot\" for a friendly tone.", minutes: 2 },
    { id: "g3", title: "Upper Kebab case for products", description: "Product names use Upper Kebab case.", minutes: 4 },
  ],
  activeTab: activeTabProp = "company",
  className = "",
  onTabChange,
  onEntryClick,
}: WriterStyleGuideProps) {

  "flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100";

/**
 * ZoomControlBar - canvas viewport zoom control with stepper / dropdown / slider variants and optional undo-redo pair.
 */

  min = 10,
  max = 400,

  className = "",
}: ZoomControlBarProps) {
  const [zoom, setZoom] = React.useState(() => clamp(value, min, max));
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setZoom(value);
  }, [value]);

  const change = (next: number) => {
    const clamped = clamp(Math.round(next), min, max);
    setZoom(clamped);
    onZoomChange?.(clamped);
  };

  const container =
    "inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-1 py-0.5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900";
  const percent = (
    <button
      type="button"
      data-zoom-value
      onClick={() => variant === "dropdown" && setOpen((prev) => !prev)}
      className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 tabular-nums dark:text-zinc-200 ${variant === "dropdown" ? "hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" : ""}`}
    >
      {zoom}%{variant === "dropdown" ? <span aria-hidden="true"> ▾</span> : null}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div data-zoom-control className={`${container} ${className}`}>
      {showUndoRedo ? (
        <>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-undo title="Undo" onClick={() => onUndo?.()} className={iconButton}>{UNDO_SVG}</button>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-redo title="Redo" onClick={() => onRedo?.()} className={iconButton}>{REDO_SVG}</button>
          <span className="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "stepper" ? (
        <>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-out title="Zoom out" disabled={zoom <= min} onClick={() => change(zoom - step)} className={iconButton}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
          </button>
          {percent}
          <button type="button" data-zoom-in title="Zoom in" disabled={zoom >= max} onClick={() => change(zoom + step)} className={iconButton}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 5v10M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
          </button>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "dropdown" ? (
        <div className="relative">
          {percent}
          {open ? (
            <div data-zoom-menu className="absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1 w-24 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              {presets.map((preset) => (
                <button
                  key={preset}
                  type="button"
                  data-zoom-preset={preset}
                  onClick={() => {
                    change(preset);
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={`block w-full px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs tabular-nums hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${preset === zoom ? "font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}
                >
                  {preset}%
                </button>
              ))}
              {showFit ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-zoom-fit
                  onClick={() => {
                    onFit?.();
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="block w-full border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                >
                  Fit
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "slider" ? (
        <>
          <input
            data-zoom-slider
            type="range"
            min={min}
            max={max}
            step={step}
            value={zoom}
            onChange={(e) => change(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1.5 w-24 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-full bg-zinc-200 accent-blue-600 dark:bg-zinc-700"
            aria-label="Zoom level"
          />
          {percent}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {showFit && variant !== "dropdown" ? (
        <button type="button" data-zoom-fit title="Fit to page" onClick={() => onFit?.()} className={iconButton}>{FIT_SVG}</button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface AIAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options?: string[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    actions?: AIAction[];
    loading?: boolean;
    error?: string;
    tone?: 'neutral' | 'brand';
  }>(),
  {
    actions: () => [
      { id: 'edit', label: 'Edit' },
      { id: 'tone', label: 'Change tone', options: ['Professional', 'Friendly', 'Concise'] },
    ],
    loading: false,
    error: '',
    tone: 'neutral' as const,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action', id: string, option?: string): void;
  (e: 'dismiss'): void;
}>();

const resolvedActions = computed(() => props.actions);
const openId = ref<string | null>(null);
const lastRun = ref<string | null>(null);

const run = (action: AIAction, option?: string) => {
  if (props.loading) return;
  openId.value = null;
  lastRun.value = `${action.id}${option ? `:${option}` : ''}`;
  emit('action', action.id, option);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    :class="['divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900', $attrs.class]">

          <span v-if="item.icon" class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
            <UiIcon :name="item.icon" :size="14" />
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ item.title }}</span>
            <span v-if="item.description" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ item.description }}</span>
          </span>
          <span :class="['shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200', isOpen(item.id) ? 'rotate-180' : '']">
            <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="14" />
          </span>
        </button>
      </h3>
      <div v-if="isOpen(item.id)" :id="`accordion-panel-${item.id}`" role="region"
        :aria-labelledby="`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`"
        class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {{ item.content }}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  content: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: AccordionItem[];
    allowMultiple?: boolean;
    defaultOpenIds?: string[];
  }>(),
  { allowMultiple: false }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle', id: string, open: boolean): void }>();

const openIds = ref<string[]>(
  props.defaultOpenIds ?? props.items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id)
);

const isOpen = (id: string) => openIds.value.includes(id);

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const wasOpen = isOpen(id);
  if (wasOpen) {
    openIds.value = openIds.value.filter((entry) => entry !== id);
  } else {
    openIds.value = props.allowMultiple ? [...openIds.value, id] : [id];
  }
  emit('toggle', id, !wasOpen);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Account {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  role?: string;
  plan?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    accounts?: Account[];
    currentId?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { accounts: () => [], currentId: '', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'switch', account: Account): void;
  (e: 'add-account'): void;
  (e: 'sign-out'): void;
  (e: 'open-change', open: boolean): void;
}>();

const open = ref(false);
const rootRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const current = computed(() => props.accounts.find((account) => account.id === props.currentId) || props.accounts[0]);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

function setOpen(next: boolean) {
  open.value = next;
  emit('open-change', next);
}

function choose(account: Account) {
  emit('switch', account);
  setOpen(false);
}

function addAccount() {
  emit('add-account');
  setOpen(false);
}

function signOut() {
  emit('sign-out');
  setOpen(false);
}

function onPointerDown(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
}

function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
}

watch(open, (isOpen) => {
  if (isOpen) {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  } else {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface AddonOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  price?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  contactInstead?: boolean;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  options: AddonOption[];
  selectedIds?: string[];
  totalLabel?: string;
  totalText?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Add-ons",
  selectedIds: () => [],
  totalLabel: "Estimated total",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: "change", selectedIds: string[]): void }>();

const isChecked = (id: string) => props.selectedIds.includes(id);
const toggle = (option: AddonOption) => {
  if (option.disabled) return;
  const next = isChecked(option.id)
    ? props.selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== option.id)
    : [...props.selectedIds, option.id];
  emit("change", next);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-addon-picker class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</p>
    <div class="mt-3 space-y-2">
      <label
        v-for="option in options"
        :key="option.id"
        :data-addon-row="option.id"
        class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors"
        :class="[
          isChecked(option.id)
            ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/50'
            : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700',
          option.disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : '',
        ]"
        @click.prevent="toggle(option)"
      >
        <span class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span
            data-addon-check
            role="checkbox"
            :aria-checked="isChecked(option.id)"
            class="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors"
            :class="isChecked(option.id)
              ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'

====/File: vue/AgentRunLog.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
      <UiIcon name="terminal" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />
      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ doneCount }}/{{ steps.length }}</span>
    </div>
    <ol class="px-4 py-3">
      <li v-for="(step, index) in steps" :key="step.id" class="relative pl-6">
        <span v-if="index !== steps.length - 1" aria-hidden="true"
          class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span class="absolute left-0 top-1"><UiIcon :name="statusIcon(step.status)" :size="14" :class="statusClass(step.status)" /></span>
        <div class="pb-3">
          <button type="button" :aria-expanded="step.detail ? expanded.has(step.id) : undefined"
            :class="['flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left', step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default']"
            @click="step.detail && toggle(step.id)">
            <span :class="['text-xs', step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200']">{{ step.label }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.durationMs !== undefined" class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ formatDuration(step.durationMs) }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.detail" class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <UiIcon :name="expanded.has(step.id) ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'" :size="12" />
            </span>
          </button>
          <pre v-if="step.detail && expanded.has(step.id)"
            class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">{{ step.detail }}</pre>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AgentRunStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'done' | 'error';
export interface AgentRunStep { id: string; label: string; status: AgentRunStatus; detail?: string; durationMs?: number }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  steps: AgentRunStep[];
  title?: string;
  autoExpandRunning?: boolean;
}>(), { title: 'Execution log', autoExpandRunning: true });

const expanded = ref(new Set<string>(
  props.autoExpandRunning ? props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
));

const doneCount = computed(() => props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length);

const statusIcon = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';
const statusClass = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500' : status === 'done' ? 'text-emerald-500' : status === 'error' ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';
const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);
const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expanded.value);
  next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
  expanded.value = next;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";
  duration?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps?: AgentStep[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { steps: () => [], className: "" }
);

const STATUS_META: Record<string, { icon: string; cls: string; pulse?: boolean }> = {
  pending: { icon: "clock", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" },
  running: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60", pulse: true },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60" },

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface AiTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category?: string;
}

export interface AiTemplatePickerProps {
  open?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  categories?: { id: string; label: string; count: number }[];
  templates: AiTemplate[];
  activeCategory?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AiTemplatePickerProps>(), {
  open: true,
  title: 'AI Research templates',
  categories: () => [],
  activeCategory: '',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'category-change', categoryId: string): void;
  (e: 'try', template: AiTemplate): void;
  (e: 'run-custom'): void;
  (e: 'close'): void;
}>();

const visibleTemplates = () => {
  const active = props.activeCategory || props.categories[0]?.id || '';
  return active
    ? props.templates.filter((t) => !t.category || t.category === active)
    : props.templates;
};

const isActive = (id: string) => id === (props.activeCategory || props.categories[0]?.id);
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AlertBannerTone = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';

interface ToneStyle {
  icon: IconName;
  iconClass: string;
  wrapClass: string;
  titleClass: string;
  bodyClass: string;
  actionClass: string;
  dismissClass: string;
  role: 'status' | 'alert';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tone?: AlertBannerTone;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    actionText?: string;
    dismissible?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { tone: 'info', dismissible: false }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'action'): void; (e: 'dismiss'): void }>();

const TONE: Record<AlertBannerTone, ToneStyle> = {
  info: {
    icon: 'info',
    iconClass: 'text-indigo-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300',
    actionClass: 'text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-500 dark:hover:text-indigo-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  success: {
    icon: 'check-circle',
    iconClass: 'text-emerald-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300',
    actionClass: 'text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 dark:hover:text-emerald-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  warning: {
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
    iconClass: 'text-amber-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
    actionClass: 'text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 dark:hover:text-amber-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500 dark:hover:text-amber-300',
    role: 'alert',
  },
  danger: {

    iconClass: 'text-rose-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300',
    actionClass: 'text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:text-rose-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-300',

            :key="`${approver.initials}-${index}`"

            {{ approver.initials }}

          :class="`flex items-center gap-1 font-medium capitalize ${decisionTone.className}`"
        >
          <UiIcon :name="decisionTone.icon" :size="12" />
          {{ decision }}
        </dd>
      </div>
    </dl>

      v-if="note"
      class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
    >
      {{ note }}
    </p>

    <div v-if="onApprove || onReject" class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
      <button
        v-if="onReject"
        type="button"
        data-approval-reject
        @click="handleReject"
        class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      >

      </button>

        v-if="onApprove"
        type="button"
        data-approval-approve
        @click="handleApprove"
        class="rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500"
      >
        Approve
      </button>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ApprovalApprover {
  initials: string;
  tone?: 'indigo' | 'emerald' | 'rose' | 'amber';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title: string;
    approvers: ApprovalApprover[];
    approvedCount?: number;
    dueDate?: string;
    decision?: 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'pending';
    note?: string;
    onRequestChange?: () => void;
    onApprove?: () => void;
    onReject?: () => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { approvedCount: 0, decision: 'pending', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'request-change'): void;
  (e: 'approve'): void;
  (e: 'reject'): void;
}>();

const DECISION_TONE: Record<string, { icon: IconName; className: string }> = {
  approved: { icon: 'check-circle', className: 'text-emerald-600' },
  rejected: { icon: 'circle-x', className: 'text-rose-600' },
  pending: { icon: 'clock', className: 'text-zinc-400' },
};

const decisionTone = computed(() => DECISION_TONE[props.decision] || DECISION_TONE.pending);

const avatarTone = (tone?: string) => {
  if (tone === 'emerald') return 'bg-emerald-600';
  if (tone === 'rose') return 'bg-rose-600';
  if (tone === 'amber') return 'bg-amber-500';
  return 'bg-indigo-600';
};

const handleRequestChange = () => {
  props.onRequestChange?.();
  emit('request-change');
};
const handleApprove = () => {
  props.onApprove?.();
  emit('approve');
};
const handleReject = () => {
  props.onReject?.();
  emit('reject');
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AuthProvider { name: string; icon?: string }
export interface AuthSubmitPayload { name?: string; email: string; password: string }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  mode?: 'signin' | 'signup';
  providers?: AuthProvider[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  submitText?: string;
  footerText?: string;
}>(), { mode: 'signin', providers: () => [], loading: false });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', payload: AuthSubmitPayload): void;
  (e: 'provider', provider: AuthProvider): void;
  (e: 'footer'): void;
}>();

const name = ref('');
const email = ref('');
const password = ref('');
const isSignup = computed(() => props.mode === 'signup');
const providerFallback = (value: string) => (value || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const inputClass =
  'w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors';

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.loading) return;
  emit('submit', { ...(isSignup.value ? { name: name.value } : {}), email: email.value, password: password.value });
};
</script>

  id: string;
  label: string;
  tone?: 'white' | 'brand' | 'dark';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title: string;
    providers?: AuthGateProvider[];
    secondaryAction?: { label: string; onClick?: () => void };
    dividerText?: string;
    skipLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    providers: () => [
      { id: 'google', label: 'Continue with Google', tone: 'white' as const },

====/File: vue/AutoScrollAnchor.vue/====

<template>
  <div :ref="(el) => { bottomEl = el as HTMLElement; }" :class="['h-px w-full pointer-events-none', className]"></div>

  <!-- Floating Back to Bottom Button -->
  <button
    v-if="!isAtBottom"
    type="button"
    @click="scrollToBottom"
    class="fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
    title="Scroll to bottom"
  >
    <span>↓</span>
    <span v-if="isStreaming" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-ping"></span>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isStreaming?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isStreaming: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const bottomEl = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const isAtBottom = ref(true);

const handleScroll = () => {
  const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
  const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
  const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
  const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
  isAtBottom.value = distanceFromBottom < 80;
};

onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
});

watch(
  () => props.isStreaming,
  (streaming) => {
    if (streaming && isAtBottom.value) {
      bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }
);

const scrollToBottom = () => {
  bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
};
</script>

  <div :class="['flex items-center -space-x-2', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="member in visible" :key="member.id" type="button" :title="member.name" :aria-label="member.name"
      class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900"
      :class="sizeClass" @click="$emit('member-click', member)">
      <img v-if="member.src" :src="member.src" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
      <span v-else-if="member.name.trim()" aria-hidden="true">{{ initials(member.name) }}</span>
      <UiIcon v-else name="user" :size="iconSize" />
      <span v-if="member.status" aria-hidden="true"
        :class="['absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900', DOT_CLASS[member.status]]" />
    </button>
    <span v-if="overflow > 0" :title="`${overflow} more`"
      :class="['relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900', sizeClass]">
      +{{ overflow }}
    </span>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AvatarStatus = 'online' | 'away' | 'offline';

export interface AvatarMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    members: AvatarMember[];
    max?: number;
    size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  }>(),
  { max: 4, size: 'md' }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'member-click', member: AvatarMember): void }>();

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', string> = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const visible = computed(() => props.members.slice(0, Math.max(0, props.max)));
const overflow = computed(() => props.members.length - visible.value.length);
const sizeClass = computed(() => SIZE_CLASS[props.size]);
const iconSize = computed(() => (props.size === 'sm' ? 12 : props.size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14));

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');
</script>

====/File: vue/Breadcrumb.vue/====

<template>
  <nav :aria-label="ariaLabel" :class="$attrs.class">
    <ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
      <li v-for="(item, index) in trail" :key="item ? item.id ?? `${item.label}-${index}` : `ellipsis-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span v-if="index > 0" aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
          <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="11" />
        </span>
        <span v-if="!item" aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>
        <span v-else-if="index === trail.length - 1" aria-current="page"
          :class="[BASE, 'font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <a v-else-if="item.href" :href="item.href" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]"
          @click="onLinkClick($event, item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </a>
        <button v-else type="button" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]" @click="emit('navigate', item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </nav>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: BreadcrumbItem[];
    maxItems?: number;
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { maxItems: 0, ariaLabel: 'Breadcrumb' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'navigate', item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number): void }>();

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

const trail = computed<(BreadcrumbItem | null)[]>(() => {
  const { items, maxItems } = props;
  if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
  const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
  return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
});

const onLinkClick = (event: MouseEvent, item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  emit('navigate', item, index);
};
</script>

      <span v-if="showDiffstat" class="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs">
        <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ totals.additions }}</span>
        {{ ' ' }}
        <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{{ totals.deletions }}</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <div v-if="open" class="px-2 pb-2">
      <div v-for="(group, index) in groups" :key="group.folder || index" :data-files-group="group.folder || undefined">
        <p v-if="grouped && group.folder" class="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ group.folder }}/</p>
        <button v-for="file in group.files" :key="file.path" type="button" :data-changed-file="file.path" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" @click="emit('file-click', file)">
          <span class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ extOf(file.path) }}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ grouped ? nameOf(file.path) : file.path }}</span>
          <span v-if="file.status && STATUS_TAG[file.status]" :class="['shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold', STATUS_TAG[file.status]]">{{ file.status }}</span>
          <span v-if="showDiffstat" class="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]">
            <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ file.additions }}</span>
            {{ ' ' }}
            <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{{ file.deletions }}</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface ChangedFile {
  path: string;
  additions: number;
  deletions: number;
  status?: 'new' | 'modified' | 'generated' | 'deleted';
}

const STATUS_TAG: Record<string, string> = {
  new: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  generated: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300',
  deleted: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  modified: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    files: ChangedFile[];
    grouped?: boolean;
    showDiffstat?: boolean;
    defaultExpanded?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { title: 'Files changed', grouped: false, showDiffstat: true, defaultExpanded: true },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'file-click', file: ChangedFile): void;
}>();

const open = ref(props.defaultExpanded);

const nameOf = (path: string) => path.split('/').pop() || path;
const extOf = (path: string) => nameOf(path).split('.').pop() || '';
const parentOf = (path: string) => {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  return parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') : '';
};

const groups = computed(() => {
  if (!props.grouped) return [{ folder: '', files: props.files }];
  const map = new Map<string, ChangedFile[]>();
  props.files.forEach((file) => {
    const folder = parentOf(file.path) || '/';
    if (!map.has(folder)) map.set(folder, []);
    map.get(folder)!.push(file);
  });
  return [...map.entries()].map(([folder, files]) => ({ folder, files }));
});

const totals = computed(() =>
  props.files.reduce(
    (acc, file) => ({ additions: acc.additions + file.additions, deletions: acc.deletions + file.deletions }),
    { additions: 0, deletions: 0 },
  ),
);
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Attachment {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  url?: string;
  type: 'image' | 'file';
}

export interface PromptChip {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  active?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    modelValue: string;
    isGenerating?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    allowAttachments?: boolean;
    attachments?: Attachment[];
    chips?: PromptChip[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isGenerating: false,
    placeholder: 'Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)',
    disabled: false,
    allowAttachments: true,
    attachments: () => [],
    chips: () => [],
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void;
  (e: 'submit'): void;
  (e: 'stop'): void;
  (e: 'addAttachment', file: File): void;
  (e: 'removeAttachment', id: string): void;
  (e: 'chipClick', chip: PromptChip): void;
}>();

const textareaRef = ref<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
const fileInputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const adjustHeight = () => {
  const textarea = textareaRef.current;
  if (!textarea) return;
  textarea.style.height = 'auto';
  const nextHeight = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 240);
  textarea.style.height = `${Math.max(nextHeight, 48)}px`;
};

const handleInput = (e: Event) => {
  const val = (e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).value;
  emit('update:modelValue', val);
  adjustHeight();
};

watch(() => props.modelValue, () => {
  nextTick(adjustHeight);
});

const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
    if (e.isComposing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!props.isGenerating && props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
      emit('submit');
    }
  }
};

const handleFileChange = (e: Event) => {
  const target = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  const files = target.files;
  if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
  Array.from(files).forEach((file) => emit('addAttachment', file));
  target.value = '';
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
    emit('submit');
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden" :class="className">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">

        {{ initials }}

      <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ChatSessionItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  timeLabel?: string;
  /** Optional group label (e.g. "Today", "Previous 7 days"); sessions without one go to "Recent". */
  group?: string;
}

export interface ChatSessionUser {
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    sessions?: ChatSessionItem[];
    activeId?: string | number | null;
    user?: ChatSessionUser;
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { sessions: () => [], activeId: null, title: "Chats", emptyText: "No conversations yet", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", session: ChatSessionItem): void;
  (e: "delete", id: string | number): void;
  (e: "userClick"): void;
}>();

const collapsedGroups = ref(new Set<string>());
const toggleGroup = (label: string) => {
  const next = new Set(collapsedGroups.value);
  if (next.has(label)) next.delete(label);
  else next.add(label);
  collapsedGroups.value = next;
};

// Preserve the sessions' original order; group headers appear on first occurrence.
const groups = computed(() => {
  const result: { label: string; items: ChatSessionItem[] }[] = [];
  props.sessions.forEach((s) => {
    const label = s.group || "Recent";
    const existing = result.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (existing) existing.items.push(s);
    else result.push({ label, items: [s] });
  });
  return result;
});

const initials = computed(() =>
  props.user
    ? (props.user.name || "?")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase()
    : ""
);
</script>

<template>

    <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
      <span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">?</span>

    className: "",

          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: string;
    swatches?: string[];
    documentColors?: string[];
    customColors?: string[];
    showEyedropper?: boolean;
    showRgbInputs?: boolean;
    showHexInput?: boolean;
  }>(),
  {
    value: '#2563eb',
    swatches: () => [],
    documentColors: () => [],
    customColors: () => [],
    showEyedropper: false,
    showRgbInputs: false,
    showHexInput: true,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', hex: string): void;
  (e: 'eyedropper-click'): void;
  (e: 'add-custom', hex: string): void;
}>();

const DEFAULT_ROWS = [
  ['#000000', '#374151', '#6b7280', '#9ca3af', '#d1d5db', '#f3f4f6'],
  ['#dc2626', '#ef4444', '#f87171', '#fca5a5', '#fecaca', '#fee2e2'],
  ['#ea580c', '#f97316', '#fb923c', '#fdba74', '#fed7aa', '#ffedd5'],
  ['#16a34a', '#22c55e', '#4ade80', '#86efac', '#bbf7d0', '#dcfce7'],
  ['#2563eb', '#3b82f6', '#60a5fa', '#93c5fd', '#bfdbfe', '#dbeafe'],
  ['#7c3aed', '#8b5cf6', '#a78bfa', '#c4b5fd', '#ddd6fe', '#ede9fe'],
];

const rows = computed(() => (props.swatches.length ? [props.swatches] : DEFAULT_ROWS));

const normalizeHex = (input: string): string | null => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(input.trim());
  return match ? `#${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : null;
};

const hexToRgb = (hexValue: string) => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hexValue.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const int = parseInt(match[1], 16);
  return { r: (int >> 16) & 255, g: (int >> 8) & 255, b: int & 255 };
};

const rgbToHex = (r: number, g: number, b: number) =>
  `#${[r, g, b].map((c) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;

const initial = normalizeHex(props.value) || '#2563eb';
const hex = ref(initial);
const draft = ref(initial);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    const parsed = normalizeHex(next);
    if (parsed) {
      hex.value = parsed;
      draft.value = parsed;
    }
  },
);

const rgb = computed(() => hexToRgb(hex.value) || { r: 37, g: 99, b: 235 });

const apply = (next: string) => {
  hex.value = next;
  draft.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const onHexInput = (raw: string) => {
  draft.value = raw;
  const parsed = normalizeHex(raw);
  if (parsed) {
    hex.value = parsed;
    emit('change', parsed);
  }
};

const onChannel = (channel: 'r' | 'g' | 'b', raw: string) => {
  const num = parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return;
  const current = rgb.value;
  const next = rgbToHex(channel === 'r' ? num : current.r, channel === 'g' ? num : current.g, channel === 'b' ? num : current.b);
  apply(next);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-column-visibility-menu class="w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <p data-column-count class="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        Showing <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ visibleCount }}</span> of {{ columns.length }}
      </p>
      <button type="button" data-column-reset class="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" @click="emit('reset')">{{ resetLabel }}</button>
    </div>
    <ul class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto py-1">
      <li v-for="(column, index) in columns" :key="column.id" :data-column-row="column.id" :data-column-visible="isVisible(column) ? 'true' : 'false'">
        <div :class="['flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5', column.locked ? 'opacity-60' : '']">
          <span v-if="showReorderHandles && !column.locked" class="flex shrink-0 flex-col text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3 w-3"><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="18" r="1.5" /></svg>
          </span>
          <svg v-if="column.locked" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2" /><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4" /></svg>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ column.label }}</span>
          <button type="button" data-column-toggle :aria-label="`${isVisible(column) ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${column.label}`" :disabled="column.locked" :class="['shrink-0 rounded p-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', isVisible(column) ? 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-600']" @click="toggle(column)">
            <svg v-if="isVisible(column)" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /></svg>
            <svg v-else viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7c2 0 3.7.6 5.1 1.5M22 12s-3.5 7-10 7c-2 0-3.7-.6-5.1-1.5" /><path d="m4 4 16 16" /></svg>
          </button>
          <span v-if="showReorderHandles && !column.locked" class="flex shrink-0 flex-col">
            <button type="button" data-column-up :aria-label="`Move ${column.label} up`" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('reorder', index, index - 1)">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m18 15-6-6-6 6" /></svg>
            </button>
            <button type="button" data-column-down :aria-label="`Move ${column.label} down`" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('reorder', index, index + 1)">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>
            </button>
          </span>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div v-if="applyMode === 'apply-button'" class="border-t border-zinc-100 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button type="button" data-column-apply class="w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white" @click="emit('apply', [...draft])">
        {{ applyLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface ColumnDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  locked?: boolean;
  hidden?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    columns: ColumnDef[];
    visibleIds?: string[];
    showReorderHandles?: boolean;
    applyMode?: 'instant' | 'apply-button';
    resetLabel?: string;
    applyLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { visibleIds: () => [], showReorderHandles: true, applyMode: 'instant', resetLabel: 'Reset to default', applyLabel: 'Apply' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'toggle', id: string, visible: boolean): void;
  (e: 'reorder', from: number, to: number): void;
  (e: 'reset'): void;
  (e: 'apply', visibleIds: string[]): void;
}>();

const draft = ref(new Set<string>(props.visibleIds.length ? props.visibleIds : props.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.id)));

watch(
  () => props.visibleIds,
  (ids) => {
    if (ids.length) draft.value = new Set(ids);
  },
);

const isVisible = (column: ColumnDef) => {
  if (column.locked) return true;
  if (props.applyMode === 'apply-button') return draft.value.has(column.id);
  return props.visibleIds.length ? props.visibleIds.includes(column.id) : !column.hidden;
};

const visibleCount = computed(() => props.columns.filter((c) => isVisible(c)).length);

const toggle = (column: ColumnDef) => {
  if (column.locked) return;
  const nextVisible = !isVisible(column);
  if (props.applyMode === 'apply-button') {
    const next = new Set(draft.value);
    if (nextVisible) next.add(column.id);
    else next.delete(column.id);
    draft.value = next;
  } else {
    const next = props.visibleIds.includes(column.id)
      ? props.visibleIds.filter((id) => id !== column.id)
      : [...props.visibleIds, column.id];
    emit('apply', next);
  }
  emit('toggle', column.id, nextVisible);
};
</script>

<template>

      :class="['flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900',

        :aria-label="placeholder" :value="query" :placeholder="placeholder"
        @input="onInput($event)" @keydown="onFieldKeyDown" @focus="open = true"
        class="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
      <button v-if="query" type="button" aria-label="Clear"
        @click="query = ''; selected = null"
        class="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
      </button>

        :class="['flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs', index === active ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : '']">

        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">

          <span v-if="option.description" class="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ option.description }}</span>
        </span>
        <UiIcon v-if="selected === option.value" name="check" :size="13" class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ComboBoxOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    options: ComboBoxOption[];
    placeholder?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
  }>(),
  { placeholder: 'Search…', emptyText: 'No matches found.' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', value: string): void }>();

const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const open = ref(false);
const query = ref('');
const active = ref(0);
const selected = ref<string | null>(null);
const id = useId();

const filtered = computed(() => {
  const q = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return props.options;
  return props.options.filter(
    (option) =>
      option.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (option.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
  );
});

watch(query, () => {
  active.value = 0;
});

const choose = (option: ComboBoxOption) => {
  selected.value = option.value;
  query.value = option.label;
  open.value = false;
  emit('change', option.value);
};

const onInput = (event: Event) => {
  query.value = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
  open.value = true;
};

const onFieldKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    event.preventDefault();
    open.value = true;
    active.value = Math.min(active.value + 1, filtered.value.length - 1);
  } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    event.preventDefault();
    active.value = Math.max(active.value - 1, 0);
  } else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    const option = filtered.value[active.value];
    if (option && open.value) {
      event.preventDefault();
      choose(option);
    }
  }
};

const onDocMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) open.value = false;
};
const onDocKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') open.value = false;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface CommandItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  icon?: string;
  group?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items?: CommandItem[];
    isOpen: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { items: () => [], placeholder: "Type a command or search...", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", item: CommandItem): void;
  (e: "close"): void;
}>();

const query = ref("");
const activeIndex = ref(0);
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const shortcutHints = [
  { keys: ["↑", "↓"], label: "Navigate" },
  { keys: ["↵"], label: "Select" },
  { keys: ["esc"], label: "Close" },
] as const;

const filtered = computed(() => {
  if (!query.value.trim()) return props.items;
  const q = query.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.items.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (i.hint && i.hint.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (i.group && i.group.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
});

function select(item: CommandItem) {
  emit("select", item);
  emit("close");
}

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    if (open) {
      query.value = "";
      activeIndex.value = 0;
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);
watch(query, () => (activeIndex.value = 0));

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("close");
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.min(filtered.value.length - 1, activeIndex.value + 1);
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.max(0, activeIndex.value - 1);
  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    const item = filtered.value[activeIndex.value];
    if (item) select(item);
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

        </button>
      </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface CommentItem {
  id: string | number;
  /** Parent comment id; omit or null for a root comment. */
  parentId?: string | number | null;
  author: string;
  /** Image URL; falls back to initials. */
  avatar?: string;
  text: string;
  time?: string;
  likes?: number;
  resolved?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    comments?: CommentItem[];
    placeholder?: string;
    submitText?: string;
    allowComment?: boolean;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    comments: () => [],
    placeholder: 'Write a comment...',
    submitText: 'Comment',
    allowComment: true,
    emptyText: 'No comments yet. Start the conversation.',
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', text: string, parentId: string | number | null): void;
  (e: 'like', comment: CommentItem): void;
  (e: 'resolve', comment: CommentItem): void;
}>();

const draft = ref('');
const replyTo = ref<string | number | null>(null);
const replyDraft = ref('');

/** Flat comments + parentId → depth-tagged render order (parents before children). */
const rows = computed(() => {
  const children = new Map<string, CommentItem[]>();
  const roots: CommentItem[] = [];
  props.comments.forEach((comment) => {
    if (comment.parentId == null) {
      roots.push(comment);
      return;
    }
    const key = String(comment.parentId);
    children.set(key, [...(children.get(key) || []), comment]);
  });

  const out: Array<{ comment: CommentItem; depth: number }> = [];
  const walk = (list: CommentItem[], depth: number) => {
    list.forEach((comment) => {
      out.push({ comment, depth });
      // Cap nesting at 3 levels so deep threads never break the layout.
      if (depth < 2) walk(children.get(String(comment.id)) || [], depth + 1);
      else (children.get(String(comment.id)) || []).forEach((child) => out.push({ comment: child, depth: depth + 1 }));
    });
  };
  walk(roots, 0);
  return out;
});

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');

function toggleReply(id: string | number) {
  replyTo.value = replyTo.value === id ? null : id;
  replyDraft.value = '';
}

function submitRoot() {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, null);
  draft.value = '';
}

function submitReply(parentId: string | number) {
  const text = replyDraft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, parentId);
  replyDraft.value = '';
  replyTo.value = null;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">

import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

type Tone = "danger" | "warning" | "default";

const TONE_META: Record<Tone, { chip: string; button: string; icon: string }> = {
  danger: {
    chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
    button: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-red-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  warning: {
    chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
    button: "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 focus-visible:ring-amber-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  default: {
    chip: "bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    button: "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500",
    icon: "info",
  },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;

    loading: false,
    className: "",

  (e: "cancel"): void;
}>();

const typed = ref("");
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const tone = computed(() => TONE_META[props.tone] ?? TONE_META.default);
const blocked = computed(() => Boolean(props.requireText) && typed.value !== props.requireText);
const canConfirm = computed(() => !blocked.value && !props.loading);

    typed.value = "";

  }
);

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("cancel");
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));

<template>

====/File: vue/ContextUsageBadge.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none" :class="className">
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="showPopover = !showPopover"
      @blur="onBlur"
      class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
      aria-label="Context Window Usage"
      :aria-expanded="showPopover"
    >
      <UiIcon name="cpu" :size="14" class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span
        v-if="modelName && !compact"
        class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]"
      >
        {{ modelName }}
      </span>
      <div class="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
        <div
          class="h-full transition-all duration-300"
          :class="barColor"
          :style="{ width: `${percentage}%` }"
        ></div>
      </div>
      <span class="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
        {{ percentage }}%
      </span>
    </button>

    <div
      v-if="showPopover"
      class="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
          {{ formatNumber(safeUsed) }} / {{ formatNumber(safeMax) }}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="modelName" class="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
        <span>Model</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">{{ modelName }}</span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="breakdown && breakdown.length > 0" class="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
        <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
        <div
          v-for="(item, idx) in breakdown"
          :key="idx"
          class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"
        >
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" :class="item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400'"></span>
            {{ item.label }}
          </span>
          <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            {{ formatNumber(item.count) }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ContextUsageTokenBreakdown {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  colorClass?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    usedTokens: number;
    maxTokens: number;
    modelName?: string;
    breakdown?: ContextUsageTokenBreakdown[];
    compact?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    compact: false,
    className: "",
    breakdown: () => [],
  }
);

const showPopover = ref(false);

const safeMax = computed(() => Math.max(1, props.maxTokens));
const safeUsed = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.usedTokens));
const percentage = computed(() =>
  Math.min(100, Math.round((safeUsed.value / safeMax.value) * 100))
);

const barColor = computed(() => {
  if (percentage.value >= 90) return "bg-rose-500";
  if (percentage.value >= 70) return "bg-amber-500";
  return "bg-emerald-500";
});

function formatNumber(num: number): string {
  if (num >= 1_000_000) return `${(num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (num >= 1_000) return `${(num / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(num);
}

function onBlur() {
  setTimeout(() => {
    showPopover.value = false;
  }, 200);
}
</script>

import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface ConsentCategory {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  alwaysActive?: boolean;
  cookies?: string[];
}

  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    policyLabel?: string;
    categories?: ConsentCategory[];
    acceptLabel?: string;
    rejectLabel?: string;

    description: 'We use cookies to personalize content, run analytics and improve your experience.',
    policyLabel: 'Privacy Policy',
    categories: () => [],
    acceptLabel: 'Accept All',
    rejectLabel: 'Reject All',
    saveLabel: 'Confirm',
  },
);

  (e: 'confirm', accepted: string[]): void;
}>();

const confirm = (accepted: string[]) => emit('confirm', accepted);
