              :class="['px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200', alignClass(column.align), column.align === 'right' ? 'tabular-nums' : '']">
              {{ row[column.key] ?? '—' }}
            </td>
            <td v-if="actions.length" class="px-3 py-2">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button" :aria-label="action.label" :title="action.label"
                  class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  @click="action.onClick(row)">
                  <UiIcon :name="action.icon || 'more-horizontal'" :size="14" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div v-if="selectable && selected.size > 0"
      class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ selected.size }} selected</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button"
          class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors"
          @click="runBatch(action)">{{ action.label }}</button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" aria-label="Clear selection" class="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
        @click="selected = new Set()">
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="13" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, reactive } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DataTableColumn { key: string; label: string; align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'; width?: string }
export type DataTableRow = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
export interface DataTableAction { label: string; icon?: string; onClick: (row: DataTableRow) => void }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  rows: DataTableRow[];
  selectable?: boolean;
  onSort?: (key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  actions?: DataTableAction[];
  emptyText?: string;
}>(), { selectable: false, actions: () => [], emptyText: 'No results' });

const sortKey = ref<string | null>(null);
const sortDir = ref<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
const selected = ref(new Set<number>());

const alignClass = (align?: DataTableColumn['align']) =>
  align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : align === 'center' ? 'text-center' : 'text-left';

const sortedRows = computed(() => {
  if (props.onSort || !sortKey.value) return props.rows;
  const key = sortKey.value;
  const dir = sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  return [...props.rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const av = a[key]; const bv = b[key];
    if (av === bv) return 0;
    return (String(av ?? '') > String(bv ?? '') ? 1 : -1) * dir;
  });
});

const allSelected = computed(() => sortedRows.value.length > 0 && selected.value.size === sortedRows.value.length);

const toggleSort = (key: string) => {
  const nextDir = sortKey.value === key && sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
  sortKey.value = key; sortDir.value = nextDir; props.onSort?.(key, nextDir);
};
const sortIcon = (key: string) => (sortKey.value === key ? (sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down') : 'chevron-down');
const toggleAll = () => { selected.value = allSelected.value ? new Set() : new Set(sortedRows.value.map((_, i) => i)); };
const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
  const next = new Set(selected.value);
  next.has(index) ? next.delete(index) : next.add(index);
  selected.value = next;
};
const runBatch = (action: DataTableAction) => {
  selected.value.forEach((index) => action.onClick(sortedRows.value[index]));
  selected.value = new Set();
};
</script>

          :aria-pressed="value === iso(day)"

            value === iso(day)
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
              : iso(day) === today
                ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40'
                : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',

        @click="selectToday"
      >
        Today
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];
const WEEKDAYS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD. */
    value?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    weekStartsOn?: 0 | 1;
    showToday?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { weekStartsOn: 1, showToday: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', isoDate: string): void }>();

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const toIso = (year: number, month: number, day: number) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

const parseIso = (iso?: string) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const now = new Date();
const today = toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

const selected = computed(() => parseIso(props.value));
const initial = selected.value || parseIso(today)!;
const view = ref({ year: initial.year, month: initial.month });

watch(
  () => props.value,
  () => {
    if (selected.value) view.value = { year: selected.value.year, month: selected.value.month };
  }
);

const cells = computed(() => {
  const first = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month, 1).getDay();
  const lead = (first - props.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
  const total = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const out: Array<number | null> = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
  for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) out.push(day);
  while (out.length % 7 !== 0) out.push(null);
  return out;
});

const weekdays = computed(() => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + props.weekStartsOn) % 7]));

const iso = (day: number) => toIso(view.value.year, view.value.month, day);

function shift(delta: number) {
  const next = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + delta, 1);
  view.value = { year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() };
}

function isDisabled(day: number) {
  if (props.disabled) return true;
  const value = iso(day);
  if (props.min && value < props.min) return true;
  if (props.max && value > props.max) return true;
  return false;
}

function selectDay(day: number) {
  if (isDisabled(day)) return;
  emit('change', iso(day));
}

function selectToday() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  if ((props.min && today < props.min) || (props.max && today > props.max)) return;
  emit('change', today);
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface DiffLine {
  type: "add" | "remove" | "context";
  content: string;
}

export interface DiffFile {
  filename: string;
  language?: string;
  lines: DiffLine[];
}

const LINE_STYLE: Record<string, { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string }> = {
  add: { row: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", gutter: "text-emerald-500", sign: "+" },
  remove: { row: "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300", gutter: "text-rose-500", sign: "-" },
  context: { row: "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400", gutter: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600", sign: " " },
};

interface HiddenLine {
  line: DiffLine;
  oldNo: number;
  newNo: number;
}

interface RenderRow {
  kind: "line" | "collapsed";
  line?: DiffLine;
  meta?: { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string };
  oldNo?: number | "";
  newNo?: number | "";
  count?: number;
  hidden?: HiddenLine[];
  key: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Legacy single-diff API (kept for backward compatibility). */
    lines?: DiffLine[];
    filename?: string;
    language?: string;
    /** Multi-file API: renders a tab bar when 1+ files are provided. */
    files?: DiffFile[];
    /** Context lines kept visible around each collapsed gap (default 3). */
    contextSize?: number;
    showLineNumbers?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { lines: () => [], files: () => [], contextSize: 3, showLineNumbers: true, className: "" }
);

const activeIdx = ref(0);
const expandedGaps = ref(new Set<string>());

watch(
  () => props.files,
  () => {
    activeIdx.value = 0;
    expandedGaps.value = new Set();
  }
);

const activeFile = computed(() => (props.files.length ? props.files[Math.min(activeIdx.value, props.files.length - 1)] : null));
const activeLines = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.lines : props.lines));
const activeFilename = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.filename : props.filename));
const activeLanguage = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.language : props.language));

const countType = (lines: DiffLine[], type: DiffLine["type"]) => lines.filter((l) => l.type === type).length;

const added = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "add"));
const removed = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "remove"));

const toggleGap = (key: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expandedGaps.value);
  if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
  else next.add(key);
  expandedGaps.value = next;
};

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines: DiffLine[], contextSize: number): RenderRow[] => {
  const rows: RenderRow[] = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun: HiddenLine[] = [];

  const pushLine = (entry: HiddenLine) => {
    rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, meta: LINE_STYLE.context, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` });
  };

  const flushContext = (isTail: boolean) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach(pushLine);
    } else {
      const hidden = isTail
        ? contextRun.slice(contextSize)
        : contextRun.slice(contextSize, contextRun.length - contextSize);
      contextRun.slice(0, contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
      rows.push({ kind: "collapsed", count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== "add") oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== "remove") newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === "context") {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({
      kind: "line",
      line,
      meta: LINE_STYLE[line.type] || LINE_STYLE.context,
      oldNo: line.type !== "add" ? oldNo : "",
      newNo: line.type !== "remove" ? newNo : "",
      key: `c-${rows.length}`,
    });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

const rows = computed(() => buildRows(activeLines.value, props.contextSize));
</script>

<template>

    <input
      v-if="editing"

      type="text"
      :value="draft"
      :class="['w-full rounded-md border-2 border-teal-500 bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none dark:bg-yellow-950/40 dark:text-zinc-50', size === 'lg' ? 'text-2xl' : 'text-base']"
      @input="draft = ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value"
      @blur="commit"
      @keydown.enter="commit"
      @keydown.escape="cancel"
    />
    <button
      v-else
      type="button"
      data-heading-display
      title="Click to rename"
      :class="['-mx-2 w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800', size === 'lg' ? 'text-2xl' : 'text-base']"
      @click="draft = current; editing = true"
    >{{ current }}</button>
    <div v-if="meta" class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" v-html="meta" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    breadcrumb?: string;
    meta?: string;
    size?: 'md' | 'lg';
  }>(),
  { value: undefined, defaultValue: 'Untitled', breadcrumb: '', meta: '', size: 'lg' as const },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', value: string): void;
}>();

const current = ref(props.value ?? props.defaultValue);
const editing = ref(false);
const draft = ref(current.value);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    if (next !== undefined) current.value = next;
  },
);

const commit = () => {
  const next = draft.value.trim() || current.value;
  const changed = next !== current.value;
  current.value = next;
  editing.value = false;
  if (changed) emit('change', next);
};

const cancel = () => {
  draft.value = current.value;
  editing.value = false;
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-empty-starter
    :class="['flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center', shellClass, padClass]"
  >
    <div v-if="illustration" data-empty-illustration :class="['mb-3 flex items-center justify-center', size === 'sm' ? 'text-3xl' : 'text-5xl']" aria-hidden="true" v-html="illustration" />
    <p data-empty-title :class="['font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50', size === 'sm' ? 'text-sm' : 'text-xl']">{{ title }}</p>
    <p v-if="description" :class="['mt-1 max-w-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', size === 'sm' ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm']">{{ description }}</p>
    <button
      v-if="actionLabel"
      type="button"
      data-empty-action
      :class="['mt-4 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', actionClass]"
      @click="emit('action')"
    >{{ actionLabel }}</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    illustration?: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    variant?: 'plain' | 'dashed' | 'card';
    size?: 'md' | 'sm';
    actionVariant?: 'solid' | 'outline' | 'link';
  }>(),
  { illustration: '', description: '', actionLabel: '', variant: 'plain', size: 'md', actionVariant: 'solid' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action'): void;
}>();

const shellClass = computed(() => {
  if (props.variant === 'dashed') return 'rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700';
  if (props.variant === 'card') return 'rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900';
  return '';
});

const padClass = computed(() => (props.variant !== 'plain' ? (props.size === 'sm' ? 'p-5' : 'p-8') : ''));

const ACTION_CLASS: Record<string, string> = {
  solid: 'rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300',
  outline: 'rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
  link: 'text-sm font-medium text-blue-600 hover:underline dark:text-blue-400',
};

const actionClass = computed(() => ACTION_CLASS[props.actionVariant] || ACTION_CLASS.solid);
</script>

<template>
  <div data-entity-picker class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

        />

      <li v-if="filtered.length === 0" data-picker-empty class="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ emptyMessage }}</li>
      <li v-for="(option, index) in filtered" :key="option.id">
        <button
          type="button"
          :data-picker-option="option.id"
          :aria-pressed="picked.has(option.id)"
          :class="['flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', picked.has(option.id) ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60']"
          @click="toggle(option.id)"
        >
          <span
            data-picker-checkbox
            :class="['flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors', picked.has(option.id) ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800']"
          >
            <svg v-if="picked.has(option.id)" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>
          </span>
          <img v-if="option.avatar" :src="option.avatar" alt="" class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
          <span v-else-if="option.system" class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700">
            <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500" />
          </span>
          <span v-else :class="['flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white', AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]]">
            {{ option.initials || initialsOf(option.label) }}
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ option.label }}</span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button type="button" data-picker-cancel @click="emit('dismiss')" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
        {{ cancelLabel }}
      </button>
      <button type="button" data-picker-confirm @click="emit('select', [...picked])" class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
        {{ confirmLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface PickerOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  avatar?: string;
  initials?: string;
  system?: boolean;
}

const AVATAR_TONES = ['bg-violet-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-rose-500', 'bg-indigo-500'];

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    options: PickerOption[];
    selected?: string[];
    searchable?: boolean;
    emptyMessage?: string;
    confirmLabel?: string;
    cancelLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { selected: () => [], searchable: true, emptyMessage: 'No matches found.', confirmLabel: 'Insert results', cancelLabel: 'Cancel' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', ids: string[]): void;
  (e: 'search', query: string): void;
  (e: 'dismiss'): void;
}>();

const query = ref('');
const picked = ref(new Set<string>(props.selected));

watch(
  () => props.selected,
  (ids) => {
    picked.value = new Set(ids);
  },
);

const filtered = computed(() =>
  query.value ? props.options.filter((option) => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase())) : props.options,
);

const initialsOf = (label: string) =>
  label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(picked.value);
  if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
  else next.add(id);
  picked.value = next;
};
</script>

export type EvalScoreTone = 'pass' | 'warn' | 'fail';

export interface EvalRun {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  score: number;
  grader?: string;
  tone?: EvalScoreTone;
}

export interface EvalCriteria {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

interface Props {
  runs?: EvalRun[];
  criteria?: EvalCriteria[];
  title?: string;
  showAddCriteria?: boolean;
}

  runs: () => [],
  criteria: () => [],

  showAddCriteria: false,

  (e: 'add-criteria'): void;
}>();

const toneClasses = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case 'warn':
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300';
    case 'fail':
      return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300';

};

const toneBar = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case 'warn':
      return 'bg-amber-500';
    case 'fail':
      return 'bg-red-500';
    default:
      return 'bg-emerald-500';
  }
};
</script>

  <div data-federated-search class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <div class="relative">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
        </svg>
        <input
          type="text"
          v-model="term"
          data-federated-input
          :placeholder="searchPlaceholder"
          class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          @input="emit('query-change', term)"
        />
      </div>
      <div v-if="sourceFilters.length" class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
        <button
          v-for="filter in sourceFilters"
          :key="filter.id"
          type="button"
          :data-source-chip="filter.id"
          :aria-pressed="scopes.has(filter.id)"
          :class="['rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', scopes.has(filter.id) ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800']"
          @click="toggleSource(filter.id)"
        >
          {{ filter.label }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <ul class="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2">
      <li v-if="filtered.length === 0" data-federated-empty class="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No results match your filters.</li>
      <li v-for="result in filtered" :key="result.id">
        <button
          type="button"
          :data-federated-result="result.id"
          class="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="emit('result-select', result)"
        >
          <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span v-if="result.icon" aria-hidden="true">{{ result.icon }}</span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ result.title }}</span>
            <span v-if="result.source" class="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ result.source }}</span>
          </span>
          <span v-if="result.subtitle" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ result.subtitle }}</span>
          <span class="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" v-html="highlight(result.snippet)" />
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div v-if="showKeyboardLegend" class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
      <p data-federated-legend class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ LEGEND }}</p>
      <span v-if="askAiLabel" class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{{ askAiLabel }}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface FederatedResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  snippet: string;
  source?: string;
}

const LEGEND = '↑↓ Navigate · ⏎ Select · ESC Close · ⇧⏎ Open in new tab';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    query?: string;
    results: FederatedResult[];
    sourceFilters?: { id: string; label: string }[];
    selectedSources?: string[];
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    showKeyboardLegend?: boolean;
    askAiLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { query: '', sourceFilters: () => [], selectedSources: () => [], searchPlaceholder: 'Search everything…', showKeyboardLegend: true, askAiLabel: 'Press Tab to Ask AI' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'query-change', query: string): void;
  (e: 'source-change', ids: string[]): void;
  (e: 'result-select', result: FederatedResult): void;
}>();

const term = ref(props.query);
const scopes = ref(new Set<string>(props.selectedSources));

watch(
  () => props.query,
  (value) => {
    term.value = value;
  },
);

const escapeRegExp = (text: string) => text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

const highlight = (snippet: string) => {
  if (!term.value.trim()) return snippet;
  const parts = snippet.split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(term.value)})`, 'gi'));
  return parts
    .map((part) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === term.value.toLowerCase()
        ? `<mark class="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">${part}</mark>`
        : part,
    )
    .join('');
};

const toggleSource = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(scopes.value);
  if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
  else next.add(id);
  scopes.value = next;
  emit('source-change', [...next]);
};

const filtered = computed(() =>
  scopes.value.size ? props.results.filter((result) => !result.source || scopes.value.has(result.source)) : props.results,
);
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="files.length > 0" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2" :class="className">
    <div
      v-for="f in files"
      :key="f.id"
      class="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
    >
      <UiIcon :name="iconForType(f.type, f.name)" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span class="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">{{ f.name }}</span>
      <span v-if="formatFileSize(f.size)" class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">{{ formatFileSize(f.size) }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        :aria-label="`Remove ${f.name}`"
        class="p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
        @click="emit('remove', f.id)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AttachmentItem {
  id: string | number;
  name: string;
  size?: number;
  type?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    files?: AttachmentItem[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "remove", id: string | number): void;
}>();

function formatFileSize(bytes?: number): string {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return "";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function iconForType(type?: string, name?: string): string {
  if (type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  const ext = name?.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (["js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "py", "java", "go", "rs", "vue", "html", "css", "json", "sh"].includes(ext)) return "code";
  return "paperclip";
}
</script>

====/File: vue/FileDropzone.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="className">
    <div
      role="button"
      :tabindex="disabled ? -1 : 0"
      :aria-label="hint || 'Drop files here or browse'"
      :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
      :class="[
        'flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
        dragging
          ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600',
        disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : '',
      ]"
      @click="openPicker"
      @keydown.enter.prevent="openPicker"
      @keydown.space.prevent="openPicker"
      @dragover.prevent="!disabled && (dragging = true)"
      @dragleave="dragging = false"
      @drop.prevent="onDrop"
    >
      <span class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <UiIcon name="upload" :size="16" />
      </span>
      <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
        Drag & drop {{ multiple ? 'files' : 'a file' }} here, or
        <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span>
      </p>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ hintText }}</p>
      <input
        ref="inputRef"
        type="file"
        hidden
        :accept="accept"
        :multiple="multiple"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @change="onChange"
      />
    </div>

    <p v-if="error" role="alert" class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
      <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" :size="12" />
      {{ error }}
    </p>

    <ul v-if="files.length" class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
      <li
        v-for="(file, index) in files"
        :key="file.id ?? `${file.name}-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5"
      >
        <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
          <UiIcon :name="fileIcon(file)" :size="14" />
        </span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ file.name }}</span>
          <span class="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{{ formatBytes(file.size) }}</span>
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          :aria-label="`Remove ${file.name}`"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          @click.stop="emit('remove', file, index)"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DropzoneFile {
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface RejectedFile {
  name: string;
  reason: 'type' | 'size';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    files?: DropzoneFile[];
    accept?: string;
    multiple?: boolean;
    maxSizeMb?: number;
    hint?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], multiple: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'files', files: File[]): void;
  (e: 'reject', rejected: RejectedFile[]): void;
  (e: 'remove', file: DropzoneFile, index: number): void;
}>();

const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
const dragging = ref(false);
const error = ref<string | null>(null);

const hintText = computed(() => {
  const parts = [props.accept ? `Accepts ${props.accept}` : null, props.maxSizeMb ? `up to ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : null];
  return props.hint || parts.filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Any file type';
});

const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

const matchesAccept = (file: { name: string; type?: string }) => {
  if (!props.accept) return true;
  return props.accept
    .split(',')
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith('/*')) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type?.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file: DropzoneFile) => {
  if (file.type?.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

function handleFiles(incoming: FileList | File[] | null) {
  const list = Array.from(incoming || []);
  if (!list.length) return;

  const rejected: RejectedFile[] = [];
  const accepted = list.filter((file) => {
    if (!matchesAccept(file)) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'type' });
      return false;
    }
    if (props.maxSizeMb && file.size > props.maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'size' });
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (rejected.length) {
    const first = rejected[0];
    error.value =
      first.reason === 'size' ? `${first.name} is larger than ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : `${first.name} is not an accepted file type`;
    emit('reject', rejected);
  } else {
    error.value = null;
  }

  if (accepted.length) emit('files', props.multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1));
}

const openPicker = () => {
  if (!props.disabled) inputRef.value?.click();
};

function onDrop(event: DragEvent) {
  dragging.value = false;
  if (props.disabled) return;
  handleFiles(event.dataTransfer?.files ?? null);
}

function onChange(event: Event) {
  const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
  handleFiles(input.files);
  input.value = '';
}
</script>

====/File: vue/FilterBar.vue/====

<template>
  <div ref="rootRef" :class="['flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5', $attrs.class]">
    <div v-for="filter in filters" :key="filter.id" class="relative">
      <button type="button" :aria-expanded="openId === filter.id" aria-haspopup="true"
        @click="openId = openId === filter.id ? null : filter.id"
        :class="['inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
          (localSelected[filter.id] || []).length > 0
            ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300'
            : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600']">
        <span>{{ filter.label }}</span>
        <span v-if="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).length > 0"
          class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">{{ (localSelected[filter.id] || []).length }}</span>
        <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="11" :class="openId === filter.id ? 'rotate-180 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'" />
      </button>

      <div v-if="openId === filter.id"
        class="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <button v-for="option in filter.options" :key="option.value" type="button"
          :aria-pressed="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)"
          @click="toggleOption(filter.id, option.value)"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <span
            :class="['flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border',
              (localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)
                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600']">
            <UiIcon v-if="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)" name="check" :size="9" :stroke-width="3" />
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{{ option.label }}</span>
          <span v-if="option.count !== undefined" class="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ option.count }}</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <button v-if="activeCount > 0" type="button" @click="clearAll"
      class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">
      <UiIcon name="x" :size="11" />
      Clear all
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    filters: FilterDefinition[];
    selected?: Record<string, string[]>;
  }>(),
  { selected: () => ({}) }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', selected: Record<string, string[]>): void; (e: 'clear'): void }>();

const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const openId = ref<string | null>(null);
const localSelected = ref<Record<string, string[]>>({ ...props.selected });

watch(
  () => props.selected,
  (value) => {
    localSelected.value = { ...(value ?? {}) };
  },
  { deep: true }
);

const activeCount = computed(() =>
  Object.values(localSelected.value).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0)
);

const commit = (next: Record<string, string[]>) => {
  localSelected.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const toggleOption = (filterId: string, value: string) => {
  const values = localSelected.value[filterId] ?? [];
  const nextValues = values.includes(value) ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value) : [...values, value];
  const next = { ...localSelected.value };
  if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
  else delete next[filterId];
  commit(next);
};

const clearAll = () => {
  commit({});
  emit('clear');
};

const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) openId.value = null;
};
const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') openId.value = null;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

        <button type="button" data-filter-remove aria-label="Remove filter" class="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('change', rows.filter((item) => item.id !== row.id))">

        {{ addLabel }}
      </button>
      <button v-if="rows.length" type="button" data-filter-clear class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 hover:underline dark:text-zinc-400" @click="emit('change', []); emit('clear')">
        {{ clearLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface QueryFilterField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  operators?: string[];
}

export interface QueryFilterRow {
  id: string;
  conjunction: 'where' | 'and' | 'or';
  field: string;
  operator: string;
  value: string;
}

const OPERATOR_GLYPH: Record<string, string> = {
  equals: '=',
  'not-equals': '<>',
  greater: '>',
  less: '<',
  contains: '~',
  gte: '>=',
  lte: '<=',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    fields?: QueryFilterField[];
    rows?: QueryFilterRow[];
    addLabel?: string;
    clearLabel?: string;
    maxRows?: number;
  }>(),
  { fields: () => [], rows: () => [], addLabel: '+ Add filter', clearLabel: 'Clear filters', maxRows: 8 },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', rows: QueryFilterRow[]): void;
  (e: 'clear'): void;
}>();

const operatorsFor = (name: string) => props.fields.find((field) => field.name === name)?.operators || ['equals', 'not-equals', 'greater', 'less', 'contains', 'gte', 'lte'];

const updateRow = (id: string, patch: Partial<QueryFilterRow>) => {
  emit('change', props.rows.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item)));
};

const addRow = () => {
  emit('change', [
    ...props.rows,
    { id: `f${Date.now()}`, conjunction: props.rows.length === 0 ? 'where' : 'and', field: props.fields[0]?.name || '', operator: 'equals', value: '' },
  ]);
};
</script>

      </p>
      <span v-if="deltaLabel" class="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-semibold" :class="toneText[deltaTone]">
        <UiIcon :name="deltaIcon as IconName" :size="12" />
        {{ deltaLabel }}
      </span>
    </div>
    <p v-if="note" class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ note }}</p>
    <div class="mt-4 flex h-28 items-end gap-1" role="img" aria-label="Trend with forecast">
      <div
        v-for="(point, index) in points"

        :data-point-index="index"
        class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1"
      >

          <div
            v-if="point.forecast"
            class="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50 dark:border-sky-500 dark:bg-sky-900/40"
            :style="{ height: `${heightOf(point.value)}%` }"
            :title="`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ''} (forecast)`"
          />
          <div
            v-else
            class="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md bg-sky-500 transition-all duration-300 dark:bg-sky-400"
            :style="{ height: `${heightOf(point.value)}%` }"
            :title="`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ''}`"
          />
        </div>
        <span class="truncate text-[9px] text-zinc-400">{{ point.label }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-sky-500" /> Actual
      </span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50" /> Forecast
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ForecastPoint {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  forecast?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    headline?: string | number;
    deltaLabel?: string;
    deltaTone?: 'emerald' | 'rose' | 'zinc';
    note?: string;
    points?: ForecastPoint[];
    unit?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { headline: 0, deltaLabel: '', deltaTone: 'emerald', note: '', points: () => [], unit: '', className: '' },
);

const toneText: Record<string, string> = {
  emerald: 'text-emerald-600',
  rose: 'text-rose-600',
  zinc: 'text-zinc-400',
};

const deltaIcon = computed<IconName>(() =>
  props.deltaTone === 'emerald' ? 'trending-up' : props.deltaTone === 'rose' ? 'trending-down' : 'minus',
);

const max = computed(() => Math.max(...props.points.map((point) => point.value), 0.0001));
const heightOf = (value: number) => Math.max(4, Math.round((value / max.value) * 100));
</script>

      <span
        role="columnheader"
        class="w-44 shrink-0 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400"
      >
        {{ rowLabel }}
      </span>
      <div class="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span
          v-for="cell in cells"
          :key="cell"
          role="columnheader"
          class="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 px-1 py-2 text-center text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800"
        >
          {{ cell + 1 }}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="tasks.length === 0" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</p>
    <template v-else>
      <div
        v-for="(task, index) in tasks"
        :key="`${task.label}-${index}`"
        role="row"
        :data-task-index="index"
        @click="handleClick(task, index)"
        :class="`flex items-stretch border-b border-zinc-50 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
          onTaskClick ? 'cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40' : ''
        }`"
      >
        <span
          role="cell"
          class="flex w-44 shrink-0 items-center py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
          :style="{ paddingLeft: `${1 + (task.depth || 0) * 1.25}rem` }"
        >
          <span class="truncate">{{ task.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <div role="cell" class="relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span
            v-for="cell in cells"
            :key="cell"
            aria-hidden="true"
            class="absolute inset-y-0 border-l border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60"
            :style="{ left: `${(cell / columns) * 100}%` }"
          />
          <span
            v-if="today !== undefined"
            aria-hidden="true"
            class="absolute inset-y-0 w-px bg-rose-400"
            :style="{ left: `${(Math.min(Math.max(today, 0), columns) / columns) * 100}%` }"
          />
          <div
            data-task-bar
            class="absolute top-1/2 flex h-4 -translate-y-1/2 items-center overflow-hidden rounded"
            :style="{
              left: `${offsetOf(task) * 100}%`,
              width: `calc(${widthOf(task) * 100}% - 4px)`,
            }"
          >
            <div class="relative h-full bg-indigo-500" :class="toneClass(task.tone)">
              <span
                v-if="task.progress !== undefined"
                class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white/30"
                :style="{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(task.progress, 0), 100)}%` }"
              />
            </div>
            <span class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
              {{ task.progress !== undefined ? `${task.progress}%` : '' }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface GanttTask {
  label: string;
  start: number;
  span: number;
  progress?: number;
  tone?: 'indigo' | 'emerald' | 'amber' | 'sky';
  depth?: number;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tasks: GanttTask[];
    columns?: number;
    today?: number;
    columnLabel?: string;
    rowLabel?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    onTaskClick?: (task: GanttTask, index: number) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { columns: 10, columnLabel: 'Timeline', rowLabel: 'Name', emptyText: 'No tasks scheduled', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'task-click', task: GanttTask, index: number): void }>();

const cells = computed(() => Array.from({ length: props.columns }, (_, index) => index));

const clampStart = (task: GanttTask) => Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), props.columns);
const offsetOf = (task: GanttTask) => clampStart(task) / props.columns;
const widthOf = (task: GanttTask) =>
  Math.min(Math.max(task.span, 0), props.columns - clampStart(task)) / props.columns;

const toneClass = (tone?: string) => {
  if (tone === 'emerald') return 'bg-emerald-500';
  if (tone === 'amber') return 'bg-amber-400';
  if (tone === 'sky') return 'bg-sky-500';
  return 'bg-indigo-500';
};

const handleClick = (task: GanttTask, index: number) => {
  props.onTaskClick?.(task, index);
  emit('task-click', task, index);
};
</script>

====/File: vue/HealthDonutStats.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="cards.length"
    data-health-donut-stats
    class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
    :class="className"
  >
    <div
      v-for="(card, index) in cards"
      :key="`${card.title}-${index}`"
      :data-donut-card="index"
      class="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
        <div class="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0">
          <div class="h-16 w-16 rounded-full" :style="donutStyle(card.slices)" />
          <div class="absolute inset-[10px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <span data-donut-center class="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ percentOf(card.slices) }}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p class="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ card.title }}</p>
          <p v-if="card.caption" class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ card.caption }}</p>
          <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1">
            <li
              v-for="(slice, sliceIndex) in card.slices"
              :key="`${slice.label}-${sliceIndex}`"
              class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"
            >
              <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" :class="toneDot[slice.tone]" />
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{{ slice.label }}</span>
              <span class="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums">{{ shareOf(slice, card.slices) }}%</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        v-if="card.action"
        type="button"
        data-donut-action
        class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        @click="emit('action-click', index, card.action.label)"
      >
        {{ card.action.label }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface HealthDonutSlice {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone: 'indigo' | 'amber' | 'zinc' | 'emerald' | 'rose';
}

export interface HealthDonutCard {
  title: string;
  caption?: string;
  slices: HealthDonutSlice[];
  action?: { label: string };
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    cards?: HealthDonutCard[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { cards: () => [], className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action-click', index: number, label: string): void;
}>();

const toneDot: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const sliceColor: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const sumOf = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0);

const donutStyle = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices) || 1;
  let cursor = 0;
  const stops: string[] = [];
  slices.forEach((slice) => {
    const start = (cursor / total) * 360;
    cursor += Math.max(0, slice.value);
    const end = (cursor / total) * 360;
    stops.push(`${sliceColor[slice.tone]} ${start}deg ${end}deg`);
  });
  return { background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` };
};

const percentOf = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices);
  if (!total || !slices.length) return 0;
  const primary = slices.reduce((best, slice) => (slice.value > best.value ? slice : best), slices[0]);
  return Math.round((primary.value / total) * 100);
};

const shareOf = (slice: HealthDonutSlice, slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices);
  return total ? Math.round((slice.value / total) * 100) : 0;
};
</script>

defineEmits<{ (e: 'primary'): void; (e: 'secondary'): void }>();

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — Vue 3 (SFC)
 * A copy-paste, zero-blackbox single-file homelab dashboard with the iconic
 * gethomepage/homepage look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive
 * grouped service cards with status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source copied.
 */
export type HomepageStatus = 'online' | 'up' | 'down' | 'offline' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'unknown';

export interface HomepageService {
  /** Optional stable key — used for v-for reconciliation; falls back to name+index */
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** Only http(s), mailto, protocol-relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs are rendered as a link */
  href?: string;
  pingText?: string;
  status?: HomepageStatus;
}

export interface HomepageGroup {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  services: HomepageService[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    version?: string;
    groups?: HomepageGroup[];
    headerStyle?: 'underlined' | 'boxed' | 'clean';
    statusStyle?: 'pill' | 'dot' | 'none';
    showClock?: boolean;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    collapsible?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    title: 'Homepage',
    subtitle: 'A highly customizable homelab dashboard',
    version: 'Homepage · awesome-ui',
    groups: () => [],
    headerStyle: 'underlined',
    statusStyle: 'pill',
    showClock: true,
    showSearch: false,
    searchPlaceholder: 'Search services…',
    collapsible: true,
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'group-toggle': [group: string, collapsed: boolean] }>();

/* ---------- clock: starts/stops when showClock toggles, always cleaned up ---------- */
const now = ref(new Date());
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

const stopClock = () => {
  if (timer) {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  }
};
const startClock = () => {
  if (props.showClock && !timer) {
    timer = setInterval(() => (now.value = new Date()), 1000);
  }
};

watch(() => props.showClock, (v) => (v ? startClock() : stopClock()));
onMounted(startClock);
onBeforeUnmount(stopClock);

const time = computed(() => now.value.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
const date = computed(() =>
  now.value.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
);

/* ---------- search & collapse ---------- */
const query = ref('');

const trimmedQuery = computed(() => query.value.trim().toLowerCase());

const filteredGroups = computed<HomepageGroup[]>(() => {
  const q = trimmedQuery.value;
  if (!q) return props.groups;
  return props.groups
    .map((g) => ({
      ...g,
      services: (g.services || []).filter(
        (s) =>
          (s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (s.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ),
    }))
    .filter((g) => g.services.length > 0);
});

const collapsed = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});

const emptyMessage = computed(() => {
  if (props.groups.length === 0) return 'No services configured yet.';
  if (trimmedQuery.value) return `No matching services for “${trimmedQuery.value}”.`;
  return 'No services configured yet.';
});

const toggleGroup = (name: string) => {
  if (!props.collapsible) return;
  collapsed.value = { ...collapsed.value, [name]: !collapsed.value[name] };
  emit('group-toggle', name, collapsed.value[name]);
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const effectiveStatusStyle = computed<'pill' | 'dot' | 'none'>(() =>
  ['pill', 'dot', 'none'].includes(props.statusStyle) ? props.statusStyle : 'pill'
);

/** Hide an icon <img> on load failure (parity: letter monogram space is kept by container) */
const onIconError = (e: Event) => {
  const el = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
  el.style.display = 'none';
};

const headerCls = computed(() =>
  props.headerStyle === 'boxed'
    ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4'
    : props.headerStyle === 'clean'
      ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0'
      : 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4'
);

const statusConfig = (status: HomepageStatus = 'unknown') => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
    case 'up':
      return { dot: 'bg-emerald-500', pill: 'text-emerald-500/90', label: 'UP' };
    case 'down':
    case 'offline':
      return { dot: 'bg-rose-500', pill: 'text-rose-500/90', label: 'DOWN' };
    case 'warn':
      return { dot: 'bg-amber-500', pill: 'text-amber-500', label: 'WARN' };
    case 'error':
      return { dot: 'bg-orange-500', pill: 'text-orange-500', label: 'ERROR' };
    default:
      return { dot: 'bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60', pill: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', label: '—' };
  }
};

/** Only allow safe URL protocols into the anchor. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: … */
const isSafeHref = (href?: string): boolean => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const serviceHref = (service: HomepageService) => (isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : undefined);

const isImageIcon = (icon?: string) => !!icon && /^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(icon);

const monogram = (name?: string) => (name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const statusLabel = (service: HomepageService) => service.pingText || statusConfig(service.status).label;
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="className" class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
    <section
      v-for="column in columns"
      :key="column.id"
      :aria-label="column.title"
      :class="[
        'flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40',
        overColumn === column.id
          ? 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20'
          : 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800',
      ]"
      @dragover.prevent="overColumn = column.id"
      @dragleave="overColumn = overColumn === column.id ? null : overColumn"
      @drop.prevent="drop(column.id)"
    >
      <header class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
        <span :class="['h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', column.accent || 'bg-zinc-400']" aria-hidden="true" />

        >
          Drop cards here
        </p>
        <div
          v-for="card in cardsIn(column.id)"
          :key="card.id"
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          draggable="true"
          :class="[
            'cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600',
            draggingId === card.id ? 'opacity-40' : '',
          ]"
          @dragstart="startDrag($event, card.id)"
          @dragend="resetDrag"
          @click="emit('card-click', card)"
          @keydown="onKeydown($event, card)"
        >

            <p class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {{ card.title }}
            </p>

              v-if="card.priority"
              :class="['shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium', PRIORITY_META[card.priority].cls]"
            >
              {{ PRIORITY_META[card.priority].label }}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p v-if="card.description" class="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ card.description }}
          </p>
          <div v-if="card.tags?.length || card.assignee" class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
            <span
              v-for="tag in (card.tags || []).slice(0, 2)"
              :key="tag"
              class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
            >
              {{ tag }}
            </span>

            >
              {{ initials(card.assignee) }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface KanbanColumn {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  accent?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string;
  columnId: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  assignee?: string;
  priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

const PRIORITY_META: Record<NonNullable<KanbanCard['priority']>, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  low: { label: 'Low', cls: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' },
  high: { label: 'High', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    columns?: KanbanColumn[];
    cards?: KanbanCard[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { columns: () => [], cards: () => [], className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'move-card', cardId: string, toColumnId: string): void;
  (e: 'card-click', card: KanbanCard): void;
  (e: 'add-card', columnId: string): void;
}>();

const draggingId = ref<string | null>(null);
const overColumn = ref<string | null>(null);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const cardsIn = (columnId: string) => props.cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === columnId);

function move(cardId: string, toColumnId: string) {
  const card = props.cards.find((entry) => entry.id === cardId);
  if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
  emit('move-card', cardId, toColumnId);
}

function startDrag(event: DragEvent, cardId: string) {
  event.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain', cardId);
  if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
  draggingId.value = cardId;
}

function resetDrag() {
  draggingId.value = null;
  overColumn.value = null;
}

function drop(columnId: string) {
  const cardId = draggingId.value;
  if (cardId) move(cardId, columnId);
  resetDrag();
}

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent, card: KanbanCard) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
    event.preventDefault();
    emit('card-click', card);
    return;
  }
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
  const index = props.columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
  const next = props.columns[index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)];
  if (!next) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  move(card.id, next.id);
}
</script>

====/File: vue/LiveTailLogConsole.vue/====

<template>
  <div data-live-tail-console class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-950">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-neutral-800 px-3 py-2">
      <select v-if="sources.length" data-tail-source class="rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-neutral-200 focus-visible:outline-none" @change="emit('source-change', ($event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)">
        <option value="all">All sources</option>
        <option v-for="source in sources" :key="source" :value="source">{{ source }}</option>
      </select>
      <div class="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-neutral-500">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
        </svg>
        <input type="text" :value="query" :placeholder="searchPlaceholder" data-tail-search class="w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 py-1 pl-7 pr-2 text-xs text-neutral-200 placeholder:text-neutral-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500" @input="onInput" />
      </div>
      <button type="button" data-tail-follow :class="['inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500', follow ? 'border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400' : 'border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300']" @click="toggleFollow">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3 w-3"><path d="M13 2 3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z" /></svg>
        Live tail
      </button>
      <span v-if="timezone" class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-neutral-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{{ timezone }}</span>
    </div>
    <div data-tail-lines class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-300">
      <p v-if="filtered.length === 0" class="py-4 text-center text-neutral-500">No log lines match.</p>
      <div v-for="(line, index) in filtered" :key="index" data-tail-line class="flex items-start gap-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
        <span v-if="line.ts" class="shrink-0 text-neutral-500">{{ line.ts }}</span>
        <span :class="['mt-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full', LEVEL_DOT[line.level] || LEVEL_DOT.info]" />
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-neutral-300">{{ line.message }}</span>
        <span v-if="line.source" class="shrink-0 rounded bg-neutral-800 px-1 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{{ line.source }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface TailLogLine {
  ts?: string;
  level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'success';
  message: string;
  source?: string;
}

const LEVEL_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  info: 'bg-sky-500',
  warn: 'bg-amber-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
  success: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    lines: TailLogLine[];
    sources?: string[];
    liveTail?: boolean;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    timezone?: string;
    maxLines?: number;
  }>(),
  { sources: () => [], liveTail: true, searchPlaceholder: 'Search logs…', timezone: 'GMT+7', maxLines: 200 },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'search', query: string): void;
  (e: 'source-change', source: string): void;
  (e: 'live-tail-change', enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const query = ref('');
const follow = ref(props.liveTail);

const filtered = computed(() => {
  const base = query.value
    ? props.lines.filter((line) => line.message.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase()) || (line.source || '').toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase()))
    : props.lines;
  return props.maxLines > 0 ? base.slice(-props.maxLines) : base;
});

const onInput = (event: Event) => {
  query.value = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
  emit('search', query.value);
};

const toggleFollow = () => {
  follow.value = !follow.value;
  emit('live-tail-change', follow.value);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted } from 'vue';

export interface MarqueeCard {
  name: string;
  handle?: string;
  text: string;
  anonymous?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    rows?: MarqueeCard[][];
    speedSeconds?: number;
    paused?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { rows: () => [], speedSeconds: 40, paused: false, className: '' },
);

const avatarTones = ['bg-indigo-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-rose-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-violet-500'];

const doubled = (row: MarqueeCard[]) => [...row, ...row];
const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');
void props;

// The <style> tag is not allowed inside a client template; inject the keyframes once.
const MARQUEE_STYLE_ID = 'marquee-scroll-keyframes';
onMounted(() => {
  if (document.getElementById(MARQUEE_STYLE_ID)) return;
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.id = MARQUEE_STYLE_ID;
  style.textContent =
    '@keyframes marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } } ' +
    '[data-marquee-row]:hover div { animation-play-state: paused !important; }';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface MemoryItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  source?: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  note?: string;
  items: MemoryItem[];
  addPlaceholder?: string;
  addText?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Memory",
  note: "Facts the assistant remembers across conversations.",
  addPlaceholder: "Add a memory…",
  addText: "Add",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "add", text: string): void;
  (e: "edit", id: string, text: string): void;
  (e: "delete", id: string): void;
  (e: "clear"): void;
}>();

const draft = ref("");
const editingId = ref<string | null>(null);
const editDraft = ref("");

const submitAdd = () => {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit("add", text);
  draft.value = "";
};
const startEdit = (item: MemoryItem) => {
  editingId.value = item.id;
  editDraft.value = item.text;
};
const submitEdit = () => {
  if (!editingId.value) return;
  const text = editDraft.value.trim();
  if (text) emit("edit", editingId.value, text);
  editingId.value = null;
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-memory-panel class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

          />

<template>
  <div :class="['flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none', className]">
    <!-- Branch Navigator -->
    <div
      v-if="totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined"
      class="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"

      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span>{{ branchIndex + 1 }}/{{ totalBranches }}</span>
      <button

        :disabled="branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1"
        @click="$emit('branchChange', branchIndex + 1)"
        class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"

      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="14" />

      title="Copy response"
    >
      <UiIcon v-if="copied" name="check" :size="16" class="text-emerald-500" />

    <button
      v-if="showRetry"
      type="button"
      @click="$emit('retry')"
      class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
      title="Regenerate response"
    >
      <UiIcon name="refresh" :size="16" />
    </button>

    <!-- Thumbs Up / Down -->
    <template v-if="role === 'assistant'">
      <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleThumb('up')"
        :class="[
          'p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors',
          feedback === 'up' ? 'text-blue-500' : 'hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
        title="Good response"
      >
        <UiIcon name="thumbs-up" :size="16" />
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleThumb('down')"
        :class="[
          'p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors',
          feedback === 'down' ? 'text-rose-500' : 'hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
        title="Bad response"
      >
        <UiIcon name="thumbs-down" :size="16" />
      </button>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    role?: 'assistant' | 'user' | string;
    showRetry?: boolean;
    branchIndex?: number;
    totalBranches?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    role: 'assistant',
    showRetry: true,
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'retry'): void;
  (e: 'feedback', type: 'up' | 'down'): void;
  (e: 'branchChange', index: number): void;
}>();

const copied = ref(false);
const feedback = ref<'up' | 'down' | null>(null);

const handleCopy = async () => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.content);
  copied.value = true;
  setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 2000);
};

const handleThumb = (type: 'up' | 'down') => {
  const next = feedback.value === type ? null : type;
  feedback.value = next;
  if (next) emit('feedback', next);
};
</script>

      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-4">

          <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</h2>
          <p v-if="description" class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ description }}</p>
        </div>
        <button v-if="showClose" type="button" aria-label="Close" @click="emit('close')"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div v-if="$slots.default" class="px-5 py-4 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <slot />
      </div>
      <div v-if="$slots.footer" class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/50">
        <slot name="footer" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    open: boolean;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    dismissible?: boolean;
    showClose?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { dismissible: true, showClose: true }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'close'): void }>();

const panelRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

const onBackdrop = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (props.dismissible && panelRef.value && !panelRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) emit('close');
};

const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape' && props.dismissible && props.open) emit('close');
};

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey));
onBeforeUnmount(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey));
</script>

<template>
  <div

    class="relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
    :class="className"
  >
    <button

          <UiIcon name="search" :size="13" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    models?: ModelOption[];
    selectedId: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    models: () => [],
    placeholder: "Select model...",
    showSearch: true,
    disabled: false,
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", model: ModelOption): void;
  (e: "update:selectedId", id: string): void;
}>();

const isOpen = ref(false);
const searchQuery = ref("");
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const selectedModel = computed(
  () => props.models.find((m) => m.id === props.selectedId) || null
);

const filteredModels = computed(() => {
  if (!searchQuery.value.trim()) return props.models;
  const q = searchQuery.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.models.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
  );
});

function handleSelect(model: ModelOption) {
  emit("select", model);
  emit("update:selectedId", model.id);
  isOpen.value = false;
  searchQuery.value = "";
}

function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (containerRef.value && !containerRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    isOpen.value = false;
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});
</script>
