<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: number | null;
    label?: string;
    status?: "streaming" | "done" | "error";
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { value: null, status: "streaming", className: "" }
);

const clamped = computed(() =>
  props.value === null || props.value === undefined ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, props.value))
);
const indeterminate = computed(() => clamped.value === null);

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  streaming: "bg-indigo-500",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
};

  { icon: '', duration: 3000, position: 'top-right' as const },
);

  (e: 'close'): void;

====/File: vue/Tabs.vue/====

<template>
  <div role="tablist" :aria-label="ariaLabel"
    :class="[variant === 'pills' ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="(tab, index) in tabs" :key="tab.id" :ref="(el) => setRef(tab.id, el)" type="button" role="tab"
      :id="`tab-${tab.id}`" :aria-selected="tab.id === current" :aria-controls="`panel-${tab.id}`"
      :tabindex="tab.id === current ? 0 : -1" :disabled="tab.disabled" @click="select(tab)"
      @keydown="move($event, index)"
      :class="['inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        variant === 'pills' ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2',
        variant === 'pills'
          ? (tab.id === current ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')
          : (tab.id === current ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400' : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')]">
      <UiIcon v-if="tab.icon" :name="tab.icon" :size="13" />
      <span>{{ tab.label }}</span>
      <span v-if="tab.badge !== undefined"
        class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ tab.badge }}</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tabs: TabItem[];
    activeId?: string;
    defaultActiveId?: string;
    variant?: 'underline' | 'pills';
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'underline', ariaLabel: 'Tabs' }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', id: string): void }>();

const internalId = ref(props.defaultActiveId ?? props.tabs[0]?.id ?? '');
const current = computed(() => props.activeId ?? internalId.value);
const refs: Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null> = {};

const setRef = (id: string, el: unknown) => {
  refs[id] = (el as HTMLButtonElement) ?? null;
};

const select = (tab: TabItem) => {
  if (tab.disabled) return;
  if (props.activeId === undefined) internalId.value = tab.id;
  emit('change', tab.id);
};

const move = (event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
  const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
  if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const enabled = props.tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
  if (enabled.length === 0) return;
  const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
  let next = position;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
  if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
  const target = enabled[next];
  if (target) {
    select(target.tab);
    refs[target.tab.id]?.focus();
  }
};
</script>

====/File: vue/TargetGauge.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    data-target-gauge
    role="img"
    :aria-label="`${label}: ${valuePrefix}${value}${valueSuffix} of ${valuePrefix}${target}${valueSuffix}`"
    class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    :class="className"
  >
    <p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{{ label }}</p>
    <div class="relative mx-auto mt-3 h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden">
      <div class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden rounded-t-full">
        <span v-for="(zone, index) in segments" :key="index" class="h-full" :class="zoneColor[zone.tone]" :style="{ width: zone.width }" />
      </div>
      <div class="absolute left-1/2 top-[18px] h-[52px] w-[104px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-t-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900" />
      <div
        data-gauge-needle
        class="absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 h-[54px] w-0.5 origin-bottom bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100"
        :style="{ transform: `rotate(${angle}deg)` }"
      >
        <span class="absolute -top-[3px] left-1/2 h-2 w-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
      </div>
      <div class="absolute bottom-[-4px] left-1/2 h-3 w-3 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
    </div>
    <div class="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
      <span>{{ valuePrefix }}0{{ valueSuffix }}</span>
      <span data-gauge-value class="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white" :class="zoneColor[currentTone]">
        {{ valuePrefix }}{{ value }}{{ valueSuffix }}
      </span>
      <span>{{ valuePrefix }}{{ target }}{{ valueSuffix }}</span>
    </div>
    <p v-if="remainingLabel" class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
      {{ remaining > 0 ? `Remaining: ${valuePrefix}${remaining}${valueSuffix} — ` : '' }}{{ remainingLabel }}
    </p>
    <span class="hidden" data-gauge-percent>{{ Math.round(percent) }}%</span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface TargetGaugeZone {
  from: number;
  tone: 'rose' | 'amber' | 'emerald';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: number;
    target?: number;
    label?: string;
    valuePrefix?: string;
    valueSuffix?: string;
    zones?: TargetGaugeZone[];
    remainingLabel?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    value: 0,
    target: 100,
    label: 'Progress',
    valuePrefix: '',
    valueSuffix: '',
    zones: () => [
      { from: 0, tone: 'rose' },
      { from: 60, tone: 'amber' },
      { from: 85, tone: 'emerald' },
    ],
    remainingLabel: '',
    className: '',
  },
);

const zoneColor: Record<string, string> = {
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

const clamp01 = (raw: number) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, raw));

const percent = computed(() => (props.target > 0 ? (props.value / props.target) * 100 : 0));
const angle = computed(() => (clamp01(percent.value) / 100) * 180 - 90);
const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.target - props.value));

const segments = computed(() => {
  const sorted = [...props.zones].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
  return sorted.map((zone, index) => {
    const end = index + 1 < sorted.length ? sorted[index + 1].from : 100;
    return { ...zone, width: `${Math.max(0, end - zone.from)}%` };
  });
});

const currentTone = computed<'rose' | 'amber' | 'emerald'>(() => {
  const found = [...segments.value].reverse().find((zone) => clamp01(percent.value) >= zone.from);
  return found?.tone ?? 'rose';
});
</script>

====/File: vue/ThemeToggle.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none',
      className
    ]"
    role="group"
    aria-label="Theme toggle"
  >
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('auto')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'auto'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Follow System/Time"
    >
      <span>💻</span>
      <span>Auto</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('light')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'light'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Light Mode"
    >
      <span>☀️</span>
      <span>Light</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('dark')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'dark'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Dark Mode"
    >
      <span>🌙</span>
      <span>Dark</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

export type ThemeMode = 'auto' | 'light' | 'dark';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    storageKey?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    storageKey: 'mango-theme',
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', mode: ThemeMode, resolved: 'light' | 'dark'): void;
}>();

const mode = ref<ThemeMode>('auto');

const resolveTheme = (m: ThemeMode): 'light' | 'dark' => {
  if (m === 'light' || m === 'dark') return m;
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const isNight =
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) ||
    hour >= 19 ||
    hour < 7;
  return isNight ? 'dark' : 'light';
};

const applyTheme = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
  const resolved = resolveTheme(nextMode);
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
  document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
  document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
  if (resolved === 'dark') {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
  } else {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
  }
  mode.value = nextMode;
  localStorage.setItem(props.storageKey, nextMode);
  emit('change', nextMode, resolved);
};

onMounted(() => {
  const saved = (localStorage.getItem(props.storageKey) as ThemeMode) || 'auto';
  applyTheme(saved);
});
</script>

                :key="slot.id"

                :data-time-slot="slot.id"
                :disabled="slot.disabled"

'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/60' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800']"
                @click="choose(slot)"
              >
                <span :class="['block text-xs font-semibold', isSelected(slot) ? 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">{{ slot.label }}</span>
                <span v-if="slot.available != null" :class="['mt-0.5 block text-[10px]', slot.available > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-zinc-400']">
                  {{ slot.available > 0 ? `${slot.available} available` : 'Fully booked' }}
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </template>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface TimeSlot {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  period?: 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening';
  available?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface SlotDay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  weekday: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  slots: TimeSlot[];
}

const PERIODS = ['morning', 'afternoon', 'evening'] as const;
const PERIOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { morning: 'Morning', afternoon: 'Afternoon', evening: 'Evening' };

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    days: SlotDay[];
    value?: { dayId: string; slotId: string } | null;
    timezone?: string;
    daysLabel?: string;
    slotsLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { value: null, daysLabel: 'Date', slotsLabel: 'Select a time' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', value: { dayId: string; slotId: string; slot: TimeSlot }): void;
}>();

const selected = ref(props.value);
const activeDayId = ref(props.value?.dayId || props.days.find((day) => !day.disabled)?.id || props.days[0]?.id || '');

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (value) => {
    if (value) {
      selected.value = value;
      activeDayId.value = value.dayId;
    }
  },
);

const activeDay = computed(() => props.days.find((day) => day.id === activeDayId.value) || props.days[0]);

const slotsFor = (day: SlotDay, period: string) => day.slots.filter((slot) => (slot.period || 'morning') === period);

const isSelected = (slot: TimeSlot) => selected.value?.dayId === activeDayId.value && selected.value?.slotId === slot.id;

const choose = (slot: TimeSlot) => {
  if (slot.disabled) return;
  selected.value = { dayId: activeDayId.value, slotId: slot.id };
  emit('select', { dayId: activeDayId.value, slotId: slot.id, slot });
};
</script>

====/File: vue/ToastStack.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="toasts.length > 0"
    class="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
    :class="className"
    aria-live="polite"
  >
    <div
      v-for="toast in toasts"
      :key="toast.id"
      class="relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 animate-in slide-in-from-right fade-in duration-200"
      role="alert"
      @mouseenter="pause(toast.id)"
      @mouseleave="resume(toast.id)"
    >
      <UiIcon :name="typeMeta(toast.type).icon" :size="16" class="shrink-0" :class="typeMeta(toast.type).color" />
      <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">{{ toast.message }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0"
        aria-label="Dismiss"
        @click="emit('dismiss', toast.id)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span
        v-if="duration > 0"
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear"
        :class="[typeMeta(toast.type).bar, remaining.get(toast.id) !== undefined ? '' : '']"
        :style="{ width: `${remaining.get(toast.id) ?? 100}%` }"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, watch, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string | number;
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    toasts?: ToastItem[];
    duration?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { toasts: () => [], duration: 4000, className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "dismiss", id: string | number): void;
}>();

const META: Record<string, { icon: string; color: string; bar: string }> = {
  success: { icon: "check-circle", color: "text-emerald-500", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", color: "text-rose-500", bar: "bg-rose-500" },
  warning: { icon: "alert-triangle", color: "text-amber-500", bar: "bg-amber-500" },
  info: { icon: "sparkles", color: "text-sky-500", bar: "bg-sky-500" },
};

function typeMeta(type?: string) {
  return META[type || "info"] || META.info;
}

interface ToastClock {
  started: number;
  /** Percent (0-100) remaining when the clock (re)started. */
  startPct: number;
  /** ms budget corresponding to startPct. */
  total: number;
  timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  ticker?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
}

const clocks = new Map<string | number, ToastClock>();
const remaining = reactive(new Map<string | number, number>());

function stopClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (clock) {
    if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
    if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
    clocks.delete(id);
  }
}

function startClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock || clock.total <= 0 || props.duration <= 0) return;
  const started = Date.now();
  clock.started = started;
  clock.timer = setTimeout(() => {
    remaining.set(id, 0);
    stopClock(id);
    emit("dismiss", id);
  }, clock.total);
  clock.ticker = setInterval(() => {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
    remaining.set(id, Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total)));
  }, 100);
}

function pause(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock) return;
  if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
  if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
  const elapsed = Date.now() - clock.started;
  const nextPct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total));
  clock.startPct = nextPct;
  clock.total = Math.max(0, clock.total - elapsed);
  remaining.set(id, nextPct);
}

function resume(id: string | number) {
  startClock(id);
}

watch(
  () => props.toasts.map((t) => t.id).join(","),
  () => {
    if (props.duration <= 0) {
      for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
      return;
    }
    const alive = new Set(props.toasts.map((t) => t.id));
    for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) stopClock(id);
    }
    for (const t of props.toasts) {
      if (!clocks.has(t.id)) {
        clocks.set(t.id, { started: Date.now(), startPct: 100, total: props.duration });
        remaining.set(t.id, 100);
        startClock(t.id);
      }
    }
  },
  { immediate: true }
);

onUnmounted(() => {
  for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface TokenCostSegment {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  amountUsd: number;
  color?: string;
}

export interface TokenUsageRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  tokens: number;
  percent: number;
  barColor?: string;
}

interface Props {
  segments?: TokenCostSegment[];
  usageRows?: TokenUsageRow[];
  title?: string;
  spendUsed?: number;
  spendTotal?: number;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  segments: () => [],
  usageRows: () => [],
  title: 'Spend breakdown',
  spendUsed: undefined,
  spendTotal: undefined,
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'segment-select', segment: TokenCostSegment): void;
}>();

const defaultColors = ['bg-zinc-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-violet-500', 'bg-rose-500'];

const segColor = (segment: TokenCostSegment, index: number) => segment.color ?? defaultColors[index % defaultColors.length];

const fmtUsd = (usd: number) =>
  usd >= 100 ? `$${usd.toFixed(0)}` : usd >= 1 ? `$${usd.toFixed(2)}` : `$${usd.toFixed(3)}`;

const fmtTokens = (tokens: number) => tokens.toLocaleString('en-US');

const totalUsd = props.segments.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.amountUsd, 0);
const used = typeof props.spendUsed === 'number' ? props.spendUsed : totalUsd;
const percent =
  typeof props.spendTotal === 'number' && props.spendTotal > 0 ? Math.min((used / props.spendTotal) * 100, 100) : 100;
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-token-cost
    class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        {{ typeof props.spendTotal === 'number' ? `${fmtUsd(used)} of ${fmtUsd(props.spendTotal)}` : fmtUsd(totalUsd) }}
      </span>
    </div>

    <div data-token-cost-bar class="mt-3 flex h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
      <span
        v-for="(segment, index) in props.segments"
        :key="segment.id"
        :data-token-cost-segment="segment.id"
        class="h-full cursor-pointer"
        :class="segColor(segment, index)"
        :style="{ width: `${totalUsd > 0 ? (segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * percent : 0}%` }"
        @click="emit('segment-select', segment)"
      ></span>
    </div>

    <div data-token-cost-legend class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
      <div v-for="(segment, index) in props.segments" :key="segment.id" class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
        <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-sm" :class="segColor(segment, index)"></span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ segment.label }}</span>
        <span class="font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ fmtUsd(segment.amountUsd) }}</span>
        <span class="w-12 text-right tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {{ totalUsd > 0 ? `${Math.round((segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * 100)}%` : '—' }}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface ToolParameter {
  name: string;
  type: "string" | "number" | "boolean";
  required?: boolean;
}
export interface ToolSchema {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  method?: string;
  endpoint?: string;
  parameters?: ToolParameter[];
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  tools: ToolSchema[];
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Tools & functions",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "validate", tool: ToolSchema): void;
  (e: "toggle", tool: ToolSchema, enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const disabled = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const isEnabled = (id: string) => !disabled.value[id];
const toggle = (tool: ToolSchema) => {
  const next = !isEnabled(tool.id);
  disabled.value = { ...disabled.value, [tool.id]: !next };
  emit("toggle", tool, next);
};
const enabledCount = () => props.tools.filter((t) => isEnabled(t.id)).length;

const TYPE_BADGE: Record<string, string> = {
  string: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300",
  number: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300",
  boolean: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-tool-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
      <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</p>
      <span data-tool-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
        {{ enabledCount() }}/{{ props.tools.length }} enabled
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">
      <div
        v-for="tool in props.tools"
        :key="tool.id"
        :data-tool-card="tool.id"
        class="rounded-lg border px-3 py-3 transition-colors"
        :class="!isEnabled(tool.id)
          ? 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 opacity-60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40'
          : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'"
      >
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <p class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <code data-tool-name class="truncate font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ tool.name }}</code>
              <span
                v-if="tool.method"
                data-tool-method
                class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold"
                :class="tool.method === 'GET' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300'"
              >{{ tool.method }}</span>
            </p>
            <code v-if="tool.endpoint" data-tool-endpoint class="mt-0.5 block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ tool.endpoint }}</code>
            <p v-if="tool.description" class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ tool.description }}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-tool-toggle
            :aria-pressed="isEnabled(tool.id)"
            @click="toggle(tool)"
            class="relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors"
            :class="isEnabled(tool.id) ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600'"
            :title="isEnabled(tool.id) ? 'Disable tool' : 'Enable tool'"
          >
            <span class="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all" :class="isEnabled(tool.id) ? 'left-4' : 'left-0.5'"></span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div v-if="tool.parameters && tool.parameters.length > 0" data-tool-params class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span
            v-for="param in tool.parameters"
            :key="param.name"
            :data-tool-param="param.name"
            class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold"
            :class="TYPE_BADGE[param.type] || TYPE_BADGE.string"
          >
            {{ param.name }}
            <span class="font-normal opacity-70">{{ param.type }}</span>
            <span v-if="param.required" class="font-bold text-red-500" title="required">*</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-2 flex justify-end">
          <button type="button" data-tool-validate @click="emit('validate', tool)" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Validate schema</button>
        </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
export type TraceSpanKind = 'llm' | 'tool' | 'retrieval';

export interface TraceSpan {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  startMs: number;
  durationMs: number;
  depth?: number;
  kind?: TraceSpanKind;
  costUsd?: number;
  tokens?: number;
}

interface Props {
  spans?: TraceSpan[];
  title?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  spans: () => [],
  title: 'Trace waterfall',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'span-select', span: TraceSpan): void;
}>();

const kindDot = (kind?: TraceSpanKind) => {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'tool':
      return 'bg-emerald-500';
    case 'retrieval':
      return 'bg-amber-500';
    default:
      return 'bg-indigo-500';
  }
};

const formatDuration = (ms: number) => (ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

const formatCost = (usd?: number) => (typeof usd === 'number' ? `$${usd.toFixed(3)}` : '');

const total = props.spans.length > 0 ? Math.max(...props.spans.map((s) => s.startMs + s.durationMs)) : 0;
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-trace-waterfall
    class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        {{ props.spans.length }} spans · {{ formatDuration(total) }}
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="px-4 py-2">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-4 pb-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500"></span> LLM
        </span>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> Tool
        </span>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span> Retrieval
        </span>
      </div>

      <div data-trace-rows class="space-y-1.5">
        <button
          v-for="span in props.spans"
          :key="span.id"
          type="button"
          :data-trace-row="span.id"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="emit('span-select', span)"
        >
          <span
            class="flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
            :style="{ width: `${Math.max(120 - (span.depth ?? 0) * 14, 88)}px`, paddingLeft: `${(span.depth ?? 0) * 14}px` }"
          >
            <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" :class="kindDot(span.kind)"></span>
            <span data-trace-name class="min-w-0 truncate">{{ span.name }}</span>
          </span>
          <span class="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span
              data-trace-bar
              class="absolute top-0.5 h-3 rounded-full"
              :class="kindDot(span.kind)"
              :style="{
                left: `${total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0}%`,
                width: `${total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0}%`,
              }"
            ></span>
            <span
              class="absolute top-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
              :style="{ left: `calc(${total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0}% + ${total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0}% + 6px)` }"
            >

<template>
  <div
    class="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
    :class="className"
    role="status"
    :aria-label="label || 'Loading'"
  >
    <span class="inline-flex items-center" :class="gapClass">
      <span
        v-for="i in 3"
        :key="i"
        class="rounded-full bg-current"
        :class="[dotClass, variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce']"
        :style="{ animationDelay: `${(i - 1) * 160}ms` }"
      ></span>
    </span>
    <span v-if="label" class="text-xs font-sans">{{ label }}</span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    label?: string;
    variant?: "dots" | "pulse";
    size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    variant: "dots",
    size: "md",
    className: "",
  }
);

const dotClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "w-1.5 h-1.5" : props.size === "lg" ? "w-2.5 h-2.5" : "w-2 h-2"
);
const gapClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "gap-1" : props.size === "lg" ? "gap-2" : "gap-1.5"
);
</script>

  used: number;
  limit: number;
  planName?: string;
  unit?: string;
  title?: string;
  features?: string[];
  ctaText?: string;
}>(), {
  planName: 'Free',
  unit: 'requests',
  title: 'Upgrade to keep going',
  features: () => [],
  ctaText: 'See plans',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'upgrade'): void }>();

const formatNumber = (value: number) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));
const percent = computed(() => {
  const safeLimit = props.limit > 0 ? props.limit : 1;
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((props.used / safeLimit) * 100)));
});
const tone = computed(() =>
  percent.value >= 90
    ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
    : percent.value >= 70
      ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
      : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' }
);
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="['rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900', $attrs.class]">
    <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
      <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ label }}</p>
      <p :class="['text-xs font-bold tabular-nums', styles.text]">{{ percent }}%</p>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
      <div :class="['h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500', styles.bar]" :style="{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <span>{{ used.toLocaleString() }} / {{ limit.toLocaleString() }}{{ unit ? ` ${unit}` : '' }}</span>
      <span v-if="showLegend && remaining > 0" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        <UiIcon name="clock" :size="10" />
        {{ remaining.toLocaleString() }} left
      </span>
      <span v-else-if="showLegend && remaining <= 0" class="font-semibold text-rose-500">Limit reached</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type UsageMeterTone = 'ok' | 'warning' | 'danger';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    label: string;
    used: number;
    limit: number;
    unit?: string;
    showLegend?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { unit: '', showLegend: true }
);

const TONE = {
  ok: { bar: 'bg-indigo-500', text: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' },
  warning: { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' },
  danger: { bar: 'bg-rose-500', text: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

const ratio = computed(() => {
  if (props.limit <= 0) return 1;
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, props.used / props.limit));
});

const tone = computed<UsageMeterTone>(() => {
  if (props.limit <= 0) return 'danger';
  const value = props.used / props.limit;
  if (value >= 0.9) return 'danger';
  if (value >= 0.7) return 'warning';
  return 'ok';
});

const styles = computed(() => TONE[tone.value]);
const percent = computed(() => Math.round(ratio.value * 100));
const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.limit - props.used));
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type VoiceModeState = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    state?: VoiceModeState;
    transcript?: string;
    reply?: string;
    showEnd?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { state: 'idle', showEnd: true }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle'): void; (e: 'end'): void }>();

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: { label: 'Tap to speak', hint: 'Voice mode is ready', ring: 'bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40', orb: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300' },
  listening: { label: 'Listening…', hint: 'Speak now — tap again to stop', ring: 'bg-indigo-400/40', orb: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' },
  thinking: { label: 'Thinking…', hint: 'Working on a response', ring: 'bg-amber-400/40', orb: 'bg-amber-500 text-white' },
  speaking: { label: 'Speaking…', hint: 'Tap to interrupt', ring: 'bg-emerald-400/40', orb: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white' },
};

const meta = computed(() => STATE_META[props.state]);
const animated = computed(() => props.state === 'listening' || props.state === 'speaking');

  if (props.state === 'listening') return 'bg-indigo-400/40';
  if (props.state === 'speaking') return 'bg-emerald-400/40';
  return 'bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40';
});
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="variant === 'bar'" data-wizard-steps role="group" aria-label="Wizard progress" :class="`flex flex-col gap-2 ${className}`">
    <p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ current + 1 }} of {{ steps.length }} steps</span>
      <template v-if="nextStep">
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">|</span>
        <span>Next: {{ nextStep.label }}</span>
      </template>
    </p>
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      :aria-valuemin="0"
      :aria-valuemax="steps.length"
      :aria-valuenow="current + 1"
      class="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50"
    >
      <div class="h-full rounded-full bg-violet-600 transition-all duration-300" :style="{ width: `${progress}%` }" />
    </div>
  </div>
  <ol v-else data-wizard-steps :class="`flex flex-col ${className}`">
    <li
      v-for="(step, index) in steps"
      :key="`${step.label}-${index}`"
      class="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 last:pb-0"
    >
      <span
        v-if="index < steps.length - 1"
        aria-hidden="true"
        :class="`absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-0 w-px ${index < current ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'}`"
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        :data-step-index="index"
        :disabled="!interactive(index)"
        :aria-current="index === current ? 'step' : undefined"
        @click="handleClick(index)"
        :class="`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          index < current
            ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
            : index === current
              ? 'border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900'
              : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400'
        } ${interactive(index) ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}`"
      >
        <UiIcon v-if="index < current" name="check" :size="13" />
        <template v-else>{{ index + 1 }}</template>
      </button>
      <span class="min-w-0 pt-1">
        <span
          :class="`block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
            index === current
              ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
              : index < current
                ? 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
          }`"
        >
          {{ step.label }}
          <span v-if="step.optional" class="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>
        </span>
        <span v-if="step.hint" class="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ step.hint }}</span>
      </span>
    </li>
    <li v-if="nextLabel" class="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ nextLabel }}</li>
  </ol>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface WizardStep {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps: WizardStep[];
    current: number;
    variant?: 'vertical' | 'bar';
    nextLabel?: string;
    onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'vertical', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'step-click', index: number): void }>();

const nextStep = computed(() => props.steps[props.current + 1]);
const progress = computed(() =>
  props.steps.length ? Math.round(((props.current + 1) / props.steps.length) * 100) : 0
);
const interactive = (index: number) =>
  typeof props.onStepClick === 'function' && index <= props.current;

const handleClick = (index: number) => {
  props.onStepClick?.(index);
  emit('step-click', index);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface WorkspaceOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  logo?: string;
  memberCount?: number;
  role?: string;
  current?: boolean;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    workspaces?: WorkspaceOption[];
    footerUser?: { name: string; email: string; initials?: string };
    createLabel?: string;
    logoutLabel?: string;
    variant?: 'page' | 'dropdown';
  }>(),
  { title: 'Workspaces', subtitle: 'Choose the workspace you want to access', workspaces: () => [], footerUser: undefined, createLabel: '+ Create new workspace', logoutLabel: 'Log out', variant: 'page' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', workspace: WorkspaceOption): void;
  (e: 'create-new'): void;
  (e: 'logout'): void;
}>();

const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const roleLine = (workspace: WorkspaceOption) => {
  const count = workspace.memberCount ?? 1;
  let line = `${count} member${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  if (workspace.role) {
    const article = workspace.role.startsWith('A') || workspace.role.startsWith('E') ? 'an' : 'a';
    line += ` · You are ${article} ${workspace.role}`;
  }
  return line;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: number;
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    step?: number;
    variant?: 'stepper' | 'dropdown' | 'slider';
    presets?: number[];
    showFit?: boolean;
    showUndoRedo?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { value: 100, min: 10, max: 400, step: 10, variant: 'stepper', presets: () => [25, 50, 75, 100, 200], showFit: false, showUndoRedo: false },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'zoom-change', value: number): void;
  (e: 'fit'): void;
  (e: 'undo'): void;
  (e: 'redo'): void;
}>();

const zoom = ref(props.value);
const open = ref(false);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    zoom.value = next;
  },
);

const change = (next: number) => {
  const clamped = Math.min(props.max, Math.max(props.min, Math.round(next)));
  zoom.value = clamped;
  emit('zoom-change', clamped);
};
</script>

====/File: vanilla/AIInlineMenu.js/====

/**
 * AIInlineMenu - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <ai-inline-menu actions='[...]' loading="false" tone="neutral|brand"></ai-inline-menu>
 * Attributes: actions (JSON [{id,label,options?[]}]), loading, error, tone
 * Properties: actions
 * Events: action (detail {id, option?}), dismiss
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SPARKLE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 2.5l1.4 4.1L15.5 8l-4.1 1.4L10 13.5 8.6 9.4 4.5 8l4.1-1.4L10 2.5Z"/><path d="M15.8 12.6l.7 2 2 .7-2 .7-.7 2-.7-2-2-.7 2-.7.7-2Z" opacity="0.7"/></svg>';
const CARET_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 8 4 4 4-4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class AIInlineMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['actions', 'loading', 'error', 'tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._actions = [];
    this._openId = null;
    this._lastRun = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._actions.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('actions');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._actions = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._actions = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const dismiss = event.target.closest('[data-ai-dismiss]');
        if (dismiss) {
          this._openId = null;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss'));
          return;
        }
        const optionButton = event.target.closest('[data-ai-option]');
        if (optionButton) {
          const option = optionButton.getAttribute('data-ai-option');
          const actionId = optionButton.closest('[data-ai-menu]').getAttribute('data-ai-menu');
          this._openId = null;
          this._lastRun = `${actionId}:${option}`;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { id: actionId, option } }));
          return;
        }
        const actionButton = event.target.closest('[data-ai-action]');
        if (actionButton && !this.getAttribute('loading')) {
          const id = actionButton.getAttribute('data-ai-action');
          const action = this._resolvedActions().find((a) => a.id === id);
          if (action && action.options && action.options.length) {
            this._openId = this._openId === id ? null : id;
            this.render();
          } else if (action) {
            this._openId = null;
            this._lastRun = id;
            this.render();
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { id } }));
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'actions') this._actions = [];
    if (name === 'loading') this.render();
    this.render();
  }

  get actions() { return this._actions; }
  set actions(v) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _resolvedActions() {
    return this._actions.length
      ? this._actions
      : [{ id: 'edit', label: 'Edit' }, { id: 'tone', label: 'Change tone', options: ['Professional', 'Friendly', 'Concise'] }];
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const loading = this.getAttribute('loading') === 'true';
    const error = this.getAttribute('error') || '';
    const brand = this.getAttribute('tone') === 'brand';
    const actions = this._resolvedActions();

    const hostClass = 'inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full border bg-white py-1 pl-1.5 pr-1 shadow-lg dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const chipClass = brand
      ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700'
      : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600';

    const actionButtons = actions
      .map((action) => {
        const menu = this._openId === action.id && action.options && action.options.length
          ? `<div data-ai-menu="${escapeAttribute(action.id)}" class="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-10 mb-1 w-40 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg">${action.options.map((option) => `<button type="button" data-ai-option="${escapeAttribute(option)}" class="block w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-zinc-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700">${escapeAttribute(option)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`
          : '';
        return `<div class="relative"><button type="button" data-ai-action="${escapeAttribute(action.id)}"${loading ? ' disabled' : ''} class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}${action.options && action.options.length ? CARET_SVG : ''}</button>${menu}</div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const status = this._lastRun && !loading && !error
      ? `<span data-ai-status class="max-w-[160px] truncate px-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400" title="${escapeAttribute(this._lastRun)}">${escapeAttribute(this._lastRun)}</span>`
      : '';
    const loadingLabel = loading ? '<span data-ai-loading class="px-1 text-[10px] text-indigo-500">Working…</span>' : '';
    const errorLabel = error ? `<span data-ai-error class="px-1 text-[10px] text-red-600">${escapeAttribute(error)}</span>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-ai-inline-menu class="${hostClass}">
  <span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${chipClass}"><span style="display:inline-flex${loading ? ';animation:pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite' : ''}">${SPARKLE_SVG}</span>AI</span>
  <span class="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200"></span>
  ${actionButtons}
  ${status}${loadingLabel}${errorLabel}
  <button type="button" data-ai-dismiss title="Dismiss" class="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>
</div>`;

====/File: vanilla/Accordion.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Accordion - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <accordion-list allow-multiple></accordion-list>
 * Properties: items (AccordionItem[])
 * Events: toggle (detail: { id, open })
 */
export class AccordionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['allow-multiple', 'default-open-ids'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._openIds = null;
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._openIds === null) {
      this._openIds = this._items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id);
    }
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _openList() {
    if (this._openIds !== null) return this._openIds;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('default-open-ids');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  _toggle(id) {
    const openIds = this._openList();
    const wasOpen = openIds.includes(id);
    const allowMultiple = this.hasAttribute('allow-multiple');
    this._openIds = wasOpen
      ? openIds.filter((entry) => entry !== id)
      : allowMultiple
        ? [...openIds, id]
        : [id];
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, open: !wasOpen } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const openIds = this._openList();

    const rows = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const open = openIds.includes(item.id);
        return `<div>
          <h3>
            <button type="button" data-accordion-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}"
              aria-controls="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
              class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
              ${item.icon ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                ${item.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</span>` : ''}
              </span>
              <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}</span>
            </button>
          </h3>
          ${
            open
              ? `<div id="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-trigger-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
                  class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.content)}</div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${rows}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-id]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._toggle(node.getAttribute('data-accordion-id')));
    });
  }
}

  customElements.define('accordion-list', AccordionElement);
}
export default AccordionElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AccountSwitcher - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <account-switcher current-id="a1"></account-switcher>
 * Properties: accounts (Account[])
 * Events: switch (detail: account), add-account, sign-out, open-change (detail: boolean)
 */
export class AccountSwitcherElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._accounts = [];
    this._open = false;
    this._onPointerDown = this._onPointerDown.bind(this);
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get accounts() {
    return this._accounts;
  }

  set accounts(value) {
    this._accounts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }

  set open(value) {
    this._setOpen(Boolean(value));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._detachGlobal();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    const currentId = this.getAttribute('current-id');
    return this._accounts.find((account) => String(account.id) === String(currentId)) || this._accounts[0];
  }

  _setOpen(next) {
    if (this._open === next) return;
    this._open = next;
    if (next) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    } else {
      this._detachGlobal();
    }
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-change', { detail: next }));
  }

  _detachGlobal() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  _onPointerDown(event) {
    if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _avatar(account, sizeClass) {
    const inner = account.avatar
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(account.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
      : escapeAttribute(initials(account.name));
    return `<span class="flex ${sizeClass} shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full ${sizeClass.includes('h-6') ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'} text-[10px] font-semibold">${inner}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-block');

    const current = this._current();
    if (!current) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const rows = this._accounts
      .map((account) => {
        const active = String(account.id) === String(current.id);
        const meta = [account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || account.email || '';
        return `<li>
          <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="${active}" data-account="${escapeAttribute(account.id)}"
            class="account-row flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
            ${this._avatar(account, 'h-6 w-6')}
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(account.name)}</span>
              <span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</span>
            </span>
            ${active ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
          </button>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="relative inline-block text-left">
        <button type="button" class="account-trigger flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="${this._open}">
          ${this._avatar(current, 'h-6 w-6')}
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(current.name)}</span>
            ${current.email ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(current.email)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>
        </button>

        ${
          this._open
            ? `<div role="menu" aria-label="Switch account" class="account-menu absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                <ul class="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">${rows}</ul>
                <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-add flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                    <span class="text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}</span>Add account
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-signout flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30">
                    <span>${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 12 })}</span>Sign out
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.account-trigger').addEventListener('click', () => this._setOpen(!this._open));

    this.querySelectorAll('.account-row').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-account');
        const account = this._accounts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (!account) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('switch', { detail: account }));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    });

    const add = this.querySelector('.account-add');
    if (add) {
      add.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-account'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }

    const signOut = this.querySelector('.account-signout');
    if (signOut) {
      signOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sign-out'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('account-switcher')) {
  customElements.define('account-switcher', AccountSwitcherElement);
}
export default AccountSwitcherElement;

/**
 * AddonPicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <addon-picker options='[{"id":"doc","label":"Document signing","price:"+$600 / year"}]' selected-ids='["doc"]'></addon-picker>
 * Attributes: title, options (JSON [{id,label,price?,disabled?,contactInstead?}]), selected-ids (JSON string[]), total-label, total-text
 * Property: options, selectedIds
 * Events: change (detail.selectedIds)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';

export class AddonPickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['options', 'selected-ids', 'title', 'total-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._options = [];
    this._selectedIds = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._options.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('options');
      if (raw) { try { this._options = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._options = []; } }
    }
    if (!this._selectedIds.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('selected-ids');
      if (raw) { try { this._selectedIds = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._selectedIds = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-addon-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-addon-row');
        const option = this._options.find((o) => String(o.id) === id);
        if (!option || option.disabled) return;
        this._selectedIds = this._selectedIds.includes(id)
          ? this._selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== id)
          : [...this._selectedIds, id];
        this.render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { selectedIds: [...this._selectedIds] } }));
      });
    }
  }

  get options() { return this._options; }
  set options(v) {
    this._options = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectedIds() { return this._selectedIds; }
  set selectedIds(v) {
    this._selectedIds = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'options' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._options = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (name === 'selected-ids' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._selectedIds = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (this._options.length) this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Add-ons');
    const totalLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-label') || 'Estimated total');
    const totalText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-text') || '');

    const rows = this._options.map((option) => {
      const checked = this._selectedIds.includes(String(option.id));
      return `
      <div data-addon-row="${escapeAttribute(String(option.id))}" role="checkbox" aria-checked="${checked}" class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors ${checked ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300'} ${option.disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : ''}">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span data-addon-check class="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${checked ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-transparent'}">${CHECK_SVG}</span>
          <span class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
        </span>
        ${option.contactInstead ? `<a href="#" data-addon-contact class="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline">Let's talk</a>` : `<span data-addon-price class="text-xs text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(option.price || '')}</span>`}
      </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-addon-picker class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4">
  <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${title}</p>
  <div class="mt-3 space-y-2">${rows}
  </div>
  ${totalText ? `<div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-sm">
    <span class="text-zinc-600">${totalLabel}</span>
    <span data-addon-total class="font-semibold text-zinc-900">${totalText}</span>
  </div>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('addon-picker')) {
  customElements.define('addon-picker', AddonPickerElement);
}

/**
 * AgentBuilderCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <agent-builder-card agent-name="Support triage" run-text="Run agent"></agent-builder-card>
 * Property: nodes ([{id, label, type: trigger|tool|llm|output, status?: idle|active|done|error}])
 * Attributes: title, agent-name, run-text, running
 * Events: run, edit
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentBuilderCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'agent-name', 'run-text', 'running'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._nodes = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-builder-run]')) {
          if ((this.getAttribute('running') || '') === 'true') return;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-builder-edit]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('edit'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get nodes() { return this._nodes; }
  set nodes(v) {
    this._nodes = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((n) => ({ ...n })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before nodes are captured.
    if (this._nodes.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Agent workflow');
    const agentName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('agent-name') || 'Untitled agent');
    const runText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('run-text') || 'Run agent');
    const running = this.getAttribute('running') === 'true';
    const NODE_STYLE = {
      trigger: { icon: '⚡', chip: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300' },
      tool: { icon: '🔧', chip: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300' },
      llm: { icon: '🧠', chip: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300' },
      output: { icon: '📤', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300' },
    };
    const STATUS_DOT = {
      idle: 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600',
      active: 'bg-indigo-500 animate-pulse',
      done: 'bg-emerald-500',
      error: 'bg-red-500',
    };

    const rows = this._nodes.map((node, i) => {
      const style = NODE_STYLE[node.type] || NODE_STYLE.tool;
      const last = i === this._nodes.length - 1;
      return `
        <div data-builder-node="${escapeAttribute(node.id)}" class="relative flex items-center gap-3 pb-3">
          ${last ? '' : '<span class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 h-[calc(100%-16px)] w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" aria-hidden="true"></span>'}
          <span class="relative flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-xs dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800" aria-hidden="true">${style.icon}</span>
          <span data-builder-status="${escapeAttribute(node.status || 'idle')}" class="absolute left-[22px] top-[22px] h-2 w-2 rounded-full border border-white dark:border-zinc-900 ${STATUS_DOT[node.status || 'idle']}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 ${node.status === 'active' ? 'bg-indigo-50/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : ''}">
            <span class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(node.label)}</span>
            <span class="shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${style.chip}">${escapeAttribute(node.type)}</span>
          </span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-agent-builder class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <div class="min-w-0">
      <p data-builder-agent-name class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${agentName}</p>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${title} · ${this._nodes.length} nodes</p>
    </div>
    <button type="button" data-builder-edit class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Edit</button>
  </div>
  <div data-builder-chain class="mt-3 space-y-0">${rows}</div>
  <button type="button" data-builder-run ${running ? 'disabled' : ''} class="mt-1 w-full rounded-md px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${running ? 'cursor-wait bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'}">${running ? 'Running…' : runText}</button>
</div>`;
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const statusIcon = (status) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';

const statusClass = (status) =>
  status === 'running'
    ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500'
    : status === 'done'
      ? 'text-emerald-500'
      : status === 'error'
        ? 'text-red-500'
        : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';

const formatDuration = (ms) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

export class AgentRunLogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'title', 'auto-expand-running'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
    this._expanded = new Set();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get steps() {
    if (this._steps.length) return this._steps;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('steps') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const auto = this.getAttribute('auto-expand-running') !== 'false';
    this._expanded = new Set(
      auto ? this._steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
    );
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const steps = this.steps;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Execution log';
    const doneCount = steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900');

    const items = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
        const isOpen = this._expanded.has(step.id);
        return `
          <li class="relative pl-6">
            ${isLast ? '' : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'}
            <span class="absolute left-0 top-1 ${statusClass(step.status)}">${uiIcon(statusIcon(step.status), { size: 14 })}</span>
            <div class="pb-3">
              <button type="button" data-step="${escapeAttribute(step.id)}" ${step.detail ? `aria-expanded="${isOpen}"` : ''} class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left ${step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}">
                <span class="text-xs ${step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
                ${step.durationMs !== undefined ? `<span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${formatDuration(step.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
                ${step.detail ? `<span class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(isOpen ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
              </button>
              ${step.detail && isOpen ? `<pre class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(step.detail)}</pre>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
        <span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 14 })}</span>
        <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${doneCount}/${steps.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ol class="px-4 py-3">${items}</ol>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-step');
        const step = steps.find((s) => s.id === id);
        if (!step?.detail) return;
        this._expanded.has(id) ? this._expanded.delete(id) : this._expanded.add(id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, expanded: this._expanded.has(id) } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('agent-run-log')) {
  customElements.define('agent-run-log', AgentRunLogElement);
}
export default AgentRunLogElement;

const STATUS_META = {
  pending: { icon: 'clock', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' },
  running: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60', pulse: true },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60' },
  error: { icon: 'circle-x', cls: 'text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60' },
};

export class AgentStepTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(val) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;

    if (this._steps.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;

    this._applyHostClass('block');

      .map((step, i) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[step.status] || STATUS_META.pending;
        const isLast = i === this._steps.length - 1;
        return `
          <li class="relative flex gap-3">
            ${
              !isLast
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px ${

                  }"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <span class="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 ${meta.cls}">
              ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 15, className: meta.pulse ? 'animate-spin' : '' })}
            </span>
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-sm font-medium ${
                  meta === STATUS_META.pending ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
                }">${escapeAttribute(step.title)}</span>
                ${step.duration ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(step.duration)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${step.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.description)}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<ol class="relative space-y-4">${items}</ol>`;
  }

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

const STATUS_ICON = {
  pending: { icon: 'square', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600' },
  active: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 animate-spin' },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500' },
};

export class AgentTaskChecklistElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(val) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {

    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
