/**
 * AutoScrollAnchor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <auto-scroll-anchor is-streaming></auto-scroll-anchor>
 */
class AutoScrollAnchor extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.isAtBottom = true;
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._scrollHandler) {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (name === "is-streaming" && newValue !== null && this.isAtBottom) {
      this.scrollToBottom();
    }
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div id="anchor" class="h-px w-full pointer-events-none"></div>
      <button type="button" id="back-to-bottom" class="hidden fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium" title="Scroll to bottom">
        <span>↓</span>
      </button>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    const btn = this.querySelector("#back-to-bottom");
    this._scrollHandler = () => {
      const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
      this.isAtBottom = distanceFromBottom < 80;

      btn.classList.toggle("hidden", this.isAtBottom);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler, { passive: true });
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => this.scrollToBottom());
  }

  scrollToBottom() {
    this.querySelector("#anchor")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("auto-scroll-anchor")) {
  customElements.define("auto-scroll-anchor", AutoScrollAnchor);
}
export default AutoScrollAnchor;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SIZE_CLASS = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const initials = (name) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AvatarGroup - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <avatar-group max="4" size="md"></avatar-group>
 * Properties: members (AvatarMember[])
 * Events: member-click (detail: member)
 */
export class AvatarGroupElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._members = [];
  }

  get members() {
    return this._members;
  }

  set members(value) {
    this._members = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-center -space-x-2');

    const size = SIZE_CLASS[this.getAttribute('size')] ? this.getAttribute('size') : 'md';
    const rawMax = this.getAttribute('max');
    const max = rawMax !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(rawMax)) ? Math.max(0, Number(rawMax)) : 4;
    const visible = this._members.slice(0, max);
    const overflow = this._members.length - visible.length;
    const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASS[size];
    const iconSize = size === 'sm' ? 12 : size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14;

    const avatars = visible
      .map((member) => {
        const inner = member.src
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(member.src)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
          : member.name && member.name.trim()
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(initials(member.name))}</span>`
            : uiIcon('user', { size: iconSize });
        const dot = member.status && DOT_CLASS[member.status]
          ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${DOT_CLASS[member.status]}"></span>`
          : '';
        return `<button type="button" data-member-id="${escapeAttribute(member.id)}" title="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}"
          class="avatar-member relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">
          ${inner}${dot}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `${avatars}${
      overflow > 0
        ? `<span title="${overflow} more" class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">+${overflow}</span>`
        : ''
    }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.avatar-member').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const member = this._members.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-member-id'));
        if (member) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('member-click', { detail: member }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('avatar-group')) {
  customElements.define('avatar-group', AvatarGroupElement);

    });

    if (cta) cta.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta')));
  }
}

 * Property: rows ([{id, prompt, topic?, visibility, sentiment, position, mentions?}])
 * Attributes: title, quota-used, quota-total

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class BrandPromptTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'quota-used', 'quota-total'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._rows = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-brand-add]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-prompt'));
          return;
        }
        const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-brand-row]');
        if (rowEl) {
          const row = this._rows.find((r) => r.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-brand-row'));
          if (row) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-click', { detail: { row } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get rows() { return this._rows; }
  set rows(v) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

    if (this._rows.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Prompts');
    const quotaUsed = this.getAttribute('quota-used');
    const quotaTotal = this.getAttribute('quota-total');
    const hasQuota = quotaUsed !== null && quotaTotal !== null;
    const sentimentClass = (s) =>
      s >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : s >= 50 ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';

      ? '<p data-brand-empty class="px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">No prompts tracked yet — add your first brand prompt.</p>'
      : `<table class="w-full text-left text-xs">

      <th class="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">Sentiment</th>
      <th class="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">Position</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    ${this._rows.map((row) => `
    <tr data-brand-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-100 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
      <td class="max-w-xs truncate px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(row.prompt)}</td>
      <td data-brand-visibility class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${row.visibility}%</td>
      <td data-brand-sentiment class="px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold ${sentimentClass(row.sentiment)}">${row.sentiment}</td>
      <td data-brand-position class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">#${row.position}</td>
    </tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody>

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-brand-prompt-table class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">

  </div>
  ${body}
</div>`;
  }

====/File: vanilla/Breadcrumb.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

/**
 * Breadcrumb - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <breadcrumb-trail max-items="4"></breadcrumb-trail>
 * Properties: items ({ id?, label, href?, icon? }[])
 * Attributes: max-items, aria-label
 * Events: navigate (detail: { item, index })
 */
export class BreadcrumbElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max-items', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = null;
  }

  get items() {
    if (this._items !== null) return this._items;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('items');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get maxItems() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('max-items');
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _trail() {
    const items = this.items;
    const maxItems = this.maxItems;
    if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
    const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
    return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
  }

  _content(item) {
    return `${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 12 }) : ''}<span>${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const trail = this._trail();
    const ariaLabel = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Breadcrumb';

    const rows = trail
      .map((item, index) => {
        const last = index === trail.length - 1;
        const separator =
          index > 0
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 11 })}</span>`
            : '';

        let body;
        if (!item) {
          body = '<span aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>';
        } else if (last) {
          body = `<span aria-current="page" class="${BASE} font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${this._content(item)}</span>`;
        } else if (item.href) {
          body = `<a href="${escapeAttribute(item.href)}" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</a>`;
        } else {
          body = `<button type="button" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</button>`;
        }

        return `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5">${separator}${body}</li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ariaLabel)}"><ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">${rows}</ol></nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-breadcrumb-index]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-breadcrumb-index'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate', { detail: { item: trail[index], index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('breadcrumb-trail')) {
  customElements.define('breadcrumb-trail', BreadcrumbElement);
}
export default BreadcrumbElement;

/**
 * CampsiteHandoff - Campsite design handoff panel: checklist entries with
 * done state, assignee initials avatar and due date, plus an AI summary
 * block recapping the handoff.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class CampsiteHandoffElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['items', 'summary'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._items = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._items.length) {
      this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), [
        { id: 'h1', label: 'Redlines attached for spacing scale', done: true, assignee: 'Alex Smith', due: 'Nov 12' },
        { id: 'h2', label: 'Empty states exported to Lottie', done: true, assignee: 'Brook Taylor', due: 'Nov 13' },
        { id: 'h3', label: 'Motion spec review with eng', done: false, assignee: 'Casey Morgan', due: 'Nov 15' },
      ]);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'items' && !this._items.length) {
      this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }
  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  get summary() {
    return this.getAttribute('summary') ?? '3 handoff tasks, 2 done. Motion spec review is still open and due Nov 15 — the only blocker for a clean handoff.';
  }
  set summary(value) {
    this.setAttribute('summary', value);
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const itemEl = event.target.closest('[data-campsite-handoff-item]');
    if (!itemEl) return;
    const item = this._items.find((i) => String(i.id) === itemEl.getAttribute('data-campsite-handoff-item'));
    if (item) {
      item.done = !item.done;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { item }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const doneCount = this._items.filter((i) => i.done).length;
    const initialsFor = (name) =>
      String(name ?? '')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((part) => part[0] ?? '')
        .join('')
        .slice(0, 2)
        .toUpperCase();
    const itemsHtml = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const assignee = item.assignee
          ? `<span data-campsite-handoff-assignee title="${escapeAttribute(item.assignee)}" class="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[9px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(initialsFor(item.assignee))}</span>`
          : '';
        const due = item.due
          ? `<span data-campsite-handoff-due class="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(item.due)}</span>`
          : '';
        return `
        <label data-campsite-handoff-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <input type="checkbox" data-campsite-handoff-check ${item.done ? 'checked' : ''} class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded accent-indigo-500" />
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs ${item.done ? 'text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
          ${assignee}
          ${due}
        </label>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-campsite-handoff class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 data-campsite-handoff-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Design handoff</h3>
          <span data-campsite-handoff-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${doneCount}/${this._items.length} done</span>
        </div>
        <div data-campsite-handoff-items class="mt-3 space-y-2">${itemsHtml}</div>
        <div data-campsite-handoff-summary class="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 p-3 dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
          <p class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-300">
            <span aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
            AI summary
          </p>
          <p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200">${escapeAttribute(this.summary)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('campsite-handoff', CampsiteHandoffElement);

/**
 * ChangedFilesList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <changed-files-list title="3 Files Changed"></changed-files-list>
 * Attributes: title, grouped (true|false), show-diffstat (true|false), default-expanded (true|false), files (JSON attribute)
 * Properties: files (Array<{path, additions, deletions, status?}>)
 * Events: file-click (detail {file}), toggle (detail {open})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_TAG = {
  new: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  generated: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300',
  deleted: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  modified: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
};

const nameOf = (path) => String(path || '').split('/').pop() || path;
const extOf = (path) => nameOf(path).split('.').pop() || '';
const parentOf = (path) => {
  const parts = String(path || '').split('/');
  return parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') : '';
};

export class ChangedFilesListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'grouped', 'show-diffstat', 'default-expanded'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._files = [];
    this._open = true;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get files() {
    return this._files;
  }

  set files(list) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._files.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('files');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._files = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._files = []; }
      }
    }
    this._open = this.getAttribute('default-expanded') !== 'false';
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-changed-files-toggle]')) {
          this._open = !this._open;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { open: this._open } }));
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-changed-file]');
        if (row) {
          const file = this._files.find((item) => item.path === row.getAttribute('data-changed-file'));
          if (file) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-click', { detail: { file } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Files changed';
    const grouped = this.getAttribute('grouped') === 'true';
    const showDiffstat = this.getAttribute('show-diffstat') !== 'false';
    const files = Array.isArray(this._files) ? this._files : [];
    const totals = files.reduce(
      (acc, file) => ({ additions: acc.additions + (file.additions || 0), deletions: acc.deletions + (file.deletions || 0) }),
      { additions: 0, deletions: 0 },
    );

    let groups;
    if (grouped) {
      const map = new Map();
      files.forEach((file) => {
        const folder = parentOf(file.path) || '/';
        if (!map.has(folder)) map.set(folder, []);
        map.get(folder).push(file);
      });
      groups = [...map.entries()].map(([folder, list]) => ({ folder, files: list }));
    } else {
      groups = [{ folder: '', files }];
    }

    const rowHtml = (file) => `<button type="button" data-changed-file="${escapeAttribute(file.path)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <span class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(extOf(file.path))}</span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(grouped ? nameOf(file.path) : file.path)}</span>
        ${file.status && STATUS_TAG[file.status] ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_TAG[file.status]}">${escapeAttribute(file.status)}</span>` : ''}
        ${showDiffstat ? `<span class="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]"><span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${file.additions || 0}</span> <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−${file.deletions || 0}</span></span>` : ''}
      </button>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-changed-files class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <button type="button" data-changed-files-toggle class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-left focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${this._open ? 'rotate-90' : ''}"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
        ${showDiffstat ? `<span class="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs"><span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${totals.additions}</span> <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−${totals.deletions}</span></span>` : ''}
      </button>
      ${
        this._open
          ? `<div class="px-2 pb-2">
              ${groups
                .map(
                  (group) => `<div ${group.folder ? `data-files-group="${escapeAttribute(group.folder)}"` : ''}>
                    ${grouped && group.folder ? `<p class="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(group.folder)}/</p>` : ''}
                    ${group.files.map(rowHtml).join('')}
                  </div>`,
                )
                .join('')}
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('changed-files-list')) {
  customElements.define('changed-files-list', ChangedFilesListElement);
}
export default ChangedFilesListElement;

    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Latest updates';
    const footerLink = this.getAttribute('footer-link') || '';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No updates yet';

    const items = this._entries.length
      ? `<ol class="flex-1 space-y-3 divide-y divide-zinc-50 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">${this._entries
          .map(
            (entry, index) => `<li>
            <div ${this.hasAttribute('selectable') ? 'role="button" tabindex="0"' : ''} data-entry-index="${index}" class="text-left">
              <h4 class="text-xs font-semibold leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                ${entry.badge ? `<span class="mr-1.5 inline-block rounded-full px-1.5 py-px align-middle font-medium text-[9.5px] ${TONE[entry.badgeTone] || TONE.rose}">${escapeAttribute(entry.badge)}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(entry.title)}
              </h4>
              ${entry.detail ? `<p class="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(entry.detail)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`
          )
          .join('')}</ol>`
      : `<p class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<aside class="flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <header class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h3>
        ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14, className: 'text-amber-500' })}
      </header>
      ${items}
      ${
        footerLink
          ? `<footer class="border-t border-zinc-100 text-center dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button type="button" data-footer-link
          class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(footerLink)}</button>
      </footer>`
          : ''
      }
    </aside>`;

    if (this.hasAttribute('selectable')) {
      this.querySelectorAll('[data-entry-index]').forEach((row) => {
        row.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const entry = this._entries[Number(row.getAttribute('data-entry-index'))];
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { entry } }));
        });
      });
    }
    const footer = this.querySelector('[data-footer-link]');
    if (footer) footer.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('footer-click')));
  }
}

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',

    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',

export class ChatMessageRowElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['role', 'name', 'avatar', 'timestamp', 'content'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._content = '';
    this._appliedLayout = '';
  }

  get content() {
    return this._content;
  }

  set content(val) {
    this._content = String(val ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._content) {
      const attr = this.getAttribute('content');
      if (attr !== null) this._content = attr;
      else if (this.textContent.trim()) this._content = this.textContent;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
    if (name === 'content' && newVal !== null && newVal !== oldVal) {
      this._content = newVal;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const role = this.getAttribute('role') || 'assistant';
    const name = this.getAttribute('name') || '';
    const avatar = this.getAttribute('avatar') || '';
    const timestamp = this.getAttribute('timestamp') || '';

    if (role === 'system') {
      this._applyHostClass('flex justify-center py-2');
      this.innerHTML = `
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">${escapeAttribute(this._content)}</span>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const isUser = role === 'user';

    const avatarHtml = avatar
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(avatar)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(name || role)}" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700" />`
      : `<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
          isUser
            ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
        }">${uiIcon(isUser ? 'user' : 'sparkles', { size: 16 })}</div>`;

    this._applyHostClass(`flex gap-3 py-3 ${isUser ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}`);
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${avatarHtml}
      <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0 max-w-[85%] ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}">
        ${(name || timestamp) ? `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            ${name ? `<span class="font-medium">${escapeAttribute(name)}</span>` : ''}
            ${timestamp ? `<span class="font-mono">${escapeAttribute(timestamp)}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <div class="rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-wrap ${
          isUser
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-sm'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 rounded-tl-sm'
        }">${escapeAttribute(this._content)}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

  }[char]));

/**
 * ChatPromptInput - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <chat-prompt-input placeholder="Ask anything..."></chat-prompt-input>
 * Events: submit (detail: text), stop, attachments (detail: File[]), chip (detail: chip)
 */
class ChatPromptInput extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['placeholder', 'is-generating', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.attachments = [];
    this.isGenerating = false;
    this._chips = [];
  }

  get chips() {
    return this._chips;
  }

  set chips(val) {
    this._chips = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute("placeholder") || "Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)";
    const isGenerating = this.isGenerating || this.hasAttribute('is-generating');

    const chipsHtml = this.chips
      .map((chip) => {
        return `<button type="button" data-chip-id="${escapeAttribute(chip.id)}" aria-pressed="${!!chip.active}"
          class="prompt-chip flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
            chip.active
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'
          }">${chip.icon ? uiIcon(chip.icon, { size: 12 }) : ''}${escapeAttribute(chip.label)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="relative w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-zinc-900/10 focus-within:border-zinc-400 transition-all">
        <div id="attachments-container" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-3 pb-0 hidden"></div>
        <div class="flex items-end px-3 py-2.5 gap-2">
          <input type="file" multiple class="hidden" id="file-input" />
          <button type="button" id="attach-btn" class="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Add attachment">${uiIcon('paperclip', { size: 16 })}</button>
          <textarea id="prompt-textarea" rows="1" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" class="flex-1 bg-transparent resize-none border-0 p-1 text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 leading-relaxed max-h-[240px] min-h-[36px]"></textarea>
          <button type="button" id="submit-btn" class="p-2 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm flex-shrink-0" title="Send message">${uiIcon('arrow-up', { size: 16 })}</button>
        </div>
        ${chipsHtml ? `<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">${chipsHtml}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    const textarea = this.querySelector("#prompt-textarea");
    const submitBtn = this.querySelector("#submit-btn");
    const fileInput = this.querySelector("#file-input");
    const attachBtn = this.querySelector("#attach-btn");

    textarea.addEventListener("input", () => {
      textarea.style.height = "auto";
      textarea.style.height = `${Math.max(Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 240), 48)}px`;
    });

    textarea.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
        if (e.isComposing) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this.triggerSubmit();
      }
    });

    attachBtn.addEventListener("click", () => fileInput.click());
    fileInput.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("attachments", { detail: files }));
      e.target.value = "";
    });

    submitBtn.addEventListener("click", () => this.triggerSubmit());

    this.querySelectorAll(".prompt-chip").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const chip = this.chips.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(btn.getAttribute("data-chip-id")));
        if (chip) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("chip", { detail: chip }));
      });
    });
  }

  triggerSubmit() {
    const textarea = this.querySelector("#prompt-textarea");
    const val = textarea.value.trim();
    if (val) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("submit", { detail: val }));
      textarea.value = "";
      textarea.style.height = "48px";
    }
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * ChatSessionList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <chat-session-list active-id="2"></chat-session-list>
 * Sessions: property [{ id, title, timeLabel?, group? }] — optional `group`
 * labels (e.g. "Today") render collapsible headers; sessions without one go
 * to an uncollapsible "Recent" bucket. `user` property { name, email?,
 * avatarUrl? } renders a bottom user card. Events: select (detail: session),
 * delete (detail: { id }), user-click. Group collapse is internal view state.
 */
export class ChatSessionListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-id', 'title', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._sessions = [];
    this._user = null;
    this._collapsedGroups = new Set();
  }

  get sessions() {
    return this._sessions;
  }

  set sessions(val) {
    this._sessions = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get user() {
    return this._user;
  }

  set user(val) {
    this._user = val && typeof val === 'object' ? val : null;
    this.render();
  }

  get activeId() {
    return this.getAttribute('active-id');
  }

  set activeId(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) this.removeAttribute('active-id');
    else this.setAttribute('active-id', String(val));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _sessionRow(s) {
    const isActive = String(s.id) === String(this.activeId);
    return `
      <li>
        <div
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          data-session-id="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}"
          class="session-item group w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
            isActive
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300'
              : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/70'
          }"
        >
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <span class="block truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(s.title)}</span>
            ${s.timeLabel ? `<span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(s.timeLabel)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-delete-id="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}"
            aria-label="Delete session"
            class="session-delete opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-all shrink-0"
          >${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>
        </div>
      </li>`;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Chats';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No conversations yet';

    const headerHtml = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 15, className: 'text-indigo-500' })}
        ${escapeAttribute(title)}
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">${this._sessions.length}</span>
      </div>`;

    // Bottom user card
    let userHtml = '';
    if (this._user) {
      const initials = (this._user.name || '?')
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();
      userHtml = `
        <button type="button" class="user-card flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left">
          ${
            this._user.avatarUrl
              ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(this._user.avatarUrl)}" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />`
              : `<span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(initials)}</span>`
          }
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <span class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(this._user.name)}</span>
            ${this._user.email ? `<span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._user.email)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          ${uiIcon('settings', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        </button>`;
    }

    if (this._sessions.length === 0) {
      this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
      this.innerHTML = `${headerHtml}<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</div>${userHtml}`;
      this._bindUserCard();
      return;
    }

    // Preserve the sessions' original order; group headers appear on first occurrence.
    const groups = [];
    this._sessions.forEach((s) => {
      const label = s.group || 'Recent';
      const existing = groups.find((g) => g.label === label);
      if (existing) existing.items.push(s);
      else groups.push({ label, items: [s] });
    });

    const groupsHtml = groups
      .map((group) => {
        if (group.label === 'Recent') {
          return `<div class="mb-1 last:mb-0"><ul class="space-y-0.5">${group.items.map((s) => this._sessionRow(s)).join('')}</ul></div>`;
        }
        const isCollapsed = this._collapsedGroups.has(group.label);
        return `
          <div class="mb-1 last:mb-0">
            <button type="button" data-group-label="${escapeAttribute(group.label)}" aria-expanded="${!isCollapsed}"
              class="group-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-1 px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors select-none">
              <span class="inline-flex transition-transform duration-150 ${isCollapsed ? '-rotate-90' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 11 })}</span>
              <span class="flex-1 text-left">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</span>
              <span class="font-mono font-normal">${group.items.length}</span>
            </button>
            ${isCollapsed ? '' : `<ul class="space-y-0.5">${group.items.map((s) => this._sessionRow(s)).join('')}</ul>`}
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `${headerHtml}<div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">${groupsHtml}</div>${userHtml}`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.group-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const label = btn.getAttribute('data-group-label');
        if (this._collapsedGroups.has(label)) this._collapsedGroups.delete(label);
        else this._collapsedGroups.add(label);
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.session-item').forEach((row) => {
      const id = row.getAttribute('data-session-id');
      const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(id));
      if (!session) return;
      const select = () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: session }));
      row.addEventListener('click', select);
      row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          select();
        }
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.session-delete').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-delete-id');
        const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(id));
        if (session) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('delete', { detail: { id: session.id } }));
      });
    });

    this._bindUserCard();
  }

  _bindUserCard() {
    const card = this.querySelector('.user-card');
    if (card) {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('user-click')));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('chat-session-list')) {
  customElements.define('chat-session-list', ChatSessionListElement);
}
export default ChatSessionListElement;

====/File: vanilla/ClarifyQuestionCard.js/====

/**
 * ClarifyQuestionCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <clarify-question question="..." title="..." index="1" total="3" answered="false"></clarify-question>
 * Attributes: question, title, value, placeholder, index, total, answered (true|false), step-label
 * Events: answer (detail {value}), prev, next
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ClarifyQuestionCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['question', 'title', 'value', 'placeholder', 'index', 'total', 'answered', 'step-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get value() {
    return this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(text) {
    this.setAttribute('value', String(text ?? ''));
  }

  get answered() {
    return this.getAttribute('answered') === 'true';
  }

  set answered(flag) {
    this.setAttribute('answered', flag ? 'true' : 'false');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-clarify-prev]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('prev'));
        if (event.target.closest('[data-clarify-next]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('next'));
      });
      this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        const input = event.target.closest('[data-clarify-input]');
        if (input && event.key === 'Enter') {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('answer', { detail: { value: input.value } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const question = this.getAttribute('question') || '';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Type your answer…';
    const index = Number(this.getAttribute('index')) || 1;
    const total = Number(this.getAttribute('total')) || 1;
    const answered = this.answered;
    const stepLabel = this.getAttribute('step-label') || 'Used ask user question';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-clarify-card class="w-full rounded-lg border border-indigo-300 bg-white p-3 dark:border-indigo-500/60 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
        <span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">?</span>
        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title || question)}</p>
          ${title ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(question)}</p>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${
          total > 1
            ? `<span data-clarify-paging class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400">
                <button type="button" data-clarify-prev aria-label="Previous question" class="rounded px-1 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60">‹</button>
                ${index} of ${total}
                <button type="button" data-clarify-next aria-label="Next question" class="rounded px-1 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60">›</button>
              </span>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>
      ${
        answered
          ? `<p data-clarify-value class="mt-2.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(value || '—')}</p>`
          : `<input type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(value)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" data-clarify-input class="mt-2.5 w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50" />`
      }
      <p data-clarify-step class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>
        ${escapeAttribute(stepLabel)}
      </p>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('clarify-question')) {
  customElements.define('clarify-question', ClarifyQuestionCardElement);
}

====/File: vanilla/CodeBlock.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const escapeText = escapeAttribute;

export class CodeBlockElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['language', 'filename', 'show-line-numbers', 'show-copy', 'max-height'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._code = '';
    this._copied = false;
  }

  get code() {
    return this._code;
  }

  set code(val) {
    this._code = String(val ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._code && this.textContent.trim()) {
      this._code = this.textContent;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  async _handleCopy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(this._code);
      this._copied = true;
      this.render();
      setTimeout(() => {
        this._copied = false;
        this.render();
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      this._copied = false;
    }
  }

  render() {
    const language = this.getAttribute('language') || '';
    const filename = this.getAttribute('filename') || '';
    const showLineNumbers = this.hasAttribute('show-line-numbers');
    const showCopy = this.getAttribute('show-copy') !== 'false';
    const maxHeight = this.getAttribute('max-height') || '';
    const customClass = this.getAttribute('class') || '';

    const lines = this._code.replace(/\n$/, '').split('\n');

    const bodyHtml = showLineNumbers
      ? `<code>${lines
          .map(
            (line, idx) =>
              `<div class="flex"><span class="w-8 shrink-0 select-none text-right pr-3 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">${idx + 1}</span><span class="flex-1">${escapeText(line) || ' '}</span></div>`
          )
          .join('')}</code>`
      : `<code>${escapeText(this._code)}</code>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="group relative rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 overflow-hidden text-sm font-mono ${escapeAttribute(customClass)}">
        ${(language || filename || showCopy) ? `
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-100/60 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              ${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 13, className: 'shrink-0' })}
              ${filename ? `<span class="font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">${escapeText(filename)}</span>` : ''}
              ${language ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wide shrink-0">${escapeText(language)}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            ${showCopy ? `
              <button
                type="button"
                class="cb-copy-btn flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/70 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shrink-0"
                aria-label="Copy code"
              >
                ${uiIcon(this._copied ? 'check' : 'copy', { size: 13, className: this._copied ? 'text-emerald-500' : '' })}
                <span class="hidden sm:inline">${this._copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</span>
              </button>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <div class="overflow-auto p-3.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200" ${maxHeight ? `style="max-height: ${escapeAttribute(maxHeight)}"` : ''}>
          <pre class="whitespace-pre">${bodyHtml}</pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const copyBtn = this.querySelector('.cb-copy-btn');
    if (copyBtn) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._handleCopy());
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('code-block')) {
  customElements.define('code-block', CodeBlockElement);
}
export default CodeBlockElement;

/**
 * ColorPickerPopover - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <color-picker-popover value="#2563eb" swatches='[...]' document-colors='[...]' custom-colors='[...]'></color-picker-popover>
 * Attributes: value, swatches (JSON string[]), document-colors, custom-colors, show-eyedropper, show-rgb-inputs, show-hex-input
 * Properties: value, swatches, documentColors, customColors
 * Events: change (detail {hex}), eyedropper-click, add-custom (detail {hex})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const DEFAULT_ROWS = [
  ['#000000', '#374151', '#6b7280', '#9ca3af', '#d1d5db', '#f3f4f6'],
  ['#dc2626', '#ef4444', '#f87171', '#fca5a5', '#fecaca', '#fee2e2'],
  ['#ea580c', '#f97316', '#fb923c', '#fdba74', '#fed7aa', '#ffedd5'],
  ['#16a34a', '#22c55e', '#4ade80', '#86efac', '#bbf7d0', '#dcfce7'],
  ['#2563eb', '#3b82f6', '#60a5fa', '#93c5fd', '#bfdbfe', '#dbeafe'],
  ['#7c3aed', '#8b5cf6', '#a78bfa', '#c4b5fd', '#ddd6fe', '#ede9fe'],
];

const normalizeHex = (input) => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(String(input || '').trim());
  return match ? `#${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : null;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const int = parseInt(match[1], 16);
  return { r: (int >> 16) & 255, g: (int >> 8) & 255, b: int & 255 };
};

const rgbToHex = (r, g, b) =>
  `#${[r, g, b].map((c) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;

export class ColorPickerPopoverElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'swatches', 'document-colors', 'custom-colors'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._swatches = [];
    this._documentColors = [];
    this._customColors = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._swatches.length) this._parseAttr('swatches', '_swatches');
    if (!this._documentColors.length) this._parseAttr('document-colors', '_documentColors');
    if (!this._customColors.length) this._parseAttr('custom-colors', '_customColors');
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const swatch = event.target.closest('[data-color-swatch]');
        if (swatch) {
          const color = swatch.getAttribute('data-color-swatch');
          if (normalizeHex(color)) this._apply(color.toLowerCase());
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-color-eyedropper]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('eyedropper-click'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-color-custom-add]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-custom', { detail: { hex: this._hex } }));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target.hasAttribute && target.hasAttribute('data-color-hex-input')) {
          const raw = target.value;
          this._draft = raw;
          const parsed = normalizeHex(raw);
          if (parsed) {
            this._hex = parsed;
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { hex: parsed } }));
            this.render();
            const input = this.querySelector('[data-color-hex-input]');
            if (input) {
              input.value = raw;
              input.focus();
            }
          }
        } else if (target.hasAttribute && target.hasAttribute('data-color-channel')) {
          const channel = target.getAttribute('data-color-channel');
          const num = parseInt(target.value, 10);
          if (Number.isNaN(num)) return;
          const rgb = hexToRgb(this._hex) || { r: 37, g: 99, b: 235 };
          const next = rgbToHex(
            channel === 'r' ? num : rgb.r,
            channel === 'g' ? num : rgb.g,
            channel === 'b' ? num : rgb.b,
          );
          this._apply(next);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'value') this._value = undefined;
    if (name === 'swatches') this._swatches = [];
    if (name === 'document-colors') this._documentColors = [];
    if (name === 'custom-colors') this._customColors = [];
    this.render();
  }

  _parseAttr(name, field) {
    const raw = this.getAttribute(name);
    if (!raw) return;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) this[field] = parsed;
    } catch { /* keep default */ }
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value !== undefined ? this._value : normalizeHex(this.getAttribute('value')) || '#2563eb';
  }

  set value(hex) {
    this._value = normalizeHex(hex);
    this.setAttribute('value', this._value || '');
    this.render();
  }

  get swatches() { return this._swatches; }
  set swatches(v) { this._swatches = Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; this.render(); }
  get documentColors() { return this._documentColors; }
  set documentColors(v) { this._documentColors = Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; this.render(); }
  get customColors() { return this._customColors; }
  set customColors(v) { this._customColors = Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; this.render(); }

  _apply(next) {
    this._hex = next;
    this._value = next;
    this.setAttribute('value', next);
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { hex: next } }));
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const hex = this.value;
    this._hex = hex;
    const rows = this._swatches.length ? [this._swatches] : DEFAULT_ROWS;
    const showEyedropper = this.getAttribute('show-eyedropper') === 'true';
    const showRgb = this.getAttribute('show-rgb-inputs') === 'true';
    const showHexInput = this.getAttribute('show-hex-input') !== 'false';
    const rgb = hexToRgb(hex) || { r: 37, g: 99, b: 235 };

    const hostClass = 'w-64 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const swatchButton = (color, key) => {
      const selected = color.toLowerCase() === hex;
      const lightSwatch = color.toLowerCase() === '#ffffff' || color.toLowerCase() === '#f3f4f6';
      const check = selected
        ? `<span style="color:${lightSwatch ? '#71717a' : '#ffffff'};display:inline-flex"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10.5 8 14.5 16 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>`
        : '';
      return `<button type="button" data-color-swatch="${escapeAttribute(color)}" key="${escapeAttribute(key)}" title="${escapeAttribute(color)}" class="relative flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md border transition-shadow focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${selected ? 'border-indigo-600' : 'border-zinc-200'}" style="background-color:${escapeAttribute(color)};${selected ? 'box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(199,210,254,1);' : ''}">${check}</button>`;
    };

    const gridHtml = rows
      .map((row, index) => `<div class="flex justify-between">${row.map((color, i) => swatchButton(color, `${index}-${i}`)).join('')}</div>`)
      .join('');

    const docSection = this._documentColors.length
      ? `<div class="mt-3"><p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">Document colors</p><div class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${this._documentColors.map((color, i) => swatchButton(color, `doc-${i}`)).join('')}</div></div>`
      : '';

    const customSection = `<div class="mt-3"><p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">Custom colors</p><div class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">${this._customColors.map((color, i) => swatchButton(color, `custom-${i}`)).join('')}<button type="button" data-color-custom-add title="Add ${escapeAttribute(hex)}" class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button></div></div>`;

    const rgbSection = showRgb
      ? `<div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">${['r', 'g', 'b'].map((channel) => `<label class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 py-1"><span class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-zinc-400">${channel}</span><input data-color-channel="${channel}" type="number" min="0" max="255" value="${rgb[channel]}" class="w-full min-w-0 bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-700 focus:outline-none"/></label>`).join('')}</div>`
      : '';

    const eyedropperBtn = showEyedropper
      ? `<button type="button" data-color-eyedropper title="Pick color from page" class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.7 3.3a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3l-1.2 1.2 1.1 1.1-1.5 1.5-1.1-1.1-6.3 6.3c-.3.3-.6.4-1 .4H4v-2.7c0-.4.1-.7.4-1l6.3-6.3-1.1-1.1L10.1 4l1.1 1.1 1.5-1.8Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-color-picker class="${hostClass}">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
    <span class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200" style="background-color:${escapeAttribute(hex)}"></span>
    ${showHexInput ? `<input data-color-hex-input type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(hex)}" placeholder="#2563eb" aria-label="Hex color" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"/>` : ''}
    ${eyedropperBtn}
  </div>
  ${rgbSection}
  <div data-color-grid class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${gridHtml}</div>
  ${docSection}
  ${customSection}
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * ColumnVisibilityMenu - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <column-visibility-menu columns='[...]' visible-ids='[...]'></column-visibility-menu>
 * Attributes: columns (JSON), visible-ids (JSON), show-reorder-handles, apply-mode (instant|apply-button), reset-label, apply-label
 * Properties: columns, visibleIds
 * Events: toggle (detail {id, visible}), reorder (detail {from, to}), reset, apply (detail {visibleIds})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const GRIP_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3 w-3"><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="18" r="1.5" /></svg>';
const LOCK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2" /><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4" /></svg>';
const EYE_OPEN_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /></svg>';
const EYE_OFF_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7c2 0 3.7.6 5.1 1.5M22 12s-3.5 7-10 7c-2 0-3.7-.6-5.1-1.5" /><path d="m4 4 16 16" /></svg>';
const UP_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m18 15-6-6-6 6" /></svg>';
const DOWN_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>';

export class ColumnVisibilityMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns', 'visible-ids', 'show-reorder-handles', 'apply-mode', 'reset-label', 'apply-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._visibleIds = [];
    this._draft = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._columns.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('columns');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._columns = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._columns = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._visibleIds.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('visible-ids');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._visibleIds = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._visibleIds = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const toggle = event.target.closest('[data-column-toggle]');
        if (toggle) {
          const rowEl = toggle.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const column = this._columns.find((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (column && !column.locked) this.toggleColumn(column);
          return;
        }
        const up = event.target.closest('[data-column-up]');
        if (up) {
          const rowEl = up.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const index = this._columns.findIndex((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (index > 0) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reorder', { detail: { from: index, to: index - 1 } }));
          }
          return;
        }
        const down = event.target.closest('[data-column-down]');
        if (down) {
          const rowEl = down.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const index = this._columns.findIndex((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (index >= 0 && index < this._columns.length - 1) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reorder', { detail: { from: index, to: index + 1 } }));
          }
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-column-reset]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reset'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-column-apply]')) {
          const ids = this.applyMode() === 'apply-button' ? [...(this._draft || this.defaultVisible())] : [...this.visibleIdsResolved()];
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply', { detail: { visibleIds: ids } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._draft = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get visibleIds() {
    return this._visibleIds;
  }

  set visibleIds(value) {
    this._visibleIds = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._draft = null;
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  applyMode() {
    return this.getAttribute('apply-mode') || 'instant';
  }

  defaultVisible() {
    return this._columns.filter((column) => !column.hidden).map((column) => column.id);
  }

  visibleIdsResolved() {
    return this._visibleIds.length ? this._visibleIds : this.defaultVisible();
  }

  isVisible(column) {
    if (column.locked) return true;
    if (this.applyMode() === 'apply-button') {
      if (!this._draft) this._draft = new Set(this.visibleIdsResolved());
      return this._draft.has(column.id);
    }
    return this.visibleIdsResolved().includes(column.id);
  }

  toggleColumn(column) {
    const nextVisible = !this.isVisible(column);
    if (this.applyMode() === 'apply-button') {
      if (!this._draft) this._draft = new Set(this.visibleIdsResolved());
      if (nextVisible) this._draft.add(column.id);
      else this._draft.delete(column.id);
    } else {
      const current = this.visibleIdsResolved();
      this._visibleIds = nextVisible
        ? [...current, column.id]
        : current.filter((id) => id !== column.id);
    }
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id: column.id, visible: nextVisible } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const showHandles = this.getAttribute('show-reorder-handles') !== 'false';
    const applyMode = this.applyMode();
    const resetLabel = this.getAttribute('reset-label') || 'Reset to default';
    const applyLabel = this.getAttribute('apply-label') || 'Apply';
    const visibleCount = this._columns.filter((column) => this.isVisible(column)).length;
    const rowsHtml = this._columns
      .map((column) => {
        const visible = this.isVisible(column);
        const rowClass = column.locked ? 'opacity-60' : '';
        const toggleClass = visible
          ? 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
          : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-600';
        const handleColumn = showHandles && !column.locked
          ? `<span class="flex shrink-0 flex-col text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" aria-hidden="true">${GRIP_SVG}</span>`
          : '<span class="w-3 shrink-0"></span>';
        const lockIcon = column.locked ? LOCK_SVG : '';
        const toggleButton = `<button type="button" data-column-toggle aria-label="${escapeAttribute(`${visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${column.label}`)}"${column.locked ? ' disabled' : ''} class="shrink-0 rounded p-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${toggleClass}">${visible ? EYE_OPEN_SVG : EYE_OFF_SVG}</button>`;
        const reorderColumn = showHandles && !column.locked
          ? `<span class="flex shrink-0 flex-col">
              <button type="button" data-column-up aria-label="Move ${escapeAttribute(column.label)} up" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${UP_SVG}</button>
              <button type="button" data-column-down aria-label="Move ${escapeAttribute(column.label)} down" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${DOWN_SVG}</button>
            </span>`
          : '<span class="w-2.5 shrink-0"></span>';
        return `<li data-column-row="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" data-column-visible="${visible ? 'true' : 'false'}">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 ${rowClass}">
            ${handleColumn}
            ${lockIcon}
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(column.label)}</span>
            ${toggleButton}
            ${reorderColumn}
          </div>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const footer =
      applyMode === 'apply-button'
        ? `<div class="border-t border-zinc-100 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button type="button" data-column-apply class="w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">${escapeAttribute(applyLabel)}</button>
          </div>`
        : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-column-visibility-menu class="w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-column-count class="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Showing <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${visibleCount}</span> of ${this._columns.length}</p>
        <button type="button" data-column-reset class="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(resetLabel)}</button>
      </div>
      <ul class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto py-1">${rowsHtml}</ul>
      ${footer}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('column-visibility-menu')) {
  customElements.define('column-visibility-menu', ColumnVisibilityMenuElement);
}
