import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * PromptLibrary - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-library searchable></prompt-library>
 * Properties: prompts (PromptItem[]), categories (string[])
 * Events: use (detail: prompt), toggle-favorite (detail: prompt)
 */
export class PromptLibraryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['searchable'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._prompts = [];
    this._categories = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._category = 'all';
  }

  get prompts() {
    return this._prompts;
  }

  set prompts(value) {
    this._prompts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get categories() {
    return this._categories;
  }

  set categories(value) {
    this._categories = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _categoryOptions() {
    const seen = new Set(this._categories);
    for (const prompt of this._prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
    return ['all', ...Array.from(seen)];
  }

  _visible() {
    const needle = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return this._prompts.filter((prompt) => {
      const inCategory = this._category === 'all' || prompt.category === this._category;
      if (!inCategory) return false;
      if (!needle) return true;
      return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(needle);
    });
  }

  _chips() {
    return this._categoryOptions()
      .map((category) => {
        const active = this._category === category;
        return `<button type="button" class="prompt-chip rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          active
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'
        }" data-category="${escapeAttribute(category)}" aria-pressed="${active}">${category === 'all' ? 'All' : escapeAttribute(category)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  _list() {
    const visible = this._visible();
    if (visible.length === 0) {
      return `<p class="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No prompts match your filters.</p>`;
    }
    const items = visible
      .map((prompt) => {
        const tags = (prompt.tags || [])
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((tag) => `<span class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tag)}</span>`)
          .join('');
        return `<li class="prompt-card group flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-indigo-700" data-prompt="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
          <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}</span>
                ${prompt.category ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.category)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${prompt.description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-fav shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              prompt.favorite ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-amber-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400'
            }" aria-label="${prompt.favorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'} ${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}" aria-pressed="${!!prompt.favorite}" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">${uiIcon('star', { size: 13 })}</button>
          </div>

          <p class="mt-2 line-clamp-2 rounded bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.prompt)}</p>

          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">${tags}</div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-use inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
              Use${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 10 })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    return `<ul class="grid gap-2 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${items}</ul>`;
  }

  _updateCount() {
    const count = this.querySelector('.prompt-count');
    if (count) count.textContent = String(this._visible().length);
  }

  _renderRegion() {
    const chips = this.querySelector('.prompt-chips');
    const list = this.querySelector('.prompt-body');
    if (chips) chips.innerHTML = this._chips();
    if (list) list.innerHTML = this._list();
    this._updateCount();
    this._bindItems();
  }

  _bindItems() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-chip').forEach((chip) => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._category = chip.getAttribute('data-category');
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-use').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('use', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-fav').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-favorite', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const searchable = this.hasAttribute('searchable');
    const search = searchable
      ? `<div class="relative sm:ml-auto sm:w-56">
          <span class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <input type="search" class="prompt-search w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 pl-6 pr-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
            placeholder="Search prompts…" aria-label="Search prompts" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" />
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold">Prompt library</h3>
          <span class="prompt-count rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${this._visible().length}</span>
        </div>
        ${search}
      </div>
      <div class="prompt-chips flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800">${this._chips()}</div>
      <div class="prompt-body">${this._list()}</div>
    </div>`;

    const input = this.querySelector('.prompt-search');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this._query = input.value;
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    }

    this._bindItems();
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-library')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-library', PromptLibraryElement);
}
export default PromptLibraryElement;

/**
 * PromptPerformanceTable - Peec AI prompt tracking table: rows of tracked
 * prompts with Visibility %, Sentiment score, Position # and Mentions
 * columns, plus an Export CTA in the header.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class PromptPerformanceTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'export-label', 'rows'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._rows = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'rows' && !this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'Prompt performance';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get exportLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('export-label') ?? 'Export';
  }
  set exportLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('export-label', value);
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }
  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-prompt-performance-export]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('export', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-prompt-row]');
    if (!rowEl) return;
    const row = this._rows.find((r) => String(r.id) === rowEl.getAttribute('data-prompt-row'));
    if (row) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-click', { detail: { row }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const rows = this._rows;
    const trendMark = (r) => {
      if (r.trend === 'up') return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-emerald-500">▲</span>';
      if (r.trend === 'down') return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-red-500">▼</span>';
      return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-400">—</span>';
    };
    const body = rows.length
      ? `<table data-prompt-performance-list class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Prompt</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Visibility</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Sentiment</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Position</th>
              <th class="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">Mentions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows
            .map(
              (r) => `
            <tr data-prompt-row="${escapeAttribute(r.id)}" class="cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
              <td data-prompt-row-prompt class="max-w-[220px] truncate px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(r.prompt)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-visibility class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.visibility)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-sentiment class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.sentiment)} ${trendMark(r)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-position class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.position)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-mentions class="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.mentions)}</td>
            </tr>`
            )
            .join('')}</tbody>
        </table>`
      : `<p data-prompt-performance-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No tracked prompts yet.</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-prompt-performance-table class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 data-prompt-performance-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</h4>
          <button type="button" data-prompt-performance-export class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this.exportLabel)}</button>
        </div>
        ${body}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-performance-table')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-performance-table', PromptPerformanceTableElement);
}

export default PromptPerformanceTableElement;

/**
 * PromptSaveDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-save-dialog title="..." folder="..."></prompt-save-dialog>
 * Attributes: open, title, folder, description, prompt, variables (JSON array)
 * Events: save (detail {title, prompt, variables}), cancel, close
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class PromptSaveDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'folder', 'description', 'prompt', 'variables'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-prompt-save-close]')) {
          this.setAttribute('open', 'false');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-prompt-save-cancel]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-prompt-save-submit]')) {
          const title = this.querySelector('[data-prompt-save-title]')?.value ?? this.getAttribute('title') ?? '';
          const prompt = this.querySelector('[data-prompt-save-body]')?.value ?? this.getAttribute('prompt') ?? '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', { detail: { title, prompt, variables: this._vars } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get variables() {
    return this._vars;
  }
  set variables(v) {
    this._vars = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(String) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _parseVars() {
    try {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('variables');
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : ['company'];
    } catch (e) {
      return ['company'];
    }
  }

  render() {
    if ((this.getAttribute('open') || 'true') === 'false') {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    this._vars = this._vars || this._parseVars();

  <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
    <button type="button" data-prompt-save-folder class="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
      <span aria-hidden="true">📁</span>${folder}<span class="text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">▾</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" data-prompt-save-close aria-label="Close" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
  </div>
  <input data-prompt-save-title type="text" value="${title}" aria-label="Prompt title" class="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-transparent bg-transparent px-1 py-1 text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-zinc-300 focus:bg-white dark:text-zinc-50 dark:focus:border-zinc-600 dark:focus:bg-zinc-900">
  <textarea data-prompt-save-body rows="6" aria-label="Prompt body" class="mt-2 w-full resize-y rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 outline-none transition-colors focus:border-indigo-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:focus:border-indigo-500">${prompt}</textarea>
  <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
    <button type="button" data-prompt-save-add-var class="rounded-md border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">+ Add variable</button>
    <button type="button" data-prompt-save-expand aria-label="Expand editor" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 p-1.5 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">⤢</button>
  </div>
  ${this._vars.length > 0 ? `<div data-prompt-save-vars class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${varChips}</div>` : ''}

      <button type="button" data-prompt-save-cancel class="rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class PromptTemplateGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._templates = [];
  }

  get templates() {
    return this._templates;
  }

  set templates(val) {
    this._templates = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._templates.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3');
    this.innerHTML = this._templates
      .map(
        (t) => `
        <button
          type="button"
          data-template-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}"
          class="template-card group flex flex-col text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 hover:shadow-md transition-all"
        >
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
            <span class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">${escapeAttribute(t.title)}</span>
            ${
              t.tag
                ? `<span class="ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(t.tag)}</span>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>
          ${t.description ? `<div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-clamp-2">${escapeAttribute(t.description)}</div>` : ''}
          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
            ${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 12 })}
            Use template
          </div>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.template-card').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-template-id');
        const template = this._templates.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
        if (template) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('use', { detail: template }));
      });
    });
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/PromptVariantDiff.js/====

/**
 * PromptVariantDiff - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-variant-diff title="Prompt variants" variants='[...]'></prompt-variant-diff>
 * Attributes: title, variants (JSON: [{id,label,text}], requires exactly 2: base + compare)
 * Events: apply (detail {variant})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const extractVars = (text) =>
  (text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ''));

/** Render prompt text with {{var}} tokens as chips. */
const renderText = (text) =>
  text
    .split(/(\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\})/g)
    .map((part) =>
      /^\{\{/.test(part)
        ? `<span class="inline rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(part.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ''))}</span>`
        : escapeAttribute(part)
    )
    .join('');

export class PromptVariantDiffElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'variants'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._variants = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._variants.length) this._variants = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('variants'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-variant-apply]');
        if (!btn) return;
        const panel = btn.closest('[data-variant-panel]');
        const variant = this._variants.find((v) => v.id === panel?.getAttribute('data-variant-panel'));
        if (variant) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply', { detail: { variant } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'variants' && !this._variants.length) {
      this._variants = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('variants'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get variants() { return this._variants; }
  set variants(v) {
    this._variants = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((x) => ({ ...x })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const variants = this._variants;
    const [base, compare] = variants;
    if (!base || !compare) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Prompt variants');

    const baseVars = extractVars(base.text);
    const cmpVars = extractVars(compare.text);
    const addedVars = cmpVars.filter((v) => !baseVars.includes(v));
    const removedVars = baseVars.filter((v) => !cmpVars.includes(v));
    const changedText = base.text !== compare.text;

    const panels = variants.map((variant, index) => `
      <div data-variant-panel="${escapeAttribute(variant.id)}" class="flex flex-col p-4">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2">
          <span class="h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${index === 0 ? 'bg-zinc-400' : 'bg-violet-500'}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span data-variant-label class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(variant.label)}</span>
          ${index === 0 ? '<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">Base</span>' : ''}
        </div>
        <p data-variant-text class="min-h-16 flex-1 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200">${renderText(variant.text)}</p>
        <button type="button" data-variant-apply class="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Use this version</button>
      </div>`).join('');

    const varlist = addedVars.length > 0 || removedVars.length > 0
      ? `<div data-variant-varlist class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          ${addedVars.map((v) => `<span data-var-added class="inline rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300">+ ${escapeAttribute(v)}</span>`).join('')}
          ${removedVars.map((v) => `<span data-var-removed class="inline rounded bg-red-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300">− ${escapeAttribute(v)}</span>`).join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-prompt-variant-diff class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
      <span data-diff-added class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${addedVars.length}</span>
      <span data-diff-removed class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">−${removedVars.length}</span>
      ${changedText ? '<span data-diff-text class="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">~text</span>' : ''}
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="grid gap-0 divide-x divide-zinc-100 sm:grid-cols-2 dark:divide-zinc-800">${panels}</div>
  ${varlist}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-variant-diff')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-variant-diff', PromptVariantDiffElement);
}

export default PromptVariantDiffElement;

/**
 * QaTestTable - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <qa-test-table title="QA tests" rows='[...]'></qa-test-table>
 * Attributes: title, rows (JSON: [{id,question,answered?,rating?}])
 *             rating: 'good' | 'acceptable' | 'poor'
 * Events: row-check (detail {row,checked}), row-select (detail {row})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const RATING_CHIP = {
  good: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  acceptable: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
  poor: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300',
};

const RATING_LABEL = { good: 'Good', acceptable: 'Acceptable', poor: 'Poor' };

export class QaTestTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'rows'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._rows = [];
    this._checked = {};
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._rows.length) this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const checkEl = event.target.closest('[data-qa-check]');
        if (checkEl) {
          const rowEl = checkEl.closest('[data-qa-row]');
          const row = this._rows.find((r) => r.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-qa-row'));
          if (row) {
            const next = !this._checked[row.id];
            this._checked = { ...this._checked, [row.id]: next };
            this.render();
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-check', { detail: { row, checked: next } }));
          }
          return;
        }
        const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-qa-row]');
        if (!rowEl) return;
        const row = this._rows.find((r) => r.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-qa-row'));
        if (row) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-select', { detail: { row } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'rows' && !this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() { return this._rows; }
  set rows(v) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const rows = this._rows;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'QA tests');
    const answeredCount = rows.filter((r) => r.answered !== false).length;

    const body = rows.map((row) => {
      const rating = row.rating && RATING_LABEL[row.rating]
        ? `<span data-qa-rating="${escapeAttribute(row.rating)}" class="inline rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${RATING_CHIP[row.rating]}">${RATING_LABEL[row.rating]}</span>`
        : '';
      const status = row.answered !== false
        ? '<span data-qa-status class="text-emerald-500">✓</span>'
        : '<span data-qa-status class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">—</span>';
      return `<tr data-qa-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <td class="py-2.5 pl-4"><input type="checkbox" data-qa-check aria-label="Select ${escapeAttribute(row.question)}" ${this._checked[row.id] ? 'checked' : ''} class="h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer accent-emerald-600"></td>
        <td data-qa-question class="max-w-72 truncate py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(row.question)}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 pr-3 text-center">${status}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 pr-4">${rating}</td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-qa-test-table class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${rows.length} questions</span>
    <span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">${answeredCount} answered</span>
  </div>
  <table data-qa-rows class="w-full text-left">
    <thead>
      <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <th class="w-10 py-2 pl-4 font-medium"></th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Question</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-3 text-center font-medium">Answer status</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Answer rating</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>${body}</tbody>
  </table>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('qa-test-table')) {
  customElements.define('qa-test-table', QaTestTableElement);
}

/**
 * QuoteMasonry - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <quote-masonry></quote-masonry> with `quotes` property
 * Attributes: columns (2|3|4)
 * Properties: quotes ({ quote, name, role?, company?, marked? }[])
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const COLUMN_CLASS = { 2: 'sm:columns-2', 3: 'sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3', 4: 'sm:columns-2 lg:columns-4' };

export class QuoteMasonryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._quotes = [];
  }

  get quotes() {
    return this._quotes;
  }

  set quotes(value) {
    this._quotes = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const columns = Number(this.getAttribute('columns')) || 3;
    this._applyHostClass(`columns-1 gap-4 ${COLUMN_CLASS[columns] || COLUMN_CLASS[3]} [column-fill:balance]`);
    const quotes = this._quotes;
    if (!quotes.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = quotes
      .map((card, index) => {
        const marked = card.marked !== false;
        return `<figure data-quote-index="${index}" class="mb-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          ${marked ? '<span aria-hidden="true" class="block text-3xl font-black leading-none text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700">&ldquo;</span>' : ''}
          <blockquote class="text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200${marked ? ' -mt-2' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(card.quote)}</blockquote>
          <figcaption class="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <span class="min-w-0">
              <span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(card.name)}</span>
              ${
                card.role || card.company
                  ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute([card.role, card.company].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</span>`
                  : ''
              }
            </span>
            ${
              card.company
                ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.company)}</span>`
                : ''
            }
          </figcaption>
        </figure>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }
}

  customElements.define('quote-masonry', QuoteMasonryElement);

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '>': '&gt;',

export class RankListElement extends HTMLElement {

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const valueHeader = this.getAttribute('value-header') || '';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No data yet';
    const showRatio = this.hasAttribute('show-ratio');
    const selectable = typeof this.onSelect === 'function' ? true : this.hasAttribute('selectable');
    const maxRaw = this.getAttribute('max-items');
    const maxItems = maxRaw === null ? Infinity : Number(maxRaw) || Infinity;
    const visible = Number.isFinite(maxItems) ? this._items.slice(0, maxItems) : this._items;
    const peak = Math.max(...visible.map((item) => Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0), 1);

    const header =
      title || valueHeader
        ? `<header class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            ${title ? `<h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h3>` : '<span></span>'}
            ${valueHeader ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(valueHeader)}</span>` : ''}
          </header>`
        : '';

    let body;
    if (!visible.length) {
      body = `<p class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;
    } else {
      body = `<ul class="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">${visible
        .map((item, index) => {
          const ratio = Math.max(4, Math.min(100, ((Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0) / peak) * 100));
          return `<li ${selectable ? 'role="button" tabindex="0"' : ''} data-rank-index="${index}"
            class="relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${selectable ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''}">
            ${
              showRatio
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-y-1 left-2 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" style="width:calc((100% - 1rem) * ${ratio / 100})"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <span class="relative z-10 flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${showRatio ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5' : ''}">
              ${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 13, className: 'shrink-0 text-zinc-400' }) : ''}<span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
            </span>
            <span class="relative z-10 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(item.value)}</span>
          </li>`;
        })
        .join('')}</ul>`;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `<section data-rank-list class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${header}${body}</section>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-rank-index]').forEach((row) => {
      const fire = () => {
        const index = Number(row.getAttribute('data-rank-index'));
        const item = this._items[index];
        if (typeof this.onSelect === 'function') this.onSelect(index, item);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { index, item } }));
      };
      row.addEventListener('click', fire);
      row.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if ((event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') && selectable) {
          event.preventDefault();
          fire();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

  }[char]));

const BASE_BUTTON =
  'flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';

/**
 * RichToolbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <rich-toolbar></rich-toolbar>
 * Properties: groups (RichToolbarGroup[])
 * Events: action (detail: item id)
 */
export class RichToolbarElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const groups = this._groups
      .map((group, groupIndex) => {
        const buttons = group.items
          .map((item) => {
            const tone = item.active
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
            const title = item.shortcut ? `${item.label} (${item.shortcut})` : item.label;
            const inner = item.text
              ? `<span class="font-semibold leading-none">${escapeAttribute(item.text)}</span>`
              : uiIcon(item.icon || 'square', { size: 15 });
            return `<button type="button" class="toolbar-item ${BASE_BUTTON} ${tone}"
              data-action="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(item.label)}"
              ${item.active ? 'aria-pressed="true"' : ''} ${item.disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
              title="${escapeAttribute(title)}">${inner}</button>`;
          })
          .join('');
        const divider =
          groupIndex > 0
            ? '<span aria-hidden="true" class="mx-0.5 h-5 w-px shrink-0 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'
            : '';
        return `${divider}<div role="group" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(group.label || group.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-0.5">${buttons}</div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="toolbar" aria-label="Formatting"
      class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${groups}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.toolbar-item').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-action') }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('rich-toolbar')) {
  customElements.define('rich-toolbar', RichToolbarElement);
}

====/File: vanilla/SchedulerSlots.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PERIODS = [
  { key: 'morning', label: 'Morning', range: [6, 12] },
  { key: 'afternoon', label: 'Afternoon', range: [12, 17] },
  { key: 'evening', label: 'Evening', range: [17, 24] },
];

const humanDate = (iso) => {
  const [year, month, day] = String(iso || '').split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso || '';
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
};

const hourOf = (time) => {
  const [hour] = String(time || '').split(':').map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const amPm = (time) => {
  const [hour, minute] = String(time || '').split(':').map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')} ${suffix}`;
};

/**
 * SchedulerSlots - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <scheduler-slots date="2026-11-20" timezone="GMT+8"></scheduler-slots>
 * Properties: slots (SchedulerSlot[])
 * Events: select (detail: slot)
 */
export class SchedulerSlotsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['date', 'selected-id', 'timezone', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._slots = [];
  }

  get slots() {
    return this._slots;
  }

  set slots(value) {
    this._slots = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const date = this.getAttribute('date') || '';
    const selectedId = this.getAttribute('selected-id') || '';
    const timezone = this.getAttribute('timezone') || '';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No slots available for this day.';

    const groups = PERIODS.map((period) => ({
      period,
      slots: this._slots.filter((slot) => {
        const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
        return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
      }),
    })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0);

    const openCount = this._slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length;

    const body = groups.length
      ? `<div class="mt-2 space-y-3">
          ${groups
            .map(({ period, slots }) => {
              const buttons = slots
                .map((slot) => {
                  const disabled = slot.available === false;
                  const selected = String(slot.id) === String(selectedId);
                  const tone = selected
                    ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white'
                    : disabled
                      ? 'cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600'
                      : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20';
                  return `<button type="button" class="slot flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${tone}"
                    data-slot="${escapeAttribute(slot.id)}" aria-pressed="${selected}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                    <span class="tabular-nums">${escapeAttribute(amPm(slot.time))}</span>
                    ${selected ? uiIcon('check', { size: 11 }) : disabled ? uiIcon('lock', { size: 11 }) : ''}
                  </button>`;
                })
                .join('');
              const notes = slots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note);
              return `<fieldset>
                <legend class="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${period.label}</legend>
                <div class="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">${buttons}</div>
                ${notes.length ? `<p class="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(notes.join(' · '))}</p>` : ''}
              </fieldset>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : `<p class="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <header class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('calendar', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(humanDate(date))}</h3>
            ${timezone ? `<p class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in ${escapeAttribute(timezone)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
          <span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${openCount} open</span>
        </header>
        ${body}
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-slot');
        const slot = this._slots.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (slot) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: slot }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('scheduler-slots')) {
  customElements.define('scheduler-slots', SchedulerSlotsElement);
}
export default SchedulerSlotsElement;

/**
 * SearchInput - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <search-field placeholder="Search…" shortcut="⌘K"></search-field>
 * Properties: value
 * Attributes: value, placeholder, shortcut, loading, autofocus
 * Events: change (detail: { value }), search (detail: { value }), clear
 */
export class SearchInputElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'placeholder', 'shortcut', 'loading', 'autofocus'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._value = null;
  }

  get value() {
    if (this._value !== null) return this._value;
    return this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(value) {
    this._value = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get placeholder() {
    return this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search…';
  }

  get loading() {
    return this.hasAttribute('loading');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const current = this.value;
    const loading = this.loading;
    const shortcut = this.getAttribute('shortcut') || '';

    const suffix = loading
      ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 13, className: 'animate-spin' })}</span>`
      : current
        ? `<button type="button" data-search-clear aria-label="Clear search" class="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>`
        : shortcut
          ? `<kbd class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9.5px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(shortcut)}</kbd>`
          : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-500/20 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600">
      <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 13 })}</span>
      <input data-search-input type="text" role="searchbox" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(this.placeholder)}"
        value="${escapeAttribute(current)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(this.placeholder)}"
        class="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
      ${suffix}
    </div>`;

    const input = this.querySelector('[data-search-input]');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this._value = input.value;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: this.value } }));
        this.render();
        const fresh = this.querySelector('[data-search-input]');
        if (fresh && this.contains(document.activeElement)) {
          fresh.focus();
          fresh.setSelectionRange(fresh.value.length, fresh.value.length);
        }
      });
      input.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter') {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { value: this.value } }));
        } else if (event.key === 'Escape' && this.value) {
          this._value = '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    }
    const clear = this.querySelector('[data-search-clear]');
    if (clear) {
      clear.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._value = '';
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
        this.render();
        const fresh = this.querySelector('[data-search-input]');
        if (fresh) fresh.focus();
      });
    }
    if (this.hasAttribute('autofocus')) {
      const fresh = this.querySelector('[data-search-input]');
      if (fresh) fresh.focus();
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('search-field')) {
  customElements.define('search-field', SearchInputElement);
}
export default SearchInputElement;

/**
 * SearchTypeahead - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <search-typeahead query="web dev" placeholder="Search…" highlight="web dev" results-heading="Top results" footer-hint="Not sure where to begin? Take our quiz →"></search-typeahead>
 * Properties: suggestions ({ label, type?, meta? }[]), results ({ title, badge? }[])
 * Attributes: query, placeholder, highlight, results-heading, footer-hint
 * Events: select (detail {label}), submit (detail {query})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const escapeRegExp = (value) => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

export class SearchTypeaheadElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['query', 'placeholder', 'highlight', 'results-heading', 'footer-hint'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._suggestions = [];
    this._results = [];
  }

  get suggestions() {
    return this._suggestions;
  }

  set suggestions(value) {
    this._suggestions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get results() {
    return this._results;
  }

  set results(value) {
    this._results = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _markMatches(label) {
    const highlight = (this.getAttribute('highlight') || '').trim();
    if (!highlight) return escapeAttribute(label);
    return label
      .split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(highlight)})`, 'ig'))
      .map((part) =>
        part.toLowerCase() === highlight.toLowerCase()
          ? `<mark class="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">${escapeAttribute(part)}</mark>`
          : escapeAttribute(part),
      )
      .join('');
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const query = this.getAttribute('query') || '';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search…';
    const resultsHeading = this.getAttribute('results-heading') || 'Top results';
    const footerHint = this.getAttribute('footer-hint') || '';

    const searchIcon =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4-4"/></svg>';
    const clearIcon =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-4 w-4"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>';

    const suggestionHtml = this._suggestions.length
      ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-1" data-typeahead-suggestions>
          ${this._suggestions
            .map(
              (suggestion, index) => `<li>
                <button type="button" data-typeahead-suggestion="${index}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
                  ${searchIcon.replace('class="shrink-0', 'class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0')}
                  <span class="min-w-0 truncate">${this._markMatches(suggestion.label)}</span>
                  ${suggestion.type ? `<span class="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(suggestion.type)}</span>` : ''}
                </button>
              </li>`,
            )
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : '';

    const resultsHtml = this._results.length
      ? `<div class="mt-5" data-typeahead-results>
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(resultsHeading)}</p>
          <ul class="mt-2 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            ${this._results
              .map(
                (result, index) => `<li class="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
                  <button type="button" data-typeahead-result="${index}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:text-indigo-400">${this._markMatches(result.title)}</button>
                  ${result.badge ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(result.badge)}</span>` : ''}
                </li>`,
              )
              .join('')}
          </ul>
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-search-typeahead class="w-full">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-200 pb-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
        ${searchIcon.replace('class="shrink-0', 'class="h-5 w-5 shrink-0')}
        <input type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(query)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" data-typeahead-input
          class="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-600" />
        ${query ? `<button type="button" data-typeahead-clear aria-label="Clear search" class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${clearIcon}</button>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${suggestionHtml}
      ${resultsHtml}
      ${footerHint ? `<div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400"><span>${escapeAttribute(footerHint)}</span><a href="#" class="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" data-typeahead-help>Help Center</a></div>` : ''}
    </div>`;

    const input = this.querySelector('[data-typeahead-input]');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: { query: input.value } }));
      });
    }
    const clear = this.querySelector('[data-typeahead-clear]');
    if (clear) {
      clear.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: { query: '' } })));
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-typeahead-suggestion]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const suggestion = this._suggestions[Number(button.getAttribute('data-typeahead-suggestion'))];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { label: suggestion.label } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-typeahead-result]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const result = this._results[Number(button.getAttribute('data-typeahead-result'))];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { label: result.title } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('search-typeahead')) {
  customElements.define('search-typeahead', SearchTypeaheadElement);
}
export default SearchTypeaheadElement;

/**
 * SegmentBreakdownBars - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <segment-breakdown headline="23.19" caption="Conversion rate"> with `items` property
 * Attributes: headline, headline-unit, caption, unit
 * Properties: items ({ label, value, unit?, delta?, deltaUnit?, tone? }[])
 * Events: none (display-only)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_BAR = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  sky: 'bg-sky-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

export class SegmentBreakdownBarsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['headline', 'headline-unit', 'caption', 'unit'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const headline = this.getAttribute('headline') || '0';
    const headlineUnit = this.getAttribute('headline-unit') ?? '%';
    const caption = this.getAttribute('caption') || '';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || '';
    const items = this._items;
    const max = Math.max(...items.map((item) => Math.max(0, item.value)), 0.0001);
    const total = Math.round(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Math.max(0, item.value), 0) * 100) / 100;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-segment-breakdown role="table" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p class="border-l-2 border-zinc-900 pl-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(headline)}<span class="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(headlineUnit)}</span></p>
      ${caption ? `<p class="mt-1 pl-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(caption)}</p>` : ''}
      <div class="mt-4 space-y-3">
        ${items
          .map((item, index) => {
            const share = Math.max(0, item.value);
            const width = Math.min(100, Math.round((share / max) * 100));
            const tone = TONE_BAR[item.tone || 'indigo'];
            const delta =
              item.delta !== undefined
                ? `<span class="w-16 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-medium tabular-nums ${
                    item.delta > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : item.delta < 0 ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-zinc-400'
                  }">${item.delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${escapeAttribute(item.delta)}${escapeAttribute(item.deltaUnit ?? 'pp')}</span>`
                : '<span class="w-16 shrink-0"></span>';
            return `<div role="row" data-segment-index="${index}" class="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span class="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
              <span class="relative h-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                <span data-segment-bar class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${tone}" style="width:${width}%"></span>
              </span>
              <span class="w-14 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(share)}${escapeAttribute(item.unit ?? unit)}</span>
              ${delta}
            </div>`;
          })
          .join('')}
      </div>
      <p class="mt-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">Share of ${escapeAttribute(total)}${escapeAttribute(unit)} across ${items.length} segments</p>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('segment-breakdown')) {
  customElements.define('segment-breakdown', SegmentBreakdownBarsElement);
}
export default SegmentBreakdownBarsElement;

/**
 * ServiceStatusList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <service-status-list duration-label="Worked for 37s"></service-status-list>
 * Attributes: duration-label, services (JSON attribute), checks (JSON attribute)
 * Properties: services (Array<{name, command, status: running|stopped|failed|starting, url?}>), checks (Array<{label, passed, detail?}>)
 * Events: service-click (detail {service})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SERVICE_STATUS = {
  running: {
    icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>',
    text: 'Running on',
    tone: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
  },
  starting: {
    icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>',
    text: 'Starting…',
    tone: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400',
  },
  stopped: {
    icon: '<span class="block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-400"></span>',
    text: 'Stopped',
    tone: 'text-zinc-500',
  },
  failed: {
    icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>',
    text: 'Failed',
    tone: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
  },
};

export class ServiceStatusListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['duration-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._services = [];
    this._checks = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get services() {
    return this._services;
  }

  set services(list) {
    this._services = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get checks() {
    return this._checks;
  }

  set checks(list) {
    this._checks = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._services.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('services');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._services = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._services = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._checks.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('checks');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._checks = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._checks = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-service-row]');
        if (row) {
          const service = this._services.find((item) => item.name === row.getAttribute('data-service-row'));
          if (service) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('service-click', { detail: { service } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const durationLabel = this.getAttribute('duration-label') || '';
    const services = Array.isArray(this._services) ? this._services : [];
    const checks = Array.isArray(this._checks) ? this._checks : [];

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-service-status class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Services</p>
      <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
        ${services
          .map((service) => {
            const tone = SERVICE_STATUS[service.status] || SERVICE_STATUS.stopped;
            return `<li data-service-row="${escapeAttribute(service.name)}" data-service-status="${escapeAttribute(service.status)}">
              <button type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                <span class="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(service.name)}</span>
                <code class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(service.command)}</code>
                <span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                  ${tone.icon}
                  <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-medium ${tone.tone}">${tone.text}</span>
                  ${service.url ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(service.url)}</span>` : ''}
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>`;
          })
          .join('')}
      </ul>
      ${
        checks.length
          ? `<div class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <ul class="space-y-1">
                ${checks
                  .map(
                    (check) => `<li data-check-row class="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      ${
                        check.passed
                          ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="mt-0.5 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-emerald-500"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>'
                          : '<span class="mt-1 block h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-400"></span>'
                      }
                      <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <code class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(check.label)}</code>
                        ${check.detail ? `<span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(check.detail)}</span>` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </li>`,
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </ul>
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
      ${durationLabel ? `<p class="mt-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(durationLabel)}</p>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }
}

}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class SettingsPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['sections', 'active-id', 'saving', 'save-text', 'allow-save'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'active-id' && this._sections) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || this._current;
    this.render();
  }

  get sections() {
    if (this._sections) return this._sections;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('sections') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set sections(value) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (!this._current) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || this._sections[0]?.id || '';
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const sections = this.sections;
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!sections.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    if (!this._current) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || sections[0].id;
    const current = sections.find((item) => item.id === this._current) || sections[0];
    const saving = this.getAttribute('saving') === 'true';
    const saveText = this.getAttribute('save-text') || 'Save changes';
    const allowSave = this.hasAttribute('allow-save') ? this.getAttribute('allow-save') !== 'false' : true;

    const nav = sections
      .map((item) => {
        const active = item.id === current.id;
        return `<button type="button" data-section="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-current="${active ? 'page' : 'false'}"
          class="settings-nav flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors ${
            active
              ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
              : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          }">
          ${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 }) : ''}
          <span class="whitespace-nowrap">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const items = (current.items || [])
      .map(
        (item) => `
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</div>
            ${item.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            ${item.value ? `<span class="max-w-[12rem] truncate text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.value)}</span>` : ''}
            ${
              item.actionText
                ? `<button type="button" data-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(item.actionText)}</button>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>
        </div>`)
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="md:flex md:gap-6">
        <nav class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:w-44 md:shrink-0 md:flex-col md:overflow-visible md:pb-0">${nav}</nav>
        <div class="mt-3 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mt-0">
          <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(current.title)}</div>
            ${current.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(current.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${items}</div>
          ${
            allowSave
              ? `<div class="flex justify-end border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
                   <button type="button" data-save ${saving ? 'disabled' : ''}
                     class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
                     ${saving ? `<span class="animate-spin inline-flex">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
                     ${escapeAttribute(saveText)}
                   </button>
                 </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-section');
        this._current = id;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('section-change', { detail: { id } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-item]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = (current.items || []).find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-item'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('item-action', { detail: { sectionId: current.id, item } }));
      });
    });

    const save = this.querySelector('[data-save]');
    if (save) {
      save.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', { detail: { id: current.id } })));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('settings-panel')) {
  customElements.define('settings-panel', SettingsPanelElement);
