/**
 * SettingsSideDrawer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <settings-side-drawer title="Settings" side="right|left" footer-primary="Deploy" footer-secondary="Cancel"></settings-side-drawer>
 * Attributes: title, side, footer-primary, footer-secondary
 * Properties: tabs ({ id, label }[]), active-tab (string attr), sections ({ title?, rows: { label, description?, control?, value?, options?, buttonLabel?, buttonTone?, enabled? }[] }[])
 * Events: close, tab-change (detail {id}), row-toggle (detail {label, enabled}), row-action (detail {label}), footer-primary
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BUTTON_TONE = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500',
  danger: 'border border-rose-300 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-500/50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40',
  outline: 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
};

export class SettingsSideDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'side', 'active-tab', 'footer-primary', 'footer-secondary'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._sections = [];
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get sections() {
    return this._sections;
  }

  set sections(value) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Settings';
    const side = this.getAttribute('side') || 'right';
    const activeTab = this.getAttribute('active-tab') || '';
    const footerPrimary = this.getAttribute('footer-primary') || '';
    const footerSecondary = this.getAttribute('footer-secondary') || '';
    const sideClass = side === 'left' ? 'left-0 rounded-r-2xl' : 'right-0 rounded-l-2xl';

    const rowControl = (row) => {
      if (row.control === 'toggle') {
        return `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="${Boolean(row.enabled)}" data-row-toggle
          class="flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full px-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${row.enabled ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700'}">
          <span class="h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${row.enabled ? 'translate-x-4' : ''}"></span>
        </button>`;
      }
      if (row.control === 'select') {
        return `<select data-row-select class="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
          ${(row.options || []).map((option) => `<option>${escapeAttribute(option)}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>`;
      }
      if (row.control === 'button') {
        return `<button type="button" data-row-button class="shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${BUTTON_TONE[row.buttonTone || 'outline']}">${escapeAttribute(row.buttonLabel || 'Open')}</button>`;
      }
      return '';
    };

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-side-drawer data-side="${escapeAttribute(side)}" class="fixed inset-0 z-40">
      <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/50" data-drawer-overlay></div>
      <aside data-drawer-panel role="dialog" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}" class="absolute top-0 flex h-full w-full max-w-md flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${sideClass}">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
          <button type="button" data-drawer-close aria-label="Close settings" class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${uiIcon('x', { size: 16 })}</button>
        </div>
        ${
          this._tabs.length
            ? `<div class="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 pt-1 dark:border-zinc-800" role="tablist" data-drawer-tabs>
                ${this._tabs
                  .map(
                    (tab) => `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${tab.id === activeTab}" data-drawer-tab="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"
                      class="-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                        tab.id === activeTab
                          ? 'border-indigo-500 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
                          : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                      }">${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}</button>`,
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4" data-drawer-body>
          ${this._sections
            .map(
              (section, sectionIndex) => `<section class="${sectionIndex > 0 ? 'mt-5 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-4 dark:border-zinc-800' : ''}">
                ${section.title ? `<h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(section.title)}</h3>` : ''}
                <ul class="${section.title ? 'mt-2 space-y-3' : 'space-y-3'}">
                  ${(section.rows || [])
                    .map(
                      (row) => `<li class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4" data-settings-row="${escapeAttribute(row.label)}">
                        <span class="min-w-0">
                          <span class="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(row.label)}</span>
                          ${row.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(row.description)}</span>` : ''}
                        </span>
                        ${rowControl(row)}
                      </li>`,
                    )
                    .join('')}
                </ul>
              </section>`,
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>
        ${
          footerPrimary || footerSecondary
            ? `<div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800" data-drawer-footer>
                ${footerSecondary ? `<button type="button" data-drawer-secondary class="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(footerSecondary)}</button>` : ''}
                ${footerPrimary ? `<button type="button" data-drawer-primary class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(footerPrimary)}</button>` : ''}
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </aside>
    </div>`;

    const overlay = this.querySelector('[data-drawer-overlay]');
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close')));
    const closeBtn = this.querySelector('[data-drawer-close]');
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close')));
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-drawer-tab]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-drawer-tab');
        this.setAttribute('active-tab', id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-change', { detail: { id } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-row-toggle]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const row = button.closest('[data-settings-row]');
        const label = row?.getAttribute('data-settings-row') || '';
        const enabled = button.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true';
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-toggle', { detail: { label, enabled } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-row-button]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const row = button.closest('[data-settings-row]');
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-action', { detail: { label: row?.getAttribute('data-settings-row') || '' } }));
      });
    });
    const primary = this.querySelector('[data-drawer-primary]');
    if (primary) primary.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('footer-primary')));
  }

/**
 * ShareAccessDialog - Superhuman "Share Conversation" dialog: invite-by-email
 * input, a people-with-access list showing avatar / name / email / permission
 * role with per-row remove, plus a Copy link footer action.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class ShareAccessDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'url', 'copy-label', 'people', 'open'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._people = [];
    this._open = true;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._people.length) {
      this._people = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('people'), []);
    }
    const openAttr = this.getAttribute('open');
    if (openAttr !== null) {
      this._open = openAttr === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'people' && !this._people.length) {
      this._people = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('people'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'open') {
      this._open = newValue === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'Share Conversation';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get description() {
    return this.getAttribute('description') ?? 'Invite teammates to view this conversation. Everyone with access will see future replies.';
  }
  set description(value) {
    this.setAttribute('description', value);
  }

  get url() {
    return this.getAttribute('url') ?? 'https://example.com/share/abc123';
  }
  set url(value) {
    this.setAttribute('url', value);
  }

  get copyLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('copy-label') ?? 'COPY LINK';
  }
  set copyLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('copy-label', value);
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }
  set open(value) {
    this._open = Boolean(value);
    this.setAttribute('open', this._open ? 'true' : 'false');
    this._render();
  }

  get people() {
    return this._people;
  }
  set people(value) {
    this._people = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (!this._open) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-share-access-copy]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy-link', { detail: { url: this.url }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-share-access-close]')) {
      this.open = false;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const personEl = event.target.closest('[data-access-person]');
    if (personEl && event.target.closest('[data-access-person-remove]')) {
      const person = this._people.find((p) => String(p.id) === personEl.getAttribute('data-access-person'));
      if (person) {
        this._people = this._people.filter((p) => p.id !== person.id);
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-person', { detail: { person }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    if (!this._open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const initials = (name) =>
      String(name ?? '')
        .split(' ')
        .map((part) => part[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();

    const rows = this._people.length
      ? this._people
          .map((p) => {
            const role = p.role
              ? `<span data-access-person-role class="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(p.role)}</span>`
              : '';
            return `
          <div data-access-person="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5">
            <span aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${initials(p.name)}</span>
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p data-access-person-name class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(p.name)}</p>
              <p data-access-person-email class="truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(p.email)}</p>
            </div>
            ${role}
            <button type="button" data-access-person-remove aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(p.name)}" class="shrink-0 rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-red-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">✕</button>
          </div>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<p data-share-access-empty class="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No people have access yet.</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-share-access-backdrop class="fixed inset-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950/40 p-4">
        <div data-share-access-dialog class="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h4 data-share-access-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</h4>
              <p data-share-access-description class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this.description)}</p>
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-share-access-close aria-label="Close share dialog" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
          </div>
          <div data-share-access-invite class="mt-4">
            <input type="email" data-share-access-input placeholder="Add people by name or email" class="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:border-zinc-400 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder-zinc-500 dark:focus:border-zinc-500" />
          </div>
          <div data-share-access-people class="mt-3 divide-y divide-zinc-100 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-700">${rows}</div>
          <div data-share-access-url class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
            <span data-share-access-url-text class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this.url)}</span>
            <button type="button" data-share-access-copy class="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(this.copyLabel)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('share-access-dialog')) {
  customElements.define('share-access-dialog', ShareAccessDialogElement);
}

export default ShareAccessDialogElement;

/**
 * ShareChatDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <share-chat-dialog title="Share chat" link="..." shared="true"></share-chat-dialog>
 * Attributes: open, title, description, link, shared
 * Events: create-link, copy-link, toggle-shared (detail {shared}), close
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ShareChatDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'link', 'shared'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-share-close]')) {
          this.setAttribute('open', 'false');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-share-private]')) {
          this.setAttribute('shared', 'false');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-shared', { detail: { shared: false } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-share-public]')) {
          this.setAttribute('shared', 'true');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-shared', { detail: { shared: true } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-share-create]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('create-link'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-share-copy]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy-link', { detail: { link: this.getAttribute('link') || '' } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if ((this.getAttribute('open') || 'true') === 'false') {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Share chat');
    const description = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('description') || 'Anyone with the link can view this conversation. Future messages aren\'t included.');
    const link = this.getAttribute('link') || '';
    const shared = this.getAttribute('shared') === 'true';

    const linkRow = shared ? (link ? `
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <code data-share-link class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(link)}</code>
        <button type="button" data-share-copy class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200">Copy link</button>
      </div>` : `
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button type="button" data-share-create class="w-full rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">Create link</button>
      </div>`) : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-share-chat role="dialog" aria-modal="true" class="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
    <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</h3>
    <button type="button" data-share-close aria-label="Close" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
  </div>
  <p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${description}</p>
  <div class="mt-3 space-y-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <button type="button" data-share-private class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left transition-colors ${!shared ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'}">
      <span aria-hidden="true">🔒</span>
      <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span class="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Keep private</span>
        <span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Only you have access</span>
      </span>
      ${!shared ? '<span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>' : ''}
    </button>
    <button type="button" data-share-public class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left transition-colors ${shared ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'}">
      <span aria-hidden="true">🌐</span>
      <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span class="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Create public link</span>
        <span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Anyone with the link can view</span>
      </span>
      ${shared ? '<span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>' : ''}
    </button>
  </div>
  ${linkRow}
</div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('share-chat-dialog', ShareChatDialogElement);

/**
 * SharedChatViewer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <shared-chat-viewer app-name="ChatApp" title="..." meta="..." cta-text="..."></shared-chat-viewer>
 * Property: messages ([{id, role: 'user'|'assistant', text}])
 * Events: cta
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class SharedChatViewerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['app-name', 'title', 'meta', 'cta-text', 'cta-note'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._messages = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-shared-cta]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get messages() { return this._messages; }
  set messages(v) {
    this._messages = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before messages are captured.
    if (this._messages.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const appName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('app-name') || 'ChatApp');
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Shared conversation');
    const meta = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('meta') || '');
    const ctaText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'Try it yourself');
    const ctaNote = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('cta-note') || 'This conversation is read-only.');

    const bubbles = this._messages.map((msg) => {
      const isUser = msg.role === 'user';
      return `
        <div data-shared-msg="${escapeAttribute(msg.id)}" class="flex ${isUser ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}">
          <p data-shared-role="${isUser ? 'user' : 'assistant'}" class="max-w-[80%] whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2 text-sm leading-relaxed ${isUser ? 'rounded-br-sm bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'rounded-bl-sm bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'}">${escapeAttribute(msg.text)}</p>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-shared-chat class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div data-shared-header class="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white" aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(appName.slice(0, 1))}</span>
    <div class="min-w-0">
      <p class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
      ${meta ? `<p data-shared-meta class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${appName} · ${meta}</p>` : ''}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="space-y-3 px-4 py-4">${bubbles}
  </div>
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
    <p class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${ctaNote}</p>
    <button type="button" data-shared-cta class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200">${ctaText}</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/ShortcutCheatSheet.js/====

/**
 * ShortcutCheatSheet - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <shortcut-cheat-sheet shortcuts='[...]' title="Shortcuts" searchable="true"></shortcut-cheat-sheet>
 * Attributes: shortcuts (JSON [{id,icon?,label,hint?,keys[],section?}]), title, columns (1|2), searchable
 * Properties: shortcuts
 * Events: none (internal search only)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const escapeHtml = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
  }[char]));

export class ShortcutCheatSheetElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['shortcuts', 'title', 'columns', 'searchable'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._shortcuts = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._shortcuts.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('shortcuts');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._shortcuts = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._shortcuts = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target.hasAttribute && target.hasAttribute('data-shortcut-search')) {
          this._query = target.value;
          this.render();
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-shortcut-search]');
          if (input) {
            input.value = this._query;
            input.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'shortcuts') this._shortcuts = [];
    this.render();
  }

  get shortcuts() { return this._shortcuts; }
  set shortcuts(v) {
    this._shortcuts = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Shortcuts';
    const columns = this.getAttribute('columns') === '1' ? 1 : 2;
    const searchable = this.getAttribute('searchable') === 'true';
    const needle = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = needle
      ? this._shortcuts.filter((entry) => `${entry.label} ${entry.hint || ''} ${(entry.keys || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
      : this._shortcuts;

    const sections = new Map();
    for (const entry of filtered) {
      const key = entry.section || '';
      if (!sections.has(key)) sections.set(key, []);
      sections.get(key).push(entry);
    }

    const hostClass = 'w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const kbdChip = (key, entryId, i) => `<kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[24px] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]">${escapeHtml(key)}</kbd>`;

    const sectionsHtml = Array.from(sections.entries())
      .map(([section, entries]) => {
        const rows = entries
          .map((entry) => {
            const icon = entry.icon ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 [&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4">${entry.icon}</span>` : '';
            const hint = entry.hint ? `<code class="ml-1 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-indigo-600">${escapeHtml(entry.hint)}</code>` : '';
            const keys = (entry.keys || []).map((key, i) => kbdChip(key, entry.id, i)).join('');
            return `<li data-shortcut-row="${escapeAttribute(entry.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-50">${icon}<span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs text-zinc-700">${escapeHtml(entry.label)}${hint}</span><span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">${keys}</span></li>`;
          })
          .join('');
        const header = section ? `<p class="mt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeHtml(section)}</p>` : '';
        return `<div${section ? ` data-shortcut-section="${escapeAttribute(section)}"` : ''} class="${columns === 2 ? 'sm:col-span-1' : ''}">${header}<ul class="mt-1 space-y-0.5">${rows}</ul></div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const empty = !sections.size
      ? `<p data-shortcut-empty class="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “${escapeHtml(this._query)}”.</p>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-shortcut-sheet class="${hostClass}">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${escapeHtml(title)}</p>
    ${searchable ? `<input data-shortcut-search type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" placeholder="Search…" class="w-32 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"/>` : ''}
  </div>
  <div class="mt-2 grid gap-x-6 ${columns === 2 ? 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-1'}">${sectionsHtml}</div>
  ${empty}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('shortcut-cheat-sheet')) {
  customElements.define('shortcut-cheat-sheet', ShortcutCheatSheetElement);
}

export default ShortcutCheatSheetElement;

====/File: vanilla/ShortcutsOverlay.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const kbd = (key) =>
  `<kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(key)}</kbd>`;

/**
 * ShortcutsOverlay - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <shortcuts-overlay open></shortcuts-overlay>
 * Properties: groups (ShortcutGroup[]) | shortcuts (ShortcutItem[])
 * Events: close
 */
export class ShortcutsOverlayElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
    this._shortcuts = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set isOpen(value) {
    if (value) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get shortcuts() {
    return this._shortcuts;
  }

  set shortcuts(value) {
    this._shortcuts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isOpen) this._query = '';
    this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  /** Flat list → groups bucketed by item.group, or the provided groups. */
  _normalized() {
    if (this._groups.length > 0) return this._groups;
    const buckets = [];
    this._shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
      const label = item.group || 'General';
      const bucket = buckets.find((group) => group.label === label);
      if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
      else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'), label, items: [item] });
    });
    return buckets;
  }

  _filtered(groups) {
    const query = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return groups;
    return groups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter(
          (item) =>
            String(item.label).toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            (item.keys || []).join('').toLowerCase().includes(query)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Keyboard shortcuts';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search shortcuts...';
    const normalized = this._normalized();
    const filtered = this._filtered(normalized);
    const total = normalized.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.items || []).length, 0);

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
      return;
    }

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);

    const body = filtered.length
      ? `<div class="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          ${filtered
            .map(
              (group) => `
            <section>
              <h3 class="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</h3>
              <ul class="space-y-1.5">
                ${(group.items || [])
                  .map(
                    (item) => `
                  <li class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
                    <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">${(item.keys || []).map(kbd).join('')}</span>
                  </li>`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </ul>
            </section>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : `<div class="py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match &ldquo;${escapeAttribute(this._query)}&rdquo;</div>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="shortcuts-overlay fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 pt-[10vh] backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="flex max-h-[75vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 16 })}</span>
            <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">${total}</span>
            <button type="button" class="shortcuts-close ml-auto rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Close">${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </div>

          <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5">
              <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 13 })}</span>
              <input type="text" class="shortcuts-search w-full border-none bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">${body}</div>

          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1">${kbd('esc')}<span>Close</span></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const search = this.querySelector('.shortcuts-search');
    if (search) {
      search.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._query = event.target.value;
        // Keep focus + caret while re-rendering the list.
        const caret = event.target.selectionStart;
        this.render();
        const next = this.querySelector('.shortcuts-search');
        if (next) {
          next.focus();
          if (caret != null) next.setSelectionRange(caret, caret);
        }
      });
      search.focus();
    }

    this.querySelector('.shortcuts-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });

    this.querySelector('.shortcuts-overlay').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target === event.currentTarget) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('shortcuts-overlay')) {
  customElements.define('shortcuts-overlay', ShortcutsOverlayElement);
}
export default ShortcutsOverlayElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * SideDrawer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <side-drawer open title="Filters" side="right"><p>Body</p></side-drawer>
 * Attributes: open, title, description, side (left|right), size (sm|md|lg)
 * Events: close
 * Light-DOM children are moved into the scrollable body; an element with
 * slot="footer" becomes the sticky footer row.
 */
export class SideDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'side', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    // Capture light-DOM children before the first render moves them.
    this._bodyNodes = Array.from(this.childNodes);
    this.render();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bodyNodes) this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
    if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    // Re-capture the host's own nodes: after the first render they live inside
    // our slots, so pull them back out before the shell is rebuilt.
    const existingBody = this.querySelector('.drawer-body-content');
    const existingFooter = this.querySelector('.drawer-footer');
    if (existingBody || existingFooter) {
      this._bodyNodes = [
        ...(existingBody ? Array.from(existingBody.childNodes) : []),
        ...(existingFooter ? Array.from(existingFooter.childNodes) : []),
      ];
    }

    const open = this.hasAttribute('open') && this.getAttribute('open') !== 'false';
    if (!open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Drawer';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const side = this.getAttribute('side') === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right';
    const size = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'].includes(this.getAttribute('size')) ? this.getAttribute('size') : 'md';

    const nodes = this._bodyNodes || [];
    const footerNodes = nodes.filter((node) => node.nodeType === 1 && node.getAttribute('slot') === 'footer');
    const bodyNodes = nodes.filter((node) => !footerNodes.includes(node));
    const hasFooter = footerNodes.length > 0;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex">
        <div class="drawer-backdrop absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}"
          class="relative z-10 flex h-full w-full flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
            size === 'sm' ? 'max-w-xs' : size === 'lg' ? 'max-w-xl' : 'max-w-md'
          } ${side === 'right' ? 'ml-auto border-l' : 'mr-auto border-r'}">
          <header class="flex items-start gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
              ${description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              aria-label="Close drawer">${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </header>
          <div class="drawer-body-content flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"></div>
          ${hasFooter ? '<footer class="drawer-footer border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800"></footer>' : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const bodySlot = this.querySelector('.drawer-body-content');
    bodyNodes.forEach((node) => bodySlot.appendChild(node));

    if (hasFooter) {
      const footerSlot = this.querySelector('.drawer-footer');
      footerNodes.forEach((node) => footerSlot.appendChild(node));
    }

    this.querySelector('.drawer-backdrop').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
    this.querySelector('.drawer-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

/**
 * SideNav - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <side-nav heading="Workspace" active-id="overview" groups='[{"title":"Main","items":[{"id":"overview","label":"Overview","icon":"eye"}]}]'></side-nav>
 * Attributes: heading, active-id, groups (JSON)
 * Events: navigate (detail: { id, entry })
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw) => {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

export class SideNavElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['heading', 'active-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const heading = this.getAttribute('heading') || '';
    const activeId = this.getAttribute('active-id') ?? '';

    const groupHtml = (() => {
      const groups = this._groups.length ? this._groups : parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'));
      return groups
      .map(
        (group, groupIndex) => `<div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          ${group.title ? `<p class="px-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(group.title)}</p>` : ''}
          ${Array.isArray(group.items)
            ? group.items
                .map((entry) => {
                  const active = String(entry.id) === String(activeId);
                  return `<button type="button" data-nav-id="${escapeAttribute(entry.id)}" ${active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}
                    class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                      active
                        ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300'
                        : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                    }">
                    ${entry.icon ? uiIcon(entry.icon, { size: 14, className: active ? 'text-indigo-500' : 'text-zinc-400' }) : ''}
                    <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">${escapeAttribute(entry.label)}</span>
                    ${
                      entry.count !== undefined
                        ? `<span class="rounded-full px-1.5 py-px font-mono text-[9.5px] font-semibold ${
                            entry.count > 0
                              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300'
                              : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400'
                          }">${escapeAttribute(entry.count)}</span>`
                        : ''
                    }
                  </button>`;
                })
                .join('')
            : ''}
        </div>`,
      )
      .join('');
    })();

    this.innerHTML = `<nav data-side-nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(heading || 'Side navigation')}" class="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      ${heading ? `<p class="px-2.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(heading)}</p>` : ''}
      ${groupHtml}
    </nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-id]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-nav-id');
        const entry = this._findEntry(id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate', { detail: { id, entry } }));
      });
    });
  }

  _findEntry(id) {
    const groups = this._groups.length ? this._groups : parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'));
    for (const group of groups) {
      for (const entry of Array.isArray(group.items) ? group.items : []) {
        if (String(entry.id) === String(id)) return entry;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('side-nav')) {
  customElements.define('side-nav', SideNavElement);
}
export default SideNavElement;

  }

/**
 * SourcesCitation - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <sources-citation sources='[{"title": "OpenAI Docs", "url": "https://openai.com"}]'></sources-citation>
 */
class SourcesCitation extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["sources"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let sources = [];
    try {
      sources = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("sources") || "[]");
    } catch {
      sources = [];
    }

    if (!sources || sources.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-3 space-y-2">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

          <span>Sources (${sources.length})</span>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          ${sources.map((item, idx) => {
            let domain = "web";
            try {
              domain = new URL(item.url).hostname.replace("www.", "");
            } catch {
              domain = item.siteName || "web";
            }
            return `
              <a href="${item.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="group relative flex flex-col justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 shadow-xs transition-all no-underline">
                <div class="space-y-1">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                    <span class="flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 font-bold text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</span>
                    <span class="truncate max-w-[120px]">${domain}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">${item.title}</div>
                </div>
                ${item.snippet ? `<div class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-2 leading-tight">${item.snippet}</div>` : ''}
                <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end text-[10px] text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-zinc-600 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-300">
                  <span class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">↗</span>
                </div>
              </a>
            `;

====/File: vanilla/StatCard.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const sparkline = (data, positive) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length < 2) return '';
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const points = data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" class="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="${points}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="${positive ? 'stroke-emerald-500' : 'stroke-red-500'}"/></svg>`;
};

export class StatCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'value', 'delta', 'delta-label', 'trend', 'icon'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const deltaAttr = this.getAttribute('delta');
    const delta = deltaAttr === null || deltaAttr === '' ? undefined : Number(deltaAttr);
    const deltaLabel = this.getAttribute('delta-label') || '';
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon') || '';
    let trend;
    try {
      trend = this.getAttribute('trend') ? JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('trend')) : undefined;
    } catch {
      trend = undefined;
    }

    const hasDelta = typeof delta === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(delta);
    const positive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
        ${icon ? `<span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 16 })}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(value)}</div>
          ${
            hasDelta
              ? `<div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="${positive ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'}">${uiIcon(positive ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down', { size: 13 })}</span>
                  <span class="text-[11px] font-medium ${positive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500'}">${positive ? '+' : ''}${delta}%</span>
                  ${deltaLabel ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(deltaLabel)}</span>` : ''}
                </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>
        ${sparkline(trend, positive)}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('stat-card')) {
  customElements.define('stat-card', StatCardElement);
}

/**
 * StatusCountTabs - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <status-count-tabs tabs='[...]' value="all"></status-count-tabs>
 * Attributes: tabs (JSON [{id,label,count?,disabled?}]), value, size (sm|md), full-width
 * Property: tabs, value
 * Events: change (detail {id})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class StatusCountTabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tabs', 'value', 'size', 'full-width'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._tabs.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('tabs');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._tabs = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._tabs = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const tab = event.target.closest('[data-status-tab]');
        if (!tab || tab.disabled) return;
        const id = tab.getAttribute('data-status-tab');
        if (id && id !== this._value && id !== this.getAttribute('value')) {
          this._value = id;
          this.setAttribute('value', id);
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { id } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'value') this._value = undefined;
    this.render();
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value !== undefined ? this._value : this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(id) {
    this._value = id;
    this.setAttribute('value', id);
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'md';
    const fullWidth = this.getAttribute('full-width') === 'true';
    const value = this.value;
    const sizeClass = size === 'sm' ? 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-2.5 text-sm';
    const hostClass = `flex items-stretch overflow-hidden rounded-t-lg border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 ${fullWidth ? 'w-full' : 'inline-flex max-w-full'}`;
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);
    const tabsHtml = this._tabs
      .map((tab) => {
        const active = tab.id === value;
        const stateClass = active
          ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_#18181b] dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_#fafafa]'
          : 'bg-zinc-50 text-sky-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-sky-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
        const count = tab.count != null ? `<span class="font-normal ${active ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-400/80'}">(${tab.count})</span>` : '';
        return `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${active}" data-status-tab="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"${tab.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''} class="flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap border-r border-zinc-200 font-semibold transition-colors last:border-r-0 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 ${sizeClass} ${stateClass}">${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}${count}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-status-count-tabs role="tablist" class="${hostClass}">${tabsHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * StatusIndicator - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <status-indicator status="online" label="VPS Connected" ping-ms="24"></status-indicator>
 */
class StatusIndicator extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["status", "label", "ping-ms", "show-dot"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const status = this.getAttribute("status") || "online";
    const label = this.getAttribute("label");
    const pingMs = this.getAttribute("ping-ms");
    const showDot = this.getAttribute("show-dot") !== "false";

    let dotBg = "bg-emerald-500", pingBg = "bg-emerald-400", text = "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400", badgeBg = "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60", defaultLabel = "Online";
    if (status === "connecting" || status === "busy") {
      dotBg = "bg-amber-500";
      pingBg = "bg-amber-400";
      text = "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting";
    } else if (status === "error" || status === "offline") {
      dotBg = "bg-rose-500";
      pingBg = "bg-rose-400";
      text = "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline";
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${badgeBg} ${text}">
        ${showDot ? `
          <span class="relative flex h-2 w-2">
            ${status === 'online' ? `<span class="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${pingBg}"></span>` : ''}
            <span class="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${dotBg}"></span>
          </span>
        ` : ''}
        <span class="font-semibold">${label || defaultLabel}</span>
        ${pingMs !== null && pingMs !== undefined ? `<span class="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">(${pingMs}ms)</span>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("status-indicator")) {
  customElements.define("status-indicator", StatusIndicator);
}
export default StatusIndicator;

====/File: vanilla/StepSlider.js/====

/**
 * StepSlider - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <step-slider label="Workflow credits" value="1" highlight-from="2" steps="+0k,+1k,+5k,+10k"></step-slider>
 * Attributes: steps (comma-separated), value (0-based index), highlight-from, label, disabled
 * Events: change (detail: { index, step })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class StepSliderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'value', 'highlight-from', 'label', 'disabled'];
  }

  get steps() {
    return (this.getAttribute('steps') || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }

  get value() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('value');
    if (raw === null) return 0;
    const num = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(Math.max(Math.floor(num), 0), this.steps.length - 1) : 0;
  }

  set value(index) {
    this.setAttribute('value', String(index));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block w-full');
    const steps = this.steps;
    const value = this.value;
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');
    const lastIndex = steps.length - 1;
    const ratio = steps.length > 1 ? value / lastIndex : 0;
    const highlightRaw = this.getAttribute('highlight-from');
    const highlightFrom = highlightRaw === null ? steps.length : Number(highlightRaw) || 0;

    const stops = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const reached = index <= value;
        const highlighted = index >= highlightFrom;
        return `<button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="${escapeAttribute(step)}" aria-pressed="${index === value}"
          class="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col items-center focus-visible:outline-none">
          <span class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${
            reached
              ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600'
              : highlighted
                ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-white dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-zinc-900'
                : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900'
          } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50' : ''}"></span>
          <span class="mt-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] ${index === value ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}">${escapeAttribute(step)}</span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="w-full">
      ${label ? `<p class="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(label)}</p>` : ''}
      <div role="slider" tabindex="${disabled ? -1 : 0}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label || 'Step slider')}"
        aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="${lastIndex}" aria-valuenow="${value}" aria-valuetext="${escapeAttribute(steps[value] || '')}"
        ${disabled ? 'aria-disabled="true"' : ''}
        data-slider-track class="group relative flex cursor-pointer items-center pb-1 focus-visible:outline-none">
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-0 right-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-[width] duration-150" style="width:${ratio * 100}%"></span>
        ${stops}
      </div>
    </div>`;

    const track = this.querySelector('[data-slider-track]');
    if (track && !disabled) {
      track.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' && value < lastIndex) this.value = value + 1;
        else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' && value > 0) this.value = value - 1;
        else if (event.key === 'Home') this.value = 0;
        else if (event.key === 'End') this.value = lastIndex;
        else return;
        const current = this.steps[this.value];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { index: this.value, step: current } }));
      });
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
        this.value = index;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { index, step: this.steps[index] } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('step-slider')) {
  customElements.define('step-slider', StepSliderElement);
}
export default StepSliderElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CIRCLE = {
  complete: { cls: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white', icon: 'check' },
  current: { cls: 'border-2 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: null },
  upcoming: { cls: 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700', icon: null },
  error: { cls: 'bg-rose-500 text-white', icon: 'x' },
};

/**
 * Stepper - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <step-flow current="2"></step-flow>
 * Properties: steps ({ id, label, description?, status? }[])
 * Attributes: current (1-based), static (disables click events)
 * Events: step-click (detail: { step, index })
 */
export class StepperElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current', 'static'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get current() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('current'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _statusFor(step, index) {
    if (step.status) return step.status;
    const current = this.current;
    return index + 1 < current ? 'complete' : index + 1 === current ? 'current' : 'upcoming';
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-start');
    const interactive = !this.hasAttribute('static');

    const items = this._steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const status = this._statusFor(step, index);
        const styles = CIRCLE[status] || CIRCLE.upcoming;
        const last = index === this._steps.length - 1;
        const clickable = interactive && status !== 'upcoming';
        const circle = `<button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${clickable ? '' : 'disabled'}
          ${status === 'current' ? 'aria-current="step"' : ''}
          class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-default ${styles.cls}">
          ${styles.icon ? uiIcon(styles.icon, { size: 12 }) : index + 1}
        </button>`;
        const connector = last
          ? ''
          : `<span aria-hidden="true" class="mt-3.5 h-0.5 flex-1 rounded mr-2 ml-2 ${status === 'complete' ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800'}"></span>`;
        return `<li class="flex min-w-0 ${last ? 'flex-none' : 'flex-1'}">
          <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center">${circle}
            <div class="max-w-28">
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight ${status === 'upcoming' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</p>
              ${step.description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>${connector}
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<ol class="flex items-start">${items}</ol>`;

    if (interactive) {
      this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((node) => {
        node.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (node.disabled) return;
          const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { step: this._steps[index], index } }));
        });
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('step-flow')) {
  customElements.define('step-flow', StepperElement);
}
export default StepperElement;

/**
 * StreamMarkdown - Vanilla Web Component (Powered by marked & Prism CDN)
 * Usage: <stream-markdown is-streaming content="# Hello World"></stream-markdown>
 */
class StreamMarkdown extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._clickHandler) {
      this.removeEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isStreaming = this.hasAttribute("is-streaming");
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || this.textContent || "";
    
    // Parse Markdown safely (falls back to text if marked not loaded)
    let parsedHtml = content;
    if (window.marked) {
      const renderer = new window.marked.Renderer();
      renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }) {
        const language = lang && window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
        let highlighted = text;
        try {
          if (window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[language]) {
            highlighted = window.Prism.highlight(text, window.Prism.languages[language], language);
          }
        } catch {
          highlighted = text;
        }

        return `
          <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
              <span>${lang || "code"}</span>
              <button 
                type="button" 
                data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
                class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              >
                Copy
              </button>
            </div>
            <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
          </div>
        `;
      };
      parsedHtml = window.marked.parse(content, { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed">
        <div class="inline-block w-full">${parsedHtml}</div>
        ${isStreaming ? '<span class="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm"></span>' : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    this._clickHandler = (e) => {
      const target = e.target.closest(".copy-btn");
      if (!target) return;
      const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
      if (rawCode) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
        target.textContent = "Copied";
        setTimeout(() => {
          target.textContent = "Copy";
        }, 2000);
      }
    };
    this.addEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("stream-markdown")) {
  customElements.define("stream-markdown", StreamMarkdown);
}
export default StreamMarkdown;

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '>': '&gt;',

const STATUS_BAR = {
  streaming: 'bg-indigo-500',
  done: 'bg-emerald-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
};

export class StreamingProgressBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'label', 'status'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const rawValue = this.getAttribute('value');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const status = this.getAttribute('status') || 'streaming';
    const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

    const parsed = rawValue === null ? null : Number(rawValue);
    const indeterminate = parsed === null || Number.isNaN(parsed);
    const clamped = indeterminate ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parsed));

    const labelHtml =
      label || !indeterminate
        ? `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
             ${!indeterminate ? `<span class="tabular-nums shrink-0">${Math.round(clamped)}%</span>` : ''}
           </div>`
        : '';

    const barHtml = indeterminate
      ? `<div class="h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse"></div>`
      : `<div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}" style="width: ${clamped}%"></div>`;

    this._applyHostClass('block w-full');
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${labelHtml}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin="0"
        aria-valuemax="100"
        ${indeterminate ? '' : `aria-valuenow="${Math.round(clamped)}"`}
        aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label || 'Progress')}"
        class="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >${barHtml}</div>`;
  }
