/**
 * SuccessToast - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <success-toast message="Link copied" duration="3000"></success-toast>
 * Attributes: message, duration (ms, 0 = sticky), position (top-right|bottom-right)
 * Property: message
 * Events: close
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16Zm-1.2-5.4 5-5-1.13-1.13L8.8 10.34 7.33 8.87 6.2 10l2.6 2.6Z"/></svg>';
const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class SuccessToastElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['message', 'duration', 'position'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._visible = true;
    this._timer = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    this._armTimer();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-toast-close]')) {
          this._visible = false;
          this._clearTimer();
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._clearTimer();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'message') {
      this._visible = true;
      this._armTimer();
    }
    this.render();
  }

  get message() { return this.getAttribute('message') || ''; }
  set message(v) {
    this.setAttribute('message', v || '');
    this._visible = true;
    this._armTimer();
    this.render();
  }

  show() {
    this._visible = true;
    this._armTimer();
    this.render();
  }

  _armTimer() {
    this._clearTimer();
    const duration = Number(this.getAttribute('duration'));
    if (duration > 0) {
      this._timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._visible = false;
        this.render();
      }, duration);
    }
  }

  _clearTimer() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearTimeout(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const position = this.getAttribute('position') || 'top-right';
    const hostClass = `fixed right-4 z-50 ${position === 'bottom-right' ? 'bottom-4' : 'top-4'} ${this._visible ? '' : 'hidden'}`;
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    if (!this._visible) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const icon = this._icon || CHECK_SVG;
    this.innerHTML = `<div data-success-toast role="status" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm">
  <span class="shrink-0 text-emerald-700">${icon}</span>
  <span class="text-sm text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(this.message)}</span>
  <button type="button" data-toast-close title="Dismiss" class="ml-1 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-emerald-800/70 hover:bg-emerald-200 hover:text-emerald-900 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * SystemPromptEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <system-prompt-editor title="System prompt" version="v3" saved-value="..." temperature="0.7"></system-prompt-editor>
 * Attributes: title, value, placeholder, version, saved-value, variables (JSON array), temperature
 * Events: save (detail {text}), reset, temperature-change (detail {value})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class SystemPromptEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'value', 'placeholder', 'version', 'saved-value', 'variables', 'temperature'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._variables = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-editor-save]')) {
          const ta = this.querySelector('[data-editor-textarea]');
          const text = ta ? ta.value : '';
          this.setAttribute('saved-value', text);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', { detail: { text } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-editor-reset]')) {
          const saved = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
          if (saved !== null) this.setAttribute('value', saved);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reset'));
          return;
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        if (!event.target.matches('[data-editor-textarea]')) return;
        // live dirty-state update — typing into the textarea doesn't re-render
        const saved = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
        const dirty = saved !== null ? event.target.value !== saved : true;
        const btn = this.querySelector('[data-editor-save]');
        if (btn) {
          if (dirty) btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
          else btn.setAttribute('disabled', '');
        }
        const state = this.querySelector('[data-editor-state]');
        if (state) {
          state.textContent = dirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Saved';
          state.classList.toggle('text-amber-600', dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('dark:text-amber-400', dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('text-emerald-600', !dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('dark:text-emerald-400', !dirty);
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        if (event.target.matches('[data-editor-temperature]')) {
          const value = Number(event.target.value);
          this.setAttribute('temperature', String(value));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('temperature-change', { detail: { value } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get variables() { return this._variables; }
  set variables(v) {
    this._variables = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'variables' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._variables = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children (e.g. the textarea) mid-edit.
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'System prompt');
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const placeholder = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'You are a helpful assistant that…');
    const version = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('version') || 'v3');
    const savedValue = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
    const temperature = this.getAttribute('temperature');
    const tokens = Math.max(1, Math.round(value.length * 0.25));
    const dirty = savedValue !== null ? value !== savedValue : false;

    const varChips = this._variables.map((v) =>
      `<code class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{{${escapeAttribute(v)}}}</code>`
    ).join('');

    const tempBlock = temperature !== null && temperature !== undefined && temperature !== '' ? `
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <label class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" for="prompt-editor-temp">Temperature</label>
        <input id="prompt-editor-temp" data-editor-temperature type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="${escapeAttribute(temperature)}" class="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-200 accent-indigo-600 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span data-editor-temp-value class="w-8 text-right font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${Number(temperature).toFixed(1)}</span>
      </div>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-prompt-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}<span data-editor-version class="ml-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${version}</span></p>
    <span data-editor-state class="text-[11px] font-semibold ${dirty ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'}">${dirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Saved'}</span>
  </div>
  <textarea data-editor-textarea rows="6" placeholder="${placeholder}" class="mt-3 w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(value)}</textarea>
  <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
    <span data-editor-tokens>~${tokens} tokens · ${value.length} chars</span>
    ${this._variables.length > 0 ? `<span data-editor-variables class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">${varChips}</span>` : ''}
  </div>
  ${tempBlock}
  <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
    <button type="button" data-editor-reset class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" data-editor-save ${dirty ? '' : 'disabled'} class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Save prompt</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('system-prompt-editor')) {
  customElements.define('system-prompt-editor', SystemPromptEditorElement);
}

export default SystemPromptEditorElement;

====/File: vanilla/Tabs.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Tabs - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tabs-bar active-id="overview" variant="underline"></tabs-bar>
 * Properties: tabs (TabItem[])
 * Events: change (detail: { id })
 */
export class TabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-id', 'variant', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._internalId = null;
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._internalId === null) this._internalId = this._tabs[0] ? this._tabs[0].id : '';
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    return this.getAttribute('active-id') ?? this._internalId ?? '';
  }

  _select(tab) {
    if (!tab || tab.disabled) return;
    if (!this.hasAttribute('active-id')) this._internalId = tab.id;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { id: tab.id } }));
  }

  _move(event, index) {
    const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const enabled = this._tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
    if (enabled.length === 0) return;
    const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
    let next = position;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
    if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
    const target = enabled[next];
    if (target) {
      this._select(target.tab);
      const node = this.querySelector(`[data-tab-id="${target.tab.id}"]`);
      if (node) node.focus();
    }
  }

  render() {
    const pills = this.getAttribute('variant') === 'pills';
    this._applyHostClass(pills ? 'inline-flex' : 'flex');

    const current = this._current();
    const label = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Tabs';

    const buttons = this._tabs
      .map((tab, index) => {
        const active = tab.id === current;
        const tone = pills
          ? active
            ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          : active
            ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        const shape = pills ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2';
        return `<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" data-tab-id="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"
          aria-selected="${active}" aria-controls="panel-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" tabindex="${active ? 0 : -1}"
          ${tab.disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${shape} ${tone}">
          ${tab.icon ? uiIcon(tab.icon, { size: 13 }) : ''}
          <span>${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}</span>
          ${tab.badge !== undefined ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tab.badge)}</span>` : ''}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="tablist" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="${
      pills
        ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800'
        : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
    }">${buttons}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-id]').forEach((node, index) => {
      const tab = this._tabs.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-tab-id'));
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._select(tab));
      node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => this._move(event, index));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tabs-bar')) {
  customElements.define('tabs-bar', TabsElement);
}
export default TabsElement;

====/File: vanilla/Tag.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  neutral: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  amber: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
  rose: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  sky: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300',
};

/**
 * Tag - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <ui-tag label="v1.18" tone="indigo" removable></ui-tag>
 * Properties: label (string)
 * Attributes: label, tone, size (sm|md), icon, removable, clickable
 * Events: remove, tag-click
 */
export class TagElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'tone', 'size', 'icon', 'removable', 'clickable'];
  }

  get tone() {
    const value = this.getAttribute('tone');
    return TONE[value] ? value : 'neutral';
  }

  get size() {
    return this.getAttribute('size') === 'sm' ? 'sm' : 'md';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const size = this.size;
    const removable = this.hasAttribute('removable');
    const clickable = this.hasAttribute('clickable');
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon');
    const sizing = size === 'sm' ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px]' : 'px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px]';
    const base = `inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full font-medium ${TONE[this.tone]} ${sizing}`;
    const inner = `<span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>`;

    if (clickable) {
      this.innerHTML = `<button type="button" data-tag-root class="${base} cursor-pointer transition-opacity hover:opacity-80 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
        ${icon ? uiIcon(icon, { size: size === 'sm' ? 10 : 11, className: 'shrink-0 opacity-70' }) : ''}
        ${inner}
        ${removable ? `<span data-tag-remove role="button" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 dark:hover:bg-white/10">${uiIcon('x', { size: size === 'sm' ? 9 : 10 })}</span>` : ''}
      </button>`;
    } else {
      this.innerHTML = `<span class="${base}">
        ${icon ? uiIcon(icon, { size: size === 'sm' ? 10 : 11, className: 'shrink-0 opacity-70' }) : ''}
        ${inner}
        ${removable ? `<button type="button" data-tag-remove aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-current dark:hover:bg-white/10">${uiIcon('x', { size: size === 'sm' ? 9 : 10 })}</button>` : ''}
      </span>`;
    }

    const remove = this.querySelector('[data-tag-remove]');
    if (remove) {
      remove.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove'));
      });
    }
    if (clickable) {
      this.querySelector('[data-tag-root]').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tag-click'));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ui-tag')) {
  customElements.define('ui-tag', TagElement);
}
export default TagElement;

/**
 * TargetGauge - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <target-gauge value="600" target="700" label="Quarterly revenue" value-prefix="$" value-suffix="k" remaining-label="…">
 * Attributes: value, target, label, value-prefix, value-suffix, remaining-label
 * Zones default to rose (0-60) / amber (60-85) / emerald (85-100); set the `zones` property to override.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const ZONE_COLOR = {
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

const clamp01 = (value) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));

export class TargetGaugeElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'target', 'label', 'value-prefix', 'value-suffix', 'remaining-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._zones = [
      { from: 0, tone: 'rose' },
      { from: 60, tone: 'amber' },
      { from: 85, tone: 'emerald' },
    ];
  }

  get zones() {
    return this._zones;
  }

  set zones(value) {
    this._zones = Array.isArray(value) && value.length ? value : this._zones;
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    return Number(this.getAttribute('value')) || 0;
  }

  set value(raw) {
    this.setAttribute('value', String(raw));
  }

  get target() {
    return Number(this.getAttribute('target')) || 0;
  }

  set target(raw) {
    this.setAttribute('target', String(raw));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const value = this.value;
    const target = this.target;
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || 'Progress';
    const valuePrefix = this.getAttribute('value-prefix') || '';
    const valueSuffix = this.getAttribute('value-suffix') || '';
    const remainingLabel = this.getAttribute('remaining-label') || '';
    const percent = target > 0 ? (value / target) * 100 : 0;
    const angle = (clamp01(percent) / 100) * 180 - 90;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, target - value);
    const sorted = [...this._zones].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
    const segments = sorted.map((zone, index) => {
      const end = index + 1 < sorted.length ? sorted[index + 1].from : 100;
      return { ...zone, width: Math.max(0, end - zone.from) };
    });
    const currentTone = [...segments].reverse().find((zone) => clamp01(percent) >= zone.from)?.tone || 'rose';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-target-gauge role="img" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}: ${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix + value + valueSuffix)} of ${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix + target + valueSuffix)}" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</p>
      <div class="relative mx-auto mt-3 h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden rounded-t-full">
          ${segments.map((zone) => `<span class="h-full ${ZONE_COLOR[zone.tone]}" style="width:${zone.width}%"></span>`).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="absolute left-1/2 top-[18px] h-[52px] w-[104px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-t-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900"></div>
        <div data-gauge-needle class="absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 h-[54px] w-0.5 origin-bottom bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" style="transform:rotate(${angle}deg)">
          <span class="absolute -top-[3px] left-1/2 h-2 w-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="absolute bottom-[-4px] left-1/2 h-3 w-3 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
        <span>${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix)}0${escapeAttribute(valueSuffix)}</span>
        <span data-gauge-value class="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white ${ZONE_COLOR[currentTone]}">${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix + value + valueSuffix)}</span>
        <span>${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix + target + valueSuffix)}</span>
      </div>
      ${
        remainingLabel
          ? `<p class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${remaining > 0 ? `Remaining: ${escapeAttribute(valuePrefix + remaining + valueSuffix)} — ` : ''}${escapeAttribute(remainingLabel)}</p>`
          : ''
      }
      <span class="hidden" data-gauge-percent>${Math.round(percent)}%</span>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('target-gauge')) {
  customElements.define('target-gauge', TargetGaugeElement);
}
export default TargetGaugeElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const ratingOf = (testimonial) => Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(testimonial.rating ?? 0)));

/**
 * TestimonialGrid - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <testimonial-grid columns="3"></testimonial-grid>
 * Properties: testimonials (Testimonial[])
 * Events: select (detail: testimonial)
 */
export class TestimonialGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._testimonials = [];
  }

  get testimonials() {
    return this._testimonials;
  }

  set testimonials(value) {
    this._testimonials = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (this._testimonials.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-200 p-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">No testimonials yet.</div>`;
      return;
    }

    const columns = this.getAttribute('columns') === '2' ? 2 : 3;
    const gridClass = columns === 2 ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : 'sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3';

    const cards = this._testimonials
      .map((testimonial) => {
        const rating = ratingOf(testimonial);
        const stars =
          rating > 0
            ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label="${rating} out of 5 stars">${Array.from(
                { length: 5 },
                (_, index) =>
                  uiIcon('star', {
                    size: 13,
                    className: index < rating ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700',
                  })
              ).join('')}</div>`
            : '';
        const avatar = testimonial.avatar
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(testimonial.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover" />`
          : `<span class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(initials(testimonial.name))}</span>`;
        const meta = [testimonial.role, testimonial.company].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        return `<figure class="testimonial-card flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          data-testimonial="${escapeAttribute(testimonial.id)}">
          ${stars}
          <blockquote class="mt-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“${escapeAttribute(testimonial.quote)}”</blockquote>
          <figcaption class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            ${avatar}
            <span class="min-w-0">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(testimonial.name)}</span>
              ${meta ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</span>` : ''}
            </span>
          </figcaption>
        </figure>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="grid gap-4 ${gridClass}">${cards}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-card').forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = card.getAttribute('data-testimonial');
        const testimonial = this._testimonials.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (testimonial) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: testimonial }));
      });
    });
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/ThemeToggle.js/====

/**
 * ThemeToggle - Vanilla Web Component (Auto / Light / Dark)
 * Usage: <theme-toggle storage-key="mango-theme"></theme-toggle>
 */
class ThemeToggle extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["storage-key"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.storageKey = this.getAttribute("storage-key") || "mango-theme";
    this.mode = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey) || "auto";
    this.render();
    this.applyTheme(this.mode);
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  resolveTheme(m) {
    if (m === "light" || m === "dark") return m;
    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const isNight = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches || hour >= 19 || hour < 7;
    return isNight ? "dark" : "light";
  }

  applyTheme(nextMode) {
    this.mode = nextMode;
    const resolved = this.resolveTheme(nextMode);
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
    document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
    if (resolved === "dark") {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
    }
    localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, nextMode);
    this.updateActiveButtons();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("change", { detail: { mode: nextMode, resolved } }));
  }

  updateActiveButtons() {
    this.querySelectorAll("[data-mode]").forEach((btn) => {
      const isCurrent = btn.dataset.mode === this.mode;
      btn.className = `flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
        isCurrent
          ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold"
          : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
      }`;
    });
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none" role="group" aria-label="Theme toggle">
        <button type="button" data-mode="auto" title="Follow System/Time">
          <span>💻</span>
          <span>Auto</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-mode="light" title="Light Mode">
          <span>☀️</span>
          <span>Light</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-mode="dark" title="Dark Mode">
          <span>🌙</span>
          <span>Dark</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    this.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest("[data-mode]");
      if (btn) {
        this.applyTheme(btn.dataset.mode);
      }
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("theme-toggle")) {
  customElements.define("theme-toggle", ThemeToggle);
}
export default ThemeToggle;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatDuration = (ms) => {
  if (typeof ms !== 'number') return '';
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};

/**
 * ThinkingBlock - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <thinking-block is-thinking duration="3.2"></thinking-block>
 * Optional: steps property [{ id, label, durationMs? }] renders a vertical
 * step timeline with connectors; collapsed state shows a one-line summary.
 */
class ThinkingBlock extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "is-thinking", "duration"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._expanded === undefined) this._expanded = this.hasAttribute("is-thinking");
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get steps() {
    if (this._steps) return this._steps;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('steps') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isThinking = this.hasAttribute("is-thinking");
    const duration = this.getAttribute("duration");
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || this.textContent || "";
    const steps = this.steps;
    const expanded = !!this._expanded;

    const runningStep = steps.find((step) => step.durationMs === undefined);
    const lastStep = steps[steps.length - 1];

    let summaryHtml = '';
    if (!expanded && steps.length) {
      summaryHtml = runningStep
        ? `<div class="px-3.5 pb-2.5 -mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
             <span class="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse"></span>
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(runningStep.label)}</span>
           </div>`
        : `<div class="px-3.5 pb-2.5 -mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
             <span class="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(lastStep.label)}</span>
             ${lastStep.durationMs !== undefined ? `<span class="tabular-nums">${formatDuration(lastStep.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
           </div>`;
    }

    const stepsHtml = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
        const done = step.durationMs !== undefined;
        return `
          <li class="relative pl-5">
            ${isLast ? '' : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[5px] top-4 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'}
            <span class="absolute left-0 top-1.5">
              ${
                done
                  ? '<span class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>'
                  : '<span class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 animate-pulse"></span>'
              }
            </span>
            <div class="pb-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="truncate ${done ? 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
              ${done ? `<span class="ml-auto shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${formatDuration(step.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 text-xs overflow-hidden transition-all">
        <button type="button" id="toggle-btn" aria-expanded="${expanded}" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 hover:bg-zinc-100/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium transition-colors select-none text-left">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="${isThinking ? 'animate-spin text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-400'} inline-flex">${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}</span>
            <span>${isThinking ? "Deeply thinking..." : duration ? `Thought for ${duration}s` : "Thought process"}</span>
          </div>
          <span id="chevron" class="inline-flex text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}</span>
        </button>
        ${summaryHtml}
        <div id="content-body" class="${expanded ? '' : 'hidden'} border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 bg-white/40 dark:bg-zinc-950/20">
          ${
            steps.length
              ? `<ol class="px-4 pt-3 pb-1">${stepsHtml}</ol><div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]">${escapeAttribute(content) || '<span class="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>'}</div>`
              : `<div class="px-4 py-3 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]">${escapeAttribute(content) || '<span class="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>'}</div>`
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector("#toggle-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this._expanded = !this._expanded;
      this.querySelector("#content-body").classList.toggle("hidden", !this._expanded);
      this.querySelector("#chevron").classList.toggle("rotate-180", this._expanded);
    });
  }
}

/**
 * TimeSlotPicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <time-slot-picker days='[...]' timezone="GMT+8"></time-slot-picker>
 * Attributes: days (JSON), value (JSON), timezone, days-label, slots-label
 * Properties: days, value
 * Events: select (detail {dayId, slotId, slot})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PERIOD_LABELS = { morning: 'Morning', afternoon: 'Afternoon', evening: 'Evening' };

export class TimeSlotPickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['days', 'value', 'timezone', 'days-label', 'slots-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._days = [];
    this._value = null;
    this._activeDayId = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._days.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('days');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._days = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._days = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._value) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('value');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._value = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._value = null; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._activeDayId) {
      this._activeDayId = (this._value && this._value.dayId) || (this._days.find((day) => !day.disabled) || this._days[0] || {}).id || '';
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const dayEl = event.target.closest('[data-slot-day]');
        if (dayEl && !dayEl.disabled) {
          this._activeDayId = dayEl.getAttribute('data-slot-day');
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        const slotEl = event.target.closest('[data-time-slot]');
        if (slotEl && !slotEl.disabled) {
          const slotId = slotEl.getAttribute('data-time-slot');
          const day = this._days.find((item) => item.id === this._activeDayId);
          const slot = day && day.slots.find((item) => item.id === slotId);
          if (!slot || slot.disabled) return;
          this._value = { dayId: this._activeDayId, slotId };
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { dayId: this._activeDayId, slotId, slot } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get days() {
    return this._days;
  }

  set days(value) {
    this._days = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._activeDayId = (this._days.find((day) => !day.disabled) || this._days[0] || {}).id || '';
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value;
  }

  set value(value) {
    this._value = value || null;
    if (this._value) this._activeDayId = this._value.dayId;
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const daysLabel = this.getAttribute('days-label') || 'Date';
    const slotsLabel = this.getAttribute('slots-label') || 'Select a time';
    const timezone = this.getAttribute('timezone') || '';
    const activeDay = this._days.find((day) => day.id === this._activeDayId) || this._days[0];
    const daysHtml = this._days
      .map((day) => {
        const active = day.id === this._activeDayId;
        const cls = active
          ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900'
          : 'bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700';
        return `<button type="button" data-slot-day="${escapeAttribute(day.id)}"${day.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''} class="min-w-[64px] rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${cls}">
          <span class="block text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70">${escapeAttribute(day.weekday)}</span>
          <span class="block text-sm font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(day.label)}</span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const periodsHtml = activeDay
      ? ['morning', 'afternoon', 'evening']
          .map((period) => {
            const slots = activeDay.slots.filter((slot) => (slot.period || 'morning') === period);
            if (!slots.length) return '';
            const slotButtons = slots
              .map((slot) => {
                const isSelected = this._value && this._value.dayId === this._activeDayId && this._value.slotId === slot.id;
                const cls = isSelected
                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/60'
                  : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
                const labelCls = isSelected ? 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100';
                const availability = slot.available != null
                  ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] ${slot.available > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}">${slot.available > 0 ? `${slot.available} available` : 'Fully booked'}</span>`
                  : '';
                return `<button type="button" data-time-slot="${escapeAttribute(slot.id)}"${slot.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''} class="rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${cls}">
                  <span class="block text-xs font-semibold ${labelCls}">${escapeAttribute(slot.label)}</span>
                  ${availability}
                </button>`;
              })
              .join('');
            return `<div>
              <p class="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${PERIOD_LABELS[period]}</p>
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-3">${slotButtons}</div>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-time-slot-picker class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(daysLabel)}</p>
        <div class="mt-2 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-3">${daysHtml}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="p-4">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <p data-slot-heading class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(slotsLabel)}${activeDay ? `<span class="ml-1 font-normal text-zinc-400">· ${escapeAttribute(activeDay.weekday)} ${escapeAttribute(activeDay.label)}</span>` : ''}</p>
          ${timezone ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(timezone)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${activeDay ? `<div data-slot-periods class="mt-3 space-y-4">${periodsHtml}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('time-slot-picker')) {
  customElements.define('time-slot-picker', TimeSlotPickerElement);
}

export default TimeSlotPickerElement;

/**
 * TimeframePicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <timeframe-picker value="7d" range-label="Nov 8 – Nov 14"></timeframe-picker>
 * Attributes: presets (comma-separated), value, range-label, disabled
 * Events: change (detail: { value }), step (detail: { direction, value })
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TimeframePickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['presets', 'value', 'range-label', 'disabled'];
  }

  get presets() {
    return (this.getAttribute('presets') || 'Today,7d,30d,90d,12mo')
      .split(',')
      .map((preset) => preset.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  get value() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('value');
    if (raw) return raw;
    return this.presets[0] || '';
  }

  set value(preset) {
    this.setAttribute('value', preset);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const presets = this.presets;
    const current = this.value;
    const rangeLabel = this.getAttribute('range-label') || '';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-timeframe-picker role="group" aria-label="Timeframe" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <div class="flex items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        ${presets
          .map((preset) => {
            const active = preset === current;
            return `<button type="button" data-preset="${escapeAttribute(preset)}" aria-pressed="${active ? 'true' : 'false'}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
              class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'
              } ${disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(preset)}</button>`;
          })
          .join('')}
      </div>
      <div class="flex items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <button type="button" data-step="-1" aria-label="Previous period" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
          class="px-2 py-1.5 text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">${uiIcon('chevron-left', { size: 13 })}</button>
        ${
          rangeLabel
            ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-x border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${uiIcon('calendar', { size: 12, className: 'text-zinc-400' })}${escapeAttribute(rangeLabel)}</span>`
            : ''
        }
        <button type="button" data-step="1" aria-label="Next period" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
          class="px-2 py-1.5 text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 13 })}</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-preset]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const preset = button.getAttribute('data-preset');
        this.value = preset;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: preset } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const direction = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step')) === -1 ? -1 : 1;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step', { detail: { direction, value: this.value } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

  customElements.define('timeframe-picker', TimeframePickerElement);
}

    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',

const TYPE_META = {
  success: { icon: 'check-circle', color: 'text-emerald-500', bar: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  error: { icon: 'circle-x', color: 'text-rose-500', bar: 'bg-rose-500' },
  warning: { icon: 'alert-triangle', color: 'text-amber-500', bar: 'bg-amber-500' },
  info: { icon: 'sparkles', color: 'text-sky-500', bar: 'bg-sky-500' },
};

/**
 * ToastStack - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <toast-stack duration="4000"></toast-stack>
 * JS API: el.push(message, type); el.dismiss(id); el.toasts = [...]
 * Events: dismiss (detail: { id })
 * Each toast carries a bottom countdown bar (h-0.5) that shrinks to 0 over
 * `duration` ms and pauses while hovered. duration="0" = sticky toasts.
 */
export class ToastStackElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['duration'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._toasts = [];
    this._clocks = new Map(); // id -> { started, startPct, total, timer, ticker }
    this._seq = 0;
    this._appliedLayout = '';
  }

  get toasts() {
    return this._toasts;
  }

  set toasts(val) {
    this._toasts = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
  }

  get duration() {
    const parsed = parseInt(this.getAttribute('duration') || '4000', 10);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 4000 : parsed;
  }

  push(message, type = 'info') {
    const id = ++this._seq;
    this._toasts = [...this._toasts, { id, message, type }];
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
    return id;
  }

  dismiss(id) {
    this._stopClock(id);
    this._toasts = this._toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss', { detail: { id } }));
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) this._stopClock(id);
  }

  _stopClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (clock) {
      if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
      if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
      this._clocks.delete(id);
    }
  }

  _startClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (!clock || clock.total <= 0 || this.duration <= 0) return;
    const started = Date.now();
    clock.started = started;
    clock.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      clock.pct = 0;
      this._updateBar(id, 0);
      this._stopClock(id);
      this.dismiss(id);
    }, clock.total);
    clock.ticker = setInterval(() => {
      const pct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - (Date.now() - started) / clock.total));
      clock.pct = pct;
      this._updateBar(id, pct);
    }, 100);
  }

  _updateBar(id, pct) {
    const bar = this.querySelector(`[data-bar-id="${id}"]`);
    if (bar) bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
  }

  _pauseClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (!clock) return;
    if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
    if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
    const elapsed = Date.now() - clock.started;
    clock.startPct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total));
    clock.total = Math.max(0, clock.total - elapsed);
  }

  _syncClocks() {
    if (this.duration <= 0) {
      for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) this._stopClock(id);
      return;
    }
    const alive = new Set(this._toasts.map((t) => t.id));
    for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) this._stopClock(id);
    }
    for (const t of this._toasts) {
      if (!this._clocks.has(t.id)) {
        this._clocks.set(t.id, { started: Date.now(), startPct: 100, total: this.duration, pct: 100 });
        this._startClock(t.id);
      }
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this._toasts.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const layoutClass = 'fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]';
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
    this.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

    this.innerHTML = this._toasts
      .map((t) => {
        const meta = TYPE_META[t.type] || TYPE_META.info;
        const clock = this._clocks.get(t.id);
        const pct = clock ? (clock.pct ?? 100) : 100;
        return `
          <div class="toast-card relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200" role="alert" data-toast-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}">
            ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 16, className: `${meta.color} shrink-0` })}
            <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">${escapeAttribute(t.message)}</span>
            <button type="button" data-dismiss-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="toast-dismiss text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0" aria-label="Dismiss">
              ${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}
            </button>
            ${this.duration > 0 ? `<span data-bar-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" aria-hidden="true" class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 ${meta.bar} transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear" style="width:${pct}%"></span>` : ''}
          </div>
        `;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.toast-card').forEach((card) => {
      const id = card.getAttribute('data-toast-id');
      const toast = this._toasts.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
      if (!toast) return;
      card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this._pauseClock(toast.id));
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this._startClock(toast.id));
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.toast-dismiss').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-dismiss-id');
        const toast = this._toasts.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
        if (toast) this.dismiss(toast.id);
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('toast-stack')) {
  customElements.define('toast-stack', ToastStackElement);
}
export default ToastStackElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * ToggleSwitch - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <toggle-switch label="Email alerts" description="…" checked></toggle-switch>
 * Properties: checked
 * Attributes: label, description, checked, disabled, size (sm|md)
 * Events: change (detail: { checked })
 */
export class ToggleSwitchElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'description', 'checked', 'disabled', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._checked = null;
  }

  get checked() {
    if (this._checked !== null) return this._checked;
    return this.hasAttribute('checked');
  }

  set checked(value) {
    this._checked = Boolean(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get size() {
    return this.getAttribute('size') === 'sm' ? 'sm' : 'md';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _control() {
    const checked = this.checked;
    const track = this.size === 'sm' ? 'h-4 w-8' : 'h-5 w-9';
    const knob = this.size === 'sm' ? 'h-3 w-3' : 'h-4 w-4';
    const shift = checked ? 'translate-x-4' : 'translate-x-0.5';
    return `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="${checked}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('label') || '')}"
      ${this.hasAttribute('disabled') ? 'disabled' : ''}
      data-toggle-control
      class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors duration-200 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-white dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
        checked ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700'
      } ${track}">
      <span class="inline-block transform rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform duration-200 ${shift} ${knob}"></span>
    </button>`;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label');
    const description = this.getAttribute('description');
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');

    if (!label && !description) {
      this._applyHostClass('inline-flex');
      this.innerHTML = this._control();
    } else {
      this._applyHostClass('flex items-start gap-2.5');
      this.innerHTML = `${this._control()}
        <span class="min-w-0">
          ${label ? `<span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>` : ''}
          ${description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</span>` : ''}
        </span>`;
    }

    const control = this.querySelector('[data-toggle-control]');
    if (control) {
      control.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        this.checked = !this.checked;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { checked: this.checked } }));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('toggle-switch')) {
  customElements.define('toggle-switch', ToggleSwitchElement);
}
export default ToggleSwitchElement;

/**
 * TokenCostBreakdown - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <token-cost-breakdown title="Spend breakdown" segments='[...]' usage-rows='[...]'></token-cost-breakdown>
 * Attributes: title, segments (JSON: [{id,label,amountUsd,color?}]),
 *             usage-rows (JSON: [{id,label,tokens,percent,barColor?}]),
 *             spend-used (number), spend-total (number)
 * Events: segment-select (detail {segment})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const defaultColors = ['bg-zinc-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-violet-500', 'bg-rose-500'];

const segColor = (segment, index) =>
  segment.color ?? defaultColors[index % defaultColors.length];

const fmtUsd = (usd) =>
  usd >= 100 ? `$${usd.toFixed(0)}` : usd >= 1 ? `$${usd.toFixed(2)}` : `$${usd.toFixed(3)}`;

const fmtTokens = (tokens) => Number(tokens).toLocaleString('en-US');

export class TokenCostBreakdownElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'segments', 'usage-rows', 'spend-used', 'spend-total'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._segments = [];
    this._usageRows = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._segments.length) this._segments = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('segments'), []);
    if (!this._usageRows.length) this._usageRows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('usage-rows'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const segEl = event.target.closest('[data-token-cost-segment]');
        if (!segEl) return;
        const segment = this._segments.find((s) => s.id === segEl.getAttribute('data-token-cost-segment'));
        if (segment) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('segment-select', { detail: { segment } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'segments' && !this._segments.length) {
      this._segments = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('segments'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'usage-rows' && !this._usageRows.length) {
      this._usageRows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('usage-rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get segments() { return this._segments; }
  set segments(v) {
    this._segments = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((s) => ({ ...s })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get usageRows() { return this._usageRows; }
  set usageRows(v) {
    this._usageRows = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const segments = this._segments;
    const usageRows = this._usageRows;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Spend breakdown');
    const spendTotal = Number(this.getAttribute('spend-total'));
    const spendUsedAttr = Number(this.getAttribute('spend-used'));

    const totalUsd = segments.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.amountUsd, 0);
    const used = Number.isFinite(spendUsedAttr) && this.getAttribute('spend-used') !== null ? spendUsedAttr : totalUsd;
    const percent = Number.isFinite(spendTotal) && spendTotal > 0 ? Math.min((used / spendTotal) * 100, 100) : 100;
    const headerValue = Number.isFinite(spendTotal) && this.getAttribute('spend-total') !== null
      ? `${fmtUsd(used)} of ${fmtUsd(spendTotal)}`
      : fmtUsd(totalUsd);

    const segmentsMarkup = segments.map((segment, index) => `
      <span data-token-cost-segment="${escapeAttribute(segment.id)}" class="h-full cursor-pointer ${segColor(segment, index)}" style="width: ${totalUsd > 0 ? (segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * percent : 0}%;"></span>`).join('');

    const legend = segments.map((segment, index) => `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
        <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-sm ${segColor(segment, index)}"></span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(segment.label)}</span>
        <span class="font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${fmtUsd(segment.amountUsd)}</span>
        <span class="w-12 text-right tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${totalUsd > 0 ? Math.round((segment.amountUsd / totalUsd) * 100) : 0}%</span>
      </div>`).join('');

    const usage = usageRows.map((row) => `
      <div data-token-usage-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span class="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(row.label)}</span>
          <span class="tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${fmtTokens(row.tokens)} (${row.percent}%)</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-1 h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div data-token-usage-bar class="h-full rounded-full ${row.barColor ?? 'bg-sky-500'}" style="width: ${Math.min(Math.max(row.percent, 0), 100)}%;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-token-cost class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${headerValue}</span>
  </div>
  <div data-token-cost-bar class="mt-3 flex h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">${segmentsMarkup}</div>
  <div data-token-cost-legend class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${legend}</div>
  ${usageRows.length > 0 ? `<div data-token-usage class="mt-4 space-y-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Token usage</p>
    ${usage}
  </div>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('token-cost-breakdown')) {
  customElements.define('token-cost-breakdown', TokenCostBreakdownElement);
}

export default TokenCostBreakdownElement;

            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'

          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
            <span class="font-mono truncate">${escapeAttribute(toolName)}</span>
            ${
              isHigh
                ? '<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0">high risk</span>'
                : ''
            }
          </div>
          ${description ? `<div class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate">${escapeAttribute(description)}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${
        argsText
          ? `<pre class="mx-3.5 mb-2.5 max-h-40 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">${escapeAttribute(argsText)}</pre>`
          : ''
      }
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 pb-3">${actionsHtml}</div>`;

    const approveBtn = this.querySelector('.approval-approve');
    const rejectBtn = this.querySelector('.approval-reject');
    if (approveBtn) approveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._resolve('approved', 'approve'));
    if (rejectBtn) rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._resolve('rejected', 'reject'));
  }
}

/**
 * ToolCallBadge - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tool-call-badge name="web_search" status="running"></tool-call-badge>
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

class ToolCallBadge extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["name", "status", "args", "output", "error"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const name = this.getAttribute("name") || "tool";
    const status = this.getAttribute("status") || "running";
    const args = this.getAttribute("args");
    const output = this.getAttribute("output");
    const error = this.getAttribute("error");

    let statusHtml = `<span class="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 14, className: 'animate-spin' })} Running...</span>`;
    if (status === "success") {
      statusHtml = `<span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 14 })} Success</span>`;
    } else if (status === "error") {
      statusHtml = `<span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('circle-x', { size: 14 })} Failed</span>`;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/80 shadow-sm overflow-hidden text-xs transition-all">
        <button type="button" id="toggle-btn" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left select-none">

          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            ${statusHtml}
            ${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14, className: `tool-call-chevron text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${this.isOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}` })}

          ${args ? `<div><div class="text-zinc-400 font-semibold mb-1">Arguments:</div><pre class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 overflow-x-auto m-0">${args}</pre></div>` : ''}

          ${error ? `<div><div class="text-rose-500 font-semibold mb-1">Error:</div><pre class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 overflow-x-auto m-0">${error}</pre></div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

      this.isOpen = !this.isOpen;
      this.querySelector("#drawer").classList.toggle("hidden", !this.isOpen);
      this.querySelector(".tool-call-chevron")?.classList.toggle("rotate-90", this.isOpen);
    });
