/**
 * ToolSchemaEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tool-schema-editor title="Tools & functions"></tool-schema-editor>
 * Property: tools ([{id, name, description?, method?, endpoint?, parameters?: [{name, type, required?}]}])
 * Attributes: title
 * Events: validate (detail {tool}), toggle (detail {tool, enabled})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ToolSchemaEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tools = [];
    this._disabled = {};
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const validateBtn = event.target.closest('[data-tool-validate]');
        if (validateBtn) {
          const card = validateBtn.closest('[data-tool-card]');
          const tool = this._tools.find((t) => t.id === card?.getAttribute('data-tool-card'));
          if (tool) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('validate', { detail: { tool } }));
          return;
        }
        const toggleBtn = event.target.closest('[data-tool-toggle]');
        if (toggleBtn) {
          const card = toggleBtn.closest('[data-tool-card]');
          const id = card?.getAttribute('data-tool-card');
          const tool = this._tools.find((t) => t.id === id);
          if (tool) {
            const enabled = !!this._disabled[id];
            this._disabled[id] = !enabled;
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { tool, enabled } }));
            this.render();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get tools() { return this._tools; }
  set tools(v) {
    this._tools = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((t) => ({ ...t })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before tools are captured.
    if (this._tools.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Tools & functions');
    const enabledCount = this._tools.filter((t) => !this._disabled[t.id]).length;

    const TYPE_BADGE = {
      string: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300',
      number: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300',
      boolean: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
    };

    const cards = this._tools.map((tool) => {
      const off = !!this._disabled[tool.id];
      const params = (tool.parameters || []).map((param) =>
        `<span data-tool-param="${escapeAttribute(param.name)}" class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold ${TYPE_BADGE[param.type] || TYPE_BADGE.string}">${escapeAttribute(param.name)}<span class="font-normal opacity-70">${escapeAttribute(param.type)}</span>${param.required ? '<span class="font-bold text-red-500" title="required">*</span>' : ''}</span>`
      ).join('');
      return `
        <div data-tool-card="${escapeAttribute(tool.id)}" class="rounded-lg border px-3 py-3 transition-colors ${off ? 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 opacity-60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'}">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <p class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <code data-tool-name class="truncate font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(tool.name)}</code>
                ${tool.method ? `<span data-tool-method class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tool.method === 'GET' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300'}">${escapeAttribute(tool.method)}</span>` : ''}
              </p>
              ${tool.endpoint ? `<code data-tool-endpoint class="mt-0.5 block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(tool.endpoint)}</code>` : ''}
              ${tool.description ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tool.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-tool-toggle aria-pressed="${!off}" title="${off ? 'Enable tool' : 'Disable tool'}" class="relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors ${off ? 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-indigo-600'}">
              <span class="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${off ? 'left-0.5' : 'left-4'}"></span>
            </button>
          </div>
          ${params ? `<div data-tool-params class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">${params}</div>` : ''}
          <div class="mt-2 flex justify-end">
            <button type="button" data-tool-validate class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Validate schema</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-tool-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
    <span data-tool-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${enabledCount}/${this._tools.length} enabled</span>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">${cards}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tool-schema-editor')) {
  customElements.define('tool-schema-editor', ToolSchemaEditorElement);
}

export default ToolSchemaEditorElement;

====/File: vanilla/Tooltip.js/====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SIDE_CLASS = {
  top: 'bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  bottom: 'top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  left: 'right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
  right: 'left-full top-1/2 ml-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
};

let tooltipSeq = 0;

/**
 * Tooltip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tooltip-hint content="Save changes"><button>…</button></tooltip-hint>
 * Attributes: content, side (top|bottom|left|right)
 */
export class TooltipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['content', 'side'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._content = null;
    this._side = null;
    this._tooltipId = `tooltip-${++tooltipSeq}`;
  }

  get content() {
    return this._content ?? this.getAttribute('content') ?? '';
  }

  set content(value) {
    this._content = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get side() {
    const value = this._side ?? this.getAttribute('side') ?? 'top';
    return SIDE_CLASS[value] ? value : 'top';
  }

  set side(value) {
    this._side = value;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const existing = this.querySelector(`#${this._tooltipId}`);
    const slots = Array.from(this.childNodes).filter((node) => node !== existing);

    this._applyHostClass('group relative inline-flex');
    this.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this._tooltipId);

    this.innerHTML = `<span id="${this._tooltipId}" role="tooltip"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute z-30 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 ${SIDE_CLASS[this.side]}">${escapeAttribute(this.content)}</span>`;

    const tooltip = this.firstChild;
    slots.forEach((node) => this.insertBefore(node, tooltip));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tooltip-hint')) {
  customElements.define('tooltip-hint', TooltipElement);
}
export default TooltipElement;

/**

 * Attributes: step, total-steps, title, body, theme, caret, feedback
 * Events: prev, next, dismiss, feedback (detail {helpful})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TourTooltipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['step', 'total-steps', 'title', 'body', 'theme', 'caret', 'feedback'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 1;
    const totalSteps = Number(this.getAttribute('total-steps')) || 1;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const body = this.getAttribute('body') || '';
    const dark = this.getAttribute('theme') === 'dark';
    const caret = this.getAttribute('caret') || 'top';
    const feedback = this.hasAttribute('feedback');

    const caretClass =
      caret === 'top'
        ? 'before:absolute before:-top-1.5 before:left-8 before:h-3 before:w-3 before:rotate-45 before:rounded-[2px] before:border-l before:border-t'
        : caret === 'bottom'
          ? 'after:absolute after:-bottom-1.5 after:left-8 after:h-3 after:w-3 after:rotate-45 after:rounded-[2px] after:border-r after:border-b'
          : '';
    const caretBorder = dark ? 'before:border-zinc-700 after:border-zinc-700' : 'before:border-zinc-200 after:border-zinc-200';
    const caretBg = dark ? 'before:bg-zinc-900 after:bg-zinc-900' : 'before:bg-white after:bg-white';
    const borderTone = dark ? 'border-zinc-700' : 'border-zinc-200';
    const surface = dark ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-50 border-zinc-700' : 'bg-white text-zinc-900 border-zinc-200';
    const bodyTone = dark ? 'text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-500';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-tour-tooltip role="dialog" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}"
      class="relative w-80 rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-xl ${surface} ${caretClass} ${caretBorder} ${caretBg}">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <p class="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">Step ${step} of ${totalSteps}</p>
        <button type="button" data-tour-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss" class="rounded-md p-0.5 transition-colors ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-200' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600'}">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-4 w-4"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <p class="mt-2 text-sm font-bold leading-snug">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
      <p class="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed ${bodyTone}">${escapeAttribute(body)}</p>
      <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-3 ${borderTone}">
        ${
          feedback
            ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="text-[11px] ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400' : 'text-zinc-500'}">Was this helpful?</span>
                <button type="button" data-tour-feedback-up aria-label="Yes" class="rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? 'border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50'}">👍</button>
                <button type="button" data-tour-feedback-down aria-label="No" class="rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? 'border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50'}">👎</button>
              </div>`
            : `<span class="text-[11px] ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}">${step}/${totalSteps}</span>`
        }
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          ${step > 1 ? `<button type="button" data-tour-prev class="text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${dark ? 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-white' : 'text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900'}">Previous</button>` : ''}
          <button type="button" data-tour-next class="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
            step >= totalSteps ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500' : 'bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-indigo-600 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500'
          }">${step >= totalSteps ? 'Finish tour' : 'Next'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

    const on = (selector, eventName, detail) => {
      const node = this.querySelector(selector);
      if (node) node.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, detail ? { detail } : undefined)));
    };
    on('[data-tour-dismiss]', 'dismiss');
    on('[data-tour-prev]', 'prev');
    on('[data-tour-next]', 'next');
    on('[data-tour-feedback-up]', 'feedback', { helpful: true });
    on('[data-tour-feedback-down]', 'feedback', { helpful: false });
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/TraceSpanWaterfall.js/====

/**
 * TraceSpanWaterfall - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <trace-span-waterfall title="Trace waterfall" spans='[...]'></trace-span-waterfall>
 * Attributes: title, spans (JSON: [{id,name,startMs,durationMs,depth?,kind?,costUsd?,tokens?}])
 * Events: span-select (detail {span})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const kindDot = (kind) =>
  kind === 'tool' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : kind === 'retrieval' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-indigo-500';

const formatDuration = (ms) => (ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

const formatCost = (usd) => (typeof usd === 'number' ? `$${usd.toFixed(3)}` : '');

export class TraceSpanWaterfallElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'spans'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._spans = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._spans.length) this._spans = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('spans'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-trace-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        const span = this._spans.find((s) => s.id === row.getAttribute('data-trace-row'));
        if (span) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('span-select', { detail: { span } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'spans' && !this._spans.length) {
      this._spans = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('spans'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get spans() { return this._spans; }
  set spans(v) {
    this._spans = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((s) => ({ ...s })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const spans = this._spans;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Trace waterfall');
    const total = spans.length > 0 ? Math.max(...spans.map((s) => s.startMs + s.durationMs)) : 0;

    const rows = spans.map((span) => {
      const depth = span.depth ?? 0;
      const left = total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0;
      const width = total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0;
      const cost = formatCost(span.costUsd);
      return `
      <button type="button" data-trace-row="${escapeAttribute(span.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <span class="flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200" style="width: ${Math.max(120 - depth * 14, 88)}px; padding-left: ${depth * 14}px;">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${kindDot(span.kind)}"></span>
          <span data-trace-name class="min-w-0 truncate">${escapeAttribute(span.name)}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span data-trace-bar class="absolute top-0.5 h-3 rounded-full ${kindDot(span.kind)}" style="left: ${left}%; width: ${width}%;"></span>
          <span class="absolute top-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" style="left: calc(${left}% + ${width}% + 6px);">${formatDuration(span.durationMs)}${cost ? ` · ${cost}` : ''}</span>
        </span>
      </button>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-trace-waterfall class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${spans.length} spans · ${formatDuration(total)}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="px-4 py-2">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-4 pb-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500"></span> LLM</span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> Tool</span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span> Retrieval</span>
    </div>
    <div data-trace-rows class="space-y-1.5">${rows}</div>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('trace-span-waterfall')) {
  customElements.define('trace-span-waterfall', TraceSpanWaterfallElement);
}

export default TraceSpanWaterfallElement;

/**

 * Usage: <trial-banner days-left="11" plan-name="Pro"></trial-banner>
 * Attributes: plan-name, days-left, message, cta-text, tone (indigo|amber), dismissible

    '>': '&gt;',

const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class TrialBannerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plan-name', 'days-left', 'message', 'cta-text', 'tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._hidden = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-trial-cta]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta'));
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-trial-dismiss]')) {
          this._hidden = true;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  show() {
    this._hidden = false;
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (!this._hidden) this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (this._hidden) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const planName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Pro');
    const daysLeft = Number(this.getAttribute('days-left')) || 0;
    const message = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('message') || `Your ${planName} trial ends soon — upgrade to keep ${planName} features.`);
    const ctaText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'Upgrade now');
    const tone = this.getAttribute('tone') || 'indigo';
    const dismissible = this.hasAttribute('dismissible');
    const urgent = daysLeft <= 3;
    const toneClass = tone === 'amber'
      ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50'
      : 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50';
    const pillClass = tone === 'amber' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-indigo-600';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-trial-banner class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${toneClass}">
  <span data-trial-days class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white ${pillClass} ${urgent ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}">${daysLeft} ${daysLeft === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} left</span>
  <span data-trial-message class="flex-1 text-sm text-zinc-800">${message}</span>
  <button type="button" data-trial-cta class="rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700">${ctaText}</button>
  ${dismissible ? `<button type="button" data-trial-dismiss title="Dismiss" class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-700">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('trial-banner')) {
  customElements.define('trial-banner', TrialBannerElement);
}

export default TrialBannerElement;

====/File: vanilla/TypingIndicator.js/====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TypingIndicatorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'variant', 'size'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'dots';
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'md';

    const dotClass = size === 'sm' ? 'w-1.5 h-1.5' : size === 'lg' ? 'w-2.5 h-2.5' : 'w-2 h-2';
    const gapClass = size === 'sm' ? 'gap-1' : size === 'lg' ? 'gap-2' : 'gap-1.5';
    const animClass = variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce';

    const dots = [0, 1, 2]
      .map(
        (i) =>
          `<span class="${dotClass} rounded-full bg-current ${animClass}" style="animation-delay: ${i * 160}ms"></span>`
      )
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400');
    this.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    this.setAttribute('aria-label', label || 'Loading');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <span class="inline-flex items-center ${gapClass}">${dots}</span>
      ${label ? `<span class="text-xs font-sans">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>` : ''}
    `;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('typing-indicator')) {
  customElements.define('typing-indicator', TypingIndicatorElement);
}
export default TypingIndicatorElement;

/**
 * UpgradeCheckoutPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <upgrade-checkout-panel line-items='[...]' total="$405.00" seats="5"></upgrade-checkout-panel>
 * Attributes: title, plan-name, billing-period (monthly|annual), seats, min-seats, max-seats,
 *             line-items (JSON [{id,label,amount,muted?,strikethrough?}]), total-label, total, total-note,
 *             discount-label, discount, confirm-text, terms
 * Property: lineItems
 * Events: billing-period-change (detail.period), seats-change (detail.seats), confirm
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'plan-name', 'billing-period', 'seats', 'line-items', 'total-label', 'total', 'total-note', 'discount', 'confirm-text', 'terms'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._lineItems = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._lineItems.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('line-items');
      if (raw) { try { this._lineItems = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._lineItems = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const periodBtn = event.target.closest('[data-checkout-period]');
        if (periodBtn) {
          const period = periodBtn.getAttribute('data-checkout-period');
          this.setAttribute('billing-period', period);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('billing-period-change', { detail: { period } }));
          return;
        }
        const seats = Number(this.getAttribute('seats'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(seats) && this.getAttribute('seats') !== null) {
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min-seats')) || 1;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max-seats')) || 99;
          if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-seat-minus]')) {
            const next = Math.max(min, seats - 1);
            // read next BEFORE setAttribute (attributeChangedCallback re-renders synchronously)
            this.setAttribute('seats', String(next));
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seats-change', { detail: { seats: next } }));
            return;
          }
          if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-seat-plus]')) {
            const next = Math.min(max, seats + 1);
            this.setAttribute('seats', String(next));
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seats-change', { detail: { seats: next } }));
            return;
          }
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-confirm]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('confirm'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get lineItems() { return this._lineItems; }
  set lineItems(v) {
    this._lineItems = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'line-items' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._lineItems = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Upgrade to the Teams plan');
    const planName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Teams');
    const period = this.getAttribute('billing-period') || 'annual';
    const seatsAttr = this.getAttribute('seats');
    const totalLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-label') || 'Total billed today');
    const total = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total') || '');
    const totalNote = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-note') || '');
    const discount = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('discount') || '');
    const discountLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('discount-label') || 'Discount');
    const confirmText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('confirm-text') || 'Confirm upgrade');
    const terms = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('terms') || '');

    const periodBtn = (p, label) => `
      <button type="button" data-checkout-period="${p}" class="rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${period === p ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800'}">${label}</button>`;

    const seatsBlock = seatsAttr !== null && seatsAttr !== undefined && seatsAttr !== '' ? `
      <p class="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">Seats</p>
      <div data-checkout-seats class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button type="button" data-checkout-seat-minus title="Fewer seats" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.5 9.25h9v1.5h-9v-1.5Z"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span data-checkout-seat-count class="min-w-8 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(seatsAttr)}</span>
        <button type="button" data-checkout-seat-plus title="More seats" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.25 5.5h1.5v3.75h3.75v1.5h-3.75v3.75h-1.5v-3.75H5.5v-1.5h3.75V5.5Z"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500">${planName} plan · ${period === 'annual' ? 'billed annually' : 'billed monthly'}</span>
      </div>` : '';

    const items = this._lineItems.map((item) => `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <span class="text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
        <span class="font-medium ${item.strikethrough ? 'text-zinc-400 line-through' : 'text-zinc-900'} ${item.muted ? 'text-zinc-400' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(item.amount)}</span>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-upgrade-checkout class="grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr]">
  <div>
    <h3 data-checkout-title class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">${title}</h3>
    <p class="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">Billing cadence</p>
    <div class="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-0.5">${periodBtn('monthly', 'Monthly plan')}${periodBtn('annual', 'Annual plan')}</div>
    ${seatsBlock}
  </div>
  <div data-checkout-summary class="rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 p-4">
    <div class="space-y-2.5">${items}
    </div>
    <div class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm font-semibold">
        <span class="text-zinc-900">${totalLabel}</span>
        <span data-checkout-total class="text-zinc-900">${total}</span>
      </div>
      ${discount ? `<div class="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span class="text-emerald-600">${discountLabel}</span>
        <span data-checkout-discount class="font-medium text-emerald-600">${discount}</span>
      </div>` : ''}
      ${totalNote ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">${totalNote}</p>` : ''}
    </div>
    ${terms ? `<p class="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500">${terms}</p>` : ''}
    <button type="button" data-checkout-confirm class="mt-4 w-full rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500">${confirmText}</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('upgrade-checkout-panel')) {
  customElements.define('upgrade-checkout-panel', UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement);
}

export default UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatNumber = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));

export class UpgradePromptCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['used', 'limit', 'plan-name', 'unit', 'title', 'features', 'cta-text'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get features() {
    if (this._features) return this._features;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('features') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set features(value) {
    this._features = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const used = Number(this.getAttribute('used') || 0);
    const limit = Number(this.getAttribute('limit') || 0);
    const planName = this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Free';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'requests';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Upgrade to keep going';
    const ctaText = this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'See plans';
    const features = this.features;

    const safeLimit = limit > 0 ? limit : 1;
    const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((used / safeLimit) * 100)));
    const tone =
      percent >= 90
        ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
        : percent >= 70
          ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
          : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' };

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const featureItems = features
      .map(
        (feature) => `
        <li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</span>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${tone.chip} ${tone.text}">${uiIcon('zap', { size: 16 })}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
            <div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">You're on the ${escapeAttribute(planName)} plan — ${percent}% of your ${escapeAttribute(unit)} used.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div class="h-full rounded-full ${tone.bar} transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${percent}%"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span class="tabular-nums">${formatNumber(used)} / ${formatNumber(limit)} ${escapeAttribute(unit)}</span>
          <span class="ml-auto tabular-nums ${tone.text}">${percent}%</span>
        </div>

        ${featureItems ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${featureItems}</ul>` : ''}

        <button type="button"
          class="upgrade-cta mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
          ${escapeAttribute(ctaText)}
        </button>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.upgrade-cta').addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('upgrade')));
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  ok: { bar: 'bg-indigo-500', text: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' },
  warning: { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' },
  danger: { bar: 'bg-rose-500', text: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

export const usageTone = (used, limit) => {
  if (limit <= 0) return 'danger';
  const ratio = used / limit;
  if (ratio >= 0.9) return 'danger';
  if (ratio >= 0.7) return 'warning';
  return 'ok';
};

/**
 * UsageMeter - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <usage-meter label="Context window" used="68500" limit="128000" unit="tokens"></usage-meter>
 * Attributes: label, used, limit, unit, show-legend
 */
export class UsageMeterElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'used', 'limit', 'unit', 'show-legend'];
  }

  get label() {
    return this.getAttribute('label') || '';
  }

  get used() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('used'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  }

  get limit() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('limit'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  }

  get unit() {
    return this.getAttribute('unit') || '';
  }

  get showLegend() {
    return this.getAttribute('show-legend') !== 'false';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const used = this.used;
    const limit = this.limit;
    const tone = usageTone(used, limit);
    const styles = TONE[tone];
    const ratio = limit > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, used / limit)) : 1;
    const percent = Math.round(ratio * 100);
    const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - used);

    const legend =
      remaining > 0
        ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('clock', { size: 10 })} ${remaining.toLocaleString()} left</span>`
        : '<span class="font-semibold text-rose-500">Limit reached</span>';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this.label)}</p>
        <p class="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums ${styles.text}">${percent}%</p>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 ${styles.bar}" style="width:${ratio * 100}%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span>${used.toLocaleString()} / ${limit.toLocaleString()}${this.unit ? ` ${escapeAttribute(this.unit)}` : ''}</span>
        ${this.showLegend ? legend : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('usage-meter')) {
  customElements.define('usage-meter', UsageMeterElement);
}

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

export class VoiceOrbElement extends HTMLElement {

  }

    this.render();

    const STATE_LABEL = {
      listening: 'Listening…',
      speaking: 'Speaking…',
      thinking: 'Thinking…',
      idle: 'Tap to talk',

    const SIZE = { sm: 'h-20 w-20', md: 'h-36 w-36', lg: 'h-56 w-56' };
    const state = this.getAttribute('state') || 'idle';
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || STATE_LABEL[state];
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint');
    const size = SIZE[this.getAttribute('size')] || SIZE.md;
    const showControls = (this.getAttribute('show-controls') || 'true') !== 'false';
    const muted = this.getAttribute('muted') === 'true';
    const BARS = [10, 18, 26, 34, 26, 18, 10];
    const wave = state !== 'idle' ? `
      <div data-voice-orb-wave class="flex h-8 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
        ${BARS.map((h) => `<span class="w-1 rounded-full ${state === 'idle' ? 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-400'}" style="height:${h}px"></span>`).join('')}
      </div>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-voice-orb class="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">

'Unmute' : 'Mute'}</button>

====/File: vanilla/VoiceSessionHistory.js/====

/**
 * VoiceSessionHistory - ElevenLabs Voice "History" sidebar: session rows with
 * title, date/duration metadata, status badge and a replay button.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class VoiceSessionHistoryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'sessions', 'empty-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sessions = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._sessions.length) {
      this._sessions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sessions'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'sessions' && !this._sessions.length) {
      this._sessions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sessions'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'History';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get emptyLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('empty-label') ?? 'No sessions yet.';
  }
  set emptyLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('empty-label', value);
  }

  get sessions() {
    return this._sessions;
  }
  set sessions(value) {
    this._sessions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const sessionEl = event.target.closest('[data-voice-session]');
    if (!sessionEl) return;
    const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === sessionEl.getAttribute('data-voice-session'));
    if (!session) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-voice-session-play]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('play', { detail: { session }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { session }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _render() {
    const sessions = this._sessions;
    const active = sessions.filter((s) => s.status !== 'failed').length;
    const statusMeta = (s) => {
      if (s.status === 'failed') return ['bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400', 'Failed'];
      if (s.status === 'in-progress') return ['bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400', 'Running'];
      return ['bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400', 'Completed'];
    };
    const rows = sessions.length
      ? sessions
          .map((s) => {
            const [statusClass, statusLabel] = statusMeta(s);
            const meta = [s.date, s.duration].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
            return `
          <div data-voice-session="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p data-voice-session-title class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(s.title)}</p>
              <p data-voice-session-meta class="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</p>
            </div>
            <span data-voice-session-status class="shrink-0 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${statusClass}">${statusLabel}</span>
            <button type="button" data-voice-session-play aria-label="Play ${escapeAttribute(s.title)}" class="shrink-0 rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">▶</button>
          </div>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<p data-voice-history-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this.emptyLabel)}</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-voice-history class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)} <span data-voice-history-count class="ml-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${active}</span></h4>
        </div>
        <div data-voice-history-list class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/WizardSteps.js/====

/**
 * WizardSteps - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <wizard-steps current="1" variant="vertical"></wizard-steps> with `steps` property
 * Attributes: current, variant (vertical|bar), next-label
 * Properties: steps ({ label, hint?, optional? }[])
 * Events: step-click (detail: { index, step })
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class WizardStepsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current', 'variant', 'next-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get current() {
    return Number(this.getAttribute('current')) || 0;
  }

  set current(index) {
    this.setAttribute('current', String(index));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const steps = this._steps;
    const current = this.current;
    const total = steps.length;
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'vertical';
    const nextLabel = this.getAttribute('next-label') || '';
    const interactive = true;

    if (variant === 'bar') {
      const progress = total ? Math.round(((current + 1) / total) * 100) : 0;
      const nextStep = steps[current + 1];
      this.innerHTML = `<div data-wizard-steps role="group" aria-label="Wizard progress" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${current + 1} of ${total} steps</span>
          ${nextStep ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">|</span><span>Next: ${escapeAttribute(nextStep.label)}</span>` : ''}
        </p>
        <div role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="${total}" aria-valuenow="${current + 1}" class="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50">
          <div class="h-full rounded-full bg-violet-600 transition-all duration-300" style="width:${progress}%"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `<ol data-wizard-steps class="flex flex-col">
      ${steps
        .map((step, index) => {
          const state = index < current ? 'done' : index === current ? 'active' : 'todo';
          const isLast = index === total - 1;
          return `<li class="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 ${isLast ? 'last:pb-0' : ''}">
            ${
              !isLast
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-0 w-px ${
                    index < current ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                  }"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${index === current ? 'aria-current="step"' : ''} ${
              interactive && index <= current ? '' : 'disabled'
            }
              class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                state === 'done'
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                  : state === 'active'
                    ? 'border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900'
                    : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400'
              } ${interactive && index <= current ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}">
              ${state === 'done' ? uiIcon('check', { size: 13 }) : index + 1}
            </button>
            <span class="min-w-0 pt-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
                state === 'active'
                  ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
                  : state === 'done'
                    ? 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                    : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
              }">
                ${escapeAttribute(step.label)}${step.optional ? '<span class="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>' : ''}
              </span>
              ${step.hint ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(step.hint)}</span>` : ''}
            </span>
          </li>`;
        })
        .join('')}
      ${nextLabel ? `<li class="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(nextLabel)}</li>` : ''}
    </ol>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
        if (index > current) return;
        if (typeof this.onStepClick === 'function') this.onStepClick(index, this._steps[index]);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { index, step: this._steps[index] } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('wizard-steps')) {
  customElements.define('wizard-steps', WizardStepsElement);
}
export default WizardStepsElement;

/**
 * WorkspaceSwitcherMenu - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <workspace-switcher workspaces='[{"id":"acme","name":"Acme Inc","memberCount":12,"role":"Admin","current":true}]'></workspace-switcher>
 * Attributes: variant (page|dropdown), title, subtitle, create-label, logout-label, footer-name, footer-email, footer-initials
 * Properties: workspaces (Array<{id,name,logo?,memberCount?,role?,current?}>), footerUser ({name,email,initials?})
 * Events: select (detail {workspace}), create-new, logout
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initialsOf = (name) =>
  String(name || '')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

export class WorkspaceSwitcherMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['variant', 'title', 'subtitle', 'create-label', 'logout-label', 'footer-name', 'footer-email', 'footer-initials'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._workspaces = [];
    this._footerUser = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get workspaces() {
    return this._workspaces;
  }

  set workspaces(list) {
    this._workspaces = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get footerUser() {
    return this._footerUser;
  }

  set footerUser(user) {
    this._footerUser = user && typeof user === 'object' ? user : null;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._workspaces.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('workspaces');
      if (raw) {
        try {
          this._workspaces = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch {
          this._workspaces = [];
        }
      }
    }
    if (!this._footerUser) {
      const name = this.getAttribute('footer-name');
      if (name) {
        this._footerUser = {
          name,
          email: this.getAttribute('footer-email') || '',
          initials: this.getAttribute('footer-initials') || undefined,
        };
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const option = event.target.closest('[data-workspace-option]');
        if (option) {
          const workspace = this._workspaces.find((item) => item.id === option.getAttribute('data-workspace-option'));
          if (workspace) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { workspace } }));
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-workspace-create]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('create-new'));
        if (event.target.closest('[data-workspace-logout]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('logout'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const page = (this.getAttribute('variant') || 'page') === 'page';
    this._applyHostClass(page ? 'block' : 'block w-72');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Workspaces';
    const subtitle = this.getAttribute('subtitle') || 'Choose the workspace you want to access';
    const createLabel = this.getAttribute('create-label') || '+ Create new workspace';
    const logoutLabel = this.getAttribute('logout-label') || 'Log out';
    const workspaces = Array.isArray(this._workspaces) ? this._workspaces : [];
    const footerUser = this._footerUser;

    const roleLine = (workspace) => {
      const count = workspace.memberCount ?? 1;
      let line = `${count} member${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      if (workspace.role) {
        const article = workspace.role.startsWith('A') || workspace.role.startsWith('E') ? 'an' : 'a';
        line += ` · You are ${article} ${workspace.role}`;
      }
      return line;
    };

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-workspace-switcher class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${page ? 'p-5' : 'p-3'}">
      ${
        title
          ? `<div class="${page ? '' : 'px-2 pt-1'}">
              <p class="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
              ${subtitle ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
      <ul class="${page ? 'mt-4 space-y-2' : 'mt-3 space-y-1'}">
        ${workspaces
          .map(
            (workspace) => `<li>
              <button type="button" data-workspace-option="${escapeAttribute(workspace.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                workspace.current ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'
              }">
                ${
                  workspace.logo
                    ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(workspace.logo)}" alt="" class="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-lg" />`
                    : `<span class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-violet-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">${escapeAttribute(initialsOf(workspace.name))}</span>`
                }
                <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(workspace.name)}</span>
                  <span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(roleLine(workspace))}</span>
                </span>
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>
              </button>
            </li>`,
          )
          .join('')}
      </ul>
      ${
        createLabel
          ? `<button type="button" data-workspace-create class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${page ? 'mt-4' : 'mt-2'}">${escapeAttribute(createLabel)}</button>`
          : ''
      }
      ${
        footerUser
          ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800 ${page ? 'mt-4' : 'mt-3'}">
              <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(footerUser.initials || initialsOf(footerUser.name))}</span>
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(footerUser.name)}</span>
                <span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(footerUser.email)}</span>
              </span>
              ${

                  ? `<button type="button" data-workspace-logout class="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(logoutLabel)}</button>`
                  : ''
              }
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>`;
  }

/**
 * WriterStyleGuide - Writer term/style guide card: company / team / my tabs,
 * guide entry rows with number, title, description and reading time.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class WriterStyleGuideElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['entries', 'active-tab'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._entries = [];
    this._activeTab = 'company';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._entries.length) {
      this._entries = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('entries'), [
        { id: 'g1', title: "Don't use passive voice", description: 'It dilutes meaning and bloats sentences.', minutes: 3 },
        { id: 'g2', title: 'Use contracted forms', description: 'Write "can\'t" instead of "cannot" for a friendly tone.', minutes: 2 },
        { id: 'g3', title: 'Upper Kebab case for products', description: 'Product names use Upper Kebab case.', minutes: 4 },
      ]);
    }
    const tabAttr = this.getAttribute('active-tab');
    if (tabAttr) {
      this._activeTab = tabAttr;
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'entries' && !this._entries.length) {
      this._entries = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('entries'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'active-tab' && newValue) {
      this._activeTab = newValue;
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get entries() {
    return this._entries;
  }
  set entries(value) {
    this._entries = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  get activeTab() {
    return this._activeTab;
  }
  set activeTab(value) {
    this._activeTab = value === 'team' || value === 'my' ? value : 'company';
    this.setAttribute('active-tab', this._activeTab);
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tabEl = event.target.closest('[data-writer-tab]');
    if (tabEl) {
      this.activeTab = tabEl.getAttribute('data-writer-tab');
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-change', { detail: { tab: this._activeTab }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const entryEl = event.target.closest('[data-writer-entry]');
    if (entryEl) {
      const entry = this._entries.find((e) => String(e.id) === entryEl.getAttribute('data-writer-entry'));
      if (entry) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('entry-click', { detail: { entry }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const tabs = [
      { id: 'company', label: 'Company' },
      { id: 'team', label: 'Team' },
      { id: 'my', label: 'My' },
    ];
    const tabHtml = tabs
      .map(
        (tab) => `
        <button type="button" data-writer-tab="${tab.id}" class="rounded-t-md px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${this._activeTab === tab.id ? 'border-b-2 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'border-b-2 border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${tab.label}</button>`
      )
      .join('');
    const entriesHtml = this._entries
      .map(
        (entry, index) => `
        <button type="button" data-writer-entry="${escapeAttribute(entry.id)}" class="flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-lg p-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <span class="mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${index + 1}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span data-writer-entry-title class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(entry.title)}</span>
            <span data-writer-entry-desc class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(entry.description)}</span>
          </span>
          <span data-writer-entry-minutes class="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(entry.minutes)} min</span>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-writer-style-guide class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-writer-tabs class="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${tabHtml}</div>
        <div class="p-4">
          <div data-writer-entries class="space-y-3">${entriesHtml}</div>
          <button type="button" data-writer-add class="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-400">+ Add guideline</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('writer-style-guide')) {
  customElements.define('writer-style-guide', WriterStyleGuideElement);
}

export default WriterStyleGuideElement;

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'fields' && !this._fields.length) {
      this._fields = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('fields'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get fields() {
    return this._fields;
  }
  set fields(value) {
    this._fields = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const fieldEl = event.target.closest('[data-zendesk-suggest-field]');
    if (fieldEl) {
      const field = this._fields.find((f) => String(f.id) === fieldEl.getAttribute('data-zendesk-suggest-field'));
      if (field) {
        // applying a suggestion removes it from the bar
        this._fields = this._fields.filter((f) => f !== field);
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply', { detail: { field }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-zendesk-suggest-dismiss]')) {
      this._fields = [];
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const fieldsHtml = this._fields
      .map(
        (field) => `
        <button type="button" data-zendesk-suggest-field="${escapeAttribute(field.id)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:border-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:border-amber-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/40">
          <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(field.label)}:</span>
          <span>${escapeAttribute(field.value)}</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[9px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">${Math.round((field.confidence ?? 0) * 100)}%</span>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-zendesk-field-suggest class="w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 shadow-sm dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40">
        <p data-zendesk-suggest-label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
          <span aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
          Suggested fields
        </p>
        <div data-zendesk-suggest-fields class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${fieldsHtml}</div>
        <div class="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-zendesk-suggest-dismiss class="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-amber-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/40">Ignore</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('zendesk-field-suggest')) {
  customElements.define('zendesk-field-suggest', ZendeskFieldSuggestElement);
}

export default ZendeskFieldSuggestElement;

====/File: vanilla/ZoomControlBar.js/====

/**
 * ZoomControlBar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <zoom-control-bar value="100" variant="stepper|dropdown|slider"></zoom-control-bar>
 * Attributes: value, min, max, step, variant, presets (JSON number[]), show-fit, show-undo-redo
 * Properties: value
 * Events: zoom-change (detail {value}), fit, undo, redo
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const ICON_BUTTON = 'flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';

const UNDO_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 5 3.5 8.5 7 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M3.5 8.5H12a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0 9h-1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const REDO_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m13 5 3.5 3.5L13 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M16.5 8.5H8a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0 9h1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const FIT_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6V3h3M17 6V3h-3M3 14v3h3M17 14v3h-3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const MINUS_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const PLUS_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 5v10M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class ZoomControlBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'variant', 'presets', 'show-fit', 'show-undo-redo'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._zoom = null;
    this._open = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const clampZoom = (next) => {
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
          return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(next)));
        };
        const change = (next) => {
          const final = clampZoom(next);
          this._zoom = final;
          this.setAttribute('value', String(final));
          this._open = false;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zoom-change', { detail: { value: final } }));
        };
        const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 10;
        if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-in]')) change(this.value + step);
        else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-out]')) change(this.value - step);
        else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-value]') && this.getAttribute('variant') === 'dropdown') {
          this._open = !this._open;
          this.render();
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-preset]')) {
          change(Number(event.target.closest('[data-zoom-preset]').getAttribute('data-zoom-preset')));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-fit]')) {
          this._open = false;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fit'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-undo]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('undo'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-redo]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('redo'));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target.hasAttribute && target.hasAttribute('data-zoom-slider')) {
          const next = Number(target.value);
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
          const final = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(next)));
          this._zoom = final;
          this.setAttribute('value', String(final));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zoom-change', { detail: { value: final } }));
          const valueLabel = this.querySelector('[data-zoom-value]');
          if (valueLabel) valueLabel.textContent = `${final}%`;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'value') this._zoom = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    if (this._zoom !== null) return this._zoom;
    return Number(this.getAttribute('value')) || 100;
  }

  set value(v) {
    this._zoom = Number(v) || 100;
    this.setAttribute('value', String(this._zoom));
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'stepper';
    const showFit = this.getAttribute('show-fit') === 'true';
    const showUndoRedo = this.getAttribute('show-undo-redo') === 'true';
    const zoom = this.value;
    const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
    const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
    const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 10;
    let presets = [25, 50, 75, 100, 200];
    const rawPresets = this.getAttribute('presets');
    if (rawPresets) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawPresets);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) presets = parsed;
      } catch { /* keep default */ }
    }

    const hostClass = 'inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-1 py-0.5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const percentButton = `<button type="button" data-zoom-value class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 tabular-nums${variant === 'dropdown' ? ' hover:bg-zinc-100' : ''}">${zoom}%${variant === 'dropdown' ? ' <span aria-hidden="true">▾</span>' : ''}</button>`;

    const undoRedoHtml = showUndoRedo
      ? `<button type="button" data-zoom-undo title="Undo" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${UNDO_SVG}</button><button type="button" data-zoom-redo title="Redo" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${REDO_SVG}</button><span class="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200"></span>`
      : '';

    let variantHtml = '';
    if (variant === 'stepper') {
      variantHtml = `<button type="button" data-zoom-out title="Zoom out"${zoom <= min ? ' disabled' : ''} class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${MINUS_SVG}</button>${percentButton}<button type="button" data-zoom-in title="Zoom in"${zoom >= max ? ' disabled' : ''} class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${PLUS_SVG}</button>`;
    } else if (variant === 'dropdown') {
      const menu = this._open
        ? `<div data-zoom-menu class="absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1 w-24 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg">${presets.map((preset) => `<button type="button" data-zoom-preset="${escapeAttribute(preset)}" class="block w-full px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs tabular-nums hover:bg-zinc-50 ${preset === zoom ? 'font-semibold text-blue-600' : 'text-zinc-700'}">${preset}%</button>`).join('')}${showFit ? '<button type="button" data-zoom-fit class="block w-full border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50">Fit</button>' : ''}</div>`
        : '';
      variantHtml = `<div class="relative">${percentButton}${menu}</div>`;
    } else {
      variantHtml = `<input data-zoom-slider type="range" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="${step}" value="${zoom}" class="h-1.5 w-24 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-full bg-zinc-200" aria-label="Zoom level"/>${percentButton}`;
    }

    const fitButton = showFit && variant !== 'dropdown' ? `<button type="button" data-zoom-fit title="Fit to page" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${FIT_SVG}</button>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-zoom-control class="${hostClass}">${undoRedoHtml}${variantHtml}${fitButton}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('zoom-control-bar')) {
  customElements.define('zoom-control-bar', ZoomControlBarElement);
}

export default ZoomControlBarElement;
